sys_update_xml.name: sys_script_7e86a05e1b8c5350f2e9edf3604bcbf6
sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update sys_domain="global" table="sys_script"><sys_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><abort_action>false</abort_action><access>package_private</access><action_delete>false</action_delete><action_insert>false</action_insert><action_query>false</action_query><action_update>true</action_update><active>true</active><add_message>false</add_message><advanced>true</advanced><change_fields>false</change_fields><client_callable>false</client_callable><collection>x_crli_squirrel_race</collection><condition/><description>Squirrel Scramble (SPEC.md section 6). A drawn race is a final result. Before every update to a Race this rule refuses: any change to a void race; a change to any field except State, Void reason and Voided by (every changed field is checked, so a column added later is locked by default; sys_* fields are exempt); a State move other than Drawn to Void; Void reason or Voided by changing without the race being voided in the same save; and voiding without a Void reason. When a void is allowed it sets Voided by to the current user. Refusals use setAbortAction with an error message and a [SquirrelScramble][LockDrawnRaces][Warn] log line. No condition and no interactive-session bypass: it holds for forms, REST, scripts and the race engine (whose Draw failed path voids with a reason). Order 50 so it vetoes before any rule at the default order. Owner: Squirrel Scramble server lane.</description><execute_function>false</execute_function><filter_condition/><is_rest>false</is_rest><message/><name>Lock drawn races</name><order>50</order><priority>100</priority><rest_method/><rest_method_text/><rest_service/><rest_service_text/><rest_variables/><role_conditions/><script><![CDATA[/**
 * Lock drawn races (x_crli_squirrel_race, before update, order 50).
 *
 * A drawn race is a final result. The only change allowed is voiding it: in one save the
 * state moves from Drawn to Void with a void reason, and this rule stamps Voided by with the
 * current user. A void race cannot change at all.
 *
 * Every changed field is checked, not a named list, so a column added later is locked by
 * default. System fields (sys_*) are exempt so platform bookkeeping saves still pass. There is
 * no interactive-session bypass: forms, REST, scripts and the race engine are held alike.
 */
(function executeRule(current, previous) {
  var componentName = 'LockDrawnRaces';
  var stateDrawn = 'drawn';
  var stateVoid = 'void';
  var voidFields = ['state', 'void_reason', 'voided_by'];

  /**
   * @description Writes one log line in the app's format: [SquirrelScramble][Component][Level].
   * @param {String} level - 'Info', 'Warn' or 'Error'.
   * @param {String} message - The text to log.
   * @returns {void}
   * @throws Never.
   * @example writeLog('Info', 'ENTER | race=RACE0001000');
   * @since 2026-10-22
   */
  function writeLog(level, message) {
    var line = '[SquirrelScramble][' + componentName + '][' + level + '] ' + message;
    if (level === 'Error') {
      gs.error(line);
    } else if (level === 'Warn') {
      gs.warn(line);
    } else {
      gs.info(line);
    }
  }

  /**
   * @description Returns a field's label for messages, falling back to the column name when
   *   the element offers no label (some element APIs are missing inside a live rule).
   * @param {GlideElement} element - The field's element on the record.
   * @param {String} fieldName - The column name.
   * @returns {String} The label, or the column name.
   * @throws Never: a label is a courtesy and the refusal stands without it.
   * @example labelFor(current.getElement('winner_name'), 'winner_name'); // 'Winner'
   * @since 2026-10-22
   */
  function labelFor(element, fieldName) {
    try {
      if (element && typeof element.getLabel === 'function' && element.getLabel()) {
        return String(element.getLabel());
      }
      if (element && typeof element.getED === 'function') {
        var descriptor = element.getED();
        if (descriptor && typeof descriptor.getLabel === 'function' && descriptor.getLabel()) {
          return String(descriptor.getLabel());
        }
      }
    } catch (labelError) {
      writeLog('Warn', 'labelFor fell back to the column name for ' + fieldName);
    }
    return fieldName;
  }

  /**
   * @description Lists every non-system field this save changes. Handles both a JavaScript
   *   array and a Java list from getElements(), because the platform has returned each.
   * @param {GlideRecord} record - The record being saved.
   * @returns {Array|null} Objects { name, label } for each changed field; null when the
   *   record's fields cannot be read, so the caller can refuse rather than guess.
   * @throws Never.
   * @example listChangedFields(current); // [{ name: 'winner_name', label: 'Winner' }]
   * @since 2026-10-22
   */
  function listChangedFields(record) {
    if (typeof record.getElements !== 'function') {
      return null;
    }
    var elements = record.getElements();
    if (!elements) {
      return null;
    }
    var isJavaList = typeof elements.size === 'function';
    var elementCount = isJavaList ? elements.size() : elements.length;
    var changedFields = [];
    for (var index = 0; index < elementCount; index += 1) {
      var element = isJavaList ? elements.get(index) : elements[index];
      if (element) {
        var fieldName = String(element.getName());
        if (fieldName.indexOf('sys_') !== 0 && element.changes()) {
          changedFields.push({ name: fieldName, label: labelFor(element, fieldName) });
        }
      }
    }
    return changedFields;
  }

  /**
   * @description Joins field labels for a message, for example 'Winner, Title'.
   * @param {Array} fields - Objects { name, label }.
   * @returns {String} The labels separated by commas.
   * @throws Never.
   * @example joinLabels([{ name: 'title', label: 'Title' }]); // 'Title'
   * @since 2026-10-22
   */
  function joinLabels(fields) {
    var labels = [];
    for (var index = 0; index < fields.length; index += 1) {
      labels.push(fields[index].label);
    }
    return labels.join(', ');
  }

  /**
   * @description Refuses the save: shows the message, aborts, and logs the refusal.
   * @param {String} message - The UK English reason shown to the user.
   * @returns {void}
   * @throws Never.
   * @example refuse('RACE0001000 is void and can no longer be changed.');
   * @since 2026-10-22
   */
  function refuse(message) {
    gs.addErrorMessage(message);
    current.setAbortAction(true);
    writeLog('Warn', 'Refused | ' + message);
  }

  var raceNumber = current.getValue('number') || 'This race';
  writeLog('Info', 'ENTER | race=' + raceNumber);

  // A before-update rule always has previous; without it the lock cannot judge, so it refuses.
  if (!previous) {
    refuse(raceNumber + ' could not be checked against its stored values, so it was not saved.');
    return;
  }

  var changedFields = listChangedFields(current);
  if (changedFields === null) {
    refuse(raceNumber + ' could not be checked field by field, so it was not saved.');
    return;
  }
  if (changedFields.length === 0) {
    writeLog('Info', 'EXIT | race=' + raceNumber + ' no field changes, allowed');
    return;
  }

  var fromState = previous.getValue('state');
  var toState = current.getValue('state');

  if (fromState === stateVoid) {
    refuse(raceNumber + ' is void and can no longer be changed (refused: '
      + joinLabels(changedFields) + ').');
    return;
  }

  var lockedFields = [];
  for (var index = 0; index < changedFields.length; index += 1) {
    if (voidFields.indexOf(changedFields[index].name) === -1) {
      lockedFields.push(changedFields[index]);
    }
  }
  if (lockedFields.length > 0) {
    refuse(raceNumber + ' has been drawn and its result is final; only voiding is allowed '
      + '(refused: ' + joinLabels(lockedFields) + ').');
    return;
  }

  // Write is narrowed to voiding, so the void fields only move with the state itself.
  if (fromState === toState) {
    refuse('Void reason and Voided by can only be set while voiding ' + raceNumber
      + '. Use Void race (refused: ' + joinLabels(changedFields) + ').');
    return;
  }

  if (fromState !== stateDrawn || toState !== stateVoid) {
    refuse('A race can only move from Drawn to Void (refused: '
      + previous.getDisplayValue('state') + ' to ' + current.getDisplayValue('state')
      + ' on ' + raceNumber + ').');
    return;
  }

  var voidReason = String(current.getValue('void_reason') || '').trim();
  if (voidReason === '') {
    refuse('Enter a void reason to void ' + raceNumber + '.');
    return;
  }

  // Always the person (or session) doing the voiding, whatever value the save carried.
  current.setValue('voided_by', gs.getUserID());
  writeLog('Info', 'EXIT | race=' + raceNumber + ' voided by ' + gs.getUserName());
})(current, previous);
]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin.identity_2</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-10-22 11:58:11</sys_created_on><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_domain_path>/</sys_domain_path><sys_id>7e86a05e1b8c5350f2e9edf3604bcbf6</sys_id><sys_mod_count>2</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Lock drawn races</sys_name><sys_overrides/><sys_package display_value="Squirrel Scramble" source="x_crli_squirrel">4ea49ea28f8447dc9e14c1b33913cb48</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Squirrel Scramble">4ea49ea28f8447dc9e14c1b33913cb48</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_7e86a05e1b8c5350f2e9edf3604bcbf6</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin.identity_2</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-10-22 12:07:33</sys_updated_on><template/><when>before</when></sys_script><sys_translated_text action="delete_multiple" query="documentkey=7e86a05e1b8c5350f2e9edf3604bcbf6"/></record_update>

sys_update_xml.name: sys_ws_operation_f92ba4561b009350f2e9edf3604bcbd4
sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_ws_operation"><sys_ws_operation action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><active>true</active><consumes>application/json,application/xml,text/xml</consumes><consumes_customized>false</consumes_customized><default_operation_uri/><enforce_acl>cf9d01d3e73003009d6247e603f6a990</enforce_acl><http_method>GET</http_method><name>Search groups</name><operation_script><![CDATA[/**
 * Squirrel Race: GET /groups?q=text. Up to 20 active groups whose name contains the text, as
 * [{ sysId, name }] with 200. 400 bad_query when q is shorter than 2 characters; 403
 * forbidden without the marshal role. All logic lives in SquirrelRaceEngine.
 */
(function process(request, response) {
  const engine = new SquirrelRaceEngine();
  const denied = engine.checkMarshal();
  const result = denied || engine.searchGroups(engine.paramValue(request.queryParams.q));
  const reply = engine.toHttp(result, 200);
  response.setStatus(reply.status);
  response.setBody(reply.body);
})(request, response);
]]></operation_script><operation_uri>/api/x_crli_squirrel/race/groups</operation_uri><produces>application/json,application/xml,text/xml</produces><produces_customized>false</produces_customized><relative_path>/groups</relative_path><request_example/><requires_acl_authorization>true</requires_acl_authorization><requires_authentication>true</requires_authentication><requires_snc_internal_role>true</requires_snc_internal_role><short_description>Up to 20 active groups whose name contains q (2+ characters).</short_description><support_trailing_slash>false</support_trailing_slash><sys_class_name>sys_ws_operation</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin.identity_3</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-10-22 12:18:18</sys_created_on><sys_id>f92ba4561b009350f2e9edf3604bcbd4</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Search groups</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Squirrel Scramble" source="x_crli_squirrel">4ea49ea28f8447dc9e14c1b33913cb48</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Squirrel Scramble">4ea49ea28f8447dc9e14c1b33913cb48</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_ws_operation_f92ba4561b009350f2e9edf3604bcbd4</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin.identity_3</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-10-22 12:18:18</sys_updated_on><web_service_definition display_value="Squirrel Race">48aaacde1bc4135083ceedf3604bcb27</web_service_definition><web_service_version/></sys_ws_operation></record_update>

sys_update_xml.name: sys_ws_operation_51fa6456974c93906df5bcd3f153affc
sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_ws_operation"><sys_ws_operation action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><active>true</active><consumes>application/json,application/xml,text/xml</consumes><consumes_customized>false</consumes_customized><default_operation_uri/><enforce_acl>cf9d01d3e73003009d6247e603f6a990</enforce_acl><http_method>GET</http_method><name>Get a race</name><operation_script><![CDATA[/**
 * Squirrel Race: GET /races/{sys_id}. Returns a stored race's payload with 200, for replay; it
 * is the same payload POST /draw returned, entrants sorted by lane. 403 forbidden without the
 * marshal role; 404 not_found when no race has that sys_id. All logic lives in
 * SquirrelRaceEngine.
 */
(function process(request, response) {
  const engine = new SquirrelRaceEngine();
  const denied = engine.checkMarshal();
  const result = denied
    || engine.getRace(request.pathParams.sys_id)
    || engine.notFoundError('No race has that sys_id.');
  const reply = engine.toHttp(result, 200);
  response.setStatus(reply.status);
  response.setBody(reply.body);
})(request, response);
]]></operation_script><operation_uri>/api/x_crli_squirrel/race/races/{sys_id}</operation_uri><produces>application/json,application/xml,text/xml</produces><produces_customized>false</produces_customized><relative_path>/races/{sys_id}</relative_path><request_example/><requires_acl_authorization>true</requires_acl_authorization><requires_authentication>true</requires_authentication><requires_snc_internal_role>true</requires_snc_internal_role><short_description>Returns a stored race's payload for replay (200). Marshals only.</short_description><support_trailing_slash>false</support_trailing_slash><sys_class_name>sys_ws_operation</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin.identity_3</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-10-22 12:17:28</sys_created_on><sys_id>51fa6456974c93906df5bcd3f153affc</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Get a race</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Squirrel Scramble" source="x_crli_squirrel">4ea49ea28f8447dc9e14c1b33913cb48</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Squirrel Scramble">4ea49ea28f8447dc9e14c1b33913cb48</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_ws_operation_51fa6456974c93906df5bcd3f153affc</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin.identity_3</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-10-22 12:17:28</sys_updated_on><web_service_definition display_value="Squirrel Race">48aaacde1bc4135083ceedf3604bcb27</web_service_definition><web_service_version/></sys_ws_operation></record_update>

sys_update_xml.name: sys_script_46c6209e1b8c5350f2e9edf3604bcb01
sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update sys_domain="global" table="sys_script"><sys_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><abort_action>false</abort_action><access>package_private</access><action_delete>false</action_delete><action_insert>false</action_insert><action_query>false</action_query><action_update>true</action_update><active>true</active><add_message>false</add_message><advanced>true</advanced><change_fields>false</change_fields><client_callable>false</client_callable><collection>x_crli_squirrel_entrant</collection><condition/><description>Squirrel Scramble (SPEC.md section 6). The race engine inserts each entrant with lane, finishing position and time already set, and nothing is updated afterwards. Changing an entrant would change a drawn result, so this rule refuses every update to an Entrant with setAbortAction, an error message naming the entrant and race, and a [SquirrelScramble][EntrantsAreFinal][Warn] log line. No condition and no interactive-session bypass: it holds for forms, REST, scripts and the engine. Inserts and deletes (admin only) are not affected. Order 50 so it vetoes before any rule at the default order. Owner: Squirrel Scramble server lane.</description><execute_function>false</execute_function><filter_condition/><is_rest>false</is_rest><message/><name>Entrants are final</name><order>50</order><priority>100</priority><rest_method/><rest_method_text/><rest_service/><rest_service_text/><rest_variables/><role_conditions/><script><![CDATA[/**
 * Entrants are final (x_crli_squirrel_entrant, before update, order 50).
 *
 * The race engine inserts each entrant with its lane, finishing position and time already
 * set, and nothing is updated afterwards. Changing an entrant would change a drawn result,
 * so every update is refused, from every source: forms, REST, scripts and the engine alike.
 * Deleting entrants (admin only) is not an update and is not affected.
 */
(function executeRule(current) {
  var componentName = 'EntrantsAreFinal';

  /**
   * @description Writes one log line in the app's format: [SquirrelScramble][Component][Level].
   * @param {String} level - 'Info', 'Warn' or 'Error'.
   * @param {String} message - The text to log.
   * @returns {void}
   * @throws Never.
   * @example writeLog('Warn', 'Refused | Entrants are final.');
   * @since 2026-10-22
   */
  function writeLog(level, message) {
    var line = '[SquirrelScramble][' + componentName + '][' + level + '] ' + message;
    if (level === 'Error') {
      gs.error(line);
    } else if (level === 'Warn') {
      gs.warn(line);
    } else {
      gs.info(line);
    }
  }

  var entrantName = current.getValue('name') || 'This entrant';
  var raceNumber = current.getDisplayValue('race') || 'its race';
  writeLog('Info', 'ENTER | entrant=' + entrantName + ' race=' + raceNumber);

  var message = 'Entrants are final: ' + entrantName + ' in ' + raceNumber
    + ' cannot be changed once the race has been drawn.';
  gs.addErrorMessage(message);
  current.setAbortAction(true);
  writeLog('Warn', 'Refused | ' + message);
})(current, previous);
]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin.identity_2</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-10-22 11:59:13</sys_created_on><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_domain_path>/</sys_domain_path><sys_id>46c6209e1b8c5350f2e9edf3604bcb01</sys_id><sys_mod_count>1</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Entrants are final</sys_name><sys_overrides/><sys_package display_value="Squirrel Scramble" source="x_crli_squirrel">4ea49ea28f8447dc9e14c1b33913cb48</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Squirrel Scramble">4ea49ea28f8447dc9e14c1b33913cb48</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_46c6209e1b8c5350f2e9edf3604bcb01</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin.identity_2</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-10-22 12:07:34</sys_updated_on><template/><when>before</when></sys_script><sys_translated_text action="delete_multiple" query="documentkey=46c6209e1b8c5350f2e9edf3604bcb01"/></record_update>

sys_update_xml.name: sys_ws_operation_c3da6056974c93906df5bcd3f153afb4
sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_ws_operation"><sys_ws_operation action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><active>true</active><consumes>application/json,application/xml,text/xml</consumes><consumes_customized>false</consumes_customized><default_operation_uri/><enforce_acl>cf9d01d3e73003009d6247e603f6a990</enforce_acl><http_method>POST</http_method><name>Draw a race</name><operation_script><![CDATA[/**
 * Squirrel Race: POST /draw. Draws, stores and returns a race with 201, or answers the shared
 * error shape: 403 forbidden without the marshal role, 400 with a validation code, 500
 * draw_failed. Body fields read: title, mode, chaosLevel (Chaos only), names[], outfits[],
 * places, raceSeconds, rematchOf. All logic lives in SquirrelRaceEngine; this resource reads the
 * body and maps the result to a status.
 */
(function process(request, response) {
  /**
   * @description Reads the JSON body without letting an empty or malformed one throw.
   * @param {RESTAPIRequest} incoming - The request.
   * @returns {Object} The body, or {} when there is none (draw() then answers no_names).
   * @throws Never.
   * @example
   *   const body = readBody(request);
   * @since 2026-10-22
   */
  function readBody(incoming) {
    try {
      const data = incoming.body.data;
      return data && typeof data === 'object' ? data : {};
    } catch (err) {
      return {};
    }
  }

  const engine = new SquirrelRaceEngine();
  // The role is checked before the body is read; draw() checks it again itself.
  const denied = engine.checkMarshal();
  const reply = denied
    ? engine.toHttp(denied, 403)
    : engine.toHttp(engine.draw(readBody(request)), 201);
  response.setStatus(reply.status);
  response.setBody(reply.body);
})(request, response);
]]></operation_script><operation_uri>/api/x_crli_squirrel/race/draw</operation_uri><produces>application/json,application/xml,text/xml</produces><produces_customized>false</produces_customized><relative_path>/draw</relative_path><request_example>{"title": "Friday coffee", "mode": "classic", "names": ["Alex", "Sam"], "outfits": [{"hat": "viking"}, {}], "places": 2, "raceSeconds": 20, "rematchOf": null}</request_example><requires_acl_authorization>true</requires_acl_authorization><requires_authentication>true</requires_authentication><requires_snc_internal_role>true</requires_snc_internal_role><short_description>Draws, stores and returns a race (201). Marshals only.</short_description><support_trailing_slash>false</support_trailing_slash><sys_class_name>sys_ws_operation</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin.identity_3</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-10-22 12:17:02</sys_created_on><sys_id>c3da6056974c93906df5bcd3f153afb4</sys_id><sys_mod_count>1</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Draw a race</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Squirrel Scramble" source="x_crli_squirrel">4ea49ea28f8447dc9e14c1b33913cb48</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Squirrel Scramble">4ea49ea28f8447dc9e14c1b33913cb48</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_ws_operation_c3da6056974c93906df5bcd3f153afb4</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin.identity_3</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-10-22 14:34:39</sys_updated_on><web_service_definition display_value="Squirrel Race">48aaacde1bc4135083ceedf3604bcb27</web_service_definition><web_service_version/></sys_ws_operation></record_update>

Marshals have no write access, so the Race form is read-only for them.</description><local_or_existing>Existing</local_or_existing><name>x_crli_squirrel_race</name><operation display_value="write">write</operation><script/><security_attribute/><sys_class_name>sys_security_acl</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin.identity_2</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-10-22 11:40:09</sys_created_on><sys_id>fa6228561b84135083ceedf3604bcbbc</sys_id><sys_mod_count>2</sys_mod_count><sys_name>x_crli_squirrel_race</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Squirrel Scramble" source="x_crli_squirrel">4ea49ea28f8447dc9e14c1b33913cb48</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Squirrel Scramble">4ea49ea28f8447dc9e14c1b33913cb48</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_security_acl_fa6228561b84135083ceedf3604bcbbc</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin.identity_2</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-10-22 11:40:10</sys_updated_on><type display_value="record">record</type></sys_security_acl></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_ws_operation"><sys_ws_operation action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><active>true</active><consumes>application/json,application/xml,text/xml</consumes><consumes_customized>false</consumes_customized><default_operation_uri/><enforce_acl>cf9d01d3e73003009d6247e603f6a990</enforce_acl><http_method>GET</http_method><name>Recent races</name><operation_script><![CDATA[/**
 * Squirrel Race: GET /races?limit=n. The most recent races, newest first, each with its
 * entrants' names in lane order, for reusing a line-up (200; limit 1 to 25, default 10).
 * 403 forbidden without the marshal role. All logic lives in SquirrelRaceEngine.
 */
(function process(request, response) {
  const engine = new SquirrelRaceEngine();
  const denied = engine.checkMarshal();
  const result = denied || engine.recentRaces(engine.paramValue(request.queryParams.limit));
  const reply = engine.toHttp(result, 200);
  response.setStatus(reply.status);
  response.setBody(reply.body);
})(request, response);

replay_racetruetrueSquirrel Scramble (SPEC.md section 8, Navigation). Classic Race form button for x_crli_squirrel.marshal (admin contains marshal), set by a sys_ui_action_role row. Client only: opens the current Lux replay route, /aiux/scramble-v6/v6/replay/<sys_id>, in a new tab with g_navigation.open. The route version changes with each Lux redeploy (see utils/routes.js in the SDK sub-project), so the SQUIRREL_REPLAY_BASE constant in the script is re-pointed each time. Nothing is submitted or saved, and the replay is drawn from the stored record, so it cannot change who won. Shown on existing records only (show_insert false, condition !current.isNewRecord()), for drawn and void races alike: a void race replays under a VOID banner.!current.isNewRecord()truetruefalsefalsefalsefalsefalseOpen this race in the Squirrel Scramble replay page in a new tabtruefalsefalsefalsefalsefalsefalsefalseReplayopenRaceReplay()100falsefalsefalsefalsefalsetruesys_ui_actionadmin.identity_22026-10-22 12:03:35global/8ac7e8121bcc5350f2e9edf3604bcb5e8Replay4ea49ea28f8447dc9e14c1b33913cb484ea49ea28f8447dc9e14c1b33913cb48sys_ui_action_8ac7e8121bcc5350f2e9edf3604bcb5eadmin.identity_12026-11-05 13:45:36x_crli_squirrel_race

    top: calc(var(--climb-top) * 0.6);
    bottom: 0;
    width: clamp(4px, calc(var(--lane-w) * 0.22), 28px);
    transform: translateX(-50%);
    border-radius: 6px 6px 2px 2px;
    background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--ss-bark-dark), var(--ss-bark), var(--ss-bark-dark));
  }

  .tree.is-plain::after {
    content: '';
    position: absolute;
    left: 50%;
    top: 22%;
    width: clamp(10px, calc(var(--lane-w) * 0.5), 60px);
    height: 4px;
    transform: translateX(-10%) rotate(-18deg);
    border-radius: 2px;
    background: var(--ss-bark);
  }

  .tree-nut {
    position: absolute;
    top: 0;
    left: 50%;
    width: calc(var(--sprite) * 0.55);
    height: calc(var(--sprite) * 0.55);
    transform: translateX(-50%);
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    font-size: calc(var(--sprite) * 0.45);
  }

  .tree-nut svg {
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
  }

  .tree-nut.is-bouncing {
    animation: stage-nut-bounce 700ms var(--ease-heavy-bounce, ease-in-out) infinite;
  }

  .tree.is-plain.is-swaying {
    animation: stage-tree-sway 320ms ease-in-out infinite alternate;
  }

  .trees.is-twisting .tree.is-plain {
    animation: stage-tree-bend 520ms ease-in-out infinite alternate;
  }

  .tree.is-plain.is-wobbling {
    animation: stage-tree-wobble 90ms linear infinite alternate;
  }

  .racers {
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
    z-index: 3;
    pointer-events: none;
  }

  .racer {
    position: absolute;
    left: 0;
    top: var(--climb-top);
    width: var(--lane-w);

    transform: translate3d(calc(var(--start-lane) * 100%), 100%, 0);
    /* Which way the eagle dives in from and flies off to (stage-scrubs.js). */
    --away-x: 1;

  .racer.is-east {
    --away-x: -1;
  }

  .racer-body {
    position: absolute;
    top: 0;
    left: 50%;
    width: var(--sprite);
    height: var(--sprite);
    margin-left: calc(var(--sprite) / -2);
    transform-origin: 50% 70%;
  }

  .racer-sprite {
    display: flex;
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    font-size: calc(var(--sprite) * 0.8);
    line-height: 1;
  }

  .racer-sprite svg {
    display: block;
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
  }

  /* Plain climbing needs no wrapper motion: the kit's climb pose wobbles and flicks its tail. */
  .racer.motion-burst .racer-body {
    animation: stage-wobble 160ms ease-in-out infinite alternate;
  }

  .racer.motion-burst .racer-body::after {
    content: '';
    position: absolute;
    left: 15%;
    right: 15%;
    top: 100%;
    height: 60%;
    background: repeating-linear-gradient(
      90deg,
      transparent 0 18%,
      var(--ss-speed-line) 18% 24%

    opacity: 0.8;

  .racer.motion-shake .racer-body {
    animation: stage-shake 120ms linear infinite;
  }

  .racer.motion-spin .racer-body {

  .racer.motion-tumble .racer-body {

  }

  .racer.motion-lean.lean-left .racer-body {

  .racer.motion-flag .racer-body {

  }

  .racer.motion-quake .racer-body {
    animation: stage-bounce 220ms ease-in-out infinite alternate;
  }

  .racer.motion-vibrate .racer-body {

  .bib-size-chip {

  .bib-number,
  .bib-name {

  .bib-name {

    text-overflow: ellipsis;
  }

  .bib-shape-circle {

  }

  .bib-shape-square {

  }

  .bib-shape-diamond {

  .bib-shape-shield {

  .bib-shape-hexagon {

  .bib-pattern-stripes::before {

  }

  .bib-pattern-dots::before {
    background: radial-gradient(var(--bib-ink) 1px, transparent 1.5px) 0 0 / 5px 5px;
  }

  .bib-pattern-chevrons::before {
    background: repeating-linear-gradient(135deg, var(--bib-ink) 0 2px, transparent 2px 7px);
  }

  .bib-pattern-checks::before {
    background: repeating-conic-gradient(var(--bib-ink) 0 25%, transparent 0 50%) 0 0 / 6px 6px;
  }

  .bib-pattern-zigzag::before {
    background: repeating-linear-gradient(60deg, var(--bib-ink) 0 1px, transparent 1px 5px);
  }

  .bib-pattern-stars::before {
    background: radial-gradient(circle, var(--bib-ink) 1.5px, transparent 2px) 0 0 / 7px 7px;

  .bib-pattern-hoops::before {
    background: repeating-linear-gradient(0deg, var(--bib-ink) 0 2px, transparent 2px 6px);

  }

      transform: rotate(-4deg) translateY(0);
    }
    to {
      transform: rotate(4deg) translateY(-3%);
    }
  }

  @keyframes stage-shake {
    0%,
    100% {
      transform: translateX(0);
    }
    25% {
      transform: translateX(-8%);
    }
    75% {
      transform: translateX(8%);
    }
  }

  @keyframes stage-spin {
    to {
      transform: rotate(360deg);
    }
  }

  @keyframes stage-tumble {
    from {
      transform: rotate(0deg);
    }
    to {
      transform: rotate(540deg);
    }
  }

  @keyframes stage-tree-sway {
    from {
      transform: rotate(-3deg);
    }
    to {
      transform: rotate(3deg);
    }
  }

  @keyframes stage-tree-bend {
    from {
      transform: skewX(-6deg);
    }
    to {
      transform: skewX(8deg);
    }
  }

    0%,
    100% {

    40% {
      transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(-45%);

  }

  @keyframes stage-flicker {
    to {
      opacity: 0.2;
    }

  @keyframes stage-heavy-wobble {
    from {
      transform: rotate(-6deg) translateY(0);
    }
    to {
      transform: rotate(6deg) translateY(4%);
    }

    from {
      transform: skewY(-6deg) translateX(-4%);
    }
    to {
      transform: skewY(6deg) translateX(4%);
    }
  }

    from {
      transform: translateY(0);
    }
    to {
      transform: translateY(-14%);
    }
  }

  @keyframes stage-vibrate {
    0%,
    100% {
      transform: translate(0, 0);
    }
    25% {
      transform: translate(-6%, 2%);
    }
    50% {
      transform: translate(5%, -2%);
    }
    75% {
      transform: translate(-3%, -3%);
    }
  }

  @keyframes stage-beamed {
    from {
      transform: rotate(-12deg) scale(0.95);
    }
    to {
      transform: rotate(12deg) scale(1.05);
    }
  }

  @keyframes stage-tree-wobble {
    from {
      transform: translateX(-2px) rotate(-1deg);
    }
    to {
      transform: translateX(2px) rotate(1deg);
    }
  }

  /* The VAR freeze: everything on the field holds still while the review runs. */
  .field.is-var .trees *,

  .field-disco-floor,

    --ball-x: 50cqw;

    --ball-x: 22cqw;
  }

  .field-disco-wash {
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
    background: radial-gradient(
      ellipse at 50% 0%,
      var(--ss-disco-spot),
      var(--ss-disco-wash) 60%
    );
    opacity: 0;
    will-change: opacity;
  }

  .field-disco-beams {
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
    overflow: hidden;
    opacity: 0;
    will-change: opacity;
  }

  .field-disco-beam {
    position: absolute;
    top: 4cqh;
    left: calc(var(--ball-x) - 15cqw);
    width: 30cqw;
    height: 110cqh;
    clip-path: polygon(47% 0, 53% 0, 100% 100%, 0 100%);
    transform-origin: 50% 0;
    will-change: transform;
    animation: stage-disco-beam 2200ms ease-in-out infinite alternate;
  }

  .field-disco-beam-1 {
    background: linear-gradient(var(--ss-disco-beam-1), transparent 85%);
  }

  .field-disco-beam-2 {
    background: linear-gradient(var(--ss-disco-beam-2), transparent 85%);
    animation-direction: alternate-reverse;
    animation-duration: 1900ms;
  }

  .field-disco-beam-3 {
    background: linear-gradient(var(--ss-disco-beam-3), transparent 85%);
    animation-delay: -1100ms;
    animation-duration: 2600ms;
  }

  .field-disco-ball {
    position: absolute;

    width: min(12cqh, 8cqw);
    height: min(24cqh, 16cqw);
    opacity: 0;
  }

  .field-disco-drop {
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
  }

  .field-disco-string {
    position: absolute;
    left: calc(50% - 1px);
    top: 0;
    width: 2px;
    height: 50%;
    background: var(--ss-label-ink);
    opacity: 0.6;

  .field-disco-ball-art {
    position: absolute;

    right: 0;
    bottom: 0;
    height: 50%;

    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    font-size: min(9cqh, 6cqw);
    opacity: 0.7;
  }

  /* The stage drops the ball itself; the kit's own drop would play it twice. */
  .field-disco-ball-art .ss-mirror-ball .ball-rig {
    animation: none;
  }

  .field-disco-beaver {
    position: absolute;
    bottom: 0;
    left: 46%;
    width: min(14cqh, 9cqw);
    height: min(12cqh, 8cqw);
  }

  .field-disco-robot {
    display: flex;
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    align-items: flex-end;
    justify-content: center;
    font-size: min(9cqh, 6cqw);
    transform-origin: 50% 100%;
    animation: stage-robot-cameo 480ms steps(2, end) infinite;
  }

  /* The leaf gust. The leaves stream across inside the field and fade before its edge. */

    position: absolute;
    left: 0;
    right: 0;
    top: 8%;
    height: 70%;
    opacity: 0;
  }

  .field-gust-leaves {
    position: absolute;
    left: 0;
    width: 22cqw;
    height: 18cqh;
    font-size: min(8cqh, 5cqw);
    animation: stage-leaves-blow 900ms linear infinite;
  }

  .field-gust.is-rtl .field-gust-leaves {
    animation-direction: reverse;

  .field-gust-leaves-1 {
    top: 5%;
  }

  .field-gust-leaves-2 {
    top: 38%;
    animation-delay: -300ms;
  }

  .field-gust-leaves-3 {
    top: 70%;
    animation-delay: -600ms;

  /* The pigeon and the toupee fly low, under the leaderboard's side. */
  .field-gust-item {

    width: var(--walker-w);
    height: var(--walker-w);
    font-size: calc(var(--walker-w) * 0.8);
    transform: translate(-100%, 0);
  }

  .field-pigeon {

  .field-toupee {

  .field-toupee-art {

  .field-mole {

    right: 0;

    );
    width: min(9cqh, 6cqw);
    height: min(9cqh, 6cqw);
    font-size: min(7cqh, 5cqw);
    /* Still frame: bobbing mid-field. */
    transform: translate(45cqw, 0);
  }

  /* The acorn hail. */
  .field-hail-band {

  .field-var-line-2 {

  }

  .field-var-lines-art {

  .field-var-owl {

    right: 3%;

    height: clamp(56px, 26cqh, 170px);

  .field-var.is-checking .field-var-text {

  }

  .field-var-badge {
    padding: 0.1rem 0.45rem;
    border-radius: 4px;
    color: var(--ss-var-badge-ink);
    background-color: var(--ss-var-line);

  @keyframes stage-leaves-blow {

  }

  @keyframes stage-var-blink {
    to {
      opacity: 0.35;
    }
  }

  /* The owl's booth (contract § 12): 64 to 88 px in the roomy band, at least 44 px. */
  .owl-booth {
    --owl-booth-size: clamp(64px, 9vh, 88px);

  /* The race log, filling the board column under the leaderboard (contract § 11). */
  .race-log,
  .what-happened {
    --race-log-rule: var(--ss-rule, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.12));
    --race-log-flash: var(--color-primary, #1f4e9e);
    --race-log-focus: var(--ss-focus, var(--color-primary, #1f4e9e));
    min-width: 0;
  }

  /* Opaque paper on purpose (never the board's see-through white): the log stops above the

  .race-log {
    --race-log-ink: var(--ss-board-ink, var(--color-base-content, #1a1a1a));

    flex: 1 1 0;
    flex-direction: column;
    min-height: 0;
    padding: 0.5rem;
    border-radius: 10px;
    color: var(--race-log-ink);
    background-color: var(--race-log-paper);
  }

  .race-log-heading {
    flex: none;
    margin: 0 0 0.35rem;
    font-size: 0.8rem;
    font-weight: 800;
    letter-spacing: 0.06em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
  }

  .race-log-scroll {
    flex: 1 1 auto;
    min-height: 0;
    overflow-y: auto;
    overscroll-behavior: contain;
    border-radius: 6px;
  }

  .race-log-scroll:focus {
    outline: none;
  }

  .race-log-scroll:focus-visible {
    outline: 2px solid var(--race-log-focus);
    outline-offset: 2px;
  }

  .race-log-list {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
    list-style: none;
  }

  .race-log-entry {
    position: relative;
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: auto minmax(0, 1fr);
    align-items: baseline;
    column-gap: 0.4rem;
    padding: 0.25rem 0.3rem;
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--race-log-rule);
    font-size: 0.78rem;
    line-height: 1.4;
  }

  .race-log-entry:last-child {
    border-bottom: none;

  /* The newest entry's highlight: a tinted layer that fades out over highlightMs. */

    inset: 0;
    border-radius: 6px;
    background-color: var(--race-log-flash);
    opacity: 0.2;
    pointer-events: none;
    animation: race-log-fade var(--race-log-highlight, 1500ms) linear
      var(--race-log-delay, 0ms) both;
  }

  .race-log-entry.is-newest {

      var(--race-log-delay, 0ms) both;

  .race-log-time,
  .race-log-body {

  .race-log-time {
    font-family: ui-monospace, monospace;
    font-size: 0.72rem;

  }

  .race-log-body {

  }

  .race-log-title {
    margin-right: 0.3rem;
    font-weight: 800;
  }

  .race-log-who-name {
    font-weight: 700;
  }

  .race-log-who .bib {
    height: 1.05rem;
    min-width: 1.05rem;
    margin-right: 0.2rem;
    font-size: 0.62rem;
    vertical-align: -0.2em;
  }

  .stage.band-packed .race-log-entry {
    font-size: 0.72rem;
  }

  /* What happened, on the result view under the podium. */
  .what-happened {
    align-self: stretch;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    text-align: start;
  }

  .what-happened .race-log-scroll {
    max-height: min(14rem, 30vh);

  }

  @keyframes race-log-fade {
    from {
      opacity: 0.2;
    }

  /* No slide-in with reduced motion; the newest entry stays highlighted until the next one. */
  @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
    .race-log-entry.is-newest,
    .race-log-entry.is-newest::before {
      animation: none;
    }
  }

  :host {
    --ss-control-base: var(--color-base-200, #eeeeee);
    --ss-control-base-ink: var(--color-base-content, #1a1a1a);
    --ss-control-paper: var(--color-base-100, #ffffff);
    --ss-control-neutral: var(--color-neutral, #1f2328);

    --ss-control-error: var(--color-error, #b3261e);
    --ss-control-ring: var(--color-primary, #1f4e9e);
  }

  .ss-btn {
    --ss-btn-bg: var(--ss-control-base);
    --ss-btn-fg: var(--ss-control-base-ink);
    --ss-btn-edge: transparent;
    --ss-btn-h: calc(var(--size-field, 0.25rem) * 10);
    --ss-btn-pad: 1rem;
    --ss-btn-font: 0.875rem;
    display: inline-flex;
    flex-shrink: 0;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    gap: 0.375rem;
    min-width: 24px;
    min-height: 24px;
    height: var(--ss-btn-h);
    padding-inline: var(--ss-btn-pad);
    border: var(--border, 1px) solid var(--ss-btn-edge);
    border-radius: var(--radius-field, 0.25rem);
    color: var(--ss-btn-fg);
    background-color: var(--ss-btn-bg);
    font-size: var(--ss-btn-font);
    font-weight: 600;
    line-height: 1;
    text-align: center;
    white-space: nowrap;
    cursor: pointer;
    user-select: none;
    touch-action: manipulation;
    transition-property: color, background-color, border-color, box-shadow;
    transition-duration: 0.2s;
    transition-timing-function: cubic-bezier(0, 0, 0.2, 1);
  }

  .ss-btn-sm {
    --ss-btn-h: calc(var(--size-field, 0.25rem) * 8);
    --ss-btn-pad: 0.75rem;
    --ss-btn-font: 0.75rem;
  }

  .ss-btn-neutral {
    --ss-btn-bg: var(--ss-control-neutral);
    --ss-btn-fg: var(--ss-control-neutral-ink);
  }

  .ss-btn-primary {
    --ss-btn-bg: var(--ss-control-primary);
    --ss-btn-fg: var(--ss-control-primary-ink);
  }

  .ss-btn-outline {
    --ss-btn-bg: transparent;
    --ss-btn-fg: currentColor;
    --ss-btn-edge: currentColor;
  }

  @media (hover: hover) {
    .ss-btn:hover {
      background-color: color-mix(in oklab, var(--ss-btn-bg), black 8%);
    }

    .ss-btn-outline:hover {
      background-color: color-mix(in oklab, currentColor 10%, transparent);
    }
  }

  .ss-btn:active {
    translate: 0 0.5px;
  }

  .ss-btn:focus-visible {
    outline: 2px solid var(--ss-control-ring);
    outline-offset: 2px;
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px var(--ss-control-paper);
  }

  .ss-btn:disabled,
  .ss-btn[aria-disabled='true'] {
    pointer-events: none;
    cursor: not-allowed;
    border-color: transparent;
    color: color-mix(in oklab, var(--ss-control-base-ink) 35%, transparent);
    background-color: color-mix(in oklab, var(--ss-control-base-ink) 10%, transparent);
    box-shadow: none;
  }

  .ss-alert {
    --ss-alert-tone: var(--ss-control-base-ink);
    display: grid;

    align-items: center;
    justify-content: start;
    gap: 1rem;

    border: var(--border, 1px) solid color-mix(in oklab, var(--ss-alert-tone) 10%, transparent);
    border-radius: var(--radius-box, 0.5rem);

    font-size: 0.875rem;
    line-height: 1.25rem;
    text-align: start;
  }

  .ss-alert-error {
    --ss-alert-tone: var(--ss-control-error);
  }

  :host {
    display: block;
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    min-height: 420px;
    --ss-bark: #6b4423;
    --ss-bark-dark: #3e2612;
    --ss-bark-light: #c9a27a;
    --ss-speed-line: #ffffff;
    --ss-label-ink: #1a1a1a;
    --ss-label-paper: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.9);
    --ss-hud-ink: #ffffff;
    --ss-hud-paper: rgba(20, 24, 28, 0.74);
    --ss-hud-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.55);
    --ss-void-ink: #ffffff;

    --ss-bolt-glow: #fff59d;
    --ss-stamp-ink: #b3261e;
    --ss-stamp-paper: rgba(255, 248, 225, 0.94);
    --ss-veil: rgba(10, 20, 10, 0.35);
    --ss-panel: var(--color-base-100, #ffffff);
    --ss-panel-ink: var(--color-text-primary, #1a1a1a);
    --ss-podium: #e8d9b5;
    --ss-rule: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.12);
    --ss-focus: #1f4e9e;
    --ss-confetti-0: #e53935;
    --ss-confetti-1: #fdd835;
    --ss-confetti-2: #43a047;
    --ss-confetti-3: #1e88e5;
    --ss-confetti-4: #8e24aa;
    --ss-confetti-5: #fb8c00;
    --ss-carnage: rgba(179, 38, 30, 0.85);
    --ss-beam: rgba(190, 255, 170, 0.95);
    --ss-toupee: #5d4037;
    --ss-crack: #2b1a0e;
    --ss-water-top: rgba(120, 190, 235, 0.85);
    --ss-water: rgba(30, 100, 170, 0.9);
    --ss-ring: #ff7043;
    --ss-disco-wash: rgba(110, 40, 170, 0.32);
    --ss-disco-spot: rgba(255, 120, 230, 0.55);
    --ss-disco-beam-1: rgba(255, 64, 129, 0.34);
    --ss-disco-beam-2: rgba(24, 255, 255, 0.3);
    --ss-disco-beam-3: rgba(255, 235, 59, 0.28);
    --ss-var-veil: rgba(10, 14, 22, 0.45);
    --ss-var-line: #00e5ff;
    --ss-var-badge-ink: #0a0e16;
  }

  /* Holds every field layer, so the earthquake shakes them all together. While it shakes it is
     the largest mover of all, so it gets its own compositor layer then (and only then). */
  .field-shaker {
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
  }

  .field.is-quaking .field-shaker {
    will-change: transform;
  }

  .stage {
    --board-w: clamp(170px, 17vw, 260px);
    --labels-h: 30px;
    --crowd-h: clamp(34px, 6.5vh, 56px);
    --label-font: 0.75rem;
    position: relative;
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) var(--board-w);
    grid-template-rows: auto minmax(0, 1fr) var(--labels-h) var(--crowd-h);
    grid-template-areas:
      'head head'
      'field board'
      'labels .'
      'crowd crowd';
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    overflow: hidden;
    isolation: isolate;
  }

  .band-roomy {
    --sprite-cap: 84px;
    --bib-h: 18px;
  }

  .band-busy {
    --sprite-cap: 44px;
    --bib-h: 13px;
    --label-font: 0.68rem;
  }

  .band-packed {
    --board-w: clamp(150px, 13.5vw, 240px);
    --sprite-cap: 22px;
    --bib-h: 10px;
    --label-font: 0.62rem;
  }

  .is-rotated-labels {
    --labels-h: 74px;
  }

  .band-packed.is-rotated-labels {
    --labels-h: 62px;
  }

  .sky {
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
    z-index: 0;
    background: linear-gradient(var(--sky-top), var(--sky-bottom));
  }

  .sky svg {
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
  }

  /* The grass strip; it holds the rain's splash ripples (stage-weather-layer.js). */
  .ground {
    grid-row: 3 / 5;
    grid-column: 1 / -1;
    position: relative;
    z-index: 0;
    overflow: hidden;
    background: linear-gradient(var(--ss-grass-top), var(--ss-grass));
  }

  .field {
    grid-area: field;
    position: relative;
    z-index: 1;
    min-width: 0;
    min-height: 0;
    container-type: size;
    container-name: field;
    --lane-w: calc(100cqw / var(--lanes));
    /* Matches TREE_BOX_MAX_PX in stage-lanes.js. */
    --tree-max: 160px;
    --tree-w: min(var(--lane-w), var(--tree-max));
    --sprite: min(calc(var(--lane-w) * 0.8), var(--sprite-cap), 15cqh);
    /* The kit's tree carries its chestnut in the top fifth of its width: at height 100 the
       squirrel's head is on the chestnut. */
    --climb-top: calc(var(--tree-w) * 0.1);
    --climb-span: calc(100cqh - var(--climb-top) - var(--sprite) - var(--bib-h) - 4px);
  }

  .labels-area {
    grid-area: labels;
    position: relative;
    z-index: 2;
    min-width: 0;
  }

  .crowd-area {
    grid-area: crowd;
    position: relative;
    z-index: 2;
    min-width: 0;
  }

  /* The leaderboard stays on top of everything in the race; only the count-in and the result
     view sit above it. */
  .stage .board-area {
    z-index: 12;
    align-self: stretch;
    min-width: 0;
  }

  .stage-message {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    height: 100%;
    padding: 1rem;
  }

  .visually-hidden,
  .sr-only {
    position: absolute;
    width: 1px;
    height: 1px;
    padding: 0;
    margin: -1px;
    overflow: hidden;
    clip: rect(0, 0, 0, 0);
    white-space: nowrap;
    border: 0;
  }

  .sprite-glyph,
  .sprite-number {
    line-height: 1;
  }

  .sprite-number {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    border-radius: 50%;
    color: var(--ss-label-ink);
    background-color: var(--ss-label-paper);
    font-size: 0.7rem;
    font-weight: 800;
  }

  /* Crowd detail by band (Chaos v2 contract § 10.2). From 13 squirrels (busy, and packed with
     it) the racers drop their detail loops: the blink, the tail flick (a flag pose keeps its
     streaming tail: its shape comes from the loop), the cape and scarf flutter, and the rainbow
     coat's colour cycle, which then shows its static stripes as with reduced motion. Limbs and
     body still move. Scoped to .racer, so the podium's squirrels keep everything. */
  .stage:is(.band-busy, .band-packed) .racer .ss-squirrel .eye,
  .stage:is(.band-busy, .band-packed) .racer .ss-squirrel:not(.ss-pose-flag) .tail,
  .stage:is(.band-busy, .band-packed) .racer .ss-squirrel :is(.cape, .scarf-tail),
  .stage:is(.band-busy, .band-packed)
    .racer
    .ss-squirrel.ss-fur-rainbow
    :is(.ss-fur, .ss-fur-dark, .ss-fur-stroke, .ss-fur-dark-stroke) {
    animation: none;
  }

  /* Packed (from 31): only the featured racers, the current top five by height (is-featured,
     set by the element at most once a second, never by re-rendering the sprite), keep their limb

  :host([reduced-motion]) .stage *::before,

    animation: none !important;
    transition: none !important;
  }

  @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
    .stage *,
    .stage *::before,
    .stage *::after {
      animation: none !important;
      transition: none !important;
    }
  }

in Chaos 136, 140 or 144 by level (an\\n *   unknown level plays at Silly's 140).\\n * @param {string} mode - 'classic' or 'chaos'.\\n * @param {string|null} chaosLevel - 'mild', 'silly' or 'carnage'.\\n * @returns {number} Beats per minute.\\n * @example\\n *   tempoFor('chaos', 'carnage');\\n *   // 144\\n * @since 1.0.0\\n */\\nexport function tempoFor(mode, chaosLevel) {\\n  if (mode !== 'chaos') {\\n    return TEMPOS.classic;\\n  }\\n  if (chaosLevel === 'mild' || chaosLevel === 'carnage') {\\n    return TEMPOS[chaosLevel];\\n  }\\n  return TEMPOS.silly;\\n}\\n\\n/**\\n * @description Which extra layers play at an intensity.\\n * @param {number} level - 0 to 1 (clamped).\\n * @returns {{shaker: boolean, glock: boolean, backbeat: boolean}} The layers.\\n * @example\\n *   layersFor(0.6);\\n *   // {shaker: true, glock: true, backbeat: false}\\n * @since 1.0.0\\n */\\nexport function layersFor(level) {\\n  const value = clamp01(level);\\n  return {\\n    shaker: value >= LAYER_THRESHOLDS.shaker,\\n    glock: value >= LAYER_THRESHOLDS.glock,\\n    backbeat: value >= LAYER_THRESHOLDS.backbeat\\n  };\\n}\\n\\n/**\\n * @description A biquad filter connected to a target.\\n * @param {BaseAudioContext} context - The AudioContext.\\n * @param {string} type - The filter type.\\n * @param {number} frequency - Hertz.\\n * @param {number} quality - Q.\\n * @param {AudioNode} target - What it feeds.\\n * @returns {BiquadFilterNode} The filter.\\n * @since 1.0.0\\n */\\nfunction filterNode(context, type, frequency, quality, target) {\\n  const node = context.createBiquadFilter();\\n  node.type = type;\\n  node.frequency.value = frequency;\\n  node.Q.value = quality;\\n  node.connect(target);\\n  return node;\\n}\\n\\n/**\\n * @description The music's long-lived buses: one output (faded in and out), the kazoo's nasal\\n *   filters, the tuba's lowpass, the drum filters and the disco's bass and stab filters. Notes\\n *   are short-lived voices that play into these.\\n * @param {BaseAudioContext} context - The AudioContext.\\n * @param {AudioNode} destination - The music bus.\\n * @returns {Object<string, AudioNode>} The buses.\\n * @since 1.0.0\\n */\\nfunction buildBuses(context, destination) {\\n  const out = context.createGain();\\n  out.gain.value = 0;\\n  out.connect(destination);\\n  const leadTone = filterNode(context, 'lowpass', 3200, 0.7, out);\\n  const nasal = filterNode(context, 'peaking', 1150, 1.4, leadTone);\\n  nasal.gain.value = 6;\\n  const drums = context.createGain();\\n  drums.connect(out);\\n  const bright = context.createGain();\\n  bright.connect(out);\\n  return {\\n    out,\\n    lead: nasal,\\n    bass: filterNode(context, 'lowpass', 700, 0.7, out),\\n    bright,\\n    drums,\\n    shaker: filterNode(context, 'highpass', 6500, 0.7, drums),\\n    hat: filterNode(context, 'highpass', 7500, 0.7, drums),\\n    snare: filterNode(context, 'bandpass', 1900, 0.8, drums),\\n    clap: filterNode(context, 'bandpass', 1400, 1.2, drums),\\n    crash: filterNode(context, 'highpass', 4500, 0.5, drums),\\n    discoBass: filterNode(context, 'lowpass', 950, 0.9, out),\\n    stab: filterNode(context, 'lowpass', 2400, 0.8, out)\\n  };\\n}\\n\\n/**\\n * @description Makes the music player for one AudioContext. Nothing sounds until start().\\n * @param {{context: BaseAudioContext, random: function(): number, noiseBuffer: AudioBuffer}} kit -\\n *   From synth.js createKit().\\n * @param {AudioNode} destination - The music bus.\\n * @param {{setTimer: function(Function, number): *, clearTimer: function(*): void,\\n *   onError?: function(*): void}} options - The scheduler's timers, and where errors go.\\n * @returns {{start: Function, stop: Function, setIntensity: Function, setSilent: Function,\\n *   discoWindow: Function, endDisco: Function, finaleLift: Function, lastStretch: Function,\\n *   keyOffset: Function, isPlaying: Function, dispose: Function}} The player.\\n * @example\\n *   const music = createMusic(kit, musicBus, {setTimer, clearTimer});\\n *   music.start({bpm: tempoFor('chaos', 'silly'), atTime: context.currentTime + 0.05});\\n * @since 1.0.0\\n */\\nexport function createMusic(kit, destination, options) {\\n  const settings = options || {};\\n  const {context} = kit;\\n  const setTimer = typeof settings.setTimer === 'function' ? settings.setTimer : null;\\n  const clearTimer = typeof settings.clearTimer === 'function' ? settings.clearTimer : null;\\n  const onError = typeof settings.onError === 'function' ? settings.onError : null;\\n  const buses = buildBuses(context, destination);\\n  let playing = false;\\n  let silent = false;\\n  let stepSeconds = 60 / TEMPOS.classic / STEPS_PER_BEAT;\\n  let step = 0;\\n  let nextTime = 0;\\n  let intensity = 0;\\n  let floor = 0;\\n  let keyShift = 0;\\n  let liftAt = Infinity;\\n  let rollFrom = Infinity;\\n  let crashed = true;\\n  let discoFrom = Infinity;\\n  let discoUntil = -Infinity;\\n  let timer = null;\\n\\n  /**\\n   * @description Passes an error to the engine, if it asked for them.\\n   * @param {*} error - What went wrong.\\n   * @returns {void}\\n   * @since 1.0.0\\n   */\\n  function report(error) {\\n    if (onError) {\\n      onError(error);\\n    }\\n  }\\n\\n  /**\\n   * @description A short-lived voice on one of the buses.\\n   * @param {AudioNode} bus - Start time.\\n   * @param {number} midi - The note.\\n   * @param {number} seconds - Length.\\n   * @param {number} level - Peak level.\\n   * @returns {void}\\n   * @since 1.0.0\\n   */\\n  function kazoo(time, midi, seconds, level) {\\n    const voice = voiceOn(buses.lead);\\n    const frequency = pitch(midi);\\n    const end = time + seconds;\\n    const amp = voice.gain(SILENT);\\n    amp.gain.setValueAtTime(SILENT, time);\\n    amp.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(level, time + 0.012);\\n    amp.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(level * 0.8, end);\\n    amp.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(SILENT, end + 0.05);\\n    const reed = voice.osc('square', frequency * 0.94, time, end + 0.06, amp);\\n    reed.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(frequency, time + 0.035);\\n    const buzz = voice.gain(0.45, amp);\\n    const edge = voice.osc('sawtooth', frequency * 0.94, time, end + 0.06, buzz);\\n    edge.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(frequency, time + 0.035);\\n    edge.detune.setValueAtTime(8, time);\\n    if (seconds > 0.18) {\\n      const wobble = voice.lfo(5.8, 0, time, end + 0.06, reed.detune);\\n      wobble.gain.setValueAtTime(0, time);\\n      wobble.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(16, time + 0.15);\\n      wobble.connect(edge.detune);\\n    }\\n  }\\n\\n  /**\\n   * @description The tuba \\\"oom\\\": a triangle with a square edge and a little pitch blat.\\n   * @param {number} time - Start time.\\n   * @param {number} midi - The note.\\n   * @param {number} seconds - Length.\\n   * @param {number} level - Peak level.\\n   * @returns {void}\\n   * @since 1.0.0\\n   */\\n  function tuba(time, midi, seconds, level) {\\n    const voice = voiceOn(buses.bass);\\n    const frequency = pitch(midi);\\n    const end = time + seconds;\\n    const amp = voice.gain(SILENT);\\n    amp.gain.setValueAtTime(SILENT, time);\\n    amp.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(level, time + 0.025);\\n    amp.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(level * 0.55, end);\\n    amp.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(SILENT, end + 0.06);\\n    const body = voice.osc('triangle', frequency, time, end + 0.08, amp);\\n    body.detune.setValueAtTime(-35, time);\\n    body.detune.linearRampToValueAtTime(0, time + 0.05);\\n    const blat = voice.gain(0.22, amp);\\n    voice.osc('square', frequency, time, end + 0.08, blat);\\n  }\\n\\n  /**\\n   * @description A pizzicato pluck: a triangle with a brief octave ping.\\n   * @param {number} time - Start time.\\n   * @param {number} midi - The note.\\n   * @param {number} level - Peak level.\\n   * @returns {void}\\n   * @since 1.0.0\\n   */\\n  function pizz(time, midi, level) {\\n    const voice = voiceOn(buses.bright);\\n    const frequency = pitch(midi);\\n    const amp = voice.gain(SILENT);\\n    pluck(amp.gain, time, level, 0.003, 0.2);\\n    voice.osc('triangle', frequency, time, time + 0.26, amp);\\n    const ping = voice.gain(SILENT);\\n    pluck(ping.gain, time, level * 0.35, 0.002, 0.06);\\n    voice.osc('sine', frequency * 2, time, time + 0.1, ping);\\n  }\\n\\n  /**\\n   * @description A strummed \\\"pah\\\": the chord's three tones plucked a few milliseconds apart.\\n   * @param {number} time - Start time.\\n   * @param {number[]} tones - MIDI notes.\\n   * @param {number} level - Peak level per note.\\n   * @returns {void}\\n   * @since 1.0.0\\n   */\\n  function strum(time, tones, level) {\\n    tones.forEach((midi, order) => pizz(time + order * 0.009, midi, level));\\n  }\\n\\n  /**\\n   * @description A glockenspiel note: a sine with an inharmonic shimmer.\\n   * @param {number} time - Start time.\\n   * @param {number} midi - The note.\\n   * @param {number} level - Peak level.\\n   * @returns {void}\\n   * @since 1.0.0\\n   */\\n  function glock(time, midi, level) {\\n    const voice = voiceOn(buses.bright);\\n    const frequency = pitch(midi);\\n    const amp = voice.gain(SILENT);\\n    pluck(amp.gain, time, level, 0.002, 0.35);\\n    voice.osc('sine', frequency, time, time + 0.4, amp);\\n    const shimmer = voice.gain(SILENT);\\n    pluck(shimmer.gain, time, level * 0.3, 0.002, 0.12);\\n    voice.osc('sine', frequency * 2.76, time, time + 0.15, shimmer);\\n  }\\n\\n  /**\\n   * @description A kick: a sine dropping fast in pitch.\\n   * @param {number} time - Start time.\\n   * @param {number} level - Peak level.\\n   * @returns {void}\\n   * @since 1.0.0\\n   */\\n  function kick(time, level) {\\n    const voice = voiceOn(buses.drums);\\n    const amp = voice.gain(SILENT);\\n    pluck(amp.gain, time, level, 0.003, 0.22);\\n    const body = voice.osc('sine', 140, time, time + 0.26, amp);\\n    body.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(46, time + 0.11);\\n  }\\n\\n  /**\\n   * @description A woodblock \\\"tok\\\".\\n   * @param {number} time - Start time.\\n   * @param {number} level - Peak level.\\n   * @returns {void}\\n   * @since 1.0.0\\n   */\\n  function clap(time, level) {\\n    noiseHit(buses.clap, time, level * 0.7, 0.012);\\n    noiseHit(buses.clap, time + 0.011, level * 0.7, 0.012);\\n    noiseHit(buses.clap, time + 0.022, level, 0.1);\\n  }\\n\\n  /**\\n   * @description The disco bass: a punchy square note.\\n   * @param {number} time - Start time.\\n   * @param {number[]} tones - MIDI notes.\\n   * @param {number} level - Peak level.\\n   * @returns {void}\\n   * @since 1.0.0\\n   */\\n  function stab(time, tones, level) {\\n    const voice = voiceOn(buses.stab);\\n    const amp = voice.gain(SILENT);\\n    pluck(amp.gain, time, level, 0.004, 0.13);\\n    tones.forEach((midi) => {\\n      voice.osc('sawtooth', pitch(midi + 12), time, time + 0.18, amp);\\n    });\\n  }\\n\\n  /**\\n   * @description The tune's note on this step, if any (quieter under the disco; doubled an\\n   *   octave up at full intensity).\\n   * @param {number} loopStep - Step within the eight-bar loop.\\n   * @param {number} time - Start time.\\n   * @param {boolean} disco - The disco groove is on.\\n   * @param {boolean} doubled - Double the lead an octave up.\\n   * @returns {void}\\n   * @since 1.0.0\\n   */\\n  function leadStep(loopStep, time, disco, doubled) {\\n    const note = LEAD_BY_STEP.get(loopStep);\\n    if (!note) {\\n      return;\\n    }\\n    const seconds = Math.max(0.07, note.length * stepSeconds * 0.88);\\n    const level = disco ? 0.16 : 0.2;\\n    kazoo(time, note.midi, seconds, level);\\n    if (doubled) {\\n      kazoo(time, note.midi + 12, seconds, level * 0.3);\\n    }\\n  }\\n\\n  /**\\n   * @description The theme's rhythm section on one step, with the layers the intensity allows.\\n   * @param {{root: number, fifth: number, tones: number[]}} chord - The bar's chord.\\n   * @param {number} sixteenth - Step within the bar.\\n   * @param {number} time - Start time.\\n   * @param {{shaker: boolean, glock: boolean, backbeat: boolean}} layers - From layersFor().\\n   * @returns {void}\\n   * @since 1.0.0\\n   */\\n  function themeStep(chord, sixteenth, time, layers) {\\n    if (sixteenth === 0) {\\n      tuba(time, chord.root, stepSeconds * 3, 0.42);\\n      kick(time, 0.45);\\n    }\\n    if (sixteenth === 8) {\\n      tuba(time, chord.fifth, stepSeconds * 3, 0.38);\\n      kick(time, 0.38);\\n    }\\n    if (sixteenth === 4 || sixteenth === 12) {\\n      strum(time, chord.tones, 0.11);\\n    }\\n    if (sixteenth % 4 === 2) {\\n      woodblock(time, 0.1);\\n    }\\n    if (layers.shaker && sixteenth % 2 === 1) {\\n      noiseHit(buses.shaker, time, 0.045, 0.035);\\n    }\\n    if (layers.shaker && (sixteenth === 6 || sixteenth === 14)) {\\n      pizz(time, chord.tones[2] + 12, 0.07);\\n    }\\n    if (layers.glock && sixteenth % 2 === 0) {\\n      glock(time, chord.tones[GLOCK_ORDER[sixteenth / 2]] + 24, 0.05);\\n    }\\n    if (layers.backbeat && (sixteenth === 4 || sixteenth === 12)) {\\n      snare(time, 0.16);\\n    }\\n  }\\n\\n  /**\\n   * @description The disco groove on one step.\\n   * @param {{root: number, tones: number[]}} chord - The step's time.\\n   * @returns {void}\\n   * @since 1.0.0\\n   */\\n  function rollStep(time) {\\n    if (time >= rollFrom && time < liftAt) {\\n      const progress = (time - rollFrom) / Math.max(liftAt -
