Draws the lift size.\\n * @param {Object} builder - The race builder.\\n * @returns {Object} A spec for placeSingle.\\n * @since 2.0.0\\n */\\nfunction eagleSpec(builder) {\\n  const rules = builder.settings.deck.eagle;\\n  const liftUnits = builder.rng.floatBetween(rules.minLiftUnits, rules.maxLiftUnits);\\n  return {\\n    type: 'eagle',\\n    outcome: null,\\n    data: {liftUnits: roundTo(liftUnits, 2)},\\n    layoutFor: (track) => eagleLayout(builder, liftUnits, track)\\n  };\\n}\\n\\n/**\\n * @description Plans the cat lady's throws from one start tick: each throw goes to a different\\n *   free squirrel, two ticks after the last.\\n * @param {Object} builder - The race builder.\\n * @param {number} firstTick - The first throw's tick.\\n * @param {number[]} clings - Cling length of each throw.\\n * @returns {Array<{tick: number, track: Object, clingTicks: number, layout: Object}>} The throws.\\n * @since 2.0.0\\n */\\nfunction planThrows(builder, firstTick, clings) {\\n  const rules = builder.settings.deck.catLady;\\n  const throws = [];\\n  const used = new Set();\\n  for (let throwIndex = 0; throwIndex < clings.length; throwIndex += 1) {\\n    const tick = firstTick + throwIndex * rules.throwGapTicks;\\n    const layout = layoutFrom([\\n      {kind: effectKinds.scale, ticks: clings[throwIndex], value: rules.clingPace}\\n    ]);\\n    const candidates = builder.tracks.filter((track) => (\\n      !used.has(track.index) && track.canPlace(tick, layout)\\n    ));\\n    if (candidates.length === 0) {\\n      break;\\n    }\\n    const target = builder.rng.pick(candidates);\\n    used.add(target.index);\\n    throws.push({tick, track: target, clingTicks: clings[throwIndex], layout});\\n  }\\n  return throws;\\n}\\n\\n/**\\n * @description The eagle that catches the cat lady's last cat instead of its squirrel (the\\n *   catVsEagle combo): no climb effect, and that throw is marked intercepted.\\n * @param {Object} builder - The race builder.\\n * @param {string} catLadyId - The cat lady's event id.\\n * @param {{tick: number, track: Object}} caught - The intercepted throw.\\n * @returns {boolean} True when the eagle fitted under the overlap cap.\\n * @since 2.0.0\\n */\\nfunction catchCat(builder, catLadyId, caught) {\\n  const startMs = builder.tickStartMs(caught.tick);\\n  const endMs = builder.tickEndMs(caught.tick + builder.settings.deck.eagle.carryTicks - 1);\\n  if (!builder.overlapAllows(startMs, endMs)) {\\n    return false;\\n  }\\n  builder.registerEvent({\\n    type: 'eagle',\\n    category: 'chaos',\\n    scope: 'entrants',\\n    outcome: null,\\n    startMs,\\n    endMs,\\n    entrants: [caught.track.index],\\n    data: {caught: 'cat', combo: {kind: 'catVsEagle', with: catLadyId}}\\n  });\\n  return true;\\n}\\n\\n/**\\n * @description The crazy cat lady (contract § 4): she walks along the ground hurling cats at 2 to\\n *   4 squirrels; each hit squirrel climbs at 40% pace for 2 to 4 ticks. With the catVsEagle combo\\n *   an eagle catches the last cat instead. Draws: throw count, each cling length, her side, the\\n *   combo roll (not inside a cluster), then per attempt a start tick and one target per throw.\\n * @param {Object} builder - The race builder.\\n * @param {Object} options - Placement options.\\n * @returns {{id: string}|null} The placed event, or null.\\n * @since 2.0.0\\n */\\nfunction placeCatLady(builder, options) {\\n  const {rng, tracks} = builder;\\n  const rules = builder.settings.deck.catLady;\\n  const throwCount = Math.min(rng.intBetween(rules.minThrows, rules.maxThrows), tracks.length);\\n  const clings = Array.from({length: throwCount}, () => (\\n    rng.intBetween(rules.minClingTicks, rules.maxClingTicks)\\n  ));\\n  const side = rng.chance(0.5) ? 'left' : 'right';\\n  // No combo inside a cluster: the eagle would take an overlap slot without being a cluster event.\\n  const clustered = Number.isInteger(options.anchorTick);\\n  const wantsEagle = !clustered && rng.chance(builder.level.deck.combos.catVsEagle);\\n  const spanTicks = Math.max(...clings.map((cling, index) => index * rules.throwGapTicks + cling));\\n  for (let attempt = 0; attempt < builder.settings.deck.placementAttempts; attempt += 1) {\\n    const firstTick = chooseStart(builder, options, spanTicks);\\n    const throws = firstTick === null ? [] : planThrows(builder, firstTick, clings);\\n    if (throws.length >= Math.min(2, tracks.length)) {\\n      const startMs = builder.tickStartMs(firstTick);\\n      const endMs = Math.max(...throws.map((item) => (\\n        builder.tickEndMs(item.tick + item.clingTicks - 1)\\n      )));\\n      if (builder.overlapAllows(startMs, endMs)) {\\n        return commitCatLady(builder, {throws, side, wantsEagle, startMs, endMs, options});\\n      }\\n    }\\n  }\\n  return null;\\n}\\n\\n/**\\n * @description Registers the cat lady and her throws, and the eagle when the combo fits.\\n * @param {Object} builder - The race builder.\\n * @param {{throws: Array<Object>, side: string, wantsEagle: boolean, startMs: number,\\n *   endMs: number, options: Object}} plan - The planned visit.\\n * @returns {{id: string}} The cat lady's event.\\n * @since 2.0.0\\n */\\nfunction commitCatLady(builder, plan) {\\n  const interceptIndex = plan.wantsEagle && plan.throws.length >= 2 ? plan.throws.length - 1 : -1;\\n  const throwData = plan.throws.map((item, index) => ({\\n    atMs: builder.tickStartMs(item.tick),\\n    entrant: item.track.index,\\n    clingTicks: item.clingTicks,\\n    intercepted: index === interceptIndex\\n  }));\\n  const {id, sequence} = builder.registerEvent({\\n    type: 'catLady',\\n    category: 'chaos',\\n    scope: 'entrants',\\n    outcome: null,\\n    startMs: plan.startMs,\\n    endMs: plan.endMs,\\n    entrants: plan.throws.map((item) => item.track.index),\\n    data: dataWithFinale({side: plan.side, throws: throwData}, plan.options)\\n  });\\n  const landCat = (item) => item.track.commit(item.tick, item.layout, {\\n    eventId: id, sequence, category: 'chaos', personal: true, extra: {clingTicks: item.clingTicks}\\n  });\\n  plan.throws.forEach((item, index) => {\\n    if (index !== interceptIndex) {\\n      landCat(item);\\n    }\\n  });\\n  if (interceptIndex >= 0 && !catchCat(builder, id, plan.throws[interceptIndex])) {\\n    // No room for the eagle under the overlap cap: the last cat lands after all.\\n    builder.patchEventData(id, {throws: throwData.map((item) => ({...item, intercepted: false}))});\\n    landCat(plan.throws[interceptIndex]);\\n  }\\n  return {id, sequence};\\n}\\n\\n/**\\n * @description The UFO (contract § 4): beams two squirrels up, swaps their outfits and drops each\\n *   on the other's tree, dazed 2 ticks.\\n * @param {Object} builder - The race builder.\\n * @param {Object} options - Placement options.\\n * @returns {{id: string}|null} The placed event, or null.\\n * @since 2.0.0\\n */\\nfunction placeUfo(builder, options) {\\n  const rules = builder.settings.deck.ufo;\\n  const {tickMs} = builder.settings;\\n  if (builder.tracks.length < 2) {\\n    return null;\\n  }\\n  const layout = layoutFrom([\\n    {kind: effectKinds.stall, ticks: rules.beamTicks},\\n    {kind: effectKinds.stall, ticks: rules.dazedTicks}\\n  ]);\\n  for (let attempt = 0; attempt < builder.settings.deck.placementAttempts; attempt += 1) {\\n    const startTick = chooseStart(builder, options, layout.spanTicks);\\n    if (startTick !== null) {\\n      const free = builder.tracks.filter((track) => track.canPlace(startTick, layout));\\n      const startMs = builder.tickStartMs(startTick);\\n      const endMs = builder.tickEndMs(startTick + layout.spanTicks - 1);\\n      if (free.length >= 2 && builder.overlapAllows(startMs, endMs)) {\\n        const pair = builder.rng.shuffle(free).slice(0, 2);\\n        return commitUfo(builder, {pair, startTick, startMs, endMs, layout, options, tickMs});\\n      }\\n    }\\n  }\\n  return null;\\n}\\n\\n/**\\n * @description Registers the UFO, stalls both squirrels, and records the tree swap (resolved in\\n *   time order later) and the outfit swap halfway through the beam.\\n * @param {Object} builder - The race builder.\\n * @param {{pair: Object[], startTick: number, startMs: number, endMs: number, layout: Object,\\n *   options: Object, tickMs: number}} plan - The planned abduction.\\n * @returns {{id: string, sequence: number}} The event.\\n * @since 2.0.0\\n */\\nfunction commitUfo(builder, plan) {\\n  const rules = builder.settings.deck.ufo;\\n  const members = plan.pair.map((track) => track.index);\\n  const beamEndMs = plan.startMs + rules.beamTicks * plan.tickMs;\\n  const swapAtMs = plan.startMs + Math.round((rules.beamTicks * plan.tickMs) / 2);\\n  const {id, sequence} = builder.registerEvent({\\n    type: 'ufo',\\n    category: 'chaos',\\n    scope: 'entrants',\\n    outcome: null,\\n    startMs: plan.startMs,\\n    endMs: plan.endMs,\\n    entrants: members,\\n    data: dataWithFinale({swapOutfits: true, beamEndMs, swapAtMs, swaps: []}, plan.options)\\n  });\\n  plan.pair.forEach((track) => track.commit(plan.startTick, plan.layout, {\\n    eventId: id, sequence, category: 'chaos', personal: true\\n  }));\\n  builder.addLaneOp({\\n    eventId: id,\\n    sequence,\\n    startMs: plan.startMs,\\n    flightEndMs: beamEndMs,\\n    landingTick: plan.startTick + rules.beamTicks,\\n    members,\\n    permutation: [1, 0]\\n  });\\n  builder.addOutfitOp({\\n    eventId: id, sequence, atMs: swapAtMs, kind: 'swap', entrants: members, note: 'none'\\n  });\\n  return {id, sequence};\\n}\\n\\n/**\\n * @description Tries start ticks for a field-wide stall (leaf blower, disco, VAR) until enough of\\n *   the field is free and the overlap cap allows it.\\n * @param {Object} builder - The race builder.\\n * @param {Object} layout - The stall each joining squirrel gets.\\n * @param {number} minPercent - The share of the field that must be free, whole percent.\\n * @param {Object} options - Placement options.\\n * @returns {{startTick: number, startMs: number, endMs: number, joining: Object[]}|null} Where\\n *   it fits and who joins, or null.\\n * @since 2.0.0\\n */\\nfunction findFieldSlot(builder, layout, minPercent, options) {\\n  for (let attempt = 0; attempt < builder.settings.deck.placementAttempts; attempt += 1) {\\n    const startTick = chooseStart(builder, options, layout.spanTicks);\\n    if (startTick !== null) {\\n      const joining = builder.tracks.filter((track) => track.canPlace(startTick, layout));\\n      const startMs = builder.tickStartMs(startTick);\\n      const endMs = builder.tickEndMs(startTick + layout.spanTicks - 1);\\n      // Relaxed (the finale's top-up): it plays even when nobody is free to join in.\\n      const enough = options.relaxed === true\\n        || enoughOfField(joining.length, builder.tracks.length, minPercent);\\n      if (enough && builder.overlapAllows(startMs, endMs)) {\\n        return {startTick, startMs, endMs, joining};\\n      }\\n    }\\n  }\\n  return null;\\n}\\n\\n/**\\n * @description Registers a field event and commits its stall on every joining squirrel.\\n * @param {Object} builder - The race builder.\\n * @param {{type: string, slot: Object, layout: Object, data: Object, options: Object,\\n *   personal?: number[]}} field - The event; personal lists squirrels it singles out.\\n * @returns {{id: string, sequence: number}} The event.\\n * @since 2.0.0\\n */\\nfunction commitFieldStall(builder, field) {\\n  const singled = field.personal || [];\\n  const {id, sequence} = builder.registerEvent({\\n    type: field.type,\\n    category: 'chaos',\\n    scope: 'field',\\n    outcome: null,\\n    startMs: field.slot.startMs,\\n    endMs: field.slot.endMs,\\n    entrants: everyone(builder),\\n    data: dataWithFinale(field.data, field.options)\\n  });\\n  field.slot.joining.forEach((track) => track.commit(field.slot.startTick, field.layout, {\\n    eventId: id, sequence, category: 'chaos', personal: singled.includes(track.index)\\n  }));\\n  return {id, sequence};\\n}\\n\\n/**\\n * @description The leaf blower (contract § 4): every free squirrel clings sideways for 2 to 3\\n *   stalled ticks; 1 or 2 of them lose their hats. Draws: cling length, hat-loss count, direction,\\n *   then per attempt a start tick, then who loses a hat.\\n * @param {Object} builder - The race builder.\\n * @param {Object} options - Placement options.\\n * @returns {{id: string}|null} The placed event, or null.\\n * @since 2.0.0\\n */\\nfunction placeLeafBlower(builder, options) {\\n  const {rng} = builder;\\n  const rules = builder.settings.deck.leafBlower;\\n  const clingTicks = rng.intBetween(rules.minClingTicks, rules.maxClingTicks);\\n  const hatLossCount = rng.intBetween(rules.minHatLoss, rules.maxHatLoss);\\n  const direction = rng.chance(0.5) ? 'ltr' : 'rtl';\\n  const layout = layoutFrom([{kind: effectKinds.stall, ticks: clingTicks}]);\\n  const slot = findFieldSlot(builder, layout, rules.minFieldPercent, options);\\n  if (!slot) {\\n    return null;\\n  }\\n  const hatted = slot.joining.filter((track) => builder.storedOutfit(track.index).hat !== 'none');\\n  const losers = rng.shuffle(hatted).slice(0, hatLossCount).map((track) => track.index);\\n  const event = commitFieldStall(builder, {\\n    type: 'leafBlower',\\n    slot,\\n    layout,\\n    data: {direction, clingTicks, hatLoss: losers, lostHats: []},\\n    options,\\n    personal: losers\\n  });\\n  if (losers.length > 0) {\\n    builder.addOutfitOp({\\n      eventId: event.id,\\n      sequence: event.sequence,\\n      atMs: slot.startMs + builder.settings.tickMs,\\n      kind: 'hatOff',\\n      entrants: losers,\\n      note: 'hatLoss'\\n    });\\n  }\\n  return event;\\n}\\n\\n/**\\n * @description The disco (contract § 4): every free squirrel stalls 2 s to dance.\\n * @param {Object} builder - The race builder.\\n * @param {Object} options - Placement options.\\n * @returns {{id: string}|null} The placed event, or null.\\n * @since 2.0.0\\n */\\nfunction placeDisco(builder, options) {\\n  const rules = builder.settings.deck.disco;\\n  const layout = layoutFrom([{kind: effectKinds.stall, ticks: rules.durationTicks}]);\\n  const slot = findFieldSlot(builder, layout, rules.minFieldPercent, options);\\n  if (!slot) {\\n    return null;\\n  }\\n  return commitFieldStall(builder, {\\n    type: 'disco', slot, layout, data: {durationTicks: rules.durationTicks}, options\\n  });\\n}\\n\\n/**\\n * @description VAR (contract § 4): everyone freezes for 1.5 s while the owl checks for a nut\\n *   infringement. Draws the verdict (a phrase key) first.\\n * @param {Object} builder - The race builder.\\n * @param {Object} options - Placement options.\\n * @returns {{id: string}|null} The placed event, or null.\\n * @since 2.0.0\\n */\\nfunction placeVar(builder, options) {\\n  const rules = builder.settings.deck.var;\\n  const verdicts = builder.settings.varVerdicts;\\n  const verdict = verdicts.length > 0 ? builder.rng.pick(verdicts) : null;\\n  const layout = layoutFrom([{kind: effectKinds.stall, ticks: rules.stallTicks}]);\\n  const slot = findFieldSlot(builder, layout, rules.minFieldPercent, options);\\n  if (!slot) {\\n    return null;\\n  }\\n  return commitFieldStall(builder, {type: 'var', slot, layout, data: {verdict}, options});\\n}\\n\\n/**\\n * @description Tries start ticks for a field event that singles some squirrels out (earthquake,\\n *   acorn hail): the visual window must fit the overlap cap and at least one squirrel must be\\n *   free for the personal effect.\\n * @param {Object} builder - The race builder.\\n * @param {number} windowTicks - The event's visual length.\\n * @param {Object} probe - The personal effect's layout.\\n * @param {Object} options - Placement options.\\n * @returns {{startTick: number, startMs: number, endMs: number, candidates: Object[]}|null} The\\n *   slot, or null.\\n * @since 2.0.0\\n */\\nfunction findSinglingSlot(builder, windowTicks, probe, options) {\\n  for (let attempt = 0; attempt < builder.settings.deck.placementAttempts; attempt += 1) {\\n    const startTick = chooseStart(builder, options, windowTicks);\\n    if (startTick !== null) {\\n      const startMs = builder.tickStartMs(startTick);\\n      const endMs = builder.tickEndMs(startTick + windowTicks - 1);\\n      const candidates = builder.tracks.filter((track) => track.canPlace(startTick, probe));\\n      // Relaxed (the finale's top-up): it plays even when it can single nobody out.\\n      const someone = candidates.length > 0 || options.relaxed === true;\\n      if (someone && builder.overlapAllows(startMs, endMs)) {\\n        return {startTick, startMs, endMs, candidates};\\n      }\\n    }\\n  }\\n  return null;\\n}\\n\\n/**\\n * @description The earthquake (contract § 4): the whole wood shakes; 2 to 4 free squirrels slip\\n *   down 5 to 15 height units. Draws: slip count, then per attempt a start tick, then who slips\\n *   and how far.\\n * @param {Object} builder - The race builder.\\n * @param {Object} options - Placement options.\\n * @returns {{id: string}|null} The placed event, or null.\\n * @since 2.0.0\\n */\\nfunction placeEarthquake(builder, options) {\\n  const {rng} = builder;\\n  const rules = builder.settings.deck.earthquake;\\n  const slipCount = rng.intBetween(rules.minSlips, rules.maxSlips);\\n  const slipLayout = (climb) => layoutFrom([\\n    {kind: effectKinds.set, ticks: 1, value: climb},\\n    {kind: effectKinds.idle, ticks: 1}\\n  ]);\\n  const slot = findSinglingSlot(builder, rules.shakeTicks, slipLayout(0), options);\\n  if (!slot) {\\n    return null;\\n  }\\n  const slipping = rng.shuffle(slot.candidates).slice(0, slipCount);\\n  const units = slipping.map(() => rng.floatBetween(rules.minSlipUnits, rules.maxSlipUnits));\\n  const {id, sequence} = builder.registerEvent({\\n    type: 'earthquake',\\n    category: 'chaos',\\n    scope: 'field',\\n    outcome: null,\\n    startMs: slot.startMs,\\n    endMs: slot.endMs,\\n    entrants: everyone(builder),\\n    data: dataWithFinale({\\n      slips: slipping.map((track) => track.index),\\n      slipUnits: units.map((value) => roundTo(value, 2)),\\n      shakeTicks: rules.shakeTicks\\n    }, options)\\n  });\\n  slipping.forEach((track, order) => {\\n    const extra = {slipUnits: roundTo(units[order], 2)};\\n    track.commit(slot.startTick, slipLayout(-unitsToClimb(builder, track, units[order])), {\\n      eventId: id, sequence, category: 'chaos', personal: true, extra\\n    });\\n  });\\n  return {id, sequence};\\n}\\n\\n/**\\n * @description Acorn hail (contract § 4): nuts pelt down; 2 to 4 free squirrels stuff their\\n *   cheeks and climb at 60% for 3 to 5 ticks. Draws: chubby count, slow length, then per attempt\\n *   a start tick, then who gets chubby.\\n * @param {Object} builder - The race builder.\\n * @param {Object} options - Placement options.\\n * @returns {{id: string}|null} The placed event, or null.\\n * @since 2.0.0\\n */\\nfunction placeAcornHail(builder, options) {\\n  const {rng} = builder;\\n  const rules = builder.settings.deck.acornHail;\\n  const chubbyCount = rng.intBetween(rules.minChubby, rules.maxChubby);\\n  const slowTicks = rng.intBetween(rules.minSlowTicks, rules.maxSlowTicks);\\n  const layout = layoutFrom([{kind: effectKinds.scale, ticks: slowTicks, value: rules.slowPace}]);\\n  const slot = findSinglingSlot(builder, rules.hailTicks, layout, options);\\n  if (!slot) {\\n    return null;\\n  }\\n  const chubby = rng.shuffle(slot.candidates).slice(0, chubbyCount);\\n  const {id, sequence} = builder.registerEvent({\\n    type: 'acornHail',\\n    category: 'chaos',\\n    scope: 'field',\\n    outcome: null,\\n    startMs: slot.startMs,\\n    endMs: slot.endMs,\\n    entrants: everyone(builder),\\n    data: dataWithFinale({chubby: chubby.map((track) => track.index), slowTicks}, options)\\n  });\\n  chubby.forEach((track) => track.commit(slot.startTick, layout, {\\n    eventId: id, sequence, category: 'chaos', personal: true\\n  }));\\n  return {id, sequence};\\n}\\n\\n/**\\n * @description The flood (contract § 4): the water rises over the field. Which squirrels are below\\n *   the waterline, and so get a burst upwards, depends on heights, so the late pass decides it\\n *   (chaos-late.js); here the flood only claims its moment. Draws the water level, then per\\n *   attempt a start tick.\\n * @param {Object} builder - The race builder.\\n * @param {Object} options - Placement options.\\n * @returns {{id: string}|null} The placed event, or null.\\n * @since 2.0.0\\n */\\nfunction placeFlood(builder, options) {\\n  const rules = builder.settings.deck.flood;\\n  const waterUnits = builder.rng.intBetween(rules.minWaterUnits, rules.maxWaterUnits);\\n  for (let attempt = 0; attempt < builder.settings.deck.placementAttempts; attempt += 1) {\\n    const startTick = chooseStart(builder, options, rules.durationTicks);\\n    if (startTick !== null) {\\n      const startMs = builder.tickStartMs(startTick);\\n      const endMs = builder.tickEndMs(startTick + rules.durationTicks - 1);\\n      if (builder.overlapAllows(startMs, endMs)) {\\n        const {id, sequence} = builder.registerEvent({\\n          type: 'flood',\\n          category: 'chaos',\\n          scope: 'field',\\n          outcome: null,\\n          startMs,\\n          endMs,\\n          entrants: everyone(builder),\\n          // burstAtMs: the moment the waterline is checked; bursts start then.\\n          data: dataWithFinale({\\n            waterHeightUnits: waterUnits,\\n            bursters: [],\\n            burstAtMs: builder.tickStartMs(startTick + rules.burstDelayTicks)\\n          }, options)\\n        });\\n        builder.addPendingFlood({\\n          eventId: id,\\n          sequence,\\n          burstStartTick: startTick + rules.burstDelayTicks,\\n          waterUnits\\n        });\\n        return {id, sequence};\\n      }\\n    }\\n  }\\n  return null;\\n}\\n\\n// One placer per event type the deck, clusters and finale can ask for by name.\\nconst placers = {\\n  hunter: (builder, options) => placeSingle(builder, hunterSpec(builder), options),\\n  suitor: (builder, options) => placeSingle(builder, suitorSpec(builder, null), options),\\n  eagle: (builder, options) => placeSingle(builder, eagleSpec(builder), options),\\n  beaver: (builder, options) => placeSingle(builder, stallSpec(builder, 'beaver', null), options),\\n  lightning: (builder, options) => (\\n    placeSingle(builder, stallSpec(builder, 'lightning', null), options)\\n  ),\\n  woodpecker: (builder, options) => (\\n    placeSingle(builder, stallSpec(builder, 'woodpecker', null), options)\\n  ),\\n  catLady: placeCatLady,\\n  ufo: placeUfo,\\n  leafBlower: placeLeafBlower,\\n  earthquake: placeEarthquake,\\n  flood: placeFlood,\\n  disco: placeDisco,\\n  acornHail: placeAcornHail,\\n  var: placeVar\\n};\\n\\n/**\\n * @description Places one event of a named type (see the module notes for the options).\\n * @param {Object} builder - The cat lady event.\\n * @param {number} raceMs - Race time.\\n * @param {Object} context - The look context.\\n * @returns {Object|null} The look, or null outside this squirrel's cling.\\n * @since 1.0.0\\n */\\nfunction catLadyLook(event, raceMs, context) {\\n  const thrown = ownThrow(context, event);\\n  if (!thrown) {\\n    return null;\\n  }\\n  const clingEnd = thrown.atMs + thrown.clingTicks * context.tickMs;\\n  if (raceMs >= thrown.atMs && raceMs < clingEnd) {\\n    return lookOf('climb', 'cling-cat', [], ['catClinging']);\\n  }\\n  return null;\\n}\\n\\n/**\\n * @description The Golden Acorn of Doom's victim: smacked off balance, then dizzy.\\n * @param {Object} event - The earthquake event.\\n * @param {number} raceMs - Race time.\\n * @param {Object} context - The look context.\\n * @returns {Object} The look.\\n * @since 1.0.0\\n */\\nfunction earthquakeLook(event, raceMs, context) {\\n  const slipping = indexList(event.data.slips).includes(context.entrantIndex);\\n  if (slipping && raceMs < event.startMs + QUAKE_SLIP_MS) {\\n    return lookOf('dizzy', 'shake');\\n  }\\n  return lookOf('climb', 'quake');\\n}\\n\\n/**\\n * @description The flood: once the water is up, a squirrel still below the waterline (the plan's\\n *   bursters) shoots up the trunk for a few ticks.\\n * @param {Object} event - The flood event.\\n * @param {number} raceMs - Race time.\\n * @param {Object} context - The look context.\\n * @returns {Object|null} The look, or null for a squirrel above the water.\\n * @since 1.0.0\\n */\\nfunction floodLook(event, raceMs, context) {\\n  const rules = STAGE_TIMINGS.flood;\\n  let bursting = indexList(event.data.bursters).includes(context.entrantIndex);\\n  if (!Array.isArray(event.data.bursters)) {\\n    // An older plan names nobody: everyone below the waterline at the start bursts.\\n    const level = Number.isFinite(event.data.waterHeightUnits) ? event.data.waterHeightUnits : 20;\\n    bursting = heightAt(context.plan, context.entrantIndex, event.startMs) < level;\\n  }\\n  const burstFrom = event.startMs + rules.burstDelayTicks * context.tickMs;\\n  const burstTo = burstFrom + rules.burstTicks * context.tickMs;\\n  return bursting && raceMs >= burstFrom && raceMs < burstTo ? lookOf('climb', 'burst') : null;\\n}\\n\\n/**\\n * @description The hailstorm: a listed squirrel stuffs its cheeks and climbs on, slowly.\\n * @param {Object} event - The acorn hail event.\\n * @param {number} raceMs - Race time.\\n * @param {Object} context - The look context.\\n * @returns {Object|null} The look, or null for a squirrel not listed.\\n * @since 1.0.0\\n */\\nfunction acornHailLook(event, raceMs, context) {\\n  if (!indexList(event.data.chubby).includes(context.entrantIndex)) {\\n    return null;\\n  }\\n  const slowEnd = event.startMs + (event.data.slowTicks || 4) * context.tickMs;\\n  return raceMs < slowEnd ? lookOf('climb', 'climb', [], ['chubby']) : null;\\n}\\n\\n/**\\n * @description The trench coat: the host wears it on the middle tree, the other two vanish inside\\n *   it, then all three are dazed after toppling apart.\\n * @param {Object} event - The trench coat event.\\n * @param {number} raceMs - Race time.\\n * @param {Object} context - The look context.\\n * @returns {Object} The look.\\n * @since 1.0.0\\n */\\nfunction trenchCoatLook(event, raceMs, context) {\\n  const disguise = context.timeline.disguises[event.id];\\n  if (!disguise) {\\n    return lookOf('idle', 'still');\\n  }\\n  if (raceMs >= disguise.startMs && raceMs < disguise.endMs) {\\n    if (disguise.host === context.entrantIndex) {\\n      // The host's head is out of the collar; the other two peek out lower down.\\n      const others = event.entrants.filter((index) => index !== disguise.host);\\n      return lookOf('idle', 'still', [], [], {coat: true, coatHeads: [disguise.host, ...others]});\\n    }\\n    const homeLane = disguise.homeLanes[context.entrantIndex];\\n    return lookOf('idle', 'still', [], [], {hidden: true, homeLane});\\n  }\\n  return raceMs >= disguise.endMs\\n    ? lookOf('dizzy', 'still', [starsFor(event)])\\n    : lookOf('idle', 'still');\\n}\\n\\n// One look per event type: (event, raceMs, context) => look, or null for \\\"nothing this moment\\\".\\nconst LOOKS = Object.freeze({\\n  nutStop: () => lookOf('idle', 'still', [], ['nutBubble']),\\n  slip: (event, raceMs) => (\\n    raceMs < event.startMs + STAGE_TIMINGS.slip.shakeMs\\n      ? lookOf('dizzy', 'shake')\\n      : lookOf('climb', 'climb')\\n  ),\\n  burst: () => lookOf('climb', 'burst'),\\n  // A tornado's flight is drawn from the lane timeline; after it, the squirrel is dizzy.\\n  tornado: (event) => lookOf('dizzy', 'still', [starsFor(event)]),\\n  hunter: hunterLook,\\n  suitor: suitorLook,\\n  eagle: (event, raceMs, context) => (\\n    comboKind(context, event) === 'catVsEagle' ? null : lookOf('fly', 'still')\\n  ),\\n  beaver: () => lookOf('idle', 'cling'),\\n  lightning: (event) => lookOf('stunned', 'still', [\\n    decoration('zap', event.startMs, event.endMs - event.startMs)\\n  ]),\\n  catLady: catLadyLook,\\n  goldenAcorn: goldenAcornLook,\\n  leafBlower: () => lookOf('flag', 'flag'),\\n  ufo: ufoLook,\\n  earthquake: earthquakeLook,\\n  flood: floodLook,\\n  disco: () => lookOf('dance', 'still'),\\n  acornHail: acornHailLook,\\n  var: () => lookOf('idle', 'still'),\\n  trenchCoat: trenchCoatLook,\\n  woodpecker: () => lookOf('idle', 'vibrate', [], ['vibrate'])\\n});\\n\\n/**\\n * @description An event's rank for deciding the pose (a hunter's miss barely counts).\\n * @param {Object} event - The event.\\n * @returns {number} The rank.\\n * @since 1.0.0\\n */\\nfunction rankOf(event) {\\n  if (event.type === 'hunter' && event.outcome !== 'hit') {\\n    return 10;\\n  }\\n  return POSE_RANK[event.type] ?? 15;\\n}\\n\\n/**\\n * @description How a squirrel looks while it flies on the lane timeline: spinning in a tornado,\\n *   floating in a UFO's beam, toppling out of a trench coat, or just flying.\\n * @param {Object} timeline - From prepareTimeline.\\n * @param {Object} entry - The lane-timeline entry.\\n * @returns {Object} The look.\\n * @since 1.0.0\\n */\\nfunction flightLook(timeline, entry) {\\n  const {kind} = flightOf(timeline, entry);\\n  if (kind === 'tornado') {\\n    return lookOf('fly', 'spin');\\n  }\\n  if (kind === 'ufo') {\\n    return lookOf('fly', 'beamed');\\n  }\\n  return kind === 'hop' ? lookOf('stunned', 'tumble') : lookOf('fly', 'still');\\n}\\n\\n/**\\n * @description The marks a squirrel carries for the rest of the race once an event has left\\n *   them: lipstick after a kiss, a red cheek after a slap, soot after a hit or lightning, and the\\n *   legendary sparkle from the start.\\n * @param {Object[]} events - event.startMs;\\n    if (event.type === 'suitor' && event.outcome === 'kiss'\\n      && raceMs >= event.startMs + span * rules.leanShare) {\\n      effects.add('lipstick');\\n    }\\n    if (event.type === 'suitor' && event.outcome === 'slap'\\n      && raceMs >= event.startMs + span * rules.slapShare) {\\n      effects.add('redCheek');\\n    }\\n    const shot = event.type === 'hunter' && event.outcome === 'hit';\\n    if ((shot || event.type === 'lightning') && raceMs >= event.startMs) {\\n      effects.add('singed');\\n    }\\n  });\\n  return effects;\\n}\\n\\n/**\\n * @description The eagle around its squirrel: diving in, carrying (unless it caught a cat\\n *   instead, catVsEagle, or drops the squirrel into a tornado, eagleIntoFunnel), then flying off.\\n *   The fly-off stretches so the whole visit lasts at least STAGE_TIMINGS.eagle.minVisitMs\\n *   (Chaos v2 contract § 8).\\n * @param {Object} event - The eagle event.\\n * @param {number} raceMs - Race time.\\n * @param {Object} context - The look context.\\n * @returns {Object|null} The decoration.\\n * @since 1.0.0\\n */\\nfunction eagleDecoration(event, raceMs, context) {\\n  const rules = STAGE_TIMINGS.eagle;\\n  const kind = comboKind(context, event);\\n  const withCat = kind === 'catVsEagle';\\n  // With a cat in its talons it never carries the squirrel: it turns away at once.\\n  let releaseMs = withCat ? event.startMs : event.endMs;\\n  if (kind === 'eagleIntoFunnel') {\\n    const entries = context.plan.entrants[context.entrantIndex].laneTimeline || [];\\n    // The funnel arrives as the carry ends, so the drop starts at or just before the end.\\n    const drop = entries.find((entry) => (\\n      entry.flightStartMs >= event.startMs - The cat lady event.\\n * @param {{atMs: number}} thrown - The throw.\\n * @param {Object} context - The look context.\\n * @returns {{fromX: number, fromY: number}} The offset.\\n * @since 1.0.0\\n */\\nfunction throwOrigin(event, thrown, context) {\\n  const row = context.timeline.walkerRows[event.id] || 0;\\n  const fraction = walkerFraction(event, thrown.atMs, walkDirection(event, row));\\n  const lane = laneAt(context.plan, context.entrantIndex, thrown.atMs).lane;\\n  const height = heightAt(context.plan, context.entrantIndex, thrown.atMs);\\n  return {\\n    fromX: Math.round((fraction * context.timeline.count - A field-wide wash never covers a squirrel, so nobody looks faded\\n *   (contract § 8);\\n * - back (z 2, in front of the trees, behind the squirrels): the tornado, ground walkers (hunter,\\n *   cat lady, gardener), the beaver, the woodpecker, lightning;\\n * - front (z 4, in front of the squirrels): the suitor on her branch, the UFO (so a beamed\\n *   squirrel vanishes inside it), the lightning's sky flash;\\n * - fx (z 5, the full field): light accents only, at low opacity: the leaf gust, the disco\\n *   beams and mirror ball, the acorn hail;\\n * - var (z 7, above everything but the photo-finish stamp): the VAR review.\\n * Ground walkers keep the row prepareTimeline gave them, one behind the other; the mirror ball\\n * hangs to one side when a UFO is about.\\n *\\n * Readability (contract § 8): every visitor has a visual window around its event's plan window\\n * (stage-shared.js): walkers walk at a readable speed and act at the plan's moment, trunk\\n * visitors arrive early and linger, field-wide events build over a lead-in and fade over a tail.\\n * All of it is drawn only: heights and trees always come from the plan.\\n *\\n * Descriptors hold discrete values only (poses, windows, lanes): they go into the scene\\n * signature, and the timed parts move by the race clock through stage-scrubs.js. A window may\\n * carry inShare and outShare, the shares of it its build-up ends and its fade starts at.\\n *\\n * Pure ES module: no DOM, no Lit and no clock.\\n */\\nimport {heightAt, laneAt} from '../lib/choreography.js';\\nimport {\\n  STAGE_TIMINGS,\\n  READABILITY,\\n  seededUnit,\\n  spanShare,\\n  walkSpan,\\n  walkDirection,\\n  catThrows,\\n  hunterPath,\\n  trunkVisit,\\n  trunkSide,\\n  fieldWindow,\\n  fadeShares,\\n  visitWindow\\n} from './stage-shared.js';\\n\\n/**\\n * @description The tree a squirrel is on at a moment, and its height then.\\n * @param {Object} plan - From prepareTimeline.\\n * @param {string} eventId - The walker's event.\\n * @returns {{row: number, rowStep: number, rowShrink: number}} The row (0 is the ground line),\\n *   the spacing between rows and the shrink per row (hundredths of the field's height).\\n * @since 2.1.0\\n */\\nfunction walkerRowOf(timeline, eventId) {\\n  const layout = timeline.walkerLayout || {stepCqh: 6, shrinkCqh: 2.4};\\n  return {\\n    row: timeline.walkerRows[eventId] || 0,\\n    rowStep: layout.stepCqh,\\n    rowShrink: layout.shrinkCqh\\n  };\\n}\\n\\n/**\\n * @description Says whether an event of a type is under way (between its own ticks).\\n * @param {Object} context - The overlay context.\\n * @param {string} type - The event type.\\n * @returns {boolean} True when one is.\\n * @since 1.0.0\\n */\\nfunction underway(context, type) {\\n  return context.timeline.events.some((event) => (\\n    event.type === type && event.startMs <= context.raceMs && context.raceMs < event.endMs\\n  ));\\n}\\n\\n/**\\n * @description The combo an event takes part in, and its partner.\\n * @param {Object} context - The overlay context.\\n * @param {Object} event - The event.\\n * @returns {{kind: string, partner: (Object|null)}} The combo ('' when none).\\n * @since 1.0.0\\n */\\nfunction comboOf(context, event) {\\n  const combo = context.timeline.combos[event.id];\\n  if (!combo) {\\n    return {kind: '', partner: null};\\n  }\\n  return {kind: combo.kind, partner: context.timeline.eventsById[combo.with] || null};\\n}\\n\\n/**\\n * @description The tornado: the sky darkens, the funnel sweeps across over the flight, then lifts\\n *   off where it stands (well clear of the leaderboard, contract § 8) as the sky clears (SPEC.md\\n *   § 10). A sharknado has sharks circling inside, one of which bites a hat off and then wears\\n *   it; a suitor swept up with her date spins round in it too.\\n * @param {Object} event - The tornado event.\\n * @param {Object} context - The overlay context.\\n * @returns {Object|null} The descriptor, or null when it is over.\\n * @since 1.0.0\\n */\\nfunction tornadoOverlay(event, context) {\\n  const {raceMs, timeline} = context;\\n  const rules = STAGE_TIMINGS.tornado;\\n  const startMs = event.startMs - rules.leadMs;\\n  const flightEndMs = timeline.flightEnds[event.id] ?? event.endMs;\\n  const endMs = Math.max(event.endMs + rules.tailMs, flightEndMs + rules.liftMs);\\n  if (raceMs < startMs || raceMs >= endMs) {\\n    return null;\\n  }\\n  const sweeping = raceMs >= event.startMs && raceMs < flightEndMs;\\n  const chomp = timeline.hatChomps[event.id] || null;\\n  let chompPhase = '';\\n  if (chomp) {\\n    chompPhase = 'circle';\\n    if (raceMs >= chomp.atMs) {\\n      chompPhase = raceMs < chomp.atMs + rules.chompMs ? 'chomp' : 'wearing';\\n    }\\n  }\\n  const sweptSuitor = timeline.events.some((other) => {\\n    const combo = timeline.combos[other.id];\\n    return other.type === 'suitor' && combo && combo.kind === 'suitorSwept'\\n      && combo.with === event.id;\\n  });\\n  return {\\n    key: event.id,\\n    type: 'tornado',\\n    layer: 'back',\\n    sweep: windowOf(event.startMs, flightEndMs),\\n    lift: windowOf(flightEndMs, endMs),\\n    dim: windowOf(startMs, endMs),\\n    twisting: sweeping,\\n    sharks: event.data.sharks === true,\\n    chomp: chomp ? {phase: chompPhase, hat: chomp.hat, victim: chomp.entrantIndex} : null,\\n    passenger: sweptSuitor && sweeping ? 'suitor' : ''\\n  };\\n}\\n\\n/**\\n * @description The hunter (SPEC.md § 10, contract § 8): walks in from the nearer edge at a\\n *   readable pace, squints and aims, BLAM at the plan's moment, then walks back out (a hit) or\\n *   grumbles with a sooty face first (a miss). Aiming at a tornado instead (hunterVsTornado), he\\n *   stands near the right edge, fires, gets the cow spat back at him and ends up flat on his\\n *   back. At a disco he dances.\\n * @param {Object} event - The hunter event.\\n * @param {Object} context - The overlay context.\\n * @returns {Object|null} The descriptor, or null when he is off stage.\\n * @since 1.0.0\\n */\\nfunction hunterOverlay(event, context) {\\n  const {plan, timeline, raceMs} = context;\\n  const rules = STAGE_TIMINGS.hunter;\\n  const vsTornado = comboOf(context, event).kind === 'hunterVsTornado';\\n  const target = event.entrants[0];\\n  if (!vsTornado && !Number.isInteger(target)) {\\n    return null;\\n  }\\n  const lane = vsTornado ? plan.entrants.length : targetAt(plan, target, event.startMs).lane;\\n  const path = hunterPath({\\n    count: plan.entrants.length,\\n    lane,\\n    vsTornado,\\n    outcome: event.outcome,\\n    startMs: event.startMs,\\n    endMs: event.endMs\\n  });\\n  if (raceMs < path.enterAt || raceMs >= path.leaveEnd) {\\n    return null;\\n  }\\n  const fireEnd = event.startMs + rules.blamMs;\\n  const cowEnd = fireEnd + rules.cowMs;\\n  let pose = 'walk';\\n  if (raceMs >= path.arriveAt && raceMs < event.startMs) {\\n    pose = 'aim';\\n  } else if (raceMs >= event.startMs && raceMs < fireEnd) {\\n    pose = path.hit || vsTornado ? 'fire' : 'backfire';\\n  } else if (!path.hit && raceMs >= fireEnd && raceMs < path.leaveAt) {\\n    pose = 'grumble';\\n  }\\n  return {\\n    key: event.id,\\n    type: 'hunter',\\n    layer: 'back',\\n    outcome: event.outcome,\\n    lane,\\n    side: path.side,\\n    // Where he stands, and how far off stage he walks from (both in hundredths of the field).\\n    stand: Math.round(path.stand * 10000) / 100,\\n    enterFrom: Math.round((path.from - path.stand) * 10000) / 100,\\n    ...walkerRowOf(timeline, event.id),\\n    pose,\\n    enter: windowOf(path.enterAt, path.arriveAt),\\n    leave: windowOf(path.leaveAt, path.leaveEnd),\\n    leaving: raceMs >= path.leaveAt && path.side !== 'vs',\\n    cow: vsTornado && raceMs >= fireEnd && raceMs < cowEnd ? windowOf(fireEnd, cowEnd) : null,\\n    floored: vsTornado && raceMs >= cowEnd,\\n    dancing: underway(context, 'disco')\\n  };\\n}\\n\\n/**\\n * @description The suitor (SPEC.md § 10): she appears on a branch beside the squirrel and flutters\\n *   her lashes, then kisses or slaps it, then waves it off and fades; her visit is long enough to\\n *   read (contract § 8). Swept up with her date by a tornado (suitorSwept), she leaves her branch\\n *   for the funnel and turns up again beside the date's new tree.\\n * @param {Object} event - The suitor event.\\n * @param {Object} context - The overlay context.\\n * @returns {Object|null} The descriptor, or null when she is off stage.\\n * @since 1.0.0\\n */\\nfunction suitorOverlay(event, context) {\\n  const {plan, timeline, raceMs} = context;\\n  const rules = STAGE_TIMINGS.suitor;\\n  const date = event.entrants[0];\\n  const combo = comboOf(context, event);\\n  const tornado = combo.kind === 'suitorSwept' && combo.partner\\n    && combo.partner.type === 'tornado' ? combo.partner : null;\\n  const sweptEnd = tornado ? (timeline.flightEnds[tornado.id] ?? tornado.endMs) : -Infinity;\\n  // Half of each fade counts as on screen.\\n  const minVisit = READABILITY.minOnScreenMs + (rules.appearMs + rules.leaveMs) / 2;\\n  const visit = visitWindow(event, rules.leadMs, rules.tailMs, minVisit);\\n  const startMs = visit.startMs;\\n  // Swept away, she turns up again beside her date's new tree once the funnel drops them.\\n  const endMs = tornado ? sweptEnd + rules.relandMs : visit.endMs;\\n  if (!Number.isInteger(date) || raceMs < startMs || raceMs >= endMs) {\\n    return null;\\n  }\\n  if (tornado && raceMs >= tornado.startMs && raceMs < sweptEnd) {\\n    // She is in the funnel (see tornadoOverlay).\\n    return null;\\n  }\\n  const relanded = tornado && raceMs >= sweptEnd;\\n  const span = event.endMs - event.startMs;\\n  let pose = 'beckon';\\n  if (relanded) {\\n    pose = event.outcome === 'slap' ? 'wave-off' : 'kiss';\\n  } else if (raceMs >= event.endMs) {\\n    pose = 'wave-off';\\n  } else if (event.outcome === 'kiss' && raceMs >= event.startMs) {\\n    pose = 'kiss';\\n  } else if (event.outcome === 'slap' && raceMs >= event.startMs + span * rules.slapShare) {\\n    pose = 'slap';\\n  }\\n  const {lane, height} = targetAt(plan, date, relanded ? sweptEnd : event.startMs);\\n  const leaveAt = endMs - rules.leaveMs;\\n  const appearFrom = relanded ? sweptEnd : startMs;\\n  return {\\n    key: event.id,\\n    type: 'suitor',\\n    layer: 'front',\\n    outcome: event.outcome,\\n    lane,\\n    height,\\n    side: lane === plan.entrants.length ? 'left' : 'right',\\n    pose,\\n    hearts: raceMs < event.startMs,\\n    appear: windowOf(appearFrom, appearFrom + rules.appearMs),\\n    leave: raceMs >= leaveAt ? windowOf(leaveAt, leaveAt + rules.leaveMs) : null\\n  };\\n}\\n\\n/**\\n * @description The beaver (contract § 8): it waddles up to the foot of the squirrel's tree about\\n *   a second early, facing the trunk from the middle-of-the-field side, chomps it (wood chips\\n *   flying, a bite appearing in the bark, the tree swaying) through the plan window, sits back\\n *   satisfied for a moment and waddles off. At a disco it does the robot instead.\\n * @param {Object} event - The beaver event.\\n * @param {Object} context - The overlay context.\\n * @returns {Object|null} The descriptor, or null when it is off stage.\\n * @since 1.0.0\\n */\\nfunction beaverOverlay(event, context) {\\n  const {plan, raceMs} = context;\\n  const victim = event.entrants[0];\\n  if (!Number.isInteger(victim)) {\\n    return null;\\n  }\\n  const visit = trunkVisit(event);\\n  if (raceMs < visit.startMs || raceMs >= visit.endMs) {\\n    return null;\\n  }\\n  const lane = targetAt(plan, victim, event.startMs).lane;\\n  const robot = underway(context, 'disco');\\n  const chompFrom = Math.max(\\n    visit.startMs + READABILITY.trunkFadeMs,\\n    event.startMs - STAGE_TIMINGS.beaver.chompLeadMs\\n  );\\n  const gnawing = !robot && raceMs >= chompFrom && raceMs < event.endMs;\\n  return {\\n    key: event.id,\\n    type: 'beaver',\\n    layer: 'back',\\n    lane,\\n    side: trunkSide(lane, plan.entrants.length),\\n    visit: envelopeOf(visit),\\n    // The bite in the bark grows while the plan's stall lasts.\\n    bite: windowOf(event.startMs, event.endMs),\\n    pose: gnawing ? 'gnaw' : 'idle',\\n    robot\\n  };\\n}\\n\\n/**\\n * @description The lightning overlay: a white flash across the sky and a bolt down to the\\n *   squirrel. Reduced motion keeps the bolt and drops the flash.\\n * @param {Object} event - The lightning event.\\n * @param {Object} context - The overlay context.\\n * @returns {Object|null} The descriptor, or null when it is over.\\n * @since 1.0.0\\n */\\nfunction lightningOverlay(event, context) {\\n  const {plan, raceMs, reduced} = context;\\n  const rules = STAGE_TIMINGS.lightning;\\n  const startMs = event.startMs - rules.leadMs;\\n  const victim = event.entrants[0];\\n  if (!Number.isInteger(victim) || raceMs < startMs || raceMs >= event.startMs + rules.boltMs) {\\n    return null;\\n  }\\n  const {lane, height} = targetAt(plan, victim, event.startMs);\\n  return {\\n    key: event.id,\\n    type: 'lightning',\\n    layer: 'back',\\n    lane,\\n    height,\\n    bolt: raceMs >= event.startMs ? windowOf(event.startMs, event.startMs + rules.boltMs) : null,\\n    flash: reduced ? null : windowOf(startMs, event.startMs + rules.flashMs)\\n  };\\n}\\n\\n/**\\n * @description The crazy cat lady walking along the ground at a readable pace (contract § 8),\\n *   hurling cats out of her bottomless handbag at the plan's moments and cackling after each\\n *   throw. The cats themselves fly with their squirrels (stage-looks.js).\\n * @param {Object} event - The cat lady event.\\n * @param {Object} context - The overlay context.\\n * @returns {Object|null} The descriptor, or null when she is off stage.\\n * @since 1.0.0\\n */\\nfunction catLadyOverlay(event, context) {\\n  const {timeline, raceMs} = context;\\n  const span = walkSpan(event);\\n  if (raceMs < span.startMs || raceMs >= span.endMs) {\\n    return null;\\n  }\\n  const rules = STAGE_TIMINGS.catLady;\\n  const throws = catThrows(event, timeline.tickMs);\\n  const rowed = walkerRowOf(timeline, event.id);\\n  // The throw pose holds a moment past the release, then she cackles.\\n  const releaseMs = 120;\\n  let pose = 'walk';\\n  if (throws.some((item) => (\\n    raceMs >= item.atMs - rules.throwPoseMs && raceMs < item.atMs + releaseMs\\n  ))) {\\n    pose = 'throw';\\n  } else if (throws.some((item) => (\\n    raceMs >= item.atMs + releaseMs && raceMs < item.atMs + releaseMs + rules.cackleMs\\n  ))) {\\n    pose = 'cackle';\\n  }\\n  return {\\n    key: event.id,\\n    type: 'catLady',\\n    layer: 'back',\\n    ...rowed,\\n    direction: walkDirection(event, rowed.row),\\n    walk: windowOf(span.startMs, span.endMs),\\n    pose\\n  };\\n}\\n\\n/**\\n * @description The UFO: glides in over its two squirrels, beams them up while they fly on the\\n *   lane timeline (their outfits swap on the outfit timeline), drops them on each other's trees\\n *   and zooms off up into the sky. Drawn in front of the squirrels, so a beamed squirrel is\\n *   inside it.\\n * @param {Object} event - The UFO event.\\n * @param {Object} context - The overlay context.\\n * @returns {Object|null} The descriptor, or null when it is off stage.\\n * @since 1.0.0\\n */\\nfunction ufoOverlay(event, context) {\\n  const {plan, raceMs} = context;\\n  const rules = STAGE_TIMINGS.ufo;\\n  const startMs = event.startMs - rules.leadMs;\\n  const endMs = event.endMs + rules.tailMs;\\n  const pair = event.entrants.filter((index) => Number.isInteger(index)).slice(0, 2);\\n  if (pair.length === 0 || raceMs < startMs || raceMs >= endMs) {\\n    return null;\\n  }\\n  const spots = pair.map((index) => targetAt(plan, index, event.startMs));\\n  const middle = spots.reduce((sum, spot) => sum + spot.lane - 1, 0) / spots.length;\\n  const entries = [];\\n  pair.forEach((index) => {\\n    (plan.entrants[index].laneTimeline || []).forEach((entry) => {\\n      if (entry.eventId === event.id) {\\n        entries.push(entry);\\n      }\\n    });\\n  });\\n  const span = event.endMs - event.startMs;\\n  const beamFrom = entries.length > 0\\n    ? Math.max(...entries.map((entry) => entry.flightEndMs))\\n    : event.endMs - span * 0.15;\\n  return {\\n    key: event.id,\\n    type: 'ufo',\\n    layer: 'front',\\n    middle: Math.round(middle * 100) / 100,\\n    height: Math.min(...spots.map((spot) => spot.height)),\\n    hover: windowOf(startMs, endMs),\\n    beam: raceMs >= beamFrom - 200 && raceMs < beamTo + 200\\n  };\\n}\\n\\n/**\\n * @description The woodpecker in its tiny hard hat (contract § 8): it flies in about a second\\n *   early to the trunk just under its squirrel (above it near the ground), facing the trunk from\\n *   the middle-of-the-field side, jackhammers it through the plan window, then perches a moment\\n *   and flies off.\\n * @param {Object} event - The woodpecker event.\\n * @param {Object} context - The overlay context.\\n * @returns {Object|null} The descriptor, or null when it is off stage.\\n * @since 1.0.0\\n */\\nfunction woodpeckerOverlay(event, context) {\\n  const {plan, raceMs} = context;\\n  const victim = event.entrants[0];\\n  if (!Number.isInteger(victim)) {\\n    return null;\\n  }\\n  const visit = trunkVisit(event);\\n  if (raceMs < visit.startMs || raceMs >= visit.endMs) {\\n    return null;\\n  }\\n  const {lane, height} = targetAt(plan, victim, event.startMs);\\n  const peckFrom = Math.max(\\n    visit.startMs + READABILITY.trunkFadeMs,\\n    event.startMs - STAGE_TIMINGS.woodpecker.peckLeadMs\\n  );\\n  const pecking = raceMs >= peckFrom && raceMs < event.endMs;\\n  return {\\n    key: event.id,\\n    type: 'woodpecker',\\n    layer: 'back',\\n    lane,\\n    height,\\n    side: trunkSide(lane, plan.entrants.length),\\n    // Below its squirrel on the trunk, unless the squirrel is too near the ground for that.\\n    perch: height >= 25 ? 'peck' : 'idle',\\n    visit: envelopeOf(visit)\\n  };\\n}\\n\\n/**\\n * @description The leaf blower: a gardener strolls across the ground at a readable pace,\\n *   blowing a gust over the whole field (leaves, then a pigeon, then his own toupee). Two descriptors: the gardener on\\n *   the back layer and the gust on the fx layer.\\n * @param {Object} event - The leaf blower event.\\n * @param {Object} context - The overlay context.\\n * @returns {Object[]} The descriptors (none when he is off stage).\\n * @since 1.0.0\\n */\\nfunction leafBlowerOverlays(event, context) {\\n  const {timeline, raceMs} = context;\\n  const rules = STAGE_TIMINGS.leafBlower;\\n  const span = walkSpan(event);\\n  const gust = fieldWindow(event);\\n  const itemsEnd = event.endMs + rules.itemTailMs;\\n  const shownUntil = Math.max(span.endMs, itemsEnd);\\n  if (raceMs < span.startMs || raceMs >= shownUntil) {\\n    return [];\\n  }\\n  const rowed = walkerRowOf(timeline, event.id);\\n  const direction = walkDirection(event, rowed.row);\\n  const found = [];\\n  if (raceMs < span.endMs) {\\n    const blowing = raceMs >= gust.startMs && raceMs < event.endMs;\\n    const toupeeOff = raceMs >= event.startMs && spanShare(event, raceMs) >= rules.toupeeShare;\\n    let pose = blowing ? 'blow' : 'walk';\\n    if (toupeeOff) {\\n      pose = 'toupee-off';\\n    }\\n    found.push({\\n      key: event.id,\\n      type: 'gardener',\\n      layer: 'back',\\n      ...rowed,\\n      direction,\\n      walk: windowOf(span.startMs, span.endMs),\\n      pose\\n    });\\n  }\\n  if (raceMs >= gust.startMs && raceMs < Math.max(gust.endMs, itemsEnd)) {\\n    const length = event.endMs - event.startMs;\\n    const toupeeFrom = event.startMs + length * rules.toupeeShare;\\n    found.push({\\n      key: `${event.id}-gust`,\\n      type: 'gust',\\n      layer: 'fx',\\n      direction,\\n      range: envelopeOf(gust),\\n      pigeon: windowOf(event.startMs - READABILITY.fieldLeadMs / 2, itemsEnd),\\n      toupee: raceMs >= toupeeFrom ? windowOf(toupeeFrom, itemsEnd) : null\\n    });\\n  }\\n  return found;\\n}\\n\\n/**\\n * @description The earthquake's ground, behind the squirrels: the ground strip cracks open as the\\n *   shaking builds, and a mole pops out of the crack just before the worst of it and sinks back\\n *   after. rules.moleLeadMs;\\n  const endMs = event.endMs + rules.moleTailMs;\\n  if (raceMs < shake.startMs || raceMs >= endMs) {\\n    return null;\\n  }\\n  // Where along the ground the mole pops up, as a percentage of the field width.\\n  const moleAcross = Math.round((0.15 + seededUnit(event.id, 2) * 0.7) * 100);\\n  return {\\n    key: event.id,\\n    type: 'earthquake',\\n    layer: 'wash',\\n    shaking: raceMs >= event.startMs && raceMs < event.endMs,\\n    ground: windowOf(shake.startMs, endMs, fadeShares(shake.startMs, endMs, 0, rules.moleSinkMs)),\\n    crack: windowOf(shake.startMs, shake.startMs + rules.crackMs),\\n    mole: {\\n      across: moleAcross,\\n      ...windowOf(moleFrom, endMs, fadeShares(moleFrom, endMs, rules.molePopMs, rules.moleSinkMs))\\n    }\\n  };\\n}\\n\\n/**\\n * @description The flood, behind the squirrels: water rises from the bottom of the field to the\\n *   waterline over the lead-in, holds through the plan window, then drains over the tail, with a\\n *   lone rubber duck floating across while it is up.\\n * @param {Object} event - The flood event.\\n * @param {Object} context - The overlay context.\\n * @returns {Object|null} The descriptor, or null outside its window.\\n * @since 1.0.0\\n */\\nfunction floodOverlay(event, context) {\\n  const {raceMs} = context;\\n  const water = fieldWindow(event);\\n  if (raceMs < water.startMs || raceMs >= water.endMs) {\\n    return null;\\n  }\\n  const units = Number.isFinite(event.data.waterHeightUnits) ? event.data.waterHeightUnits : 20;\\n  return {\\n    key: event.id,\\n    type: 'flood',\\n    layer: 'wash',\\n    units: Math.round(units * 10) / 10,\\n    range: envelopeOf(water),\\n    duck: windowOf(event.startMs, water.endMs)\\n  };\\n}\\n\\n/**\\n * @description The disco (contract § 4 and § 8): the mirror ball drops in and the lights come up\\n *   over the lead-in, so the dancing starts under full lights; the purple wash is behind the\\n *   squirrels and only the beams and the ball are in front, at low opacity. The commentary line still says what happened.\\n *\\n * Everything here is decorative and hidden from assistive technology.\\n */\\nimport {html, css, nothing} from 'lit';\\nimport {classMap} from 'lit/directives/class-map.js';\\nimport {repeat} from 'lit/directives/repeat.js';\\nimport {DEFAULT_SHAPE} from './stage-scrubs.js';\\nimport {\\n  drawTornado,\\n  drawDebris,\\n  drawHunter,\\n  drawSuitor,\\n  drawBeaver,\\n  drawBolt,\\n  drawHeart,\\n  drawSoot,\\n  drawShark,\\n  drawCatLady,\\n  drawGardener,\\n  drawUfo,\\n  drawWoodpecker\\n} from './stage-sprites.js';\\n\\n// Sharks circling in a sharknado; the first is the one that chomps a hat.\\nconst SHARK_SLOTS = Object.freeze([0, 1, 2]);\\n// The front walker row's stacking level inside the back layer; each row back is one lower, and\\n// the beaver and the woodpecker (9) stand in front of them all.\\nconst FRONT_ROW_Z = 8;\\n\\n/**\\n * @description A ground walker's row, as custom properties for its style: the row, how far apart\\n *   the rows sit and how much smaller each row back is (from prepareTimeline's layout), and its\\n *   stacking level.\\n * @param {{row?: number, rowStep?: number, rowShrink?: number}} overlay - A walker descriptor.\\n * @returns {string} The declarations.\\n * @since 2.1.0\\n */\\nfunction rowStyle(overlay) {\\n  const row = overlay.row || 0;\\n  const step = Number.isFinite(overlay.rowStep) ? range.inShare : DEFAULT_SHAPE.inShare;\\n  const outShare = Number.isFinite(range.outShare) ? range.outShare : DEFAULT_SHAPE.outShare;\\n  return html`<div\\n    class=${className}\\n    data-scrub=\\\"race\\\"\\n    data-scrub-kind=${kind}\\n    data-scrub-start=${range.startMs}\\n    data-scrub-duration=${range.durationMs}\\n    data-scrub-in=${inShare}\\n    data-scrub-out=${outShare}\\n  >${inner}</div>`;\\n}\\n\\n/**\\n * @description The sharks circling in a sharknado. One chomps a squirrel's hat off mid-flight and\\n *   wears it for the rest of the storm.\\n * @param {Object} overlay - The tornado overlay.\\n * @param {Object[]} cast - From buildCast, for the stolen hat when the plan does not name it.\\n * @returns {Array<import('lit').TemplateResult>} The sharks.\\n * @since 1.0.0\\n */\\nfunction renderSharks(overlay, cast) {\\n  const {chomp} = overlay;\\n  const victim = chomp && cast[chomp.victim] ? cast[chomp.victim] : null;\\n  const stolenHat = chomp && (chomp.hat || (victim ? victim.fullOutfit.hat : 'none'));\\n  return SHARK_SLOTS.map((slot) => {\\n    const chomper = slot === 0 && chomp;\\n    const pose = chomper && chomp.phase === 'chomp' ? 'chomp' : 'circle';\\n    const hat = chomper && chomp.phase === 'wearing' ? stolenHat : 'none';\\n    return html`<span class=\\\"chaos-debris chaos-shark chaos-shark-${slot}\\\"\\n      >${drawShark(pose, hat)}</span\\n    >`;\\n  });\\n}\\n\\n/**\\n * @description The tornado: darkening sky, then the funnel sweeping across with a leaf, a garden\\n *   gnome and a startled cow spinning in it (and sharks in a sharknado, and a swept-up suitor),\\n *   then lifting off where it stands, short of the leaderboard. The funnel follows FUNNEL's path\\n *   (stage-scrubs.js), the same path the lifted squirrels follow, so they stay inside it.\\n * @param {Object} overlay - From overlaysAt.\\n * @param {Object[]} cast - From buildCast.\\n * @returns {import('lit').TemplateResult} The template.\\n * @since 1.0.0\\n */\\nfunction renderTornado(overlay, cast) {\\n  const passenger = overlay.passenger === 'suitor'\\n    ? html`<span class=\\\"chaos-debris chaos-debris-suitor\\\">${drawSuitor('kiss')}</span>`\\n    : nothing;\\n  return html`<div class=\\\"chaos-overlay chaos-tornado\\\">\\n    ${timed('chaos-dim', overlay.dim, 'storm-dim', nothing)}\\n    ${timed('chaos-funnel', overlay.sweep, 'funnel-sweep',\\n      timed('chaos-funnel-lift', overlay.lift, 'funnel-lift', html`\\n        <span class=\\\"chaos-funnel-art\\\">${drawTornado()}</span>\\n        <span class=\\\"chaos-debris chaos-debris-leaf\\\">${drawDebris('leaf')}</span>\\n        <span class=\\\"chaos-debris chaos-debris-gnome\\\">${drawDebris('gnome')}</span>\\n        <span class=\\\"chaos-debris chaos-debris-cow\\\">${drawDebris('cow')}</span>\\n        ${overlay.sharks ? renderSharks(overlay, cast) : nothing}\\n        ${passenger}\\n      `))}\\n  </div>`;\\n}\\n\\n/**\\n * @description The hunter: walks in from the nearer edge at a readable pace to stand beside his\\n *   squirrel's tree, squints, BLAM, then walks back out (a hit) or grumbles with a sooty face\\n *   first (a miss). html`<span class=\\\"chaos-ufo-beam\\\"></span>` : nothing;\\n  return html`<div\\n    class=\\\"chaos-overlay chaos-ufo\\\"\\n    style=\\\"--mid: ${overlay.middle}; --h: ${overlay.height}\\\"\\n  >\\n    ${timed('chaos-ufo-hover', overlay.hover, 'ufo-hover', html`\\n      ${beam}\\n      <span class=\\\"chaos-ufo-saucer\\\">${drawUfo(overlay.beam)}</span>\\n    `)}\\n  </div>`;\\n}\\n\\n/**\\n * @description The woodpecker on the trunk just under (or over) its squirrel, facing the bark\\n *   from the middle-of-the-field side, flying in and out with its visit.\\n * @param {Object} overlay - From overlaysAt.\\n * @returns {import('lit').TemplateResult} The template.\\n * @since 1.0.0\\n */\\nfunction renderWoodpecker(overlay) {\\n  const classes = {\\n    'chaos-overlay': true,\\n    'chaos-woodpecker': true,\\n    [`chaos-trunk-side-${overlay.side}`]: true,\\n    [`is-perch-${overlay.perch}`]: true\\n  };\\n  return html`<div\\n    class=${classMap(classes)}\\n    style=\\\"--lane: ${overlay.lane - 1}; --h: ${overlay.height}\\\"\\n  >\\n    ${timed('chaos-trunk-visit', overlay.visit, 'trunk-visit', html`\\n      <div class=\\\"chaos-trunk-facing\\\">\\n        <span class=\\\"chaos-woodpecker-figure\\\">${drawWoodpecker(overlay.pose)}</span>\\n      </div>\\n    `)}\\n  </div>`;\\n}\\n\\n/**\\n * @description The suitor on a branch beside the squirrel, with a pulsing heart while she\\n *   beckons.\\n * @param {Object} overlay - From overlaysAt.\\n * @returns {import('lit').TemplateResult} The template.\\n * @since 1.0.0\\n */\\nfunction renderSuitor(overlay) {\\n  const classes = {\\n    'chaos-overlay': true,\\n    'chaos-suitor': true,\\n    [`chaos-side-${overlay.side}`]: true\\n  };\\n  const heart = overlay.hearts\\n    ? html`<span class=\\\"chaos-beaver-chips\\\"></span\\n      ><span class=\\\"chaos-beaver-chips chaos-beaver-chips-late\\\"></span>`\\n    : nothing;\\n  return html`<div class=${classMap(classes)} style=\\\"--lane: ${overlay.lane - 1}\\\">\\n    ${timed('chaos-trunk-visit', overlay.visit, 'trunk-visit', html`\\n      <div class=\\\"chaos-trunk-facing\\\">\\n        ${timed('chaos-beaver-bite', overlay.bite, 'grow', nothing)}\\n        <span class=\\\"chaos-beaver-figure\\\">${drawBeaver(overlay.pose)}</span>\\n        ${chips}\\n      </div>\\n    `)}\\n  </div>`;\\n}\\n\\n/**\\n * @description The lightning strike: a bolt from the sky to the squirrel.\\n * @param {Object} overlay - From overlaysAt.\\n * @returns {import('lit').TemplateResult} The template.\\n * @since 1.0.0\\n */\\nfunction renderLightning(overlay) {\\n  return html`<div\\n    class=\\\"chaos-overlay chaos-lightning\\\"\\n    style=\\\"--lane: ${overlay.lane - 1}; --h: ${overlay.height}\\\"\\n  >\\n    ${overlay.bolt ? Base values are each part's still frame (reduced motion). */\\nexport const chaosStyles = css`\\n  .chaos-overlays {\\n    position: absolute;\\n    inset: 0;\\n    pointer-events: none;\\n  }\\n\\n  /* Field layers (see stage-lanes.js): trees 1 (then the field-wide washes at the same level,\\n     stage-field-layer.js), these back overlays 2 (in front of the trees and washes, behind the\\n     squirrels, so lifted squirrels spin inside the funnel), squirrels 3, these front overlays 4\\n     (the suitor beside her squirrel, the sky flash). */\\n  .chaos-overlays-back {\\n    z-index: 2;\\n  }\\n\\n  .chaos-overlays-front {\\n    z-index: 4;\\n  }\\n\\n  .chaos-overlay {\\n    position: absolute;\\n  }\\n\\n  .chaos-overlay svg {\\n    display: block;\\n    width: 100%;\\n    height: 100%;\\n    overflow: visible;\\n  }\\n\\n  .chaos-tornado {\\n    inset: 0;\\n    /* The funnel sprite is 100 by 150: as tall as the field, two thirds as wide. */\\n    --funnel-w: min(66cqh, 45cqw);\\n  }\\n\\n  .chaos-dim {\\n    position: absolute;\\n    inset: -100vmax;\\n    background-color: var(--ss-storm-dim);\\n    opacity: 0.3;\\n  }\\n\\n  /* The funnel is one of the few large movers: its own compositor layer. */\\n  .chaos-funnel {\\n    position: absolute;\\n    top: 0;\\n    bottom: 0;\\n    left: 0;\\n    width: var(--funnel-w);\\n    transform: translateX(calc(50cqw - var(--hunter-w) / 2));\\n  }\\n\\n  .chaos-hunter-enter,\\n  .chaos-hunter-leave {\\n    position: absolute;\\n    inset: 0;\\n  }\\n\\n  .chaos-hunter-figure {\\n    position: absolute;\\n    inset: 0;\\n    display: flex;\\n    align-items: flex-end;\\n    justify-content: center;\\n    font-size: calc(var(--hunter-h) * 0.6);\\n  }\\n\\n  /* He faces his squirrel's tree (against a tornado, the funnel coming from the left), and turns\\n     round to walk back out. */\\n  .chaos-side-right .chaos-hunter-figure,\\n  .chaos-side-vs .chaos-hunter-figure,\\n  .chaos-side-left.is-leaving .chaos-hunter-figure {\\n    transform: scaleX(-1);\\n  }\\n\\n  .chaos-side-right.is-leaving .chaos-hunter-figure {\\n    transform: none;\\n  }\\n\\n  .chaos-groove {\\n    display: flex;\\n    width: 100%;\\n    height: 100%;\\n    align-items: flex-end;\\n    justify-content: center;\\n    transform-origin: 50% 100%;\\n  }\\n\\n  .chaos-hunter.is-floored .chaos-groove {\\n    transform: rotate(-80deg) translate(-20%, 10%);\\n  }\\n\\n  .chaos-hunter.is-dancing .chaos-groove {\\n    animation: stage-groove 320ms ease-in-out infinite alternate;\\n  }\\n\\n  .chaos-hunter-cow {\\n    position: absolute;\\n    left: 10%;\\n    top: -30%;\\n    width: 60%;\\n    height: 45%;\\n    font-size: calc(var(--hunter-h) * 0.3);\\n  }\\n\\n  .chaos-walker {\\n    --walker-h: clamp(36px, calc(24cqh - wash (z 1, drawn right after the trees, behind every visitor and squirrel): the disco's\\n *   purple light and its robot-beaver cameo, the flood water and its rubber duck, the\\n *   earthquake's crack and mole, and the VAR veil. The only endless loops left (beams sweeping, leaves streaming, hail\\n * falling, the robot) are transform animations on small HTML boxes.\\n *\\n * Class names all start with \\\"field-\\\", so they never style the sprite kit's inner groups (the\\n * few rules here that switch off a kit loop name the kit's class on purpose).\\n * Reduced motion: still frames (the water at its line, the ball hung, the nuts scattered), fades\\n * stay as fades, and the commentary says what happened. Everything here is decorative and\\n * hidden from assistive technology.\\n */\\nimport {html, css, nothing} from 'lit';\\nimport {classMap} from 'lit/directives/class-map.js';\\nimport {repeat} from 'lit/directives/repeat.js';\\nimport {DEFAULT_SHAPE} from './stage-scrubs.js';\\nimport {\\n  drawLeafGust,\\n  drawPigeon,\\n  drawCrack,\\n  drawMole,\\n  drawFloodWater,\\n  drawRubberDuck,\\n  drawMirrorBall,\\n  drawBeaver,\\n  drawHailNut,\\n  drawOwlReferee,\\n  drawVarLines,\\n  hasSprite\\n} from './stage-sprites.js';\\n\\n/**\\n * @description Wraps content in an element the stage times through a race-time window.\\n * @param {string} className - The element's classes.\\n * @param {{startMs: number, durationMs: number, inShare?: number, outShare?: number}|null} range -\\n *   The window, with where its build-up ends and its fade starts when it has them.\\n * @param {string} kind - The timed motion, a stage-scrubs.js kind.\\n * @param {*} inner - The content.\\n * @returns {import('lit').TemplateResult} The template.\\n * @since 1.0.0\\n */\\nfunction timed(className, range, kind, inner) {\\n  if (!range) {\\n    return html`<div class=${className}>${inner}</div>`;\\n  }\\n  const inShare = Number.isFinite(range.inShare) ? range.inShare : DEFAULT_SHAPE.inShare;\\n  const outShare = Number.isFinite(range.outShare) ? range.outShare : DEFAULT_SHAPE.outShare;\\n  return html`<div\\n    class=${className}\\n    data-scrub=\\\"race\\\"\\n    data-scrub-kind=${kind}\\n    data-scrub-start=${range.startMs}\\n    data-scrub-duration=${range.durationMs}\\n    data-scrub-in=${inShare}\\n    data-scrub-out=${outShare}\\n  >${inner}</div>`;\\n}\\n\\n/**\\n * @description The disco's floor, behind the squirrels: the purple wash, and a beaver doing the\\n *   robot when no beaver is at a tree (otherwise that one does it, see stage-chaos-layer.js).\\n *   Both build up before the dancing starts and fade after it.\\n * @param {Object} overlay - From overlaysAt (type discoWash).\\n * @returns {import('lit').TemplateResult} The template.\\n * @since 2.1.0\\n */\\nfunction renderDiscoWash(overlay) {\\n  const cameo = overlay.cameo\\n    ? html`<span class=\\\"field-disco-beaver\\\">\\n      <span class=\\\"field-disco-robot\\\">${drawBeaver('idle')}</span>\\n    </span>`\\n    : nothing;\\n  return html`<div class=\\\"field-overlay field-disco-floor\\\">\\n    ${timed('field-disco-wash', overlay.range, 'envelope', cameo)}\\n  </div>`;\\n}\\n\\n/**\\n * @description The disco's light accents, in front of the squirrels at low opacity: three beams\\n *   sweeping from the mirror ball, and the ball itself, dropped in on its string before the\\n *   dancing starts.\\n * @param {Object} overlay - From overlaysAt (type disco).\\n * @returns {import('lit').TemplateResult} The template.\\n * @since 1.0.0\\n */\\nfunction renderDisco(overlay) {\\n  const classes = {\\n    'field-overlay': true,\\n    'field-disco': true,\\n    [`field-ball-${overlay.side}`]: true\\n  };\\n  return html`<div class=${classMap(classes)}>\\n    ${timed('field-disco-beams', overlay.range, 'envelope', html`\\n      <span class=\\\"field-disco-beam field-disco-beam-1\\\"></span>\\n      <span class=\\\"field-disco-beam field-disco-beam-2\\\"></span>\\n      <span class=\\\"field-disco-beam field-disco-beam-3\\\"></span>\\n    `)}\\n    ${timed('field-disco-ball', overlay.range, 'envelope',\\n      timed('field-disco-drop', overlay.ball, 'drop-in', html`\\n        <span class=\\\"field-disco-string\\\"></span>\\n        <span class=\\\"field-disco-ball-art\\\">${drawMirrorBall()}</span>\\n      `))}\\n  </div>`;\\n}\\n\\n/**\\n * @description The leaf gust blowing across the whole field: streaming leaves, then a startled\\n *   pigeon, then the gardener's toupee, all building up with the blower and fading after it.\\n * @param {Object} overlay - From overlaysAt.\\n * @returns {import('lit').TemplateResult} The template.\\n * @since 1.0.0\\n */\\nfunction renderGust(overlay) {\\n  const rightToLeft = overlay.direction === 'rtl';\\n  const fly = rightToLeft ? 'fly-across-rtl' : 'fly-across';\\n  const classes = {'field-overlay': true, 'field-gust': true, 'is-rtl': rightToLeft};\\n  const toupee = overlay.toupee\\n    ? timed('field-gust-item field-toupee', overlay.toupee, fly, html`\\n      <span class=\\\"field-toupee-art\\\"></span>\\n    `)\\n    : nothing;\\n  return html`<div class=${classMap(classes)}>\\n    ${timed('field-gust-band', overlay.range, 'envelope', html`\\n      <span class=\\\"field-gust-leaves field-gust-leaves-1\\\">${drawLeafGust()}</span>\\n      <span class=\\\"field-gust-leaves field-gust-leaves-2\\\">${drawLeafGust()}</span>\\n      <span class=\\\"field-gust-leaves field-gust-leaves-3\\\">${drawLeafGust()}</span>\\n    `)}\\n    ${timed('field-gust-item field-pigeon', overlay.pigeon, fly, drawPigeon())}\\n    ${toupee}\\n  </div>`;\\n}\\n\\n/**\\n * @description The earthquake's ground, behind the squirrels: a crack opening along the foot of\\n *   the trees as the shaking builds, and a mole popping out of it and sinking back.\\n * @param {Object} overlay - From overlaysAt.\\n * @returns {import('lit').TemplateResult} The template.\\n * @since 1.0.0\\n */\\nfunction renderFlood(overlay) {\\n  // The kit's water fills a box spanning the climb up to the plan's level; without it the stage\\n  // paints a plain body of water from the waterline down.\\n  const body = hasSprite('floodWaterSprite')\\n    ? html`<span class=\\\"field-water-climb\\\">${drawFloodWater(overlay.units)}</span>`\\n    : html`<span class=\\\"field-water-body\\\"></span>`;\\n  return html`<div class=\\\"field-overlay field-flood\\\" style=\\\"--units: ${overlay.units}\\\">\\n    ${timed('field-water', overlay.range, 'flood-rise', html`\\n      ${body}\\n      <span class=\\\"field-water-base\\\"></span>\\n      ${timed('field-duck', overlay.duck, 'duck-float', drawRubberDuck())}\\n    `)}\\n  </div>`;\\n}\\n\\n/**\\n * @description The acorn hail: nuts pelting down all over the field.\\n * @param {Object} overlay - From overlaysAt.\\n * @returns {import('lit').TemplateResult} The template.\\n * @since 1.0.0\\n */\\nfunction renderHail(overlay) {\\n  return html`<div class=\\\"field-overlay field-hail\\\">\\n    ${timed('field-hail-band', overlay.range, 'envelope', overlay.nuts.map((nut) => html`<span\\n      class=\\\"field-hail-nut\\\"\\n      style=\\\"--across: ${nut.across}; --down: ${nut.down};\\n        --delay: ${nut.delay}ms; --size: ${nut.size}\\\"\\n      >${drawHailNut()}</span\\n    >`))}\\n  </div>`;\\n}\\n\\n/**\\n * @description The VAR veil, behind the squirrels: the frozen field dims around them while the\\n *   review runs, so they stand out instead of fading.\\n * @param {Object} overlay - From overlaysAt (type varVeil).\\n * @returns {import('lit').TemplateResult} The template.\\n * @since 2.1.0\\n */\\nfunction renderVarVeil(overlay) {\\n  return html`<div class=\\\"field-overlay field-var-under\\\">\\n    ${timed('field-var-veil', overlay.range, 'envelope', nothing)}\\n  </div>`;\\n}\\n\\n/**\\n * @description The VAR review: the lines drawn across the frozen race, the owl referee\\n *   (whistle, its tiny monitor, the card) and the banner: \\\"checking\\\", then the verdict.\\n * @param {Object} overlay -
