When the fade starts.\n     * @param {number} seconds - Fade length.\n     * @returns {void}\n     * @since 1.0.0\n     */\n    fadeOut(atTime, seconds) {\n      if (cleaned) {\n        return;\n      }\n      output.gain.cancelScheduledValues(atTime);\n      output.gain.setTargetAtTime(0, atTime, Math.max(seconds / 4, 0.005));\n      const stopAt = atTime + seconds;\n      sources.forEach((source) => {\n        try {\n          source.stop(stopAt);\n        } catch {\n          // A source that has already finished needs no stop.\n        }\n      });\n    },\n\n    /**\n     * @description Cleans up at once when nothing was scheduled (an effect that bailed out).\n     * @returns {void}\n     * @since 1.0.0\n     */\n    seal() {\n      if (liveSources <= 0) {\n        cleanup();\n      }\n    },\n\n    cleanup,\n\n    /**\n     * @description How many sources the voice has made.\n     * @returns {number} The count.\n     * @since 1.0.0\n     */\n    sourceCount() {\n      return sources.length;\n    }\n  };\n  return voice;\n}\n","/**\n * The race sound effects (Chaos v2 contract § 9): one short synthesised effect per event, plus the\n * cues (go, last stretch, finale burst, photo finish, finish) and, since 2.2.0, the owl\n * commentator's hoot (§ 12). No audio files: every sound is built from oscillators, filtered\n * noise and envelopes on the AudioContext clock.\n *\n * Every tune here is original. The finish fanfare, the VAR sting, the trench-coat tiptoe and the\n * owl's hoot were written for this app; none quotes a melody, motif or sting from an existing\n * work.\n *\n * Each entry of SFX_LIBRARY is {durationMs, play(voice, time, options)}. durationMs is an upper\n * bound on how long the effect sounds; the engine uses it to count concurrent effects (at most\n * three) and tests/audio-engine.test.js checks it against the nodes each effect schedules.\n * play() builds the whole effect inside the voice it is given (synth.js), so the voice can fade\n * it out on \"Skip to result\" and disconnects it when it ends.\n *\n * Pure ES module: no DOM and no globals.\n */\nimport {SILENT, midiToHz, pluck, swell} from './synth.js';\n\n/**\n * @description One enveloped oscillator note, optionally gliding to a second frequency.\n * @param {Object} voice - The voice (synth.js).\n * @param {{type?: string, from: number, to?: number, at: number, seconds: number, peak: number,\n *   attack?: number, glide?: number, target?: AudioNode}} spec - The note.\n * @returns {OscillatorNode} The oscillator, for extra modulation.\n * @since 1.0.0\n */\nfunction tone(voice, spec) {\n  const {type = 'sine', from, to, at, seconds, peak, attack = 0.005, glide, target} = spec;\n  const amp = voice.gain(SILENT, target);\n  pluck(amp.gain, at, peak, attack, Math.max(seconds - attack, 0.01));\n  const oscillator = voice.osc(type, from, at, at + seconds + 0.03, amp);\n  if (to && to !== from) {\n    oscillator.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(to, at + (glide || seconds));\n  }\n  return oscillator;\n}\n\n/**\n * @description One enveloped burst of filtered noise.\n * @param {Object} voice - The voice (synth.js).\n * @param {{at: number, seconds: number, peak: number, filter?: string, frequency?: number,\n *   quality?: number, attack?: number, target?: AudioNode}} spec - The burst.\n * @returns {BiquadFilterNode} The filter, for sweeps.\n * @since 1.0.0\n */\nfunction noiseBurst(voice, spec) {\n  const {\n    at, seconds, peak, filter = 'bandpass', frequency = 2000, quality = 1, attack = 0.002, target\n  } = spec;\n  const amp = voice.gain(SILENT, target);\n  pluck(amp.gain, at, peak, attack, seconds);\n  const shape = voice.filter(filter, frequency, quality, amp);\n  voice.noise(at, at + attack + seconds + 0.03, shape);\n  return shape;\n}\n\n/**\n * @description A bell: a sine with two quieter, faster-fading partials (one inharmonic).\n * @param {Object} voice - The voice.\n * @param {number} at - Start time.\n * @param {number} frequency - The bell's pitch in hertz.\n * @param {number} peak - Its level.\n * @param {number} seconds - How long it rings.\n * @returns {void}\n * @since 1.0.0\n */\nfunction bell(voice, at, frequency, peak, seconds) {\n  tone(voice, {from: frequency, at, seconds, peak, attack: 0.002});\n  tone(voice, {from: frequency * 2, at, seconds: seconds * 0.45, peak: peak * 0.25, attack: 0.002});\n  tone(voice, {\n    from: frequency * 2.76, at, seconds: seconds * 0.25, peak: peak * 0.15, attack: 0.002\n  });\n}\n\n/**\n * @description A brassy note: a sawtooth through a lowpass that opens on the attack, with a small\n *   upward scoop in pitch.\n * @param {Object} voice - The voice.\n * @param {number} at - Start time.\n * @param {number} frequency - Pitch in hertz.\n * @param {number} seconds - Note length.\n * @param {number} peak - Level.\n * @returns {OscillatorNode} The oscillator.\n * @since 1.0.0\n */\nfunction brass(voice, at, frequency, seconds, peak) {\n  const amp = voice.gain(SILENT);\n  swell(amp.gain, at, peak, 0.03, Math.max(seconds - 0.08, 0.01), 0.08);\n  const bright = voice.filter('lowpass', 700, 1.5, amp);\n  bright.frequency.setValueAtTime(700, at);\n  bright.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(2600, at + 0.05);\n  bright.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(1400, at + Math.max(seconds, 0.06));\n  const reed = voice.osc('sawtooth', frequency, at, at + seconds + 0.1, bright);\n  reed.detune.setValueAtTime(-18, at);\n  reed.detune.linearRampToValueAtTime(0, at + 0.04);\n  return reed;\n}\n\n/**\n * @description A low drum boom: a sine that drops in pitch.\n * @param {Object} voice - The voice.\n * @param {number} at - Start time.\n * @param {number} peak - Level.\n * @returns {void}\n * @since 1.0.0\n */\nfunction boom(voice, at, peak) {\n  tone(voice, {from: 110, to: 52, at, seconds: 0.4, peak, attack: 0.004, glide: 0.2});\n}\n\n/**\n * @description Tornado: a rising wind whoosh (noise through a sweeping band) with a faint howl.\n * @param {Object} voice - The voice.\n * @param {number} time - Start time.\n * @returns {void}\n * @since 1.0.0\n */\nfunction playWindWhoosh(voice, time) {\n  const amp = voice.gain(SILENT);\n  swell(amp.gain, time, 0.6, 0.9, 0.3, 0.6);\n  const band = voice.filter('bandpass', 280, 2.2, amp);\n  band.frequency.setValueAtTime(280, time);\n  band.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(1500, time + 1.1);\n  band.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(700, time + 1.8);\n  voice.noise(time, time + 1.85, band);\n  tone(voice, {\n    from: 320, to: 820, at: time + 0.1, seconds: 1.5, peak: 0.05, attack: 0.5, glide: 1.1\n  });\n}\n\n/**\n * @description Sharks: a cartoon \"chomp chomp\" (a falling square snap with a noise bite).\n * @param {Object} voice - The voice.\n * @param {number} time - Start time.\n * @returns {void}\n * @since 1.0.0\n */\nfunction playSharkChomp(voice, time) {\n  [0, 0.15].forEach((offset, order) => {\n    const at = time + offset;\n    tone(voice, {type: 'square', from: 260 - order * 30, to: 70, at, seconds: 0.09, peak: 0.26});\n    noiseBurst(voice, {at, seconds: 0.05, peak: 0.35, filter: 'lowpass', frequency: 1400});\n  });\n}\n\n/**\n * @description The cow: a low warble (a buzzy tone through a moving vowel filter, wobbling).\n * @param {Object} voice - The voice.\n * @param {number} time - Start time.\n * @returns {void}\n * @since 1.0.0\n */\nfunction playCowWarble(voice, time) {\n  const amp = voice.gain(SILENT);\n  swell(amp.gain, time, 0.5, 0.12, 0.45, 0.35);\n  const vowel = voice.filter('bandpass', 380, 3, amp);\n  vowel.frequency.setValueAtTime(380, time);\n  vowel.frequency.linearRampToValueAtTime(820, time + 0.35);\n  vowel.frequency.linearRampToValueAtTime(460, time + 0.9);\n  const throat = voice.osc('sawtooth', 128, time, time + 0.95, vowel);\n  throat.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(96, time + 0.9);\n  voice.lfo(6.5, 45, time, time + 0.95, throat.detune);\n}\n\n/**\n * @description The hunter's pop-gun: a tiny crack and a falling \"pop\".\n * @param {Object} voice - The voice.\n * @param {number} time - Start time.\n * @returns {void}\n * @since 1.0.0\n */\nfunction playPopGun(voice, time) {\n  noiseBurst(voice, {at: time, seconds: 0.03, peak: 0.6, filter: 'highpass', frequency: 1800});\n  tone(voice, {from: 1100, to: 180, at: time, seconds: 0.07, peak: 0.45, attack: 0.002});\n}\n\n/**\n * @description A miss: a cartoon spring \"boing\" (a rising tone with a dying wobble).\n * @param {Object} voice - The voice.\n * @param {number} time - Start time.\n * @returns {void}\n * @since 1.0.0\n */\nfunction playBoing(voice, time) {\n  const spring = tone(voice, {\n    type: 'triangle', from: 170, to: 420, at: time, seconds: 0.68, peak: 0.34, attack: 0.004,\n    glide: 0.08\n  });\n  const wobble = voice.lfo(13, 320, time, time + 0.72, spring.detune);\n  wobble.gain.setValueAtTime(320, time);\n  wobble.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(6, time + 0.65);\n}\n\n/**\n * @description A kiss: a little lip pop, then a \"mwah\" (a vowel filter opening and closing).\n * @param {Object} voice - The voice.\n * @param {number} time - Start time.\n * @returns {void}\n * @since 1.0.0\n */\nfunction playSmooch(voice, time) {\n  noiseBurst(voice, {at: time, seconds: 0.025, peak: 0.35, frequency: 2400, quality: 3});\n  const start = time + 0.03;\n  const amp = voice.gain(SILENT);\n  swell(amp.gain, start, 0.42, 0.06, 0.12, 0.2);\n  const vowel = voice.filter('bandpass', 500, 4, amp);\n  vowel.frequency.setValueAtTime(500, start);\n  vowel.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(1300, start + 0.15);\n  vowel.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(900, start + 0.39);\n  const lips = voice.osc('sawtooth', 280, start, start + 0.42, vowel);\n  lips.frequency.linearRampToValueAtTime(330, start + 0.17);\n  lips.frequency.linearRampToValueAtTime(300, start + 0.39);\n}\n\n/**\n * @description A slap: a sharp crack with a body thump.\n * @param {Object} voice - The voice.\n * @param {number} time - Start time.\n * @returns {void}\n * @since 1.0.0\n */\nfunction playSlapCrack(voice, time) {\n  noiseBurst(voice, {at: time, seconds: 0.07, peak: 0.7, filter: 'highpass', frequency: 1600});\n  noiseBurst(voice, {at: time, seconds: 0.12, peak: 0.25, frequency: 3200, quality: 2});\n  tone(voice, {from: 210, to: 90, at: time, seconds: 0.08, peak: 0.35, attack: 0.002});\n}\n\n/**\n * @description The eagle: a screech that sweeps down, with a fast flutter and a breathy edge.\n * @param {Object} voice - The voice.\n * @param {number} time - Start time.\n * @returns {void}\n * @since 1.0.0\n */\nfunction playEagleScreech(voice, time) {\n  const amp = voice.gain(SILENT);\n  swell(amp.gain, time, 0.22, 0.04, 0.35, 0.28);\n  const band = voice.filter('bandpass', 2600, 1.4, amp);\n  const cry = voice.osc('sawtooth', 2100, time, time + 0.72, band);\n  cry.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(2500, time + 0.08);\n  cry.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(950, time + 0.68);\n  voice.lfo(28, 70, time, time + 0.72, cry.detune);\n  noiseBurst(voice, {\n    at: time, seconds: 0.5, peak: 0.08, frequency: 3500, quality: 1.5, attack: 0.03\n  });\n}\n\n/**\n * @description The beaver: rapid gnawing ticks with a woody click on every other one.\n * @param {Object} voice - The voice.\n * @param {number} time - Start time.\n * @returns {void}\n * @since 1.0.0\n */\nfunction playThunderCrack(voice, time) {\n  noiseBurst(voice, {at: time, seconds: 0.16, peak: 0.75, filter: 'highpass', frequency: 900});\n  tone(voice, {type: 'sawtooth', from: 1500, to: 120, at: time, seconds: 0.12, peak: 0.18});\n  const rumbleAt = time + 0.08;\n  const amp = voice.gain(SILENT);\n  swell(amp.gain, rumbleAt, 0.6, 0.15, 0.4, 1.2);\n  const wobble = voice.gain(0.7, amp);\n  voice.lfo(6, 0.3, rumbleAt, rumbleAt + 1.8, wobble.gain);\n  const low = voice.filter('lowpass', 170, 0.8, wobble);\n  voice.noise(rumbleAt, rumbleAt + 1.8, low);\n}\n\n/**\n * @description The cat lady's cackle: five quick falling blips.\n * @param {Object} voice - The voice.\n * @param {number} time - Start time.\n * @returns {void}\n * @since 1.0.0\n */\nfunction playAcornWhistle(voice, time) {\n  const whistle = tone(voice, {\n    from: 700, to: 2600, at: time, seconds: 0.28, peak: 0.2, attack: 0.02\n  });\n  voice.lfo(18, 25, time, time + 0.31, whistle.detune);\n}\n\n/**\n * @description The acorn's impact: a hollow wooden \"bonk\" with a thump under it.\n * @param {Object} voice - The voice.\n * @param {number} time - Start time.\n * @returns {void}\n * @since 1.0.0\n */\nfunction playBonk(voice, time) {\n  tone(voice, {\n    type: 'triangle', from: 520, to: 300, at: time, seconds: 0.16, peak: 0.4, attack: 0.002\n  });\n  tone(voice, {from: 150, to: 80, at: time, seconds: 0.12, peak: 0.4, attack: 0.002});\n  noiseBurst(voice, {at: time, seconds: 0.02, peak: 0.3, filter: 'lowpass', frequency: 2000});\n}\n\n/**\n * @description The leaf blower: a two-stroke motor hum (a low buzz that putters) plus air.\n * @param {Object} voice - The voice.\n * @param {number} time - Start time.\n * @returns {void}\n * @since 1.0.0\n */\nfunction playMotorHum(voice, time) {\n  const end = time + 2.2;\n  const amp = voice.gain(SILENT);\n  swell(amp.gain, time, 0.3, 0.25, 1.4, 0.5);\n  const low = voice.filter('lowpass', 900, 1, amp);\n  const putter = voice.gain(0.6, low);\n  voice.lfo(22, 0.4, time, end, putter.gain);\n  const engine = voice.osc('sawtooth', 72, time, end, putter);\n  engine.frequency.linearRampToValueAtTime(84, time + 0.6);\n  engine.frequency.linearRampToValueAtTime(78, time + 2);\n  const rattle = voice.gain(0.3, putter);\n  voice.osc('square', 145, time, end, rattle);\n  const air = voice.gain(0.12, amp);\n  const airBand = voice.filter('bandpass', 1300, 0.7, air);\n  voice.noise(time, end, airBand);\n}\n\n/**\n * @description The UFO: a theremin warble (a sine gliding up and down with a deep vibrato, and a\n *   quiet fifth above it).\n * @param {Object} voice - The voice.\n * @param {number} time - Start time.\n * @returns {void}\n * @since 1.0.0\n */\nfunction playTheremin(voice, time) {\n  const end = time + 1.8;\n  const amp = voice.gain(SILENT);\n  swell(amp.gain, time, 0.22, 0.25, 1, 0.5);\n  const glidePoints = [[0.6, 1080], [1.1, 760], [1.4, 980], [1.75, 700]];\n  [[1, 1], [1.5, 0.18]].forEach(([ratio, level]) => {\n    const layer = voice.gain(level, amp);\n    const wave = voice.osc('sine', 620 * ratio, time, end, layer);\n    glidePoints.forEach(([offset, frequency]) => {\n      wave.frequency.linearRampToValueAtTime(frequency * ratio, time + offset);\n    });\n    voice.lfo(6.2, 55, time, end, wave.detune);\n  });\n}\n\n/**\n * @description The earthquake: a low wobbling rumble with a sub-bass under it and a crack.\n * @param {Object} voice - The voice.\n * @param {number} time - Start time.\n * @returns {void}\n * @since 1.0.0\n */\nfunction playRefWhistle(voice, time) {\n  const amp = voice.gain(SILENT);\n  amp.gain.setValueAtTime(SILENT, time);\n  amp.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(0.28, time + 0.01);\n  amp.gain.setValueAtTime(0.28, time + 0.13);\n  amp.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(SILENT, time + 0.16);\n  amp.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(0.28, time + 0.21);\n  amp.gain.setValueAtTime(0.28, time + 0.34);\n  amp.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(SILENT, time + 0.39);\n  const pea = voice.osc('sine', 2350, time, time + 0.4, amp);\n  voice.lfo(32, 90, time, time + 0.4, pea.detune);\n  noiseBurst(voice, {\n    at: time, seconds: 0.33, peak: 0.05, frequency: 2400, quality: 2, attack: 0.01\n  });\n}\n\n/**\n * @description VAR: an original suspense sting (two tremolo strings a tritone apart that both\n *   creep up a semitone, over a low drum).\n * @param {Object} voice - an anchor tick: the event must cover the tick after it, so a cluster's events all share one\n *   moment (the Silly pile-up, the Absolute Carnage finale);\n * - a start range: a uniform draw (the \"every squirrel\" pass's fallback, the finale's top-up);\n * - otherwise the intensity curve.\n *\n * The relaxed option (the finale's top-up only) lets a field event play when nobody is free to\n * join it or be singled out; it still affects only squirrels with room, so the quiet zone and\n * the stall cap hold, and the overlap cap is checked as always.\n *\n * Pure ES module: no DOM, no Lit and no platform imports.\n */\nimport {effectKinds, layoutFrom} from './race-builder.js';\n\n// Large enough to stand for \"no upper limit\" and still be a safe integer for intBetween.\nconst NO_LIMIT = Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER;\n\n/**\n * @description Rounds a number for the informational data on an event.\n * @param {number} value - The number.\n * @param {number} decimals - Decimal places.\n * @returns {number} The rounded number.\n * @since 2.0.0\n */\nexport function roundTo(value, decimals) {\n  const factor = 10 ** decimals;\n  return Math.round(value * factor) / factor;\n}\n\n/**\n * @description Converts height units (hundredths of the tree) into climb units for one squirrel,\n *   against its expected total climb (tickCount x paceMean).\n * @param {Object} builder - The race builder.\n * @param {Object} track - The squirrel's track.\n * @param {number} units - Height units.\n * @returns {number} Climb units.\n * @since 1.0.0\n */\nexport function unitsToClimb(builder, track, units) {\n  return (units / 100) * track.tickCount * builder.settings.paceMean;\n}\n\n/**\n * @description Picks a start tick for an event of a given length (see the module notes).\n * @param {Object} builder - The race builder.\n * @param {{anchorTick?: number, startRange?: {fromTick: number, toTick: number}}} options -\n *   Where the event may start.\n * @param {number} spanTicks - The event's length in ticks.\n * @returns {number|null} The tick, or null when no tick can satisfy the options.\n * @since 2.0.0\n */\nexport function chooseStart(builder, options, spanTicks) {\n  const range = options.startRange || {fromTick: 1, toTick: NO_LIMIT};\n  if (Number.isInteger(options.anchorTick)) {\n    // Starting anywhere from here to the anchor's next tick covers that tick.\n    const low = Math.max(options.anchorTick + 2 - spanTicks, range.fromTick);\n    const high = Math.min(options.anchorTick + 1, range.toTick);\n    return low <= high ? builder.rng.intBetween(low, high) : null;\n  }\n  if (options.startRange) {\n    const fits = range.fromTick <= range.toTick;\n    return fits ? builder.rng.intBetween(range.fromTick, range.toTick) : null;\n  }\n  return builder.sampleStartTick();\n}\n\n/**\n * @description The event's data, marked when it belongs to the finale burst.\n * @param {Object} data - The event-specific data.\n * @param {{finale?: boolean}} options - Placement options.\n * @returns {Object} A new data object.\n * @since 2.0.0\n */\nfunction dataWithFinale(data, options) {\n  return options.finale ? {...data, finale: true} : {...data};\n}\n\n/**\n * @description Says whether enough of the field is free to join a field-wide stall.\n * @param {number} joining - Squirrels free to join.\n * @param {number} fieldSize - Squirrels in the race.\n * @param {number} minPercent - The share needed, whole percent.\n * @returns {boolean} True when enough can join.\n * @since 2.0.0\n */\nfunction enoughOfField(joining, fieldSize, minPercent) {\n  return joining >= 1 && joining * 100 >= fieldSize * minPercent;\n}\n\n/**\n * @description Every entrant index, for a field event's entrants list.\n * @param {Object} builder - The race builder.\n * @returns {number[]} 0 to n - 1.\n * @since 2.0.0\n */\nfunction everyone(builder) {\n  return builder.tracks.map((track) => track.index);\n}\n\n/**\n * @description Places a single-squirrel Chaos event, trying random targets (or one fixed target)\n *   and start ticks until it fits or the attempts run out.\n * @param {Object} builder - The race builder.\n * @param {{type: string, outcome: (string|null), data: Object,\n *   layoutFor: function(Object): Object, fixedTrack?: Object, extra?: Object}} spec - What to\n *   place.\n * @param {{anchorTick?: number, startRange?: Object, finale?: boolean,\n *   attempts?: number}} [options] - Placement options.\n * @returns {{id: string, sequence: number, startTick: number}|null} The placed event, or null.\n * @example\n *   placeSingle(builder, stallSpec(builder, 'woodpecker', null), {});\n * @since 1.0.0\n */\nexport function placeSingle(builder, spec, options = {}) {\n  const attempts = options.attempts || builder.settings.deck.placementAttempts;\n  for (let attempt = 0; attempt < attempts; attempt += 1) {\n    const track = spec.fixedTrack || builder.rng.pick(builder.tracks);\n    const layout = spec.layoutFor(track);\n    const startTick = chooseStart(builder, options, layout.spanTicks);\n    if (startTick !== null && track.canPlace(startTick, layout)) {\n      const startMs = builder.tickStartMs(startTick);\n      const endMs = builder.tickEndMs(startTick + layout.spanTicks - 1);\n      if (builder.overlapAllows(startMs, endMs)) {\n        const {id, sequence} = builder.registerEvent({\n          type: spec.type,\n          category: 'chaos',\n          scope: 'entrants',\n          outcome: spec.outcome,\n          startMs,\n          endMs,\n          entrants: [track.index],\n          data: dataWithFinale(spec.data, options)\n        });\n        track.commit(startTick, layout, {\n          eventId: id, sequence, category: 'chaos', personal: true, extra: spec.extra\n        });\n        return {id, sequence, startTick};\n      }\n    }\n  }\n  return null;\n}\n\n/**\n * @description A stall-only visitor: the beaver, a lightning strike or the woodpecker.\n * @param {Object} builder - The race builder.\n * @param {string} type - 'beaver', 'lightning' or 'woodpecker'.\n * @param {Object|null} fixedTrack - A squirrel to target, or null for a random one.\n * @returns {Object} A spec for placeSingle.\n * @since 2.0.0\n */\nexport function stallSpec(builder, type, fixedTrack) {\n  const ticks = builder.settings.deck[type].stallTicks;\n  const layout = layoutFrom([{kind: effectKinds.stall, ticks}]);\n  return {type, outcome: null, data: {}, layoutFor: () => layout, fixedTrack};\n}\n\n/**\n * @description A hunter's visit: a hit (a fall of part of the running total, then a stun) or a\n *   miss (no climb effect, ticks kept clear for the backfire). Draws the hit roll, then (hits\n *   only) the fall and stun sizes.\n * @param {Object} builder - The race builder.\n * @returns {Object} A spec for placeSingle.\n * @since 1.0.0\n */\nexport function hunterSpec(builder) {\n  const {rng} = builder;\n  const rules = builder.settings.deck.hunter;\n  if (!rng.chance(rules.hitChance)) {\n    const missLayout = layoutFrom([{kind: effectKinds.idle, ticks: rules.missTicks}]);\n    return {type: 'hunter', outcome: 'miss', data: {}, layoutFor: () => missLayout};\n  }\n  const fallFraction = rng.floatBetween(rules.minFallFraction, rules.maxFallFraction);\n  const stunTicks = rng.intBetween(rules.minStunTicks, rules.maxStunTicks);\n  const hitLayout = layoutFrom([\n    {kind: effectKinds.fallFraction, ticks: 1, value: fallFraction},\n    {kind: effectKinds.stall, ticks: stunTicks}\n  ]);\n  return {\n    type: 'hunter',\n    outcome: 'hit',\n    data: {fallPercent: roundTo(fallFraction * 100, 1), stunTicks},\n    layoutFor: () => hitLayout\n  };\n}\n\n/**\n * @description A suitor's visit: a kiss (a 3 to 6 tick stall and a lipstick mark) or a slap (a\n *   2 tick stall). Draws the slap roll, then (kisses only) the kiss length.\n * @param {Object} builder - The race builder.\n * @param {Object|null} fixedTrack - A squirrel to target, or null for a random one.\n * @returns {Object} A spec for placeSingle.\n * @since 2.0.0\n */\nexport function suitorSpec(builder, fixedTrack) {\n  const {rng} = builder;\n  const rules = builder.settings.deck.suitor;\n  const slapped = rng.chance(rules.slapChance);\n  const ticks = slapped ? rules.slapTicks : rng.intBetween(rules.minKissTicks, rules.maxKissTicks);\n  const layout = layoutFrom([{kind: effectKinds.stall, ticks}]);\n  return {\n    type: 'suitor',\n    outcome: slapped ? 'slap' : 'kiss',\n    data: {lipstick: !slapped},\n    layoutFor: () => layout,\n    fixedTrack\n  };\n}\n\n/**\n * @description The eagle's lift of 10 to 20 height units, carried over a few ticks and sized for\n *   whichever squirrel it picks.\n * @param {Object} builder - The race builder.\n * @param {number} liftUnits - The lift, in height units.\n * @param {Object} track - The squirrel.\n * @returns {Object} The layout.\n * @since 2.0.0\n */\nexport function eagleLayout(builder, liftUnits, track) {\n  const rules = builder.settings.deck.eagle;\n  return layoutFrom([{\n    kind: effectKinds.set,\n    ticks: rules.carryTicks,\n    value: unitsToClimb(builder, track, liftUnits) / rules.carryTicks\n  }]);\n}\n\n/**\n * @description The eagle's visit. Draws the lift size.\n * @param {Object} builder - The race builder.\n * @returns {Object} A spec for placeSingle.\n * @since 2.0.0\n */\nfunction eagleSpec(builder) {\n  const rules = builder.settings.deck.eagle;\n  const liftUnits = builder.rng.floatBetween(rules.minLiftUnits, rules.maxLiftUnits);\n  return {\n    type: 'eagle',\n    outcome: null,\n    data: {liftUnits: roundTo(liftUnits, 2)},\n    layoutFor: (track) => eagleLayout(builder, liftUnits, track)\n  };\n}\n\n/**\n * @description Plans the cat lady's throws from one start tick: each throw goes to a different\n *   free squirrel, two ticks after the last.\n * @param {Object} builder - The race builder.\n * @param {number} firstTick - The first throw's tick.\n * @param {number[]} clings - Cling length of each throw.\n * @returns {Array<{tick: number, track: Object, clingTicks: number, layout: Object}>} The throws.\n * @since 2.0.0\n */\nfunction planThrows(builder, firstTick, clings) {\n  const rules = builder.settings.deck.catLady;\n  const throws = [];\n  const used = new Set();\n  for (let throwIndex = 0; throwIndex < clings.length; throwIndex += 1) {\n    const tick = firstTick + throwIndex * rules.throwGapTicks;\n    const layout = layoutFrom([\n      {kind: effectKinds.scale, ticks: clings[throwIndex], value: rules.clingPace}\n    ]);\n    const candidates = builder.tracks.filter((track) => (\n      !used.has(track.index) && track.canPlace(tick, layout)\n    ));\n    if (candidates.length === 0) {\n      break;\n    }\n    const target = builder.rng.pick(candidates);\n    used.add(target.index);\n    throws.push({tick, track: target, clingTicks: clings[throwIndex], layout});\n  }\n  return throws;\n}\n\n/**\n * @description The eagle that catches the cat lady's last cat instead of its squirrel (the\n *   catVsEagle combo): no climb effect, and that throw is marked intercepted.\n * @param {Object} builder - The race builder.\n * @param {string} catLadyId - The cat lady's event id.\n * @param {{tick: number, track: Object}} caught - The intercepted throw.\n * @returns {boolean} True when the eagle fitted under the overlap cap.\n * @since 2.0.0\n */\nfunction catchCat(builder, catLadyId, caught) {\n  const startMs = builder.tickStartMs(caught.tick);\n  const endMs = builder.tickEndMs(caught.tick + builder.settings.deck.eagle.carryTicks - 1);\n  if (!builder.overlapAllows(startMs, endMs)) {\n    return false;\n  }\n  builder.registerEvent({\n    type: 'eagle',\n    category: 'chaos',\n    scope: 'entrants',\n    outcome: null,\n    startMs,\n    endMs,\n    entrants: [caught.track.index],\n    data: {caught: 'cat', combo: {kind: 'catVsEagle', with: catLadyId}}\n  });\n  return true;\n}\n\n/**\n * @description The crazy cat lady (contract § 4): she walks along the ground hurling cats at 2 to\n *   4 squirrels; each hit squirrel climbs at 40% pace for 2 to 4 ticks. With the catVsEagle combo\n *   an eagle catches the last cat instead. Draws: throw count, each cling length, her side, the\n *   combo roll (not inside a cluster), then per attempt a start tick and one target per throw.\n * @param {Object} builder - The race builder.\n * @param {Object} options - Placement options.\n * @returns {{id: string}|null} The placed event, or null.\n * @since 2.0.0\n */\nfunction placeCatLady(builder, options) {\n  const {rng, tracks} = builder;\n  const rules = builder.settings.deck.catLady;\n  const throwCount = Math.min(rng.intBetween(rules.minThrows, rules.maxThrows), tracks.length);\n  const clings = Array.from({length: throwCount}, () => (\n    rng.intBetween(rules.minClingTicks, rules.maxClingTicks)\n  ));\n  const side = rng.chance(0.5) ? 'left' : 'right';\n  // No combo inside a cluster: the eagle would take an overlap slot without being a cluster event.\n  const clustered = Number.isInteger(options.anchorTick);\n  const wantsEagle = !clustered && rng.chance(builder.level.deck.combos.catVsEagle);\n  const spanTicks = Math.max(...clings.map((cling, index) => index * rules.throwGapTicks + cling));\n  for (let attempt = 0; attempt < builder.settings.deck.placementAttempts; attempt += 1) {\n    const firstTick = chooseStart(builder, options, spanTicks);\n    const throws = firstTick === null ? [] : planThrows(builder, firstTick, clings);\n    if (throws.length >= Math.min(2, tracks.length)) {\n      const startMs = builder.tickStartMs(firstTick);\n      const endMs = Math.max(...throws.map((item) => (\n        builder.tickEndMs(item.tick + item.clingTicks - 1)\n      )));\n      if (builder.overlapAllows(startMs, endMs)) {\n        return commitCatLady(builder, {throws, side, wantsEagle, startMs, endMs, options});\n      }\n    }\n  }\n  return null;\n}\n\n/**\n * @description Registers the cat lady and her throws, and the eagle when the combo fits.\n * @param {Object} builder - The race builder.\n * @param {{throws: Array<Object>, side: string, wantsEagle: boolean, startMs: number,\n *   endMs: number, options: Object}} plan - The planned visit.\n * @returns {{id: string}} The cat lady's event.\n * @since 2.0.0\n */\nfunction commitCatLady(builder, plan) {\n  const interceptIndex = plan.wantsEagle && plan.throws.length >= 2 ? plan.throws.length - 1 : -1;\n  const throwData = plan.throws.map((item, index) => ({\n    atMs: builder.tickStartMs(item.tick),\n    entrant: item.track.index,\n    clingTicks: item.clingTicks,\n    intercepted: index === interceptIndex\n  }));\n  const {id, sequence} = builder.registerEvent({\n    type: 'catLady',\n    category: 'chaos',\n    scope: 'entrants',\n    outcome: null,\n    startMs: plan.startMs,\n    endMs: plan.endMs,\n    entrants: plan.throws.map((item) => item.track.index),\n    data: dataWithFinale({side: plan.side, throws: throwData}, plan.options)\n  });\n  const landCat = (item) => item.track.commit(item.tick, item.layout, {\n    eventId: id, sequence, category: 'chaos', personal: true, extra: {clingTicks: item.clingTicks}\n  });\n  plan.throws.forEach((item, index) => {\n    if (index !== interceptIndex) {\n      landCat(item);\n    }\n  });\n  if (interceptIndex >= 0 && !catchCat(builder, id, plan.throws[interceptIndex])) {\n    // No room for the eagle under the overlap cap: the last cat lands after all.\n    builder.patchEventData(id, {throws: throwData.map((item) => ({...item, intercepted: false}))});\n    landCat(plan.throws[interceptIndex]);\n  }\n  return {id, sequence};\n}\n\n/**\n * @description The UFO (contract § 4): beams two squirrels up, swaps their outfits and drops each\n *   on the other's tree, dazed 2 ticks.\n * @param {Object} builder - The race builder.\n * @param {Object} options - Placement options.\n * @returns {{id: string}|null} The placed event, or null.\n * @since 2.0.0\n */\nfunction placeUfo(builder, options) {\n  const rules = builder.settings.deck.ufo;\n  const {tickMs} = builder.settings;\n  if (builder.tracks.length < 2) {\n    return null;\n  }\n  const layout = layoutFrom([\n    {kind: effectKinds.stall, ticks: rules.beamTicks},\n    {kind: effectKinds.stall, ticks: rules.dazedTicks}\n  ]);\n  for (let attempt = 0; attempt < builder.settings.deck.placementAttempts; attempt += 1) {\n    const startTick = chooseStart(builder, options, layout.spanTicks);\n    if (startTick !== null) {\n      const free = builder.tracks.filter((track) => track.canPlace(startTick, layout));\n      const startMs = builder.tickStartMs(startTick);\n      const endMs = builder.tickEndMs(startTick + layout.spanTicks - 1);\n      if (free.length >= 2 && builder.overlapAllows(startMs, endMs)) {\n        const pair = builder.rng.shuffle(free).slice(0, 2);\n        return commitUfo(builder, {pair, startTick, startMs, endMs, layout, options, tickMs});\n      }\n    }\n  }\n  return null;\n}\n\n/**\n * @description Registers the UFO, stalls both squirrels, and records the tree swap (resolved in\n *   time order later) and the outfit swap halfway through the beam.\n * @param {Object} builder - The race builder.\n * @param {{pair: Object[], startTick: number, startMs: number, endMs: number, layout: Object,\n *   options: Object, tickMs: number}} plan - The planned abduction.\n * @returns {{id: string, sequence: number}} The event.\n * @since 2.0.0\n */\nfunction commitUfo(builder, plan) {\n  const rules = builder.settings.deck.ufo;\n  const members = plan.pair.map((track) => track.index);\n  const beamEndMs = plan.startMs + rules.beamTicks * plan.tickMs;\n  const swapAtMs = plan.startMs + Math.round((rules.beamTicks * plan.tickMs) / 2);\n  const {id, sequence} = builder.registerEvent({\n    type: 'ufo',\n    category: 'chaos',\n    scope: 'entrants',\n    outcome: null,\n    startMs: plan.startMs,\n    endMs: plan.endMs,\n    entrants: members,\n    data: dataWithFinale({swapOutfits: true, beamEndMs, swapAtMs, swaps: []}, plan.options)\n  });\n  plan.pair.forEach((track) => track.commit(plan.startTick, plan.layout, {\n    eventId: id, sequence, category: 'chaos', personal: true\n  }));\n  builder.addLaneOp({\n    eventId: id,\n    sequence,\n    startMs: plan.startMs,\n    flightEndMs: beamEndMs,\n    landingTick: plan.startTick + rules.beamTicks,\n    members,\n    permutation: [1, 0]\n  });\n  builder.addOutfitOp({\n    eventId: id, sequence, atMs: swapAtMs, kind: 'swap', entrants: members, note: 'none'\n  });\n  return {id, sequence};\n}\n\n/**\n * @description Tries start ticks for a field-wide stall (leaf blower, disco, VAR) until enough of\n *   the field is free and the overlap cap allows it.\n * @param {Object} builder - The race builder.\n * @param {Object} layout - The stall each joining squirrel gets.\n * @param {number} minPercent - The share of the field that must be free, whole percent.\n * @param {Object} options - Placement options.\n * @returns {{startTick: number, startMs: number, endMs: number, joining: Object[]}|null} Where\n *   it fits and who joins, or null.\n * @since 2.0.0\n */\nfunction findFieldSlot(builder, layout, minPercent, options) {\n  for (let attempt = 0; attempt < builder.settings.deck.placementAttempts; attempt += 1) {\n    const startTick = chooseStart(builder, options, layout.spanTicks);\n    if (startTick !== null) {\n      const joining = builder.tracks.filter((track) => track.canPlace(startTick, layout));\n      const startMs = builder.tickStartMs(startTick);\n      const endMs = builder.tickEndMs(startTick + layout.spanTicks - 1);\n      // Relaxed (the finale's top-up): it plays even when nobody is free to join in.\n      const enough = options.relaxed === true\n        || enoughOfField(joining.length, builder.tracks.length, minPercent);\n      if (enough && builder.overlapAllows(startMs, endMs)) {\n        return {startTick, startMs, endMs, joining};\n      }\n    }\n  }\n  return null;\n}\n\n/**\n * @description Registers a field event and commits its stall on every joining squirrel.\n * @param {Object} builder - The race builder.\n * @param {{type: string, slot: Object, layout: Object, data: Object, options: Object,\n *   personal?: number[]}} field - The event; personal lists squirrels it singles out.\n * @returns {{id: string, sequence: number}} The event.\n * @since 2.0.0\n */\nfunction commitFieldStall(builder, field) {\n  const singled = field.personal || [];\n  const {id, sequence} = builder.registerEvent({\n    type: field.type,\n    category: 'chaos',\n    scope: 'field',\n    outcome: null,\n    startMs: field.slot.startMs,\n    endMs: field.slot.endMs,\n    entrants: everyone(builder),\n    data: dataWithFinale(field.data, field.options)\n  });\n  field.slot.joining.forEach((track) => track.commit(field.slot.startTick, field.layout, {\n    eventId: id, sequence, category: 'chaos', personal: singled.includes(track.index)\n  }));\n  return {id, sequence};\n}\n\n/**\n * @description The leaf blower (contract § 4): every free squirrel clings sideways for 2 to 3\n *   stalled ticks; 1 or 2 of them lose their hats. Draws: cling length, hat-loss count, direction,\n *   then per attempt a start tick, then who loses a hat.\n * @param {Object} builder - The race builder.\n * @param {Object} options - Placement options.\n * @returns {{id: string}|null} The placed event, or null.\n * @since 2.0.0\n */\nfunction placeLeafBlower(builder, options) {\n  const {rng} = builder;\n  const rules = builder.settings.deck.leafBlower;\n  const clingTicks = rng.intBetween(rules.minClingTicks, rules.maxClingTicks);\n  const hatLossCount = rng.intBetween(rules.minHatLoss, rules.maxHatLoss);\n  const direction = rng.chance(0.5) ? 'ltr' : 'rtl';\n  const layout = layoutFrom([{kind: effectKinds.stall, ticks: clingTicks}]);\n  const slot = findFieldSlot(builder, layout, rules.minFieldPercent, options);\n  if (!slot) {\n    return null;\n  }\n  const hatted = slot.joining.filter((track) => builder.storedOutfit(track.index).hat !== 'none');\n  const losers = rng.shuffle(hatted).slice(0, hatLossCount).map((track) => track.index);\n  const event = commitFieldStall(builder, {\n    type: 'leafBlower',\n    slot,\n    layout,\n    data: {direction, clingTicks, hatLoss: losers, lostHats: []},\n    options,\n    personal: losers\n  });\n  if (losers.length > 0) {\n    builder.addOutfitOp({\n      eventId: event.id,\n      sequence: event.sequence,\n      atMs: slot.startMs + builder.settings.tickMs,\n      kind: 'hatOff',\n      entrants: losers,\n      note: 'hatLoss'\n    });\n  }\n  return event;\n}\n\n/**\n * @description The disco (contract § 4): every free squirrel stalls 2 s to dance.\n * @param {Object} builder - The race builder.\n * @param {Object} options - Placement options.\n * @returns {{id: string}|null} The placed event, or null.\n * @since 2.0.0\n */\nfunction placeDisco(builder, options) {\n  const rules = builder.settings.deck.disco;\n  const layout = layoutFrom([{kind: effectKinds.stall, ticks: rules.durationTicks}]);\n  const slot = findFieldSlot(builder, layout, rules.minFieldPercent, options);\n  if (!slot) {\n    return null;\n  }\n  return commitFieldStall(builder, {\n    type: 'disco', slot, layout, data: {durationTicks: rules.durationTicks}, options\n  });\n}\n\n/**\n * @description VAR (contract § 4): everyone freezes for 1.5 s while the owl checks for a nut\n *   infringement. Draws the verdict (a phrase key) first.\n * @param {Object} builder - The race builder.\n * @param {Object} options - Placement options.\n * @returns {{id: string}|null} The placed event, or null.\n * @since 2.0.0\n */\nfunction placeVar(builder, options) {\n  const rules = builder.settings.deck.var;\n  const verdicts = builder.settings.varVerdicts;\n  const verdict = verdicts.length > 0 ? builder.rng.pick(verdicts) : null;\n  const layout = layoutFrom([{kind: effectKinds.stall, ticks: rules.stallTicks}]);\n  const slot = findFieldSlot(builder, layout, rules.minFieldPercent, options);\n  if (!slot) {\n    return null;\n  }\n  return commitFieldStall(builder, {type: 'var', slot, layout, data: {verdict}, options});\n}\n\n/**\n * @description Tries start ticks for a field event that singles some squirrels out (earthquake,\n *   acorn hail): the visual window must fit the overlap cap and at least one squirrel must be\n *   free for the personal effect.\n * @param {Object} builder - The race builder.\n * @param {number} windowTicks - The event's visual length.\n * @param {Object} probe - The personal effect's layout.\n * @param {Object} options - Placement options.\n * @returns {{startTick: number, startMs: number, endMs: number, candidates: Object[]}|null} The\n *   slot, or null.\n * @since 2.0.0\n */\nfunction findSinglingSlot(builder, windowTicks, probe, options) {\n  for (let attempt = 0; attempt < builder.settings.deck.placementAttempts; attempt += 1) {\n    const startTick = chooseStart(builder, options, windowTicks);\n    if (startTick !== null) {\n      const startMs = builder.tickStartMs(startTick);\n      const endMs = builder.tickEndMs(startTick + windowTicks - 1);\n      const candidates = builder.tracks.filter((track) => track.canPlace(startTick, probe));\n      // Relaxed (the finale's top-up): it plays even when it can single nobody out.\n      const someone = candidates.length > 0 || options.relaxed === true;\n      if (someone && builder.overlapAllows(startMs, endMs)) {\n        return {startTick, startMs, endMs, candidates};\n      }\n    }\n  }\n  return null;\n}\n\n/**\n * @description The earthquake (contract § 4): the whole wood shakes; 2 to 4 free squirrels slip\n *   down 5 to 15 height units. Draws: slip count, then per attempt a start tick, then who slips\n *   and how far.\n * @param {Object} builder - The race builder.\n * @param {Object} options - Placement options.\n * @returns {{id: string}|null} The placed event, or null.\n * @since 2.0.0\n */\nfunction placeEarthquake(builder, options) {\n  const {rng} = builder;\n  const rules = builder.settings.deck.earthquake;\n  const slipCount = rng.intBetween(rules.minSlips, rules.maxSlips);\n  const slipLayout = (climb) => layoutFrom([\n    {kind: effectKinds.set, ticks: 1, value: climb},\n    {kind: effectKinds.idle, ticks: 1}\n  ]);\n  const slot = findSinglingSlot(builder, rules.shakeTicks, slipLayout(0), options);\n  if (!slot) {\n    return null;\n  }\n  const slipping = rng.shuffle(slot.candidates).slice(0, slipCount);\n  const units = slipping.map(() => rng.floatBetween(rules.minSlipUnits, rules.maxSlipUnits));\n  const {id, sequence} = builder.registerEvent({\n    type: 'earthquake',\n    category: 'chaos',\n    scope: 'field',\n    outcome: null,\n    startMs: slot.startMs,\n    endMs: slot.endMs,\n    entrants: everyone(builder),\n    data: dataWithFinale({\n      slips: slipping.map((track) => track.index),\n      slipUnits: units.map((value) => roundTo(value, 2)),\n      shakeTicks: rules.shakeTicks\n    }, options)\n  });\n  slipping.forEach((track, order) => {\n    const extra = {slipUnits: roundTo(units[order], 2)};\n    track.commit(slot.startTick, slipLayout(-unitsToClimb(builder, track, units[order])), {\n      eventId: id, sequence, category: 'chaos', personal: true, extra\n    });\n  });\n  return {id, sequence};\n}\n\n/**\n * @description Acorn hail (contract § 4): nuts pelt down; 2 to 4 free squirrels stuff their\n *   cheeks and climb at 60% for 3 to 5 ticks. Draws: chubby count, slow length, then per attempt\n *   a start tick, then who gets chubby.\n * @param {Object} builder - The race builder.\n * @param {Object} options - Placement options.\n * @returns {{id: string}|null} The placed event, or null.\n * @since 2.0.0\n */\nfunction placeAcornHail(builder, options) {\n  const {rng} = builder;\n  const rules = builder.settings.deck.acornHail;\n  const chubbyCount = rng.intBetween(rules.minChubby, rules.maxChubby);\n  const slowTicks = rng.intBetween(rules.minSlowTicks, rules.maxSlowTicks);\n  const layout = layoutFrom([{kind: effectKinds.scale, ticks: slowTicks, value: rules.slowPace}]);\n  const slot = findSinglingSlot(builder, rules.hailTicks, layout, options);\n  if (!slot) {\n    return null;\n  }\n  const chubby = rng.shuffle(slot.candidates).slice(0, chubbyCount);\n  const {id, sequence} = builder.registerEvent({\n    type: 'acornHail',\n    category: 'chaos',\n    scope: 'field',\n    outcome: null,\n    startMs: slot.startMs,\n    endMs: slot.endMs,\n    entrants: everyone(builder),\n    data: dataWithFinale({chubby: chubby.map((track) => track.index), slowTicks}, options)\n  });\n  chubby.forEach((track) => track.commit(slot.startTick, layout, {\n    eventId: id, sequence, category: 'chaos', personal: true\n  }));\n  return {id, sequence};\n}\n\n/**\n * @description The flood (contract § 4): the water rises over the field. 1);\n      if (builder.overlapAllows(startMs, endMs)) {\n        const {id, sequence} = builder.registerEvent({\n          type: 'flood',\n          category: 'chaos',\n          scope: 'field',\n          outcome: null,\n          startMs,\n          endMs,\n          entrants: everyone(builder),\n          // burstAtMs: the moment the waterline is checked; bursts start then.\n          data: dataWithFinale({\n            waterHeightUnits: waterUnits,\n            bursters: [],\n            burstAtMs: builder.tickStartMs(startTick + rules.burstDelayTicks)\n          }, options)\n        });\n        builder.addPendingFlood({\n          eventId: id,\n          sequence,\n          burstStartTick: startTick + rules.burstDelayTicks,\n          waterUnits\n        });\n        return {id, sequence};\n      }\n    }\n  }\n  return null;\n}\n\n// One placer per event type the deck, clusters and finale can ask for by name.\nconst placers = {\n  hunter: (builder, options) => placeSingle(builder, hunterSpec(builder), options),\n  suitor: (builder, options) => placeSingle(builder, suitorSpec(builder, null), options),\n  eagle: (builder, options) => placeSingle(builder, eagleSpec(builder), options),\n  beaver: (builder, options) => placeSingle(builder, stallSpec(builder, 'beaver', null), options),\n  lightning: (builder, options) => (\n    placeSingle(builder, stallSpec(builder, 'lightning', null), options)\n  ),\n  woodpecker: (builder, options) => (\n    placeSingle(builder, stallSpec(builder, 'woodpecker', null), options)\n  ),\n  catLady: placeCatLady,\n  ufo: placeUfo,\n  leafBlower: placeLeafBlower,\n  earthquake: placeEarthquake,\n  flood: placeFlood,\n  disco: placeDisco,\n  acornHail: placeAcornHail,\n  var: placeVar\n};\n\n/**\n * @description Places one event of a named type (see the module notes for the options).\n * @param {Object} builder - Member m lands on the tree member result[m] left, which is never its own.\n * @param {Object} rng - The race generator.\n * @param {number} count - Lifted squirrels (at least two).\n * @returns {number[]} A derangement of 0 to count - 1.\n * @since 1.0.0\n */\nfunction derangement(rng, count) {\n  const result = Array.from({length: count}, (_value, slot) => slot);\n  for (let index = result.length - 1; index > 0; index -= 1) {\n    const swapWith = rng.intBetween(0, index - 1);\n    const held = result[index];\n    result[index] = result[swapWith];\n    result[swapWith] = held;\n  }\n  return result;\n}\n\n/**\n * @description The eagleIntoFunnel combo: one lifted squirrel is carried up by an eagle in the\n *   ticks just before the funnel arrives and dropped straight into it.\n * @param {Object} builder - kissTicks;\n  const layout = layoutFrom([{kind: effectKinds.stall, ticks: kissTicks}]);\n  const candidates = tornado.lifted.filter((track) => (\n    track.index !== carried && track.canPlace(startTick, layout)\n  ));\n  const startMs = builder.tickStartMs(startTick);\n  if (candidates.length === 0 || !builder.overlapAllows(startMs, tornado.startMs)) {\n    return;\n  }\n  const track = builder.rng.pick(candidates);\n  const {id, sequence} = builder.registerEvent({\n    type: 'suitor',\n    category: 'chaos',\n    scope: 'entrants',\n    outcome: 'kiss',\n    startMs,\n    endMs: tornado.startMs,\n    entrants: [track.index],\n    data: {lipstick: true, combo: {kind: 'suitorSwept', with: tornado.id}}\n  });\n  track.commit(startTick, layout, {eventId: id, sequence, category: 'chaos', personal: true});\n}\n\n/**\n * @description The hunterVsTornado combo: a hunter fires at the funnel during its flight and it\n *   spits the cow back at him. The race builder.\n * @param {number} earliestTick - The earliest arrival tick.\n * @param {number} latestTick - The latest arrival tick.\n * @returns {{startMs: number, endMs: number}|null} The placed tornado, or null.\n * @since 1.0.0\n */\nfunction tryTornado(builder, earliestTick, latestTick) {\n  if (earliestTick > latestTick) {\n    return null;\n  }\n  const rules = builder.settings.deck.tornado;\n  const probe = tornadoLayout(builder, 0);\n  for (let attempt = 0; attempt < builder.settings.deck.placementAttempts; attempt += 1) {\n    const startTick = builder.rng.intBetween(earliestTick, latestTick) + 1;\n    const free = builder.tracks.filter((track) => track.canPlace(startTick, probe));\n    const startMs = builder.tickStartMs(startTick);\n    const endMs = builder.tickEndMs(startTick + probe.spanTicks - 1);\n    if (free.length >= rules.minLifted && builder.overlapAllows(startMs, endMs)) {\n      return liftSquirrels(builder, free, startTick);\n    }\n  }\n  return null;\n}\n\n/**\n * @description Places one tornado, and at the level's chance a second one after the first has\n *   landed, both arriving between 25% and 70% of the race (three or more entrants only).\n * @param {Object} builder - The race builder.\n * @returns {void}\n * @example\n *   placeTornadoes(builder);\n * @since 1.0.0\n */\nexport function placeTornadoes(builder) {\n  const rules = builder.settings.deck.tornado;\n  if (builder.tracks.length < rules.minEntrants) {\n    return;\n  }\n  const {tickMs} = builder.settings;\n  const tornadoCount = builder.rng.chance(builder.level.deck.tornadoSecondChance) ? 2 : 1;\n  // Integer arithmetic keeps the arrival inside 25% to 70% of durationMs exactly.\n  const latestTick = Math.floor((builder.durationMs * rules.latestPercent) / (100 * tickMs));\n  let earliestTick = Math.ceil((builder.durationMs * rules.earliestPercent) / (100 * tickMs));\n  for (let round = 0; round < tornadoCount; round += 1) {\n    const placed = tryTornado(builder, earliestTick, latestTick);\n    if (!placed) {\n      return;\n    }\n    earliestTick = Math.ceil((placed.endMs + rules.spacingMs) / tickMs);\n  }\n}\n","/**\n * The Chaos deck for one race (SPEC.md § 10, Chaos v2 contract § 1 and § 4): lays the level's\n * events on top of the Classic race. Silly and Absolute Carnage: per squirrel still without a moment of its own, a woodpecker,\n *      lightning or beaver, tried on the curve and then anywhere in its window.\n * The late events (Golden Acorn, trench coat, flood bursts) follow in chaos-late.js.\n *\n * Pure ES module: no DOM, no Lit and no platform imports.\n */\nimport {placeTornadoes} from './chaos-tornado.js';\nimport {placeEvent, placeSingle, stallSpec, suitorSpec} from './chaos-events.js';\n\n// Field events come last, so they join in around the squirrels already busy.\nconst CURVE_ORDER = [\n  'eagle',\n  'beaver',\n  'lightning',\n  'woodpecker',\n  'catLady',\n  'ufo',\n  'leafBlower',\n  'earthquake',\n  'flood',\n  'disco',\n  'acornHail',\n  'var'\n];\n\n// The \"every squirrel\" pass tries these short personal gags, in this order.\nconst COVERAGE_ORDER = ['woodpecker', 'lightning', 'beaver'];\n\n// Field events that need no free squirrel when relaxed, so the finale always reaches its\n// minimum. Five types cover the worst case, a cluster that placed nothing.\nconst FINALE_TOP_UP = ['flood', 'earthquake', 'acornHail', 'disco', 'var'];\n\n/**\n * @description A whole-percent share of the race as a tick, rounded up or down.\n * @param {Object} builder - The race builder.\n * @param {number} percent - Whole percent of durationMs.\n * @param {boolean} roundUp - True to round up.\n * @returns {number} The tick.\n * @since 2.0.0\n */\nfunction tickAtPercent(builder, percent, roundUp) {\n  const exact = (builder.durationMs * percent) / (100 * builder.settings.tickMs);\n  return roundUp ? Math.ceil(exact) : Math.floor(exact);\n}\n\n/**\n * @description Places a cluster of events that all cover the tick after the anchor, so they are\n *   on screen together (contract § 1).\n * @param {Object} builder - The race builder.\n * @param {{size: number, anchorTick: number, startRange?: Object, finale?: boolean}} cluster -\n *   How many, where, and whether they belong to the finale burst.\n * @returns {string[]} The placed event ids.\n * @since 2.0.0\n */\nfunction placeCluster(builder, cluster) {\n  const {deck} = builder.settings;\n  const types = Object.keys(deck.clusterWeights);\n  const weights = types.map((type) => deck.clusterWeights[type]);\n  const options = {\n    anchorTick: cluster.anchorTick,\n    startRange: cluster.startRange,\n    finale: cluster.finale === true\n  };\n  const placed = [];\n  for (let slot = 0; slot < cluster.size; slot += 1) {\n    for (let attempt = 0; attempt < deck.finaleSlotAttempts; attempt += 1) {\n      const result = placeEvent(builder, types[builder.rng.weightedIndex(weights)], options);\n      if (result) {\n        placed.push(result.id);\n        break;\n      }\n    }\n  }\n  return placed;\n}\n\n/**\n * @description The Absolute Carnage finale burst: several events sharing one moment between 78%\n *   and 84% of the race, every one starting between 75% and 88%.\n * @param {Object} builder - The race builder.\n * @param {Object} finale - The level's finale settings.\n * @returns {void}\n * @since 2.0.0\n */\nfunction placeFinaleBurst(builder, finale) {\n  const low = tickAtPercent(builder, finale.anchorFromPercent, true);\n  const high = Math.max(low, tickAtPercent(builder, finale.anchorToPercent, false));\n  const anchorTick = builder.rng.intBetween(low, high);\n  // A start tick s begins at (s - 1) x tickMs, hence the + 1 on both ends.\n  const startRange = {\n    fromTick: tickAtPercent(builder, finale.fromPercent, true) + 1,\n    toTick: tickAtPercent(builder, finale.toPercent, false) + 1\n  };\n  const clustered = placeCluster(builder, {\n    size: finale.size, anchorTick, startRange, finale: true\n  });\n  const eventIds = topUpFinale(builder, anchorTick, clustered, finale.minEvents);\n  builder.setFinale({anchorMs: anchorTick * builder.settings.tickMs, eventIds});\n}\n\n/**\n * @description Guarantees the finale burst (contract § 1: Absolute Carnage has one in every race):\n *   while the cluster has fewer than the minimum, adds relaxed field events starting on the tick\n *   after the anchor. That moment comes after any tornado has landed and before the pile-up and\n *   the curve events are placed, so only finale events are on screen then: adding the fourth\n *   makes at most four, inside the cap of five. Relaxed events touch only squirrels with room,\n *   so the quiet zone and the stall cap hold.\n * @param {Object} builder - The race builder.\n * @param {number} anchorTick - The finale's anchor tick.\n * @param {string[]} placed - Ids the cluster placed.\n * @param {number} minEvents - Events needed to count as a finale.\n * @returns {string[]} Every finale event id.\n * @since 2.0.0\n */\nfunction topUpFinale(builder, anchorTick, placed, minEvents) {\n  const eventIds = placed.slice();\n  const options = {\n    startRange: {fromTick: anchorTick + 1, toTick: anchorTick + 1},\n    finale: true,\n    relaxed: true\n  };\n  FINALE_TOP_UP.forEach((type) => {\n    if (eventIds.length < minEvents) {\n      const result = placeEvent(builder, type, options);\n      if (result) {\n        eventIds.push(result.id);\n      }\n    }\n  });\n  return eventIds;\n}\n\n/**\n * @description The Silly and Absolute Carnage pile-up on the intensity plateau.\n * @param {Object} builder - The race builder.\n * @param {Object} peak - The level's peak-cluster settings.\n * @returns {void}\n * @since 2.0.0\n */\nfunction placePeakCluster(builder, peak) {\n  const low = tickAtPercent(builder, peak.anchorFromPercent, true);\n  const high = Math.max(low, tickAtPercent(builder, peak.anchorToPercent, false));\n  placeCluster(builder, {size: peak.size, anchorTick: builder.rng.intBetween(low, high)});\n}\n\n/**\n * @description Sends in the level's hunters.\n * @param {Object} builder - The race builder.\n * @returns {void}\n * @since 1.0.0\n */\nfunction placeHunters(builder) {\n  const hunterCount = builder.rng.weightedIndex(builder.level.deck.hunterCountWeights);\n  for (let hunter = 0; hunter < hunterCount; hunter += 1) {\n    placeEvent(builder, 'hunter');\n  }\n}\n\n/**\n * @description Gives each squirrel the level's chance of a suitor, up to a third of the field.\n *   Every squirrel rolls once, in input order; the cap only stops further placements. The chance\n *   halves above 30 entrants.\n * @param {Object} builder - The race builder.\n * @returns {void}\n * @since 1.0.0\n */\nfunction placeSuitors(builder) {\n  const {rng, tracks} = builder;\n  const {deck} = builder.settings;\n  const crowded = tracks.length > deck.crowdedFieldAbove ? deck.crowdedChanceFactor : 1;\n  const chance = builder.level.deck.suitorChance * crowded;\n  const cap = Math.floor(tracks.length / deck.suitor.fieldDivisor);\n  let placed = 0;\n  tracks.forEach((track) => {\n    const smitten = rng.chance(chance);\n    if (smitten && placed < cap && placeSingle(builder, suitorSpec(builder, track))) {\n      placed += 1;\n    }\n  });\n}\n\n/**\n * @description Rolls every other event at the level's chance and places the ones that come up.\n * @param {Object} builder - The race builder.\n * @returns {void}\n * @since 2.0.0\n */\nfunction placeCurveEvents(builder) {\n  const {chances} = builder.level.deck;\n  const {lightning} = builder.settings.deck;\n  CURVE_ORDER.forEach((type) => {\n    const chance = chances[type] || 0;\n    const strikeTwice = type === 'lightning' && builder.durationMs >= lightning.secondStrikeFromMs;\n    const rolls = strikeTwice ? 2 : 1;\n    for (let roll = 0; roll < rolls; roll += 1) {\n      if (chance > 0 && builder.rng.chance(chance)) {\n        placeEvent(builder, type);\n      }\n    }\n  });\n}\n\n/**\n * @description Gives every squirrel without a Chaos moment of its own a short personal gag: on\n *   the intensity curve first, then anywhere in its event window.\n * @param {Object} builder - The race builder.\n * @returns {void}\n * @since 2.0.0\n */\nfunction placeCoverage(builder) {\n  const attempts = builder.settings.deck.coverageAttempts;\n  builder.tracks.forEach((track) => {\n    let covered = track.hasPersonalChaos();\n    COVERAGE_ORDER.forEach((type) => {\n      if (covered) {\n        return;\n      }\n      const spec = stallSpec(builder, type, track);\n      const layout = spec.layoutFor(track);\n      const startRange = {fromTick: track.earliestEventTick, toTick: track.latestStart(layout)};\n      covered = Boolean(placeSingle(builder, spec, {attempts})\n        || placeSingle(builder, spec, {attempts, startRange}));\n    });\n  });\n}\n\n/**\n * @description Lays the level's whole Chaos deck onto a race whose Classic layer is placed, in\n *   the generator order documented at the top of this module.\n * @param {Object} builder - The race builder (see race-builder.js), with its level set.\n * @returns {void}\n * @example\n *   if (mode === 'chaos') placeChaosEvents(builder);\n * @since 1.0.0\n */\nexport function placeChaosEvents(builder) {\n  const {level} = builder;\n  placeTornadoes(builder);\n  if (level.finale) {\n    placeFinaleBurst(builder, level.finale);\n  }\n  if (level.peakCluster) {\n    placePeakCluster(builder, level.peakCluster);\n  }\n  placeHunters(builder);\n  placeSuitors(builder);\n  placeCurveEvents(builder);\n  if (level.everySquirrel) {\n    placeCoverage(builder);\n  }\n}\n","/**\n * The late (second-pass) Chaos events (Chaos v2 contract § 4): the ones that depend on heights,\n * so they can only be decided once the first pass has built every squirrel's climb.\n * - goldenAcorn: at fixed checkpoints, a leader ahead of second place by the level's threshold\n *   (15 height units, 10 in Absolute Carnage) is smacked: a fall of 20% to 30% of its height and\n *   2 dizzy ticks. At most one every 10 s; never in the quiet zone.\n * - trenchCoat: three squirrels on adjacent trees within 15 height units of each other disguise\n *   themselves as one tall squirrel on the middle tree, then topple back to their own trees.\n * - flood bursts: squirrels below the waterline when the water rises get a 3-tick burst.\n *\n * How it stays exact and deterministic. Pass one fixes each squirrel's normaliser (its final\n * running total). Candidates are visited in time order, and a late event at tick c changes only\n * ticks after c: its own span, plus a compensation that reshapes the squirrel's later free ticks\n * (between the event and the quiet zone) so its final total is unchanged. With the normaliser\n * and every earlier total unchanged, every height up to c is exactly what the decision saw, so\n * the finished plan shows the same lead (or the same trio) at that moment, and a later late event\n * can never undo an earlier decision. An event whose compensation would need too strong a boost\n * is dropped. This replaces the contract's \"insert and renormalise\" with a renormalisation that\n * leaves the past alone; the squirrel still finishes exactly on its stored time.\n *\n * Generator order: candidates in time order (floods before checkpoints on the same tick); per\n * checkpoint the acorn's fall size (only when its threshold and room are met), then the trench\n * coat's chance roll (only when a trio qualifies), trio pick and disguise length.\n *\n * Pure ES module: no DOM, no Lit and no platform imports.\n */\nimport {effectKinds, layoutFrom} from './race-builder.js';\nimport {preFinishHeight, totalsFor} from './climb.js';\nimport {roundTo} from './chaos-events.js';\n\n// Relative error allowed between a compensated final total and the fixed normaliser.\nconst TOLERANCE = 1e-9;\n// Newton steps for the compensation; one is exact unless a running total hits the 0 floor.\nconst COMPENSATION_STEPS = 3;\n\n/**\n * @description A squirrel's height at a tick, exactly as the finished plan will show it.\n * @param {Object} builder - The race builder.\n * @param {Object} track - The squirrel's track.\n * @param {number} tick - The tick.\n * @returns {number} The height, 0 to 100.\n * @since 2.0.0\n */\nfunction heightAtTick(builder, track, tick) {\n  if (tick >= track.tickCount) {\n    return 100;\n  }\n  return preFinishHeight(track.totalAt(tick), track.normaliser(), builder.settings);\n}\n\n/**\n * @description Tries a late event's layout on a copy of the squirrel's ticks and works out the\n *   compensation that keeps its final total equal to its normaliser.\n * @param {Object} builder - The race builder.\n * @param {Object} track - The squirrel's track.\n * @param {number} startTick - Where the layout starts.\n * @param {Object} layout - The late event's layout.\n * @returns {{boosts: number[], totals: number[]}|null} The accepted boosts and totals, or null\n *   when the compensation is impossible or out of bounds.\n * @since 2.0.0\n */\nfunction compensate(builder, track, startTick, layout) {\n  const rules = builder.settings.deck.compensation;\n  const effects = track.effectsCopy();\n  layout.effects.forEach((effect) => {\n    effects[startTick + effect.offset] = {kind: effect.kind, value: effect.value};\n  });\n  const free = [];\n  for (let tick = startTick + layout.spanTicks; tick <= track.lastEventTick; tick += 1) {\n    if (!effects[tick]) {\n      free.push(tick);\n    }\n  }\n  if (free.length < rules.minFreeTicks) {\n    return null;\n  }\n  const base = track.baseClimbs();\n  const target = track.normaliser();\n  const last = track.tickCount;\n  const boosts = track.boostsCopy();\n  let totals = totalsFor(base, effects, boosts);\n  for (let step = 0; step < COMPENSATION_STEPS; step += 1) {\n    const residual = target - totals[last];\n    if (Math.abs(residual) <= TOLERANCE * target) {\n      break;\n    }\n    // The final total is linear in a common factor on the free ticks' boosts, so doubling them\n    // measures the slope and one step lands on the target.\n    const doubled = boosts.slice();\n    free.forEach((tick) => {\n      doubled[tick] = boosts[tick] * 2;\n    });\n    const slope = totalsFor(base, effects, doubled)[last] - totals[last];\n    const factor = slope > 0 ? 1 + residual / slope : 0;\n    if (!(factor > 0)) {\n      return null;\n    }\n    free.forEach((tick) => {\n      boosts[tick] *= factor;\n    });\n    totals = totalsFor(base, effects, boosts);\n  }\n  const settled = Math.abs(target - totals[last]) <= TOLERANCE * target;\n  const bounded = free.every((tick) => (\n    boosts[tick] >= rules.minBoost && boosts[tick] <= rules.maxBoost\n  ));\n  return settled && bounded ? {boosts, totals} : null;\n}\n\n/**\n * @description Commits a late event's span on a squirrel together with its compensation.\n * @param {Object} track - The squirrel's track.\n * @param {number} startTick - Where the layout starts.\n * @param {Object} layout - The layout.\n * @param {{boosts: number[], totals: number[]}} trial - From compensate.\n * @param {{eventId: string, sequence: number, extra?: Object}} info - The event.\n * @returns {void}\n * @since 2.0.0\n */\nfunction applyTrial(track, startTick, layout, trial, info) {\n  track.commit(startTick, layout, {...info, category: 'chaos', personal: true});\n  track.setBoosts(trial.boosts);\n  track.setTotals(trial.totals);\n}\n\n/**\n * @description The moments the late pass visits, in time order: each pending flood at the tick\n *   before its burst, then the Golden Acorn and trench-coat checkpoints.\n * @param {Object} builder - The race builder.\n * @returns {Array<{kind: string, tick: number, flood?: Object}>} The candidates.\n * @since 2.0.0\n */\nfunction lateCandidates(builder) {\n  const {level, settings} = builder;\n  const rules = settings.deck.goldenAcorn;\n  const candidates = builder.pendingFloods().map((flood) => ({\n    kind: 'flood', tick: flood.burstStartTick - 1, order: 0, sequence: flood.sequence, flood\n  }));\n  if (level.deck.goldenAcorn || level.deck.trenchCoatMax > 0) {\n    const step = Math.max(1, Math.round(rules.checkpointMs / settings.tickMs));\n    const from = Math.ceil((builder.durationMs * rules.fromPercent) / (100 * settings.tickMs));\n    const to = Math.floor((builder.durationMs * rules.toPercent) / (100 * settings.tickMs));\n    for (let tick = from; tick <= to; tick += step) {\n      candidates.push({kind: 'checkpoint', tick, order: 1, sequence: 0});\n    }\n  }\n  return candidates.sort((left, right) => (\n    left.tick - right.tick || left.order - right.order || left.sequence - right.sequence\n  ));\n}\n\n/**\n * @description The Golden Acorn's layout: the fall, then the dizzy ticks.\n * @param {Object} rules - The deck's goldenAcorn settings.\n * @param {number} fallFraction - The share of the running total lost.\n * @returns {Object} The layout.\n * @since 2.0.0\n */\nfunction acornLayout(rules, fallFraction) {\n  return layoutFrom([\n    {kind: effectKinds.fallFraction, ticks: 1, value: fallFraction},\n    {kind: effectKinds.stall, ticks: rules.dizzyTicks}\n  ]);\n}\n\n/**\n * @description Checks the Golden Acorn at one checkpoint and smacks the leader when it is clear\n *   of second place by the level's threshold (ties go to the lower input index, as leaderAt).\n * @param {Object} builder - The race builder.\n * @param {number} tick - The checkpoint tick (the impact is the tick after).\n * @returns {boolean} True when the acorn struck.\n * @since 2.0.0\n */\nfunction tryGoldenAcorn(builder, tick) {\n  const {tracks, level, settings} = builder;\n  const rules = settings.deck.goldenAcorn;\n  const ranked = tracks\n    .map((track) => ({track, height: heightAtTick(builder, track, tick)}))\n    .sort((left, right) => right.height - left.height || left.track.index - right.track.index);\n  const lead = ranked[0].height - ranked[1].height;\n  const leader = ranked[0].track;\n  const startTick = tick + 1;\n  const probe = acornLayout(rules, rules.minFallFraction);\n  const startMs = builder.tickStartMs(startTick);\n  const endMs = builder.tickEndMs(startTick + probe.spanTicks - 1);\n  if (lead < level.goldenAcornLeadUnits || !leader.canPlace(startTick, probe)\n    || !builder.overlapAllows(startMs, endMs)) {\n    return false;\n  }\n  const fallFraction = builder.rng.floatBetween(rules.minFallFraction, rules.maxFallFraction);\n  const layout = acornLayout(rules, fallFraction);\n  const trial = compensate(builder, leader, startTick, layout);\n  if (!trial) {\n    return false;\n  }\n  const leaderLane = leader.laneAt(startMs).lane;\n  // The acorn homes in from the far side of the field.\n  const fromLane = leaderLane - 1 < tracks.length - leaderLane ? tracks.length : 1;\n  const {id, sequence} = builder.registerEvent({\n    type: 'goldenAcorn',\n    category: 'chaos',\n    scope: 'entrants',\n    outcome: 'hit',\n    startMs,\n    endMs,\n    entrants: [leader.index],\n    data: {\n      fromLane,\n      impactMs: startMs,\n      checkpointMs: tick * settings.tickMs,\n      leadUnits: roundTo(lead, 4),\n      thresholdUnits: level.goldenAcornLeadUnits,\n      fallPercent: roundTo(fallFraction * 100, 1)\n    }\n  });\n  applyTrial(leader, startTick, layout, trial, {eventId: id, sequence});\n  return true;\n}\n\n/**\n * @description The trios that could put on the trench coat at a checkpoint: three squirrels on\n *   adjacent trees, none flying or hidden, within the height gap, and all free.\n * @param {Object} builder - The race builder.\n * @param {number} tick - The checkpoint tick.\n * @param {Object} probe - The shortest coat layout.\n * @returns {Array<Object[]>} Trios as [left, host, right] tracks.\n * @since 2.0.0\n */\nfunction coatTrios(builder, tick, probe) {\n  const rules = builder.settings.deck.trenchCoat;\n  const startTick = tick + 1;\n  const startMs = builder.tickStartMs(startTick);\n  const byLane = new Map();\n  builder.tracks.forEach((track) => {\n    const where = track.laneAt(startMs);\n    if (!where.flight && !where.hidden) {\n      byLane.set(where.lane, track);\n    }\n  });\n  const trios = [];\n  for (let lane = 2; lane < builder.tracks.length; lane += 1) {\n    const trio = [byLane.get(lane - 1), byLane.get(lane), byLane.get(lane + 1)];\n    if (trio.every(Boolean)) {\n      const heights = trio.map((track) => heightAtTick(builder, track, tick));\n      const gap = Math.max(...heights) - Math.min(...heights);\n      const free = trio.every((track) => track.canPlace(startTick, probe));\n      if (gap <= rules.maxHeightGapUnits && free) {\n        trios.push(trio);\n      }\n    }\n  }\n  return trios;\n}\n\n/**\n * @description The trench coat's layout: the disguise, then the dazed topple.\n * @param {Object} rules - The deck's trenchCoat settings.\n * @param {number} disguiseTicks - How long the disguise holds.\n * @returns {Object} The layout.\n * @since 2.0.0\n */\nfunction coatLayout(rules, disguiseTicks) {\n  return layoutFrom([\n    {kind: effectKinds.stall, ticks: disguiseTicks},\n    {kind: effectKinds.stall, ticks: rules.dazedTicks}\n  ]);\n}\n\n/**\n * @description Records the outer two squirrels' trip onto the host's tree (hidden inside the coat)\n *   and their topple back. The only time a tree holds more than one racer (contract § 4).\n * @param {Object} builder - The race builder.\n * @param {{id: string, outer: Object[], ownLanes: number[], hostLane: number, startTick: number,\n *   disguiseTicks: number}} coat - The coat.\n * @returns {void}\n * @since 2.0.0\n */\nfunction disguiseLanes(builder, coat) {\n  const rules = builder.settings.deck.trenchCoat;\n  const startMs = builder.tickStartMs(coat.startTick);\n  const toppleTick = coat.startTick + coat.disguiseTicks;\n  coat.outer.forEach((track, slot) => {\n    track.addLaneChange({\n      eventId: coat.id,\n      kind: 'disguise',\n      tick: coat.startTick,\n      fromLane: coat.ownLanes[slot],\n      toLane: coat.hostLane,\n      flightStartMs: startMs,\n      flightEndMs: startMs,\n      hidden: true\n    });\n    track.addLaneChange({\n      eventId: coat.id,\n      kind: 'topple',\n      tick: toppleTick,\n      fromLane: coat.hostLane,\n      toLane: coat.ownLanes[slot],\n      flightStartMs: builder.tickStartMs(toppleTick),\n      flightEndMs: builder.tickEndMs(toppleTick + rules.dazedTicks - 1),\n      hidden: false\n    });\n  });\n}\n\n/**\n * @description Checks the trench coat at one checkpoint and, at the level's chance, dresses a\n *   qualifying trio.\n * @param {Object} builder - The race builder.\n * @param {number} tick - The checkpoint tick (the disguise starts the tick after).\n * @returns {boolean} True when a coat went on.\n * @since 2.0.0\n */\nfunction tryTrenchCoat(builder, tick) {\n  const {rng, level, settings} = builder;\n  const rules = settings.deck.trenchCoat;\n  if (builder.tracks.length < 3) {\n    return false;\n  }\n  const trios = coatTrios(builder, tick, coatLayout(rules, rules.minDisguiseTicks));\n  if (trios.length === 0 || !rng.chance(level.deck.trenchCoatChance)) {\n    return false;\n  }\n  const trio = rng.pick(trios);\n  const disguiseTicks = rng.intBetween(rules.minDisguiseTicks, rules.maxDisguiseTicks);\n  const layout = coatLayout(rules, disguiseTicks);\n  const startTick = tick + 1;\n  const startMs = builder.tickStartMs(startTick);\n  const endMs = builder.tickEndMs(startTick + layout.spanTicks - 1);\n  const fits = trio.every((track) => track.canPlace(startTick, layout));\n  const trials = fits ? trio.map((track) => compensate(builder, track, startTick, layout)) : [];\n  if (!fits || trials.some((trial) => trial === null) || !builder.overlapAllows(startMs, endMs)) {\n    return false;\n  }\n  const [left, host, right] = trio;\n  const ownLanes = [left, right].map((track) => track.laneAt(startMs).lane);\n  const hostLane = host.laneAt(startMs).lane;\n  const {id, sequence} = builder.registerEvent({\n    type: 'trenchCoat',\n    category: 'chaos',\n    scope: 'entrants',\n    outcome: null,\n    startMs,\n    endMs,\n    entrants: trio.map((track) => track.index),\n    data: {host: host.index, hidden: [left.index, right.index], hostLane, disguiseTicks}\n  });\n  trio.forEach((track, slot) => {\n    applyTrial(track, startTick, layout, trials[slot], {eventId: id, sequence});\n  });\n  disguiseLanes(builder, {id, outer: [left, right], ownLanes, hostLane, startTick, disguiseTicks});\n  return true;\n}\n\n/**\n * @description The flood's bursts: every squirrel below the waterline at the tick before the burst\n *   (and free for it) gets a 3-tick burst upwards.\n * @param {Object} builder - The race builder.\n * @param {{tick: number, flood: {eventId: string, sequence: number, burstStartTick: number,\n *   waterUnits: number}}} candidate - The flood candidate.\n * @returns {void}\n * @since 2.0.0\n */\nfunction applyFlood(builder, candidate) {\n  const rules = builder.settings.deck.flood;\n  const {flood} = candidate;\n  const layout = layoutFrom([\n    {kind: effectKinds.scale, ticks: rules.burstTicks, value: rules.burstMultiplier}\n  ]);\n  const below = builder.tracks.filter((track) => (\n    heightAtTick(builder, track, candidate.tick) < flood.waterUnits\n    && track.canPlace(flood.burstStartTick, layout)\n  ));\n  const bursters = [];\n  below.forEach((track) => {\n    const trial = compensate(builder, track, flood.burstStartTick, layout);\n    if (trial) {\n      applyTrial(track, flood.burstStartTick, layout, trial, {\n        eventId: flood.eventId, sequence: flood.sequence\n      });\n      bursters.push(track.index);\n    }\n  });\n  builder.patchEventData(flood.eventId, {bursters});\n}\n\n/**\n * @description Runs the late pass. Call it after every squirrel's totals and normaliser are set\n *   from pass one, and after lanes are resolved.\n * @param {Object} builder - The race builder, with its level set.\n * @returns {void}\n * @example\n *   placeLateEvents(builder);\n * @since 2.0.0\n */\nexport function placeLateEvents(builder) {\n  const {level, settings} = builder;\n  const minGapTicks = Math.round(settings.deck.goldenAcorn.minGapMs / settings.tickMs);\n  let lastAcornTick = null;\n  let trenchCoats = 0;\n  lateCandidates(builder).forEach((candidate) => {\n    if (candidate.kind === 'flood') {\n      applyFlood(builder, candidate);\n      return;\n    }\n    const acornDue = level.deck.goldenAcorn && builder.tracks.length >= 2\n      && (lastAcornTick === null || candidate.tick - lastAcornTick >= minGapTicks);\n    if (acornDue && tryGoldenAcorn(builder, candidate.tick)) {\n      lastAcornTick = candidate.tick;\n    }\n    if (trenchCoats < level.deck.trenchCoatMax && tryTrenchCoat(builder, candidate.tick)) {\n      trenchCoats += 1;\n    }\n  });\n}\n","/**\n * Race choreography (SPEC.md § 11, Chaos v2 contract § 3): turns a stored result into a race that\n * finishes in exactly that order, and the same inputs always give the same race.\n *\n * How the order is guaranteed: each entrant climbs in \"climb units\" tick by tick (base pace x a\n * slow form curve, changed by Classic and Chaos events). The running total is floored at 0, then\n * divided by a fixed normaliser so the final tick is exactly 100, and every earlier keyframe is\n * clamped to [0, 98]. So no squirrel shows 100 before its stored finishMs, every squirrel shows\n * 100 from then on, and the stored finish times strictly increase with position. Events never\n * touch an entrant's last 10% of ticks, so the final tick always climbs.\n *\n * The build has two passes. Pass one: the Classic layer, then (Chaos only) the level's deck\n * (chaos.js); lanes and outfits are then resolved in time order and each squirrel's normaliser is\n * fixed at its final total. Lanes or positions.\n * @param {string} label - 'lanes' or 'positions', for the message.\n * @returns {void}\n * @throws {RangeError} If the values are not a permutation of 1 to n.\n * @since 1.0.0\n */\nfunction assertPermutation(values, label) {\n  const count = values.length;\n  const inRange = values.every((value) => Number.isInteger(value) && value >= 1 && value <= count);\n  if (!inRange || new Set(values).size !== count) {\n    throw new RangeError(`Entrant ${label} must run 1 to ${count} with no repeats.`);\n  }\n}\n\n/**\n * @description Throws unless finish times strictly increase with position, the property the\n *   whole order guarantee rests on (the server's draw always gives it).\n * @param {Array<{position: number, finishMs: number}>} entrants - The inputs.\n * @returns {void}\n * @throws {TypeError|RangeError} If an input breaks the payload contract (SPEC.md § 7).\n * @since 1.0.0\n */\nfunction validateInput({entrants, durationMs, mode}) {\n  const usable = Array.isArray(entrants)\n    && entrants.length > 0\n    && entrants.every((entrant) => entrant && typeof entrant === 'object');\n  if (!usable) {\n    throw new TypeError('buildRacePlan needs at least one entrant object.');\n  }\n  if (!MODES.includes(mode)) {\n    throw new RangeError(`Unknown race mode: ${mode}.`);\n  }\n  if (!(Number.isFinite(durationMs) && durationMs > 0)) {\n    throw new RangeError('durationMs must be a positive number of milliseconds.');\n  }\n  assertPermutation(entrants.map((entrant) => entrant.lane), 'lanes');\n  assertPermutation(entrants.map((entrant) => entrant.position), 'positions');\n  assertFinishOrder(entrants);\n}\n\n/**\n * @description Tries to place one Classic event on an entrant at random start ticks.\n * @param {RaceBuilder} builder -
