The race builder.\n * @param {EntrantTrack} track - The entrant's track.\n * @returns {void}\n * @since 1.0.0\n */\nfunction placeClassicEvents(builder, track) {\n  const {rng, settings} = builder;\n  const rules = settings.classic;\n  if (rng.chance(rules.nutStop.chance)) {\n    const ticks = rng.intBetween(rules.nutStop.minTicks, rules.nutStop.maxTicks);\n    placeClassic(builder, track, 'nutStop', layoutFrom([{kind: effectKinds.stall, ticks}]), {});\n  }\n  if (rng.chance(rules.slip.chance)) {\n    const strength = rng.floatBetween(rules.slip.minMeanClimbs, rules.slip.maxMeanClimbs);\n    const layout = layoutFrom([\n      {kind: effectKinds.set, ticks: 1, value: -strength * settings.paceMean},\n      {kind: effectKinds.idle, ticks: rules.slip.recoveryTicks}\n    ]);\n    placeClassic(builder, track, 'slip', layout, {strength: Math.round(strength * 100) / 100});\n  }\n  if (rng.chance(rules.burst.chance)) {\n    const layout = layoutFrom([\n      {kind: effectKinds.scale, ticks: rules.burst.ticks, value: rules.burst.paceMultiplier}\n    ]);\n    placeClassic(builder, track, 'burst', layout, {multiplier: rules.burst.paceMultiplier});\n  }\n}\n\n/**\n * @description Rolls an entrant's base climbs (§ 11.3) and then its Classic events.\n * @param {RaceBuilder} builder - The race builder.\n * @param {EntrantTrack} track - The entrant's track.\n * @returns {number[]} Base climb per tick, index 1 to tickCount (index 0 is unused).\n * @since 1.0.0\n */\nfunction rollClassicLayer(builder, track) {\n  const {rng, settings} = builder;\n  const frequency = rng.floatBetween(settings.formFrequencyMin, settings.formFrequencyMax);\n  const phase = rng.floatBetween(0, TWO_PI);\n  const baseClimbs = [0];\n  for (let tick = 1; tick <= track.tickCount; tick += 1) {\n    const angle = (TWO_PI * frequency * tick) / track.tickCount + phase;\n    const form = 1 + settings.formAmplitude * Math.sin(angle);\n    baseClimbs.push(rng.floatBetween(settings.paceMin, settings.paceMax) * form);\n  }\n  placeClassicEvents(builder, track);\n  return baseClimbs;\n}\n\n/**\n * @description One event as the plan carries it (contract § 3), with the v1 field names kept as\n *   copies for the stage: entrantIndexes (= entrants) and details (= data).\n * @param {Object} event - A resolved event.\n * @returns {Object} The plan event.\n * @since 2.0.0\n */\nfunction planEvent(event) {\n  return {\n    id: event.id,\n    sequence: event.sequence,\n    type: event.type,\n    category: event.category,\n    scope: event.scope,\n    outcome: event.outcome,\n    startMs: event.startMs,\n    endMs: event.endMs,\n    entrants: event.entrants.slice(),\n    entrantIndexes: event.entrants.slice(),\n    data: copyData(event.data),\n    details: copyData(event.data)\n  };\n}\n\n/**\n * @description One squirrel's own record of an event: its span on that squirrel, whether the\n *   event singles it out, and the event's data plus anything specific to this squirrel (its\n *   lanes in a swap, its drop or slip size, its cling length).\n * @param {Object} span - The track span.\n * @param {Object} event - The resolved event.\n * @param {number} entrantIndex - The squirrel.\n * @param {number} tickMs - The tick length.\n * @returns {Object} The record.\n * @since 2.0.0\n */\nfunction entrantRecord(span, event, entrantIndex, tickMs) {\n  const swap = (event.data.swaps || []).find((item) => item.entrant === entrantIndex);\n  const lanes = swap ? {fromLane: swap.fromLane, toLane: swap.toLane} : {};\n  const data = {...copyData(event.data), ...span.extra, ...lanes};\n  return {\n    id: event.id,\n    sequence: event.sequence,\n    type: event.type,\n    category: event.category,\n    scope: event.scope,\n    outcome: event.outcome,\n    personal: span.personal,\n    startTick: span.startTick,\n    endTick: span.endTick,\n    startMs: (span.startTick - 1) * tickMs,\n    endMs: span.endTick * tickMs,\n    stallTicks: span.stallTicks,\n    data,\n    details: copyData(data)\n  };\n}\n\n/**\n * @description Copies one entrant into the plan.\n * @param {EntrantTrack} track - The entrant's track.\n * @param {Object} inputEntrant - The payload entrant.\n * @param {RaceBuilder} builder - The race builder (for outfits and settings).\n * @param {Map<string, Object>} eventsById - right.startTick);\n  return {\n    index: track.index,\n    lane: track.startLane,\n    position: inputEntrant.position,\n    finishMs: track.finishMs,\n    name: typeof inputEntrant.name === 'string' ? inputEntrant.name : '',\n    tickCount: track.tickCount,\n    times: keyframes.times,\n    heights: keyframes.heights,\n    classicEvents: records.filter((record) => record.category === 'classic'),\n    chaosEvents: records.filter((record) => record.category === 'chaos'),\n    laneTimeline: snapshot.laneTimeline,\n    outfitTimeline: builder.outfitTimeline(track.index),\n    stalledTicks: snapshot.stalledTicks\n  };\n}\n\n/**\n * @description The sky for a race (Chaos v2 contract § 14): one seeded pool for Classic and\n *   Chaos alike, picked from the seed without touching the generator, so the sky never changes\n *   the race (its events, order and times).\n * @param {number} seed - No longer used: both modes share the pool.\n * @param {Object} skies - The theme's skies section.\n * @returns {string} A sky preset id.\n * @since 1.0.0\n */\nfunction skyFor(seed, _mode, skies) {\n  return skies.seededChoices[seed % skies.seededChoices.length];\n}\n\n/**\n * @description Says whether an event belongs in raceEvents: a Chaos event that is field-wide or\n *   touches more than one squirrel.\n * @param {Object} event - A plan event.\n * @returns {boolean} True for a race-level event.\n * @since 2.0.0\n */\nfunction isRaceEvent(event) {\n  return event.category === 'chaos' && (event.scope === 'field' || event.entrants.length > 1);\n}\n\n/**\n * @description Copies the finished build out into the plan.\n * @param {RaceBuilder} builder - The race builder, both passes done.\n * @param {Object} input - The plan inputs.\n * @param {{seed: number, levelId: (string|null)}} resolved - The normalised seed and level.\n * @returns {Object} The plan.\n * @since 2.0.0\n */\nfunction assemblePlan(builder, input, resolved) {\n  const events = builder.eventsSnapshot();\n  const eventsById = new Map(events.map((event) => [event.id, event]));\n  const entrants = builder.tracks.map((track) => (\n    planEntrant(track, input.entrants[track.index], builder, eventsById)\n  ));\n  const planEvents = events.map(planEvent);\n  const finishOrder = entrants\n    .slice()\n    .sort((left, right) => left.position - right.position)\n    .map((entrant) => entrant.index);\n  const photoGap = entrants.length > 1\n    ? {...finale, count: finale.eventIds.length} : null\n  };\n}\n\n/**\n * @description Builds the race plan: a pure function of its inputs, chaosLevel included (same\n *   inputs, deep-equal plan). Object}>, seed: number, durationMs: number, mode: string,\n *   chaosLevel?: string}} input - The stored race. chaosLevel ('mild', 'silly' or 'carnage')\n *   defaults to 'silly' in Chaos and is photoFinish, winnerIndex, finishOrder, entrants (keyframes, Classic and Chaos event records,\n *   lane timeline, outfit timeline, stalled ticks), events (every event in time order, contract\n *   § 3 shape), raceEvents (the field-wide and multi-squirrel ones) and finaleBurst.\n * @throws {TypeError|RangeError} If the input breaks the payload contract.\n * @example\n *   const plan = 1.0.0\n */\nexport function buildRacePlan(input, theme = themeConfig) {\n  validateInput(input);\n  const level = resolveLevel(input, theme);\n  const settings = resolveSettings(theme, The cat lady event.\n * @param {number} raceMs - Race time.\n * @param {Object} context - The look context.\n * @returns {Object|null} The look, or null outside this squirrel's cling.\n * @since 1.0.0\n */\nfunction catLadyLook(event, raceMs, context) {\n  const thrown = ownThrow(context, event);\n  if (!thrown) {\n    return null;\n  }\n  const clingEnd = thrown.atMs + thrown.clingTicks * context.tickMs;\n  if (raceMs >= thrown.atMs && raceMs < clingEnd) {\n    return lookOf('climb', 'cling-cat', [], ['catClinging']);\n  }\n  return null;\n}\n\n/**\n * @description The Golden Acorn of Doom's victim: smacked off balance, then dizzy.\n * @param {Object} event - The golden acorn event.\n * @param {number} raceMs - Race time.\n * @returns {Object|null} The look, or null before the impact.\n * @since 1.0.0\n */\nfunction goldenAcornLook(event, raceMs) {\n  const impact = Number.isFinite(event.data.impactMs) ? event.data.impactMs : event.startMs;\n  if (raceMs < impact) {\n    return null;\n  }\n  if (raceMs < impact + STAGE_TIMINGS.goldenAcorn.stunnedMs) {\n    return lookOf('stunned', 'tumble');\n  }\n  return lookOf('dizzy', 'still', [starsFor(event)]);\n}\n\n/**\n * @description A UFO's passenger outside its flight: frozen in the beam before, dazed after.\n * @param {Object} event - The UFO event.\n * @param {number} raceMs - Race time.\n * @param {Object} context - The look context.\n * @returns {Object} The look.\n * @since 1.0.0\n */\nfunction ufoLook(event, raceMs, context) {\n  const entries = ownEntries(context, event.id);\n  const landed = entries.length > 0 && raceMs >= entries[entries.length - 1].flightEndMs;\n  return landed ? lookOf('dizzy', 'still', [starsFor(event)]) : lookOf('stunned', 'beamed');\n}\n\n/**\n * @description The earthquake: everyone bounces, and the listed squirrels slip.\n * @param {Object} event - The earthquake event.\n * @param {number} raceMs - Race time.\n * @param {Object} context - The look context.\n * @returns {Object} The look.\n * @since 1.0.0\n */\nfunction earthquakeLook(event, raceMs, context) {\n  const slipping = indexList(event.data.slips).includes(context.entrantIndex);\n  if (slipping && raceMs < event.startMs + QUAKE_SLIP_MS) {\n    return lookOf('dizzy', 'shake');\n  }\n  return lookOf('climb', 'quake');\n}\n\n/**\n * @description The flood: once the water is up, a squirrel still below the waterline (the plan's\n *   bursters) shoots up the trunk for a few ticks.\n * @param {Object} event - The flood event.\n * @param {number} raceMs - Race time.\n * @param {Object} context - The look context.\n * @returns {Object|null} The look, or null for a squirrel above the water.\n * @since 1.0.0\n */\nfunction floodLook(event, raceMs, context) {\n  const rules = STAGE_TIMINGS.flood;\n  let bursting = indexList(event.data.bursters).includes(context.entrantIndex);\n  if (!Array.isArray(event.data.bursters)) {\n    // An older plan names nobody: everyone below the waterline at the start bursts.\n    const level = Number.isFinite(event.data.waterHeightUnits) ? event.data.waterHeightUnits : 20;\n    bursting = heightAt(context.plan, context.entrantIndex, event.startMs) < level;\n  }\n  const burstFrom = event.startMs + rules.burstDelayTicks * context.tickMs;\n  const burstTo = burstFrom + rules.burstTicks * context.tickMs;\n  return bursting && raceMs >= burstFrom && raceMs < burstTo ? lookOf('climb', 'burst') : null;\n}\n\n/**\n * @description The hailstorm: a listed squirrel stuffs its cheeks and climbs on, slowly.\n * @param {Object} event - The acorn hail event.\n * @param {number} raceMs - Race time.\n * @param {Object} context - The look context.\n * @returns {Object|null} The look, or null for a squirrel not listed.\n * @since 1.0.0\n */\nfunction acornHailLook(event, raceMs, context) {\n  if (!indexList(event.data.chubby).includes(context.entrantIndex)) {\n    return null;\n  }\n  const slowEnd = event.startMs + (event.data.slowTicks || 4) * context.tickMs;\n  return raceMs < slowEnd ? lookOf('climb', 'climb', [], ['chubby']) : null;\n}\n\n/**\n * @description The trench coat: the host wears it on the middle tree, the other two vanish inside\n *   it, then all three are dazed after toppling apart.\n * @param {Object} event - The trench coat event.\n * @param {number} raceMs - Race time.\n * @param {Object} context - The look context.\n * @returns {Object} The look.\n * @since 1.0.0\n */\nfunction trenchCoatLook(event, raceMs, context) {\n  const disguise = context.timeline.disguises[event.id];\n  if (!disguise) {\n    return lookOf('idle', 'still');\n  }\n  if (raceMs >= disguise.startMs && raceMs < disguise.endMs) {\n    if (disguise.host === context.entrantIndex) {\n      // The host's head is out of the collar; the other two peek out lower down.\n      const others = event.entrants.filter((index) => index !== disguise.host);\n      return lookOf('idle', 'still', [], [], {coat: true, coatHeads: [disguise.host, ...others]});\n    }\n    const homeLane = disguise.homeLanes[context.entrantIndex];\n    return lookOf('idle', 'still', [], [], {hidden: true, homeLane});\n  }\n  return raceMs >= disguise.endMs\n    ? lookOf('dizzy', 'still', [starsFor(event)])\n    : lookOf('idle', 'still');\n}\n\n// One look per event type: (event, raceMs, context) => look, or null for \"nothing this moment\".\nconst LOOKS = Object.freeze({\n  nutStop: () => lookOf('idle', 'still', [], ['nutBubble']),\n  slip: (event, raceMs) => (\n    raceMs < event.startMs + STAGE_TIMINGS.slip.shakeMs\n      ? lookOf('dizzy', 'shake')\n      : lookOf('climb', 'climb')\n  ),\n  burst: () => lookOf('climb', 'burst'),\n  // A tornado's flight is drawn from the lane timeline; after it, the squirrel is dizzy.\n  tornado: (event) => lookOf('dizzy', 'still', [starsFor(event)]),\n  hunter: hunterLook,\n  suitor: suitorLook,\n  eagle: (event, raceMs, context) => (\n    comboKind(context, event) === 'catVsEagle' ? null : lookOf('fly', 'still')\n  ),\n  beaver: () => lookOf('idle', 'cling'),\n  lightning: (event) => lookOf('stunned', 'still', [\n    decoration('zap', event.startMs, event.endMs - event.startMs)\n  ]),\n  catLady: catLadyLook,\n  goldenAcorn: goldenAcornLook,\n  leafBlower: () => lookOf('flag', 'flag'),\n  ufo: ufoLook,\n  earthquake: earthquakeLook,\n  flood: floodLook,\n  disco: () => lookOf('dance', 'still'),\n  acornHail: acornHailLook,\n  var: () => lookOf('idle', 'still'),\n  trenchCoat: trenchCoatLook,\n  woodpecker: () => lookOf('idle', 'vibrate', [], ['vibrate'])\n});\n\n/**\n * @description An event's rank for deciding the pose (a hunter's miss barely counts).\n * @param {Object} event - The event.\n * @returns {number} The rank.\n * @since 1.0.0\n */\nfunction rankOf(event) {\n  if (event.type === 'hunter' && event.outcome !== 'hit') {\n    return 10;\n  }\n  return POSE_RANK[event.type] ?? 15;\n}\n\n/**\n * @description How a squirrel looks while it flies on the lane timeline: spinning in a tornado,\n *   floating in a UFO's beam, toppling out of a trench coat, or just flying.\n * @param {Object} timeline - From prepareTimeline.\n * @param {Object} entry - The lane-timeline entry.\n * @returns {Object} The look.\n * @since 1.0.0\n */\nfunction flightLook(timeline, entry) {\n  const {kind} = flightOf(timeline, entry);\n  if (kind === 'tornado') {\n    return lookOf('fly', 'spin');\n  }\n  if (kind === 'ufo') {\n    return lookOf('fly', 'beamed');\n  }\n  return kind === 'hop' ? lookOf('stunned', 'tumble') : lookOf('fly', 'still');\n}\n\n/**\n * @description The marks a squirrel carries for the rest of the race once an event has left\n *   them: lipstick after a kiss, a red cheek after a slap, soot after a hit or lightning, and the\n *   legendary sparkle from the start.\n * @param {Object[]} events - The squirrel's events.\n * @param {number} raceMs - Race time.\n * @param {boolean} legendary - Wears a legendary item.\n * @returns {Set<string>} The marks.\n * @since 1.0.0\n */\nfunction lastingEffects(events, raceMs, legendary) {\n  const rules = STAGE_TIMINGS.suitor;\n  const effects = new Set();\n  if (legendary) {\n    effects.add('sparkle');\n  }\n  events.forEach((event) => {\n    const span = event.endMs - event.startMs;\n    if (event.type === 'suitor' && event.outcome === 'kiss'\n      && raceMs >= event.startMs + span * rules.leanShare) {\n      effects.add('lipstick');\n    }\n    if (event.type === 'suitor' && event.outcome === 'slap'\n      && raceMs >= event.startMs + span * rules.slapShare) {\n      effects.add('redCheek');\n    }\n    const shot = event.type === 'hunter' && event.outcome === 'hit';\n    if ((shot || event.type === 'lightning') && raceMs >= event.startMs) {\n      effects.add('singed');\n    }\n  });\n  return effects;\n}\n\n/**\n * @description The eagle around its squirrel: diving in, carrying (unless it caught a cat\n *   instead, catVsEagle, or drops the squirrel into a tornado, eagleIntoFunnel), then flying off.\n *   The fly-off stretches so the whole visit lasts at least STAGE_TIMINGS.eagle.minVisitMs\n *   (Chaos v2 contract § 8).\n * @param {Object} event - The eagle event.\n * @param {number} raceMs - Race time.\n * @param {Object} context - The look context.\n * @returns {Object|null} The decoration.\n * @since 1.0.0\n */\nfunction eagleDecoration(event, raceMs, context) {\n  const rules = STAGE_TIMINGS.eagle;\n  const kind = comboKind(context, event);\n  const withCat = kind === 'catVsEagle';\n  // With a cat in its talons it never carries the squirrel: it turns away at once.\n  let releaseMs = withCat ? event.startMs : event.endMs;\n  if (kind === 'eagleIntoFunnel') {\n    const entries = context.plan.entrants[context.entrantIndex].laneTimeline || [];\n    // The funnel arrives as the carry ends, so the drop starts at or just before the end.\n    const drop = entries.find((entry) => (\n      entry.flightStartMs >= event.startMs - rules.leadMs\n      && entry.flightStartMs <= event.endMs\n      && flightOf(context.timeline, entry).kind === 'tornado'\n    ));\n    releaseMs = drop ? drop.flightStartMs : event.endMs;\n  }\n  const diveFrom = event.startMs - rules.leadMs;\n  const awayMs = Math.max(\n    rules.tailMs,\n    rules.minVisitMs - rules.leadMs - Math.max(0, releaseMs - event.startMs)\n  );\n  if (raceMs < diveFrom || raceMs >= releaseMs + awayMs) {\n    return null;\n  }\n  if (raceMs < event.startMs) {\n    return decoration('eagle', diveFrom, rules.leadMs, {phase: 'dive', withCat});\n  }\n  if (raceMs < releaseMs) {\n    return decoration('eagle', event.startMs, releaseMs - event.startMs, {phase: 'carry'});\n  }\n  return decoration('eagle', releaseMs, awayMs, {phase: 'away', withCat});\n}\n\n/**\n * @description Where the cat lady is, relative to the squirrel she throws at, when she throws:\n *   the flying cat starts there (lanes across, climb shares down).\n * @param {Object} event - The cat lady event.\n * @param {{atMs: number}} thrown - The throw.\n * @param {Object} context - The look context.\n * @returns {{fromX: number, fromY: number}} The offset.\n * @since 1.0.0\n */\nfunction throwOrigin(event, thrown, context) {\n  const row = context.timeline.walkerRows[event.id] || 0;\n  const fraction = walkerFraction(event, thrown.atMs, walkDirection(event, row));\n  const lane = laneAt(context.plan, context.entrantIndex, thrown.atMs).lane;\n  const height = heightAt(context.plan, context.entrantIndex, thrown.atMs);\n  return {\n    fromX: Math.round((fraction * context.timeline.count - 0.5 - (lane - 1)) * 100) / 100,\n    fromY: Math.round((height / 100 + 0.1) * 100) / 100\n  };\n}\n\n/**\n * @description The decorations a squirrel's events add in their own windows, which reach outside\n *   the events' spans: the eagle, a thrown cat flying in and dropping off, the Golden Acorn\n *   homing in and looping in triumph, and the nut that's too big.\n * @param {Object[]} events - The squirrel's events.\n * @param {number} raceMs - Race time.\n * @param {Object} context - The look context.\n * @returns {Object[]} The decorations.\n * @since 1.0.0\n */\nfunction windowDecorations(events, raceMs, context) {\n  const found = [];\n  events.forEach((event) => {\n    if (event.type === 'eagle') {\n      const eagle = eagleDecoration(event, raceMs, context);\n      if (eagle) {\n        found.push(eagle);\n      }\n    }\n    if (event.type === 'catLady') {\n      const thrown = ownThrow(context, event);\n      const flightMs = STAGE_TIMINGS.catLady.catFlightMs;\n      if (thrown && raceMs >= thrown.atMs - flightMs && raceMs < thrown.atMs) {\n        const origin = throwOrigin(event, thrown, context);\n        found.push(decoration('cat', thrown.atMs - flightMs, flightMs, {phase: 'fly', ...origin}));\n      }\n      const clingEnd = thrown ? thrown.atMs + thrown.clingTicks * context.tickMs : 0;\n      if (thrown && raceMs >= clingEnd && raceMs < clingEnd + CAT_DROP_MS) {\n        found.push(decoration('cat', clingEnd, CAT_DROP_MS, {phase: 'drop'}));\n      }\n    }\n    if (event.type === 'goldenAcorn') {\n      const rules = STAGE_TIMINGS.goldenAcorn;\n      const impact = Number.isFinite(event.data.impactMs) ? event.data.impactMs : event.startMs;\n      if (raceMs >= impact - rules.homeMs && raceMs < impact) {\n        const lane = laneAt(context.plan, context.entrantIndex, impact).lane;\n        const fromLane = Number.isInteger(event.data.fromLane) ? event.data.fromLane : lane;\n        const height = heightAt(context.plan, context.entrantIndex, impact);\n        found.push(decoration('acorn', impact - rules.homeMs, rules.homeMs, {\n          phase: 'home',\n          fromX: fromLane - lane,\n          fromY: -Math.round(((100 - height) / 100 + 0.25) * 100) / 100\n        }));\n      } else if (raceMs >= impact && raceMs < impact + rules.loopMs) {\n        found.push(decoration('acorn', impact, rules.loopMs, {phase: 'loop'}));\n      }\n    }\n    if (event.type === 'acornHail') {\n      const chubby = indexList(event.data.chubby);\n      const chosen = Number.isInteger(event.data.bigNut)\n        ? event.data.bigNut\n        : chubby[Math.floor(seededUnit(event.id, 1) * chubby.length)];\n      const slowEnd = event.startMs + (event.data.slowTicks || 4) * context.tickMs;\n      if (chosen === context.entrantIndex && raceMs >= event.startMs && raceMs < slowEnd) {\n        found.push(decoration('big-nut', event.startMs, slowEnd - event.startMs));\n      }\n    }\n  });\n  return found;\n}\n\n/**\n * @description How one squirrel looks at a race time: pose, motion, sprite effects, decorations,\n *   the outfit-timeline step it wears, whether it is hidden in or wearing a trench coat, and\n *   whether it has finished (SPEC.md § 10, § 11.9; Chaos v2 contract § 3 and § 4).\n * @param {Object} plan - From buildRacePlan.\n * @param {Object} timeline - From prepareTimeline.\n * @param {number} entrantIndex - The squirrel.\n * @param {number} raceMs - Race time.\n * @param {{legendary?: boolean}} [options] - Wears a legendary item.\n * @returns {{pose: string, motion: string, effects: string[], decor: Object[],\n *   finished: boolean, position: number, tree: number, outfitStep: number, hidden: boolean,\n *   coat: boolean, coatHeads: number[]}} The look (tree is the squirrel's own tree while it\n *   hides in a coat; coatHeads lists who is in the coat the host wears, top first).\n * @example\n *   const look = racerLook(plan, timeline, 0, vt, {legendary: true});\n * @since 1.0.0\n */\nexport function racerLook(plan, timeline, entrantIndex, raceMs, options = {}) {\n  const entrant = plan.entrants[entrantIndex];\n  const events = timeline.eventsByEntrant[entrantIndex];\n  const context = {plan, timeline, entrantIndex, tickMs: timeline.tickMs};\n  const effects = lastingEffects(events, raceMs, options.legendary === true);\n  const base = {\n    finished: false,\n    position: entrant.position,\n    tree: laneAt(plan, entrantIndex, raceMs).lane,\n    outfitStep: outfitStepAt(plan, entrantIndex, raceMs),\n    hidden: false,\n    coat: false,\n    coatHeads: []\n  };\n  const lasting = LASTING_EFFECTS.filter((effect) => effects.has(effect));\n  if (raceMs >= entrant.finishMs) {\n    return {...base, pose: 'cheer', motion: 'still', effects: lasting, decor: [], finished: true};\n  }\n  if (raceMs <= 0) {\n    return {...base, pose: 'idle', motion: 'still', effects: lasting, decor: []};\n  }\n  const looks = events\n    .filter((event) => event.startMs <= raceMs && raceMs < event.endMs)\n    .map((event) => {\n      const describe = LOOKS[event.type];\n      return {event, look: describe ? describe(event, raceMs, context) : null};\n    })\n    .filter((item) => item.look)\n    .sort((left, right) => rankOf(right.event) - rankOf(left.event));\n  const entry = laneEntryAt(plan, entrantIndex, raceMs);\n  let primary = lookOf('climb', 'climb');\n  if (entry) {\n    primary = flightLook(timeline, entry);\n  } else if (looks.length > 0) {\n    primary = looks[0].look;\n  }\n  looks.forEach(({look}) => look.effects.forEach((effect) => effects.add(effect)));\n  const decor = [];\n  const seen = new Set();\n  primary.decor.concat(windowDecorations(events, raceMs, context)).forEach((item) => {\n    const key = `${item.kind}:${item.phase || ''}`;\n    if (!seen.has(key)) {\n      seen.add(key);\n      decor.push(item);\n    }\n  });\n  const hiding = looks.find(({look}) => look.hidden);\n  const hosting = looks.find(({look}) => look.coat);\n  return {\n    ...base,\n    pose: primary.pose,\n    motion: primary.motion,\n    effects: lasting.concat(TRANSIENT_EFFECTS.filter((effect) => effects.has(effect))),\n    decor,\n    tree: hiding && Number.isInteger(hiding.look.homeLane) ? hiding.look.homeLane : base.tree,\n    hidden: Boolean(hiding),\n    coat: Boolean(hosting),\n    coatHeads: hosting ? hosting.look.coatHeads : []\n  };\n}\n","/**\n * The visitors and field-wide events on the race stage at a moment of the race (SPEC.md § 10,\n * Chaos v2 contract § 4, § 6 and § 8), as plain descriptors for the renderers in\n * stage-chaos-layer.js and stage-field-layer.js.\n *\n * Every descriptor names its layer, so overlapping events never fight over the same space:\n * - wash (z 1, drawn after the trees, behind the visitors and the squirrels): the disco's purple\n *   light and its robot-beaver cameo, the flood water and its rubber duck, the earthquake's crack\n *   and mole, and the VAR veil. A field-wide wash never covers a squirrel, so nobody looks faded\n *   (contract § 8);\n * - back (z 2, in front of the trees, behind the squirrels): the tornado, ground walkers (hunter,\n *   cat lady, gardener), the beaver, the woodpecker, lightning;\n * - front (z 4, in front of the squirrels): the suitor on her branch, the UFO (so a beamed\n *   squirrel vanishes inside it), the lightning's sky flash;\n * - fx (z 5, the full field): light accents only, at low opacity: the leaf gust, the disco\n *   beams and mirror ball, the acorn hail;\n * - var (z 7, above everything but the photo-finish stamp): the VAR review.\n * Ground walkers keep the row prepareTimeline gave them, one behind the other; the mirror ball\n * hangs to one side when a UFO is about.\n *\n * Readability (contract § 8): every visitor has a visual window around its event's plan window\n * (stage-shared.js): walkers walk at a readable speed and act at the plan's moment, trunk\n * visitors arrive early and linger, field-wide events build over a lead-in and fade over a tail.\n * All of it is drawn only: heights and trees always come from the plan.\n *\n * Descriptors hold discrete values only (poses, windows, lanes): they go into the scene\n * signature, and the timed parts move by the race clock through stage-scrubs.js. A window may\n * carry inShare and outShare, the shares of it its build-up ends and its fade starts at.\n *\n * Pure ES module: no DOM, no Lit and no clock.\n */\nimport {heightAt, laneAt} from '../lib/choreography.js';\nimport {\n  STAGE_TIMINGS,\n  READABILITY,\n  seededUnit,\n  spanShare,\n  walkSpan,\n  walkDirection,\n  catThrows,\n  hunterPath,\n  trunkVisit,\n  trunkSide,\n  fieldWindow,\n  fadeShares,\n  visitWindow\n} from './stage-shared.js';\n\n/**\n * @description The tree a squirrel is on at a moment, and its height then.\n * @param {Object} plan - From buildRacePlan.\n * @param {number} entrantIndex - The squirrel.\n * @param {number} atMs - Race time.\n * @returns {{lane: number, height: number}} The lane (1 to n) and height (0 to 100).\n * @since 1.0.0\n */\nfunction targetAt(plan, entrantIndex, atMs) {\n  return {\n    lane: laneAt(plan, entrantIndex, atMs).lane,\n    height: Math.round(heightAt(plan, entrantIndex, atMs) * 10) / 10\n  };\n}\n\n/**\n * @description A race-time window for a timed part, with the shares its build-up ends and its\n *   fade starts at when it has them.\n * @param {number} startMs - Start.\n * @param {number} endMs - End.\n * @param {{inShare: number, outShare: number}} [shares] - Build-up and fade shares.\n * @returns {{startMs: number, durationMs: number, inShare?: number, outShare?: number}} The\n *   window.\n * @since 1.0.0\n */\nfunction windowOf(startMs, endMs, shares = null) {\n  const range = {\n    startMs: Math.round(startMs),\n    durationMs: Math.max(1, Math.round(endMs - startMs))\n  };\n  return shares ? {...range, inShare: shares.inShare, outShare: shares.outShare} : range;\n}\n\n/**\n * @description The window of a visual window object that already carries its shares.\n * @param {{startMs: number, endMs: number, inShare: number, outShare: number}} visual - From\n *   fieldWindow, trunkVisit or fadeShares.\n * @returns {{startMs: number, durationMs: number, inShare: number, outShare: number}} The window.\n * @since 2.1.0\n */\nfunction envelopeOf(visual) {\n  return windowOf(visual.startMs, visual.endMs, visual);\n}\n\n/**\n * @description A ground walker's row and how the race's rows are laid out (prepareTimeline), for\n *   the walker's descriptor.\n * @param {Object} timeline - From prepareTimeline.\n * @param {string} eventId - The walker's event.\n * @returns {{row: number, rowStep: number, rowShrink: number}} The row (0 is the ground line),\n *   the spacing between rows and the shrink per row (hundredths of the field's height).\n * @since 2.1.0\n */\nfunction walkerRowOf(timeline, eventId) {\n  const layout = timeline.walkerLayout || {stepCqh: 6, shrinkCqh: 2.4};\n  return {\n    row: timeline.walkerRows[eventId] || 0,\n    rowStep: layout.stepCqh,\n    rowShrink: layout.shrinkCqh\n  };\n}\n\n/**\n * @description Says whether an event of a type is under way (between its own ticks).\n * @param {Object} context - The overlay context.\n * @param {string} type - The event type.\n * @returns {boolean} True when one is.\n * @since 1.0.0\n */\nfunction underway(context, type) {\n  return context.timeline.events.some((event) => (\n    event.type === type && event.startMs <= context.raceMs && context.raceMs < event.endMs\n  ));\n}\n\n/**\n * @description The combo an event takes part in, and its partner.\n * @param {Object} context - The overlay context.\n * @param {Object} event - The event.\n * @returns {{kind: string, partner: (Object|null)}} The combo ('' when none).\n * @since 1.0.0\n */\nfunction comboOf(context, event) {\n  const combo = context.timeline.combos[event.id];\n  if (!combo) {\n    return {kind: '', partner: null};\n  }\n  return {kind: combo.kind, partner: context.timeline.eventsById[combo.with] || null};\n}\n\n/**\n * @description The tornado: the sky darkens, the funnel sweeps across over the flight, then lifts\n *   off where it stands (well clear of the leaderboard, contract § 8) as the sky clears (SPEC.md\n *   § 10). A sharknado has sharks circling inside, one of which bites a hat off and then wears\n *   it; a suitor swept up with her date spins round in it too.\n * @param {Object} event - The tornado event.\n * @param {Object} context - The overlay context.\n * @returns {Object|null} The descriptor, or null when it is over.\n * @since 1.0.0\n */\nfunction tornadoOverlay(event, context) {\n  const {raceMs, timeline} = context;\n  const rules = STAGE_TIMINGS.tornado;\n  const startMs = event.startMs - rules.leadMs;\n  const flightEndMs = timeline.flightEnds[event.id] ?? event.endMs;\n  const endMs = Math.max(event.endMs + rules.tailMs, flightEndMs + rules.liftMs);\n  if (raceMs < startMs || raceMs >= endMs) {\n    return null;\n  }\n  const sweeping = raceMs >= event.startMs && raceMs < flightEndMs;\n  const chomp = timeline.hatChomps[event.id] || null;\n  let chompPhase = '';\n  if (chomp) {\n    chompPhase = 'circle';\n    if (raceMs >= chomp.atMs) {\n      chompPhase = raceMs < chomp.atMs + rules.chompMs ? 'chomp' : 'wearing';\n    }\n  }\n  const sweptSuitor = timeline.events.some((other) => {\n    const combo = timeline.combos[other.id];\n    return other.type === 'suitor' && combo && combo.kind === 'suitorSwept'\n      && combo.with === event.id;\n  });\n  return {\n    key: event.id,\n    type: 'tornado',\n    layer: 'back',\n    sweep: windowOf(event.startMs, flightEndMs),\n    lift: windowOf(flightEndMs, endMs),\n    dim: windowOf(startMs, endMs),\n    twisting: sweeping,\n    sharks: event.data.sharks === true,\n    chomp: chomp ? {phase: chompPhase, hat: chomp.hat, victim: chomp.entrantIndex} : null,\n    passenger: sweptSuitor && sweeping ? 'suitor' : ''\n  };\n}\n\n/**\n * @description The hunter (SPEC.md § 10, contract § 8): walks in from the nearer edge at a\n *   readable pace, squints and aims, BLAM at the plan's moment, then walks back out (a hit) or\n *   grumbles with a sooty face first (a miss). Aiming at a tornado instead (hunterVsTornado), he\n *   stands near the right edge, fires, gets the cow spat back at him and ends up flat on his\n *   back. At a disco he dances.\n * @param {Object} event - The hunter event.\n * @param {Object} context - The overlay context.\n * @returns {Object|null} The descriptor, or null when he is off stage.\n * @since 1.0.0\n */\nfunction hunterOverlay(event, context) {\n  const {plan, timeline, raceMs} = context;\n  const rules = STAGE_TIMINGS.hunter;\n  const vsTornado = comboOf(context, event).kind === 'hunterVsTornado';\n  const target = event.entrants[0];\n  if (!vsTornado && !Number.isInteger(target)) {\n    return null;\n  }\n  const lane = vsTornado ? plan.entrants.length : targetAt(plan, target, event.startMs).lane;\n  const path = hunterPath({\n    count: plan.entrants.length,\n    lane,\n    vsTornado,\n    outcome: event.outcome,\n    startMs: event.startMs,\n    endMs: event.endMs\n  });\n  if (raceMs < path.enterAt || raceMs >= path.leaveEnd) {\n    return null;\n  }\n  const fireEnd = event.startMs + rules.blamMs;\n  const cowEnd = fireEnd + rules.cowMs;\n  let pose = 'walk';\n  if (raceMs >= path.arriveAt && raceMs < event.startMs) {\n    pose = 'aim';\n  } else if (raceMs >= event.startMs && raceMs < fireEnd) {\n    pose = path.hit || vsTornado ? 'fire' : 'backfire';\n  } else if (!path.hit && raceMs >= fireEnd && raceMs < path.leaveAt) {\n    pose = 'grumble';\n  }\n  return {\n    key: event.id,\n    type: 'hunter',\n    layer: 'back',\n    outcome: event.outcome,\n    lane,\n    side: path.side,\n    // Where he stands, and how far off stage he walks from (both in hundredths of the field).\n    stand: Math.round(path.stand * 10000) / 100,\n    enterFrom: Math.round((path.from - path.stand) * 10000) / 100,\n    ...walkerRowOf(timeline, event.id),\n    pose,\n    enter: windowOf(path.enterAt, path.arriveAt),\n    leave: windowOf(path.leaveAt, path.leaveEnd),\n    leaving: raceMs >= path.leaveAt && path.side !== 'vs',\n    cow: vsTornado && raceMs >= fireEnd && raceMs < cowEnd ? windowOf(fireEnd, cowEnd) : null,\n    floored: vsTornado && raceMs >= cowEnd,\n    dancing: underway(context, 'disco')\n  };\n}\n\n/**\n * @description The suitor (SPEC.md § 10): she appears on a branch beside the squirrel and flutters\n *   her lashes, then kisses or slaps it, then waves it off and fades; her visit is long enough to\n *   read (contract § 8). Swept up with her date by a tornado (suitorSwept), she leaves her branch\n *   for the funnel and turns up again beside the date's new tree.\n * @param {Object} event - The suitor event.\n * @param {Object} context - The overlay context.\n * @returns {Object|null} The descriptor, or null when she is off stage.\n * @since 1.0.0\n */\nfunction suitorOverlay(event, context) {\n  const {plan, timeline, raceMs} = context;\n  const rules = STAGE_TIMINGS.suitor;\n  const date = event.entrants[0];\n  const combo = comboOf(context, event);\n  const tornado = combo.kind === 'suitorSwept' && combo.partner\n    && combo.partner.type === 'tornado' ? combo.partner : null;\n  const sweptEnd = tornado ? (timeline.flightEnds[tornado.id] ?? tornado.endMs) : -Infinity;\n  // Half of each fade counts as on screen.\n  const minVisit = READABILITY.minOnScreenMs + (rules.appearMs + rules.leaveMs) / 2;\n  const visit = visitWindow(event, rules.leadMs, rules.tailMs, minVisit);\n  const startMs = visit.startMs;\n  // Swept away, she turns up again beside her date's new tree once the funnel drops them.\n  const endMs = tornado ? sweptEnd + rules.relandMs : visit.endMs;\n  if (!Number.isInteger(date) || raceMs < startMs || raceMs >= endMs) {\n    return null;\n  }\n  if (tornado && raceMs >= tornado.startMs && raceMs < sweptEnd) {\n    // She is in the funnel (see tornadoOverlay).\n    return null;\n  }\n  const relanded = tornado && raceMs >= sweptEnd;\n  const span = event.endMs - event.startMs;\n  let pose = 'beckon';\n  if (relanded) {\n    pose = event.outcome === 'slap' ? 'wave-off' : 'kiss';\n  } else if (raceMs >= event.endMs) {\n    pose = 'wave-off';\n  } else if (event.outcome === 'kiss' && raceMs >= event.startMs) {\n    pose = 'kiss';\n  } else if (event.outcome === 'slap' && raceMs >= event.startMs + span * rules.slapShare) {\n    pose = 'slap';\n  }\n  const {lane, height} = targetAt(plan, date, relanded ? sweptEnd : event.startMs);\n  const leaveAt = endMs - rules.leaveMs;\n  const appearFrom = relanded ? sweptEnd : startMs;\n  return {\n    key: event.id,\n    type: 'suitor',\n    layer: 'front',\n    outcome: event.outcome,\n    lane,\n    height,\n    side: lane === plan.entrants.length ? 'left' : 'right',\n    pose,\n    hearts: raceMs < event.startMs,\n    appear: windowOf(appearFrom, appearFrom + rules.appearMs),\n    leave: raceMs >= leaveAt ? windowOf(leaveAt, leaveAt + rules.leaveMs) : null\n  };\n}\n\n/**\n * @description The beaver (contract § 8): it waddles up to the foot of the squirrel's tree about\n *   a second early, facing the trunk from the middle-of-the-field side, chomps it (wood chips\n *   flying, a bite appearing in the bark, the tree swaying) through the plan window, sits back\n *   satisfied for a moment and waddles off. At a disco it does the robot instead.\n * @param {Object} event - The beaver event.\n * @param {Object} context - The overlay context.\n * @returns {Object|null} The descriptor, or null when it is off stage.\n * @since 1.0.0\n */\nfunction beaverOverlay(event, context) {\n  const {plan, raceMs} = context;\n  const victim = event.entrants[0];\n  if (!Number.isInteger(victim)) {\n    return null;\n  }\n  const visit = trunkVisit(event);\n  if (raceMs < visit.startMs || raceMs >= visit.endMs) {\n    return null;\n  }\n  const lane = targetAt(plan, victim, event.startMs).lane;\n  const robot = underway(context, 'disco');\n  const chompFrom = Math.max(\n    visit.startMs + READABILITY.trunkFadeMs,\n    event.startMs - STAGE_TIMINGS.beaver.chompLeadMs\n  );\n  const gnawing = !robot && raceMs >= chompFrom && raceMs < event.endMs;\n  return {\n    key: event.id,\n    type: 'beaver',\n    layer: 'back',\n    lane,\n    side: trunkSide(lane, plan.entrants.length),\n    visit: envelopeOf(visit),\n    // The bite in the bark grows while the plan's stall lasts.\n    bite: windowOf(event.startMs, event.endMs),\n    pose: gnawing ? 'gnaw' : 'idle',\n    robot\n  };\n}\n\n/**\n * @description The lightning overlay: a white flash across the sky and a bolt down to the\n *   squirrel. Reduced motion keeps the bolt and drops the flash.\n * @param {Object} event - The lightning event.\n * @param {Object} context - The overlay context.\n * @returns {Object|null} The descriptor, or null when it is over.\n * @since 1.0.0\n */\nfunction lightningOverlay(event, context) {\n  const {plan, raceMs, reduced} = context;\n  const rules = STAGE_TIMINGS.lightning;\n  const startMs = event.startMs - rules.leadMs;\n  const victim = event.entrants[0];\n  if (!Number.isInteger(victim) || raceMs < startMs || raceMs >= event.startMs + rules.boltMs) {\n    return null;\n  }\n  const {lane, height} = targetAt(plan, victim, event.startMs);\n  return {\n    key: event.id,\n    type: 'lightning',\n    layer: 'back',\n    lane,\n    height,\n    bolt: raceMs >= event.startMs ? windowOf(event.startMs, event.startMs + rules.boltMs) : null,\n    flash: reduced ? null : windowOf(startMs, event.startMs + rules.flashMs)\n  };\n}\n\n/**\n * @description The crazy cat lady walking along the ground at a readable pace (contract § 8),\n *   hurling cats out of her bottomless handbag at the plan's moments and cackling after each\n *   throw. The cats themselves fly with their squirrels (stage-looks.js).\n * @param {Object} event - The cat lady event.\n * @param {Object} context - The overlay context.\n * @returns {Object|null} The descriptor, or null when she is off stage.\n * @since 1.0.0\n */\nfunction catLadyOverlay(event, context) {\n  const {timeline, raceMs} = context;\n  const span = walkSpan(event);\n  if (raceMs < span.startMs || raceMs >= span.endMs) {\n    return null;\n  }\n  const rules = STAGE_TIMINGS.catLady;\n  const throws = catThrows(event, timeline.tickMs);\n  const rowed = walkerRowOf(timeline, event.id);\n  // The throw pose holds a moment past the release, then she cackles.\n  const releaseMs = 120;\n  let pose = 'walk';\n  if (throws.some((item) => (\n    raceMs >= item.atMs - rules.throwPoseMs && raceMs < item.atMs + releaseMs\n  ))) {\n    pose = 'throw';\n  } else if (throws.some((item) => (\n    raceMs >= item.atMs + releaseMs && raceMs < item.atMs + releaseMs + rules.cackleMs\n  ))) {\n    pose = 'cackle';\n  }\n  return {\n    key: event.id,\n    type: 'catLady',\n    layer: 'back',\n    ...rowed,\n    direction: walkDirection(event, rowed.row),\n    walk: windowOf(span.startMs, span.endMs),\n    pose\n  };\n}\n\n/**\n * @description The UFO: glides in over its two squirrels, beams them up while they fly on the\n *   lane timeline (their outfits swap on the outfit timeline), drops them on each other's trees\n *   and zooms off up into the sky. Drawn in front of the squirrels, so a beamed squirrel is\n *   inside it.\n * @param {Object} event - The UFO event.\n * @param {Object} context - The overlay context.\n * @returns {Object|null} The descriptor, or null when it is off stage.\n * @since 1.0.0\n */\nfunction ufoOverlay(event, context) {\n  const {plan, raceMs} = context;\n  const rules = STAGE_TIMINGS.ufo;\n  const startMs = event.startMs - rules.leadMs;\n  const endMs = event.endMs + rules.tailMs;\n  const pair = event.entrants.filter((index) => Number.isInteger(index)).slice(0, 2);\n  if (pair.length === 0 || raceMs < startMs || raceMs >= endMs) {\n    return null;\n  }\n  const spots = pair.map((index) => targetAt(plan, index, event.startMs));\n  const middle = spots.reduce((sum, spot) => sum + spot.lane - 1, 0) / spots.length;\n  const entries = [];\n  pair.forEach((index) => {\n    (plan.entrants[index].laneTimeline || []).forEach((entry) => {\n      if (entry.eventId === event.id) {\n        entries.push(entry);\n      }\n    });\n  });\n  const span = event.endMs - event.startMs;\n  const beamFrom = entries.length > 0\n    ? Math.min(...entries.map((entry) => entry.flightStartMs))\n    : event.startMs + span * 0.15;\n  const beamTo = entries.length > 0\n    ? Math.max(...entries.map((entry) => entry.flightEndMs))\n    : event.endMs - span * 0.15;\n  return {\n    key: event.id,\n    type: 'ufo',\n    layer: 'front',\n    middle: Math.round(middle * 100) / 100,\n    height: Math.min(...spots.map((spot) => spot.height)),\n    hover: windowOf(startMs, endMs),\n    beam: raceMs >= beamFrom - 200 && raceMs < beamTo + 200\n  };\n}\n\n/**\n * @description The woodpecker in its tiny hard hat (contract § 8): it flies in about a second\n *   early to the trunk just under its squirrel (above it near the ground), facing the trunk from\n *   the middle-of-the-field side, jackhammers it through the plan window, then perches a moment\n *   and flies off.\n * @param {Object} event - The woodpecker event.\n * @param {Object} context - The overlay context.\n * @returns {Object|null} The descriptor, or null when it is off stage.\n * @since 1.0.0\n */\nfunction woodpeckerOverlay(event, context) {\n  const {plan, raceMs} = context;\n  const victim = event.entrants[0];\n  if (!Number.isInteger(victim)) {\n    return null;\n  }\n  const visit = trunkVisit(event);\n  if (raceMs < visit.startMs || raceMs >= visit.endMs) {\n    return null;\n  }\n  const {lane, height} = targetAt(plan, victim, event.startMs);\n  const peckFrom = Math.max(\n    visit.startMs + READABILITY.trunkFadeMs,\n    event.startMs - STAGE_TIMINGS.woodpecker.peckLeadMs\n  );\n  const pecking = raceMs >= peckFrom && raceMs < event.endMs;\n  return {\n    key: event.id,\n    type: 'woodpecker',\n    layer: 'back',\n    lane,\n    height,\n    side: trunkSide(lane, plan.entrants.length),\n    // Below its squirrel on the trunk, unless the squirrel is too near the ground for that.\n    perch: height >= 25 ? 'below' : 'above',\n    pose: pecking ? 'peck' : 'idle',\n    visit: envelopeOf(visit)\n  };\n}\n\n/**\n * @description The leaf blower: a gardener strolls across the ground at a readable pace,\n *   blowing a gust over the whole field (leaves, then a pigeon, then his own toupee). The gust\n *   builds over a lead-in and fades over a tail (contract § 8). Two descriptors: the gardener on\n *   the back layer and the gust on the fx layer.\n * @param {Object} event - The leaf blower event.\n * @param {Object} context - The overlay context.\n * @returns {Object[]} The descriptors (none when he is off stage).\n * @since 1.0.0\n */\nfunction leafBlowerOverlays(event, context) {\n  const {timeline, raceMs} = context;\n  const rules = STAGE_TIMINGS.leafBlower;\n  const span = walkSpan(event);\n  const gust = fieldWindow(event);\n  const itemsEnd = event.endMs + rules.itemTailMs;\n  const shownUntil = Math.max(span.endMs, itemsEnd);\n  if (raceMs < span.startMs || raceMs >= shownUntil) {\n    return [];\n  }\n  const rowed = walkerRowOf(timeline, event.id);\n  const direction = walkDirection(event, rowed.row);\n  const found = [];\n  if (raceMs < span.endMs) {\n    const blowing = raceMs >= gust.startMs && raceMs < event.endMs;\n    const toupeeOff = raceMs >= event.startMs && spanShare(event, raceMs) >= rules.toupeeShare;\n    let pose = blowing ? 'blow' : 'walk';\n    if (toupeeOff) {\n      pose = 'toupee-off';\n    }\n    found.push({\n      key: event.id,\n      type: 'gardener',\n      layer: 'back',\n      ...rowed,\n      direction,\n      walk: windowOf(span.startMs, span.endMs),\n      pose\n    });\n  }\n  if (raceMs >= gust.startMs && raceMs < Math.max(gust.endMs, itemsEnd)) {\n    const length = event.endMs - event.startMs;\n    const toupeeFrom = event.startMs + length * rules.toupeeShare;\n    found.push({\n      key: `${event.id}-gust`,\n      type: 'gust',\n      layer: 'fx',\n      direction,\n      range: envelopeOf(gust),\n      pigeon: windowOf(event.startMs - READABILITY.fieldLeadMs / 2, itemsEnd),\n      toupee: raceMs >= toupeeFrom ? windowOf(toupeeFrom, itemsEnd) : null\n    });\n  }\n  return found;\n}\n\n/**\n * @description The earthquake's ground, behind the squirrels: the ground strip cracks open as the\n *   shaking builds, and a mole pops out of the crack just before the worst of it and sinks back\n *   after. The shake itself is on the field (sceneAt's quake, with its own lead-in and tail), and\n *   the trees wobble while shaking says so.\n * @param {Object} event - The earthquake event.\n * @param {Object} context - The overlay context.\n * @returns {Object|null} The descriptor, or null outside its window.\n * @since 1.0.0\n */\nfunction earthquakeOverlay(event, context) {\n  const {raceMs} = context;\n  const rules = STAGE_TIMINGS.earthquake;\n  const shake = fieldWindow(event);\n  const moleFrom = event.startMs - rules.moleLeadMs;\n  const endMs = event.endMs + rules.moleTailMs;\n  if (raceMs < shake.startMs || raceMs >= endMs) {\n    return null;\n  }\n  // Where along the ground the mole pops up, as a percentage of the field width.\n  const moleAcross = Math.round((0.15 + seededUnit(event.id, 2) * 0.7) * 100);\n  return {\n    key: event.id,\n    type: 'earthquake',\n    layer: 'wash',\n    shaking: raceMs >= event.startMs && raceMs < event.endMs,\n    ground: windowOf(shake.startMs, endMs, fadeShares(shake.startMs, endMs, 0, rules.moleSinkMs)),\n    crack: windowOf(shake.startMs, shake.startMs + rules.crackMs),\n    mole: {\n      across: moleAcross,\n      ...windowOf(moleFrom, endMs, fadeShares(moleFrom, endMs, rules.molePopMs, rules.moleSinkMs))\n    }\n  };\n}\n\n/**\n * @description The flood, behind the squirrels: water rises from the bottom of the field to the\n *   waterline over the lead-in, holds through the plan window, then drains over the tail, with a\n *   lone rubber duck floating across while it is up.\n * @param {Object} event - The flood event.\n * @param {Object} context - The overlay context.\n * @returns {Object|null} The descriptor, or null outside its window.\n * @since 1.0.0\n */\nfunction floodOverlay(event, context) {\n  const {raceMs} = context;\n  const water = fieldWindow(event);\n  if (raceMs < water.startMs || raceMs >= water.endMs) {\n    return null;\n  }\n  const units = Number.isFinite(event.data.waterHeightUnits) ? event.data.waterHeightUnits : 20;\n  return {\n    key: event.id,\n    type: 'flood',\n    layer: 'wash',\n    units: Math.round(units * 10) / 10,\n    range: envelopeOf(water),\n    duck: windowOf(event.startMs, water.endMs)\n  };\n}\n\n/**\n * @description The disco (contract § 4 and § 8): the mirror ball drops in and the lights come up\n *   over the lead-in, so the dancing starts under full lights; the purple wash is behind the\n *   squirrels and only the beams and the ball are in front, at low opacity. A beaver does the\n *   robot (its own cameo when no beaver is on stage). Two descriptors: the wash (and cameo) on\n *   the wash layer, the beams and ball on the fx layer.\n * @param {Object} event - The disco event.\n * @param {Object} context - The overlay context.\n * @returns {Object[]} The descriptors (none when it is over).\n * @since 1.0.0\n */\nfunction discoOverlays(event, context) {\n  const {timeline, raceMs} = context;\n  const rules = STAGE_TIMINGS.disco;\n  const lights = fieldWindow(event, rules.leadMs, rules.tailMs);\n  if (raceMs < lights.startMs || raceMs >= lights.endMs) {\n    return [];\n  }\n  const range = windowOf(\n    lights.startMs,\n    lights.endMs,\n    fadeShares(lights.startMs, lights.endMs, rules.lightsUpMs, rules.tailMs)\n  );\n  const beaverOnStage = timeline.events.some((other) => {\n    if (other.type !== 'beaver') {\n      return false;\n    }\n    const visit = trunkVisit(other);\n    return raceMs >= visit.startMs && raceMs < visit.endMs;\n  });\n  return [\n    {\n      key: `${event.id}-wash`,\n      type: 'discoWash',\n      layer: 'wash',\n      range,\n      cameo: !beaverOnStage\n    },\n    {\n      key: event.id,\n      type: 'disco',\n      layer: 'fx',\n      range,\n      // The ball is in place before the lights are fully up.\n      ball: windowOf(lights.startMs, lights.startMs + rules.dropMs),\n      side: timeline.discoBallSide[event.id] || 'centre'\n    }\n  ];\n}\n\n/**\n * @description The acorn hail: nuts pelting down over the whole field, each at its own place,\n *   size and moment (seeded from the event, so a replay rains the same), building over a lead-in\n *   and easing off over a tail. The nuts keep clear of the leaderboard's side.\n * @param {Object} event - The acorn hail event.\n * @param {Object} context - The overlay context.\n * @returns {Object|null} The descriptor, or null when it is over.\n * @since 1.0.0\n */\nfunction acornHailOverlay(event, context) {\n  const {raceMs} = context;\n  const rules = STAGE_TIMINGS.acornHail;\n  const hail = fieldWindow(event);\n  if (raceMs < hail.startMs || raceMs >= hail.endMs) {\n    return null;\n  }\n  const nuts = Array.from({length: rules.nuts}, (_value, slot) => ({\n    across: Math.round((0.03 + 0.88 * ((slot + seededUnit(event.id, slot)) / rules.nuts)) * 100),\n    down: Math.round(seededUnit(event.id, slot + 40) * 80),\n    delay: Math.round(seededUnit(event.id, slot + 80) * 900),\n    size: Math.round((0.7 + seededUnit(event.id, slot + 120) * 0.6) * 100) / 100\n  }));\n  return {key: event.id, type: 'acornHail', layer: 'fx', nuts, range: envelopeOf(hail)};\n}\n\n/**\n * @description The VAR review: everyone frozen (the plan stalls them all), the owl referee blows\n *   the whistle, checks the monitor, shows the card; the lines are drawn, \"checking\", then the\n *   verdict, then play resumes. CROWD_MODES[field.type] : 'calm'\n  };\n}\n\n/**\n * @description The scale band for a field size (SPEC.md § 8 scale): roomy up to 12 squirrels\n *   (flat labels, full outfits), busy from 13 (rotated labels, hat and fur only), packed from 31\n *   (narrow lanes and small sprites; the leaderboard carries readability).\n * @param {number} count - Entrants.\n * @param {Object} [theme] - The theme config.\n * @returns {string} 'roomy', 'busy' or 'packed'.\n * @since 1.0.0\n */\nexport function scaleBand(count, theme = themeConfig) {\n  const {scale} = theme.race;\n  if (count >= scale.compactLanesFrom) {\n    return 'packed';\n  }\n  return count >= scale.simplifiedOutfitsFrom ? 'busy' : 'roomy';\n}\n\n/**\n * @description The field-wide state at a race time that the element puts on the field itself:\n *   the earthquake's shake (building over a lead-in, fading over a tail, Chaos v2 contract § 8),\n *   the disco light and the VAR freeze (both over the plan window, when everyone is stalled).\n * @param {Object} timeline - From prepareTimeline.\n * @param {number} raceMs - Race time.\n * @param {boolean} reduced - Reduced motion: no shake.\n * @returns {{quake: ({startMs: number, durationMs: number, inShare: number,\n *   outShare: number}|null), disco: boolean, varFreeze: boolean}} The state.\n * @since 1.0.0\n */\nfunction fieldStateAt(timeline, raceMs, reduced) {\n  const active = (type) => timeline.events.find((event) => (\n    event.type === type && event.startMs <= raceMs && raceMs < event.endMs\n  )) || null;\n  const quakeEvent = reduced\n    ? null\n    : timeline.events.find((event) => {\n      if (event.type !== 'earthquake') {\n        return false;\n      }\n      const shake = fieldWindow(event);\n      return shake.startMs <= raceMs && raceMs < shake.endMs;\n    });\n  let quake = null;\n  if (quakeEvent) {\n    const shake = fieldWindow(quakeEvent);\n    quake = {\n      startMs: shake.startMs,\n      durationMs: shake.endMs - shake.startMs,\n      inShare: shake.inShare,\n      outShare: shake.outShare\n    };\n  }\n  return {\n    quake,\n    disco: Boolean(active('disco')),\n    varFreeze: Boolean(active('var'))\n  };\n}\n\n/**\n * @description Everything discrete the stage shows at a stage time, plus a signature that changes\n *   only when something on it does. Continuous positions are left to racerPlacement. Since 2.2.0\n *   the scene also carries how many race log entries have appeared (logCount) and the owl\n *   commentator's pose (owlPose, Chaos v2 contract § 11 and § 12), both in the signature, and it\n *   settles only once the owl is back to idle (its cheer loops would otherwise run on).\n * @param {Object} plan - From buildRacePlan.\n * @param {Object} timeline - From prepareTimeline.\n * @param {Array<{atMs: number, trigger?: string}>} cues - Commentary cues.\n * @param {number} stageMs - Stage time.\n * @param {{reduced?: boolean, legendary?: boolean[], resultShownMs?: (number|null),\n *   confettiMs?: number, log?: Array<{atMs: number, kind: string}>}} [options] - Reduced motion,\n *   who wears a legendary item, when the result view appeared (stage time), how long confetti\n *   stays, and the race log (buildRaceLog; since 2.2.0, none when missing).\n * @returns {Object} The scene: phase, raceMs, countIn, cueIndex, logCount, owlPose, racers,\n *   occupancy, board, overlays, swayLanes, wobbleLanes, twisting, quake, disco, varFreeze, crowd,\n *   photo, confetti, settled and signature.\n * @example\n *   const scene = sceneAt(plan, timeline, cues, t, {reduced: false, log});\n * @since 1.0.0\n */\nexport function sceneAt(plan, timeline, cues, stageMs, options = {}) {\n  const reduced = options.reduced === true;\n  const legendary = options.legendary || [];\n  const raceMs = raceTimeAt(timeline, stageMs);\n  const phase = phaseAt(timeline, stageMs);\n  const racers = plan.entrants.map((_entrant, index) => (\n    racerLook(plan, timeline, index, raceMs, {legendary: legendary[index] === true})\n  ));\n  const occupancy = new Array(plan.entrants.length).fill(-1);\n  // Hidden squirrels (inside a trench coat) keep their own trees, so the labels stay put.\n  racers\n    .map((racer, index) => ({racer, index}))\n    .sort((left, right) => Number(left.racer.hidden) - Number(right.racer.hidden))\n    .forEach(({racer, index}) => {\n      if (occupancy[racer.tree - 1] === -1 || racer.hidden) {\n        occupancy[racer.tree - 1] = index;\n      }\n    });\n  const board = leaderboardAt(plan, raceMs).slice(0, 5).map((row) => ({\n    entrantIndex: row.entrantIndex,\n    finished: row.finished,\n    position: row.position\n  }));\n  const overlays = overlaysAt(plan, timeline, raceMs, reduced);\n  // A tree sways while its beaver chomps, and wobbles while its woodpecker drills or the ground\n  // shakes; Names reach the page through Lit text bindings only.\n */\nimport {html, css, nothing} from 'lit';\nimport {guard} from 'lit/directives/guard.js';\nimport {repeat} from 'lit/directives/repeat.js';\nimport {classMap} from 'lit/directives/class-map.js';\nimport {themeConfig} from '../lib/theme-config.js';\nimport {outfitForDrawing, isLegendary} from '../lib/outfits.js';\nimport {truncateLabel} from '../lib/names.js';\nimport {\n  drawSquirrel,\n  drawHeart,\n  drawKissMark,\n  drawSlapHand,\n  drawStars,\n  drawSmoke,\n  drawBolt,\n  drawEagle,\n  drawPositionBadge,\n  drawTree,\n  drawChestnut,\n  drawFlyingCat,\n  drawGoldenAcorn,\n  drawHailNut,\n  drawTrenchCoat,\n  hasSprite,\n  hasEffect\n} from './stage-sprites.js';\n\n/**\n * @description Reads a stored outfit: an object as it is, a JSON string parsed, anything else\n *   empty (which draws a plain squirrel).\n * @param {*} raw - The payload's outfit.\n * @returns {Object} The outfit object.\n * @example\n *   readOutfit('{\"hat\":\"crown\"}');\n *   // {hat: 'crown'}\n * @since 1.0.0\n */\nexport function readOutfit(raw) {\n  if (raw && typeof raw === 'object') {\n    return raw;\n  }\n  if (typeof raw === 'string' && raw.trim().startsWith('{')) {\n    try {\n      const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);\n      return parsed && typeof parsed === 'object' ? parsed : {};\n    } catch {\n      return {};\n    }\n  }\n  return {};\n}\n\n/**\n * @description Prepares how each entrant is drawn: name and label, bib number and colours, the\n *   outfit for this field size (hat and fur only from 13 squirrels, SPEC.md § 8 scale), the\n *   outfit at each step of its outfit timeline (Chaos v2 contract § 3: a hat chomped off, a UFO\n *   swap, a hat blown away), and the legendary sparkle.\n * @param {Object} plan - From buildRacePlan.\n * @param {Array<{outfit?: *}>} payloadEntrants - The race payload's entrants, in plan order.\n * @param {string} band - 'roomy', 'busy' or 'packed' (see scaleBand).\n * @param {Object} [theme] - The theme config.\n * @returns {Array<{index: number, name: string, label: string, number: number, colour: string,\n *   ink: string, pattern: string, shape: string, outfit: Object, outfits: Object[],\n *   fullOutfit: Object, hat: string, legendary: boolean}>} The cast, in plan order (outfit is\n *   what the lanes draw, outfits what they draw at each outfit-timeline step, fullOutfit what the\n *   podium draws).\n * @example\n *   const cast = buildCast(plan, payload.entrants, 'roomy');\n * @since 1.0.0\n */\nexport function buildCast(plan, payloadEntrants, band, theme = themeConfig) {\n  const palette = theme.lanePalette;\n  const {defaults} = theme.outfits;\n  // From 13 squirrels only the hat and fur are drawn (SPEC.md § 8 scale).\n  const forBand = (drawable) => (band === 'roomy'\n    ? drawable\n    : {...drawable, cape: defaults.cape, accessory: defaults.accessory});\n  return plan.entrants.map((entrant, index) => {\n    const stored = readOutfit((payloadEntrants[index] || {}).outfit);\n    const drawable = outfitForDrawing(stored, theme.outfits);\n    const outfit = forBand(drawable);\n    const timeline = Array.isArray(entrant.outfitTimeline) ? entrant.outfitTimeline : [];\n    const outfits = timeline.map((step) => {\n      const changed = readOutfit(step ? step.outfit : null);\n      return forBand(outfitForDrawing({...stored, ...changed}, theme.outfits));\n    });\n    const swatch = palette[(entrant.lane - 1) % palette.length];\n    return {\n      index,\n      name: entrant.name,\n      label: truncateLabel(entrant.name, theme.race.labelMaxChars),\n      number: entrant.lane,\n      colour: swatch.colour,\n      ink: swatch.ink,\n      pattern: swatch.bibPattern,\n      shape: swatch.bibShape,\n      outfit,\n      outfits,\n      fullOutfit: drawable,\n      hat: drawable.hat,\n      legendary: isLegendary(stored, theme.outfits)\n    };\n  });\n}\n\n/**\n * @description A bib chip: the squirrel's number on its lane colour, pattern and shape.\n * @param {Object} member - A cast member.\n * @param {string} [size] - 'chip' (labels, leaderboard) or 'bib' (on the squirrel).\n * @param {*} [name] - The name to print beside the number, when there is room.\n * @returns {import('lit').TemplateResult} The template.\n * @example\n *   renderBib(member, 'chip');\n * @since 1.0.0\n */\nexport function renderBib(member, size = 'chip', name = nothing) {\n  return html`<span\n    class=\"bib bib-size-${size} bib-shape-${member.shape} bib-pattern-${member.pattern}\"\n    style=\"--bib: ${member.colour}; --bib-ink: ${member.ink}\"\n    ><span class=\"bib-number\">${member.number}</span>${name}</span\n  >`;\n}\n\n/** The sprite kit's tree viewBox is this many units wide; its height is the caller's. */\nconst TREE_VIEW_WIDTH = 60;\n\n/** Trees are at most this wide (CSS --tree-max says the same), so a two-squirrel race has trees,\n * not tree trunks the width of the screen. */\nconst TREE_BOX_MAX_PX = 160;\n\n/**\n * @description The viewBox height for the kit's tree so it fills its lane from the ground to the\n *   top of the field without stretching (the kit draws it anchored at the bottom). Rounded up: a\n *   taller viewBox only makes the tree a little slimmer, never shorter than its lane.\n * @param {number} fieldWidth - The field's width in pixels.\n * @param {number} fieldHeight - The field's height in pixels.\n * @param {number} count - Lanes.\n * @returns {number} A viewBox height from 120 to 2000, in steps of 20.\n * @example\n *   treeViewHeight(1100, 600, 8);\n * @since 1.0.0\n */\nexport function treeViewHeight(fieldWidth, fieldHeight, count) {\n  const laneWidth = fieldWidth / Math.max(1, count);\n  const boxWidth = Math.max(1, Math.min(laneWidth, TREE_BOX_MAX_PX));\n  const raw = (TREE_VIEW_WIDTH * fieldHeight) / boxWidth;\n  return Math.min(2000, Math.max(120, Math.ceil(raw / 20) * 20));\n}\n\n/**\n * @description The trees, each with its chestnut on top. The winner's chestnut bounces once the\n *   result is in; a beaver's tree sways; a tornado bends them all; a woodpecker's tree (or every\n *   tree in an earthquake) wobbles. With the kit's tree the motion comes from the kit's classes;\n *   the plain fallback trunk animates itself.\n * @param {{count: number, swayLanes: number[], wobbleLanes?: number[], twisting: boolean,\n *   winnerLane: number, celebrate: boolean, treeHeight: number}} state - What the trees are\n *   doing, and the tree viewBox height (see treeViewHeight).\n * @returns {import('lit').TemplateResult} The template.\n * @since 1.0.0\n */\nexport function renderTrees({\n  count,\n  swayLanes,\n  wobbleLanes = [],\n  twisting,\n  winnerLane,\n  celebrate,\n  treeHeight\n}) {\n  const withArt = hasSprite('treeSprite');\n  const lanes = Array.from({length: count}, (_value, slot) => slot + 1);\n  return html`<div class=${classMap({trees: true, 'is-twisting': twisting})} aria-hidden=\"true\">\n    ${lanes.map((lane) => {\n      const swaying = swayLanes.includes(lane);\n      const wobbling = wobbleLanes.includes(lane);\n      const bouncing = celebrate && lane === winnerLane;\n      // Each tree only rebuilds when its own state changes.\n      return guard([swaying, wobbling, bouncing, twisting, treeHeight, withArt], () => {\n        const treeClasses = {\n          tree: true,\n          'is-swaying': swaying,\n          'is-wobbling': wobbling,\n          'is-plain': !withArt\n        };\n        if (withArt) {\n          const motion = [\n            bouncing ? 'ss-anim-chestnut-bounce' : '',\n            twisting ? 'ss-anim-tree-bend' : '',\n            wobbling && !twisting ? 'ss-anim-tree-wobble' : ''\n          ].filter(Boolean).join(' ');\n          const art = drawTree({height: treeHeight, swaying, className: motion});\n          return html`<div class=${classMap(treeClasses)} data-lane=${lane}>\n            <span class=\"tree-art\">${art}</span>\n          </div>`;\n        }\n        const nutClasses = {'tree-nut': true, 'is-bouncing': bouncing};\n        return html`<div class=${classMap(treeClasses)} data-lane=${lane}>\n          <span class=${classMap(nutClasses)}>${drawChestnut()}</span>\n        </div>`;\n      });\n    })}\n  </div>`;\n}\n\n// The timed motion (stage-scrubs.js) for each timed decoration; the eagle's carry has none.\nconst DECOR_MOTION = Object.freeze({\n  hearts: 'hearts-rise',\n  kiss: 'pop',\n  slap: 'slap',\n  smoke: 'smoke-rise',\n  'eagle:dive': 'eagle-dive',\n  'eagle:away': 'eagle-away',\n  'cat:fly': 'cat-fly',\n  'cat:drop': 'drop-off',\n  'acorn:home': 'acorn-home',\n  'acorn:loop': 'acorn-loop',\n  'big-nut': 'pop'\n});\n\n/**\n * @description The eagle, with the cat it caught instead of the squirrel (catVsEagle) dangling\n *   below and a puzzled question mark (drawn by the stylesheet).\n * @param {{phase: string, withCat?: boolean}} item - The eagle decoration.\n * @returns {import('lit').TemplateResult} The template.\n * @since 1.0.0\n */\nfunction renderEagle(item) {\n  const pose = {dive: 'dive', carry: 'carry', away: 'fly'}[item.phase] || 'carry';\n  if (!item.withCat) {\n    return html`${drawEagle(pose)}`;\n  }\n  return html`<span class=\"eagle-art\">${drawEagle(pose)}</span\n    ><span class=\"eagle-cat\">${drawFlyingCat('drop')}</span\n    ><span class=\"eagle-puzzled\"></span>`;\n}\n\n/**\n * @description The decoration's own art.\n * @param {Object} item - The decoration from racerLook.\n * @returns {*} A Lit-renderable value, or nothing for an unknown kind.\n * @since 1.0.0\n */\nfunction decorationArt(item) {\n  const art = {\n    hearts: () => html`<span class=\"heart heart-1\">${drawHeart()}</span\n      ><span class=\"heart heart-2\">${drawHeart()}</span\n      ><span class=\"heart heart-3\">${drawHeart()}</span>`,\n    kiss: () => drawKissMark(),\n    slap: () => drawSlapHand(),\n    smoke: () => drawSmoke(),\n    eagle: () => renderEagle(item),\n    cat: () => drawFlyingCat(item.phase === 'drop' ? 'drop' : 'fly'),\n    acorn: () => drawGoldenAcorn(item.phase === 'loop' ? 'loop' : 'fly'),\n    'big-nut': () => drawHailNut()\n  };\n  return art[item.kind] ? art[item.kind]() : nothing;\n}\n\n/**\n * @description Stand-ins for Chaos v2 squirrel effects the kit does not draw yet: a cat on the\n *   squirrel's back, nuts in its cheeks. Nothing once the kit draws them itself.\n * @param {string[]} effects - The look's effects.\n * @returns {Array<import('lit').TemplateResult>} The stand-ins.\n * @since 1.0.0\n */\nfunction effectStandIns(effects) {\n  const standIns = [];\n  if (effects.includes('catClinging') && !hasEffect('catClinging')) {\n    standIns.push(html`<span class=\"decor decor-cat-cling\">${drawFlyingCat('cling')}</span>`);\n  }\n  if (effects.includes('chubby') && !hasEffect('chubby')) {\n    standIns.push(html`<span class=\"decor decor-cheeks\"\n      ><span class=\"decor-cheek decor-cheek-left\">${drawHailNut()}</span\n      ><span class=\"decor-cheek decor-cheek-right\">${drawHailNut()}</span></span\n    >`);\n  }\n  return standIns;\n}\n\n/**\n * @description One decoration around a squirrel. Timed ones carry their race-time window and\n *   motion (data-scrub, data-scrub-kind), and the stage writes their transform and opacity every\n *   frame, so they look the same at the same moment of a replay.\n * @param {{kind: string, startMs: number, durationMs: number, phase?: string}} item - The\n *   decoration from racerLook.\n * @returns {import('lit').TemplateResult|typeof nothing} The template.\n * @since 1.0.0\n */\nfunction renderDecoration(item) {\n  const motion = DECOR_MOTION[item.phase ? `${item.kind}:${item.phase}` : item.kind] || '';\n  const classes = {\n    decor: true,\n    [`decor-${item.kind}`]: true,\n    [`decor-${item.kind}-${item.phase}`]: Boolean(item.phase),\n    'has-cat': Boolean(item.withCat)\n  };\n  // Where a cat or the Golden Acorn flies in from, relative to the squirrel (stage-scrubs.js).\n  const fromX = Number.isFinite(item.fromX) ? item.fromX : 0;\n  const fromY = Number.isFinite(item.fromY) ? item.fromY : 0;\n  const timed = (inner) => (motion\n    ? html`<span\n      class=${classMap(classes)}\n      style=\"--from-x: ${fromX}; --from-y: ${fromY}\"\n      data-scrub=\"race\"\n      data-scrub-kind=${motion}\n      data-scrub-start=${item.startMs}\n      data-scrub-duration=${item.durationMs}\n      >${inner}</span\n    >`\n    : html`<span class=${classMap(classes)}>${inner}</span>`);\n  const art = decorationArt(item);\n  if (art !== nothing) {\n    return timed(art);\n  }\n  if (item.kind === 'stars') {\n    // The kit's dizzy pose draws its own circling stars; these stand in only without the kit.\n    return hasSprite('squirrelSprite')\n      ? nothing\n      : html`<span class=\"decor decor-stars\">${drawStars()}</span>`;\n  }\n  if (item.kind === 'zap') {\n    return html`<span class=\"decor decor-zap\"\n      ><span class=\"zap zap-1\">${drawBolt()}</span\n      ><span class=\"zap zap-2\">${drawBolt()}</span></span\n    >`;\n  }\n  return nothing;\n}\n\n/**\n * @description One squirrel: body (pose, motion and decorations), bib and, once home, its\n *   position badge. The initial transform comes from --start-lane, so the server's markup already\n *   has every squirrel at the foot of its own tree. It wears the outfit of its outfit-timeline\n *   step; inside a trench coat it is hidden (its box keeps moving, unseen), and the host draws\n *   the coat instead of itself.\n * @param {Object} member - The cast member.\n * @param {Object} look - From racerLook.\n * @param {{band: string, laneCount: number, cast: Object[]}} options - Scale band, lane count\n *   and the cast (for the furs in a trench coat).\n * @returns {import('lit').TemplateResult} The template.\n * @since 1.0.0\n */\nfunction renderRacer(member, look, {band, laneCount, cast}) {\n  const step = Number.isInteger(look.outfitStep) ? look.outfitStep : -1;\n  const outfit = step >= 0 && member.outfits[step] ? member.outfits[step] : member.outfit;\n  // The outfit ids are in the key too: a rematch reuses the same racer elements.\n  const outfitKey = [outfit.fur, outfit.hat, outfit.cape, outfit.accessory].join('/');\n  const poseKey = `${look.pose}|${look.effects.join(',')}|${outfitKey}|${look.coat ? 'coat' : ''}`;\n  const leanLeft = look.tree === laneCount && laneCount > 1;\n  const classes = {\n    racer: true,\n    [`motion-${look.motion}`]: true,\n    'lean-left': leanLeft,\n    // In the right half, flyers (the eagle) come and go on the side away from the leaderboard.\n    'is-east': laneCount > 1 && look.tree > laneCount / 2,\n    'is-home': look.finished,\n    'is-hidden': look.hidden === true,\n    'is-coat': look.coat === true\n  };\n  const name = band === 'roomy'\n    ? html`<span class=\"bib-name\">${member.label}</span>`\n    : nothing;\n  // The coat shows each hidden squirrel's fur, top first.\n  const coatFurs = (look.coatHeads || [])\n    .filter((index) => cast[index])\n    .map((index) => cast[index].outfit.fur);\n  const drawBody = () => (look.coat\n    ? drawTrenchCoat(coatFurs.length > 0 ? coatFurs : 3)\n    : drawSquirrel({...outfit, pose: look.pose, effects: look.effects}));\n  return html`<div\n    class=${classMap(classes)}\n    data-racer=${member.index}\n    data-tree=${look.tree}\n    style=\"--start-lane: ${member.number - 1}\"\n  >\n    <div class=\"racer-body\">\n      <span class=\"racer-sprite\">${guard([poseKey], drawBody)}</span>\n      ${look.coat ? nothing : effectStandIns(look.effects)}\n      ${look.decor.map((item) => renderDecoration(item))}\n    </div>\n    <span class=\"racer-bib\">${renderBib(member, 'bib', name)}</span>\n    ${look.finished\n      ? html`<span class=\"racer-place\">${drawPositionBadge(look.position)}</span>`\n      : nothing}\n  </div>`;\n}\n\n/**\n * @description Every squirrel on the stage. Hidden from assistive technology: the trunk labels,\n *   the leaderboard and the result announcement say in text what is happening.\n * @param {Object[]} cast - From buildCast.\n * @param {Object[]} looks - From sceneAt, one per entrant.\n * @param {string} band - The scale band.\n * @returns {import('lit').TemplateResult} The template.\n * @since 1.0.0\n */\nexport function renderRacers(cast, looks, band) {\n  const options = {band, laneCount: cast.length, cast};\n  return html`<div class=\"racers\" aria-hidden=\"true\">\n    ${repeat(\n      cast,\n      (member) => member.index,\n      (member) => renderRacer(member, looks[member.index], options)\n    )}\n  </div>`;\n}\n\n/**\n * @description The labels at the foot of the trees: who is on each tree now, flipping after a\n *   tornado. Names truncate at 14 characters (the full name is there for screen readers and\n *   search) and rotate 45 degrees on narrow lanes (SPEC.md § 8).\n * @param {Object[]} cast - From buildCast.\n * @param {number[]} occupancy - Entrant index per tree (from sceneAt).\n * @param {boolean} rotated - Rotate the labels.\n * @param {{getMessage: Function}} i18n - The AIUX i18n service.\n * @returns {import('lit').TemplateResult} The template.\n * @since 1.0.0\n */\nexport function renderTrunkLabels(cast, occupancy, rotated, i18n) {\n  return html`<ol\n    class=${classMap({'trunk-labels': true, 'is-rotated': rotated})}\n    aria-label=${i18n.getMessage('Who is on each tree')}\n  >\n    ${occupancy.map((index, slot) => {\n      const member = cast[index];\n      if (!member) {\n        return html`<li class=\"trunk-label\" data-tree=${slot + 1}></li>`;\n      }\n      const spoken = i18n.getMessage('Tree {tree}: {name}, number {number}', {\n        tree: slot + 1,\n        name: member.name,\n        number: member.number\n      });\n      return html`<li class=\"trunk-label\" data-tree=${slot + 1} data-occupant=${member.index}>\n        <span class=\"trunk-tag\" aria-hidden=\"true\" title=${member.name}\n          >${renderBib(member, 'chip')}<span class=\"trunk-name\">${member.label}</span></span\n        >\n        <span class=\"sr-only\">${spoken}</span>\n      </li>`;\n    })}\n  </ol>`;\n}\n\n/** The lanes' styles: trees, squirrels, bibs, decorations and labels. */\nexport const laneStyles = css`\n  /* Field layers, back to front: trees 1, field-wide washes 1 (drawn after the trees,\n     stage-field-layer.js), back overlays 2 (stage-chaos-layer.js), squirrels 3, front overlays 4,\n     light accents 5, VAR review 7, photo-finish stamp 8 (stage-podium.js). Explicit, because with\n     every layer at z-index auto the trees (each with a transformed tree-art) painted over the\n     overlays. */\n  .trees {\n    position: absolute;\n    inset: 0;\n    z-index: 1;\n    display: grid;\n    grid-template-columns: repeat(var(--lanes), minmax(0, 1fr));\n  }\n\n  .tree {\n    position: relative;\n    height: 100%;\n    transform-origin: 50% 100%;\n  }\n\n  .tree-art {\n    position: absolute;\n    top: 0;\n    bottom: 0;\n    left: 50%;\n    width: var(--tree-w);\n    transform: translateX(-50%);\n  }\n\n  .tree-art svg {\n    display: block;\n    width: 100%;\n    height: 100%;\n  }\n\n  .tree.is-plain::before {\n    content: '';\n    position: absolute;\n    left: 50%;\n    top: calc(var(--climb-top) * 0.6);\n    bottom: 0;\n    width: 4px;\n    transform: translateX(-10%) rotate(-18deg);\n    border-radius: 2px;\n    background: var(--ss-bark);\n  }\n\n  .tree-nut {\n    position: absolute;\n    top: 0;\n    left: 50%;\n    width: calc(var(--sprite) * 0.55);\n    height: calc(var(--sprite) * 0.55);\n    transform: translateX(-50%);\n    display: flex;\n    align-items: center;\n    justify-content: center;\n    font-size: calc(var(--sprite) * 0.45);\n  }\n\n  .tree-nut svg {\n    width: 100%;\n    height: 100%;\n  }\n\n  .tree-nut.is-bouncing {\n    animation: stage-nut-bounce 700ms var(--ease-heavy-bounce, 'chomp' : 'circle';\n    const hat = chomper && chomp.phase === 'wearing' ? stolenHat : 'none';\n    return html`<span class=\"chaos-debris chaos-shark chaos-shark-${slot}\"\n      >${drawShark(pose, hat)}</span\n    >`;\n  });\n}\n\n/**\n * @description The tornado: darkening sky, then the funnel sweeping across with a leaf, a garden\n *   gnome and a startled cow spinning in it (and sharks in a sharknado, and a swept-up suitor),\n *   then lifting off where it stands, short of the leaderboard. The funnel follows FUNNEL's path\n *   (stage-scrubs.js), the same path the lifted squirrels follow, so they stay inside it.\n * @param {Object} overlay - From overlaysAt.\n * @param {Object[]} cast - From buildCast.\n * @returns {import('lit').TemplateResult} The template.\n * @since 1.0.0\n */\nfunction renderTornado(overlay, cast) {\n  const passenger = overlay.passenger === 'suitor'\n    ? html`<span class=\"chaos-debris chaos-debris-suitor\">${drawSuitor('kiss')}</span>`\n    : nothing;\n  return html`<div class=\"chaos-overlay chaos-tornado\">\n    ${timed('chaos-dim', overlay.dim, 'storm-dim', nothing)}\n    ${timed('chaos-funnel', overlay.sweep, 'funnel-sweep',\n      timed('chaos-funnel-lift', overlay.lift, 'funnel-lift', html`\n        <span class=\"chaos-funnel-art\">${drawTornado()}</span>\n        <span class=\"chaos-debris chaos-debris-leaf\">${drawDebris('leaf')}</span>\n        <span class=\"chaos-debris chaos-debris-gnome\">${drawDebris('gnome')}</span>\n        <span class=\"chaos-debris chaos-debris-cow\">${drawDebris('cow')}</span>\n        ${overlay.sharks ? renderSharks(overlay, cast) : nothing}\n        ${passenger}\n      `))}\n  </div>`;\n}\n\n/**\n * @description The hunter: walks in from the nearer edge at a readable pace to stand beside his\n *   squirrel's tree, squints, BLAM, then walks back out (a hit) or grumbles with a sooty face\n *   first (a miss).
