A field-wide wash never covers a squirrel, so\n *   nobody looks faded;\n * - fx (z 5, in front of the squirrels): light accents only, at low opacity: the disco beams\n *   and mirror ball, the leaf gust (leaves, then a pigeon, then the gardener's toupee) and the\n *   acorn hail;\n * - var (z 7, above everything but the photo-finish stamp): the VAR review, drawn while everyone\n *   is stalled in the plan, with the clock still running.\n * The earthquake's screen shake is on the field itself (the element's field shaker), and the\n * squirrels' own reactions (flapping, bouncing, dancing, chubby cheeks) are in stage-looks.js.\n *\n * Timing works as in stage-chaos-layer.js: each timed part carries data-scrub, data-scrub-kind,\n * data-scrub-start, data-scrub-duration, data-scrub-in and data-scrub-out, and the stage writes\n * its transform and opacity from the race clock every frame (stage-scrubs.js). Every event builds\n * over a lead-in and fades over a tail, and holds its full effect for the whole plan window.\n *\n * Smooth motion (contract § 8): only transform and opacity move; the few large movers (the\n * water, the washes, the disco beams) have will-change; the kit's water, crack and VAR lines are\n * stretched to their boxes, so their own loops are switched off here and the stage moves the\n * whole box instead. The only endless loops left (beams sweeping, leaves streaming, hail\n * falling, the robot) are transform animations on small HTML boxes.\n *\n * Class names all start with \"field-\", so they never style the sprite kit's inner groups (the\n * few rules here that switch off a kit loop name the kit's class on purpose).\n * Reduced motion: still frames (the water at its line, the ball hung, the nuts scattered), fades\n * stay as fades, and the commentary says what happened. Everything here is decorative and\n * hidden from assistive technology.\n */\nimport {html, css, nothing} from 'lit';\nimport {classMap} from 'lit/directives/class-map.js';\nimport {repeat} from 'lit/directives/repeat.js';\nimport {DEFAULT_SHAPE} from './stage-scrubs.js';\nimport {\n  drawLeafGust,\n  drawPigeon,\n  drawCrack,\n  drawMole,\n  drawFloodWater,\n  drawRubberDuck,\n  drawMirrorBall,\n  drawBeaver,\n  drawHailNut,\n  drawOwlReferee,\n  drawVarLines,\n  hasSprite\n} from './stage-sprites.js';\n\n/**\n * @description Wraps content in an element the stage times through a race-time window.\n * @param {string} className - The element's classes.\n * @param {{startMs: number, durationMs: number, inShare?: number, outShare?: number}|null} range -\n *   The window, with where its build-up ends and its fade starts when it has them.\n * @param {string} kind - The timed motion, a stage-scrubs.js kind.\n * @param {*} inner - The content.\n * @returns {import('lit').TemplateResult} The template.\n * @since 1.0.0\n */\nfunction timed(className, range, kind, inner) {\n  if (!range) {\n    return html`<div class=${className}>${inner}</div>`;\n  }\n  const inShare = Number.isFinite(range.inShare) ? range.inShare : DEFAULT_SHAPE.inShare;\n  const outShare = Number.isFinite(range.outShare) ? range.outShare : DEFAULT_SHAPE.outShare;\n  return html`<div\n    class=${className}\n    data-scrub=\"race\"\n    data-scrub-kind=${kind}\n    data-scrub-start=${range.startMs}\n    data-scrub-duration=${range.durationMs}\n    data-scrub-in=${inShare}\n    data-scrub-out=${outShare}\n  >${inner}</div>`;\n}\n\n/**\n * @description The disco's floor, behind the squirrels: the purple wash, and a beaver doing the\n *   robot when no beaver is at a tree (otherwise that one does it, see stage-chaos-layer.js).\n *   Both build up before the dancing starts and fade after it.\n * @param {Object} overlay - From overlaysAt (type discoWash).\n * @returns {import('lit').TemplateResult} The template.\n * @since 2.1.0\n */\nfunction renderDiscoWash(overlay) {\n  const cameo = overlay.cameo\n    ? html`<span class=\"field-disco-beaver\">\n      <span class=\"field-disco-robot\">${drawBeaver('idle')}</span>\n    </span>`\n    : nothing;\n  return html`<div class=\"field-overlay field-disco-floor\">\n    ${timed('field-disco-wash', overlay.range, 'envelope', cameo)}\n  </div>`;\n}\n\n/**\n * @description The disco's light accents, in front of the squirrels at low opacity: three beams\n *   sweeping from the mirror ball, and the ball itself, dropped in on its string before the\n *   dancing starts.\n * @param {Object} overlay - From overlaysAt (type disco).\n * @returns {import('lit').TemplateResult} The template.\n * @since 1.0.0\n */\nfunction renderDisco(overlay) {\n  const classes = {\n    'field-overlay': true,\n    'field-disco': true,\n    [`field-ball-${overlay.side}`]: true\n  };\n  return html`<div class=${classMap(classes)}>\n    ${timed('field-disco-beams', overlay.range, 'envelope', html`\n      <span class=\"field-disco-beam field-disco-beam-1\"></span>\n      <span class=\"field-disco-beam field-disco-beam-2\"></span>\n      <span class=\"field-disco-beam field-disco-beam-3\"></span>\n    `)}\n    ${timed('field-disco-ball', overlay.range, 'envelope',\n      timed('field-disco-drop', overlay.ball, 'drop-in', html`\n        <span class=\"field-disco-string\"></span>\n        <span class=\"field-disco-ball-art\">${drawMirrorBall()}</span>\n      `))}\n  </div>`;\n}\n\n/**\n * @description The leaf gust blowing across the whole field: streaming leaves, then a startled\n *   pigeon, then the gardener's toupee, all building up with the blower and fading after it.\n * @param {Object} overlay - From overlaysAt.\n * @returns {import('lit').TemplateResult} The template.\n * @since 1.0.0\n */\nfunction renderGust(overlay) {\n  const rightToLeft = overlay.direction === 'rtl';\n  const fly = rightToLeft ? The plan's sky.\n * @param {Object} [theme] - The theme config.\n * @returns {boolean} True when the preset lists storm clouds.\n * @example\n *   hasStormClouds('storm');\n *   // true\n * @since 2.2.0\n */\nexport function hasStormClouds(skyId, theme = themeConfig) {\n  const preset = theme.skies.presets[skyId];\n  const extras = preset && Array.isArray(preset.extras) ? preset.extras : [];\n  return extras.includes('storm_clouds');\n}\n\n/**\n * @description The rain for one race: the wind slant, each depth layer's streaks and fall time,\n *   and the splash ripples, all drawn from the race seed. Null for a dry sky.\n * @param {number} seed - The race seed.\n * @param {{density: number, speed?: number, opacity?: number}|null} rain - From rainOf.\n * @returns {{windDeg: number, layers: Array<{depth: string, fallMs: number,\n *   streaks: Array<{x: number, y: number, length: number, width: number, opacity: number,\n *   tiltDeg: number}>}>, splashes: Array<{x: number, y: number, size: number, durationMs: number,\n *   delayMs: number}>}|null} The layout: streak x and y in tile units, length in tile units,\n *   width in screen px; splash x and y in per cent of the grass strip.\n * @example\n *   rainLayout(plan.seed, rainOf(plan.sky));\n * @since 2.2.0\n */\nexport function rainLayout(seed, rain) {\n  if (!rain || !(rain.density > 0)) {\n    return null;\n  }\n  const rng = createRng(Number(seed) + RAIN_SEED_OFFSET);\n  const speed = rain.speed > 0 ? rain.speed : 1;\n  const fade = Number.isFinite(rain.opacity) ? Math.min(1, Math.max(0, rain.opacity)) : 1;\n  const windDeg = round2(rng.floatBetween(WIND_SLANT_DEG.min, WIND_SLANT_DEG.max));\n  const layers = RAIN_DEPTH_ORDER.map((depth) => {\n    const spec = RAIN_DEPTHS[depth];\n    const count = Math.max(1, Math.round(spec.count * rain.density));\n    const streaks = Array.from({length: count}, () => ({\n      x: round2(rng.floatBetween(0, RAIN_TILE.width)),\n      y: round2(rng.floatBetween(0, RAIN_TILE.height)),\n      length: round2(rng.floatBetween(spec.length[0], spec.length[1])),\n      width: round2(rng.floatBetween(spec.width[0], spec.width[1])),\n      opacity: round2(rng.floatBetween(spec.opacity[0], spec.opacity[1]) * fade),\n      tiltDeg: round2(rng.floatBetween(-STREAK_TILT_DEG, STREAK_TILT_DEG))\n    }));\n    return {depth, fallMs: Math.round(spec.fallMs / speed), streaks};\n  });\n  const splashCount = Math.max(1, Math.round(SPLASHES.count * rain.density));\n  const loopMs = SPLASHES.loopMs / speed;\n  // Spread along the strip (one per stretch, jittered inside it), each on its own loop.\n  const splashes = Array.from({length: splashCount}, (_value, index) => {\n    const durationMs = Math.round(loopMs * rng.floatBetween(0.85, 1.25));\n    return {\n      x: round2(((index + rng.floatBetween(0.15, 0.85)) / splashCount) * 100),\n      y: round2(rng.floatBetween(SPLASHES.band[0], SPLASHES.band[1])),\n      size: round2(rng.floatBetween(0.7, 1.2)),\n      durationMs,\n      // Negative: every ripple is already part-way through its loop when the race appears.\n      delayMs: -Math.round(rng.floatBetween(0, durationMs))\n    };\n  });\n  return {windDeg, layers, splashes};\n}\n\n/**\n * @description How far a rain layer must reach past each side of its box, as a share of the\n *   box's height, so the wind's slant never leaves a dry corner: half the tangent of the slant\n *   (the layer is slanted about its centre).\n * @param {number} windDeg - The wind's slant in degrees, from rainLayout.\n * @returns {number} The overhang, a share of the box's height (three decimals); 0 for no slant.\n * @example\n *   windOverhang(12);\n *   // 0.106\n * @since 2.2.0\n */\nexport function windOverhang(windDeg) {\n  const slant = Number(windDeg);\n  if (!Number.isFinite(slant) || slant <= 0) {\n    return 0;\n  }\n  return Math.round((Math.tan((Math.min(slant, 45) * Math.PI) / 180) / 2) * 1000) / 1000;\n}\n\n/**\n * @description Turns a layer's streaks into a few path groups for drawing: thickness rounded to\n *   half a pixel and opacity to 0.05, so a sheet is a handful of paths, not hundreds of lines.\n *   Each streak is drawn three times, a tile above, in place and a tile below, so the two-tile\n *   sheet repeats exactly (a streak that runs off the bottom of a tile carries on at its top).\n * @param {Array<{x: number, y: number, length: number, width: number, opacity: number,\n *   tiltDeg: number}>} streaks - Drawn only: the\n *   strike itself never changes.\n * @param {Object} plan - From buildRacePlan.\n * @param {Object} timeline - From prepareTimeline (its events are normalised).\n * @param {string} skyId - The plan's sky.\n * @param {Object} [theme] - The theme config.\n * @returns {Array<{key: string, lane: number, side: number, startMs: number,\n *   durationMs: number, inShare: number, outShare: number}>} The clouds (empty in a storm).\n * @example\n *   thundercloudsFor(plan, timeline, plan.sky);\n * @since 2.2.0\n */\nexport function thundercloudsFor(plan, timeline, skyId, theme = themeConfig) {\n  if (hasStormClouds(skyId, theme)) {\n    return [];\n  }\n  const count = plan.entrants.length;\n  return timeline.events\n    .filter((event) => (\n      event.type === 'lightning'\n      && Number.isInteger(event.entrants[0])\n      && Boolean(plan.entrants[event.entrants[0]])\n    ))\n    .map((event) => {\n      const {lane} = laneAt(plan, event.entrants[0], event.startMs);\n      return {\n        key: event.id,\n        lane,\n        side: lane > count / 2 ? 1 : -1,\n        startMs: event.startMs - THUNDERCLOUD.leadMs,\n        durationMs: THUNDERCLOUD.leadMs + THUNDERCLOUD.tailMs,\n        inShare: THUNDERCLOUD.inShare,\n        outShare: THUNDERCLOUD.outShare\n      };\n    });\n}\n","/**\n * The race stage's weather layers (Chaos v2 contract § 14): the rain in three depths, its splash\n * ripples on the grass, and the small thunderclouds a lightning strike comes out of in a sky\n * without storm clouds. components/stage-weather.js works out what to draw from the race seed;\n * this module turns that into templates and styles.\n *\n * Rain. A\n * thundercloud still fades in and out, without moving.\n */\nimport {html, css, nothing} from 'lit';\nimport {repeat} from 'lit/directives/repeat.js';\nimport {RAIN_DEPTH_ORDER, streakGroups, windOverhang} from './stage-weather.js';\nimport {drawRainSheet, drawSplash, drawThundercloud} from './stage-sprites.js';\n\n/**\n * @description One rain layer: its slant wrapper and its falling sheet.\n * @param {{depth: string, fallMs: number, streaks: Array<Object>}} layer - From rainLayout.\n * @param {number} windDeg - The race's wind slant in degrees.\n * @param {string} colour - The streaks' colour.\n * @returns {import('lit').TemplateResult} The template.\n * @since 2.2.0\n */\nfunction renderRainLayer(layer, windDeg, colour) {\n  const style = `--rain-wind: ${windDeg}deg; --rain-overhang: ${windOverhang(windDeg)}; `\n    + `--rain-fall: ${layer.fallMs}ms`;\n  return html`<div class=\"rain rain-${layer.depth}\" style=${style} data-depth=${layer.depth}>\n    <div class=\"rain-skew\">\n      <div class=\"rain-fall\">${drawRainSheet(streakGroups(layer.streaks), colour)}</div>\n    </div>\n  </div>`;\n}\n\n/**\n * @description The rain layers of the given depths, back to front. Draw it once a race (guard\n *   it on the layout): nothing in it changes while the race runs.\n * @param {{windDeg: number, layers: Array<Object>}|null} weather - From rainLayout (null for a\n *   dry sky).\n * @param {string[]} depths - Which depths: ['far', 'mid'] in the sky, ['near'] over the field.\n * @param {string} colour - The streaks' colour, a literal #RRGGBB (the sky preset's rain colour).\n * @returns {import('lit').TemplateResult|typeof nothing} The layers, or nothing when dry.\n * @example\n *   renderRain(weather, ['far', 'mid'], '#CFE3F2');\n * @since 2.2.0\n */\nexport function renderRain(weather, depths, colour) {\n  if (!weather || !Array.isArray(weather.layers)) {\n    return nothing;\n  }\n  const wanted = Array.isArray(depths) ? depths : RAIN_DEPTH_ORDER;\n  const layers = weather.layers.filter((layer) => wanted.includes(layer.depth));\n  if (layers.length === 0) {\n    return nothing;\n  }\n  return html`${layers.map((layer) => renderRainLayer(layer, weather.windDeg, colour))}`;\n}\n\n/**\n * @description The splash ripples on the grass strip. Base values are each part's still frame (reduced motion). */\nexport const weatherStyles = css`\n  /* A rain layer fills its box (the sky, or the field for the near layer) and clips its sheet.\n     It is a size container, so its slant wrapper can reach past each side by the wind's overhang\n     (a share of the box's height). */\n  .rain {\n    position: absolute;\n    inset: 0;\n    overflow: hidden;\n    pointer-events: none;\n    container-type: size;\n  }\n\n  .rain-skew {\n    position: absolute;\n    top: 0;\n    bottom: 0;\n    left: calc(var(--rain-overhang, 0.2) * -100cqh - 4px);\n    right: calc(var(--rain-overhang, 0.2) * -100cqh - 4px);\n    transform: skewX(var(--rain-wind, 12deg));\n  }\n\n  /* The sheet is two tiles tall and starts one tile up, so moving down by half its own height\n     (one tile) brings it back to the same picture. */\n  .rain-fall {\n    position: absolute;\n    top: -100%;\n    left: 0;\n    width: 100%;\n    height: 200%;\n    animation: stage-rain-fall var(--rain-fall, 1600ms) linear infinite;\n    will-change: transform;\n  }\n\n  .rain-fall svg {\n    display: block;\n    width: 100%;\n    height: 100%;\n  }\n\n  /* The near layer: the field's top layer but two, in front of the squirrels, their visitors and\n     the light accents (5), behind the VAR review (7) and the photo-finish stamp (8). Sparse and faint; the leaderboard stays above it. */\n  .rain-near {\n    position: absolute;\n    inset: 0;\n    z-index: 6;\n    opacity: 0.3;\n    pointer-events: none;\n  }\n\n  .rain-splashes {\n    position: absolute;\n    inset: 0;\n    overflow: hidden;\n    pointer-events: none;\n  }\n\n  .rain-splash {\n    --splash-w: calc(clamp(12px, 1.6vw, 26px) * var(--splash-size, 1));\n    position: absolute;\n    left: var(--splash-x, 50%);\n    top: var(--splash-y, 30%);\n    width: var(--splash-w);\n    aspect-ratio: 20 / 9;\n    margin-left: calc(var(--splash-w) / -2);\n    opacity: 0;\n    transform-origin: 50% 70%;\n    animation: stage-rain-splash var(--splash-ms, 1100ms) ease-out var(--splash-delay, 0ms)\n      infinite;\n  }\n\n  .rain-splash svg {\n    display: block;\n    width: 100%;\n    height: 100%;\n  }\n\n  /* Thunderclouds sit with the back visitors, in front of the top of the lightning bolt, so the\n     bolt comes out of the cloud. */\n  .weather-clouds {\n    position: absolute;\n    inset: 0;\n    z-index: 2;\n    pointer-events: none;\n  }\n\n  .weather-thundercloud {\n    --cloud-w: clamp(44px, calc(var(--lane-w) * 1.5), 200px);\n    position: absolute;\n    top: -5cqh;\n    left: calc(var(--lane-w) * (var(--lane) + 0.5) - var(--cloud-w) / 2);\n    width: var(--cloud-w);\n    aspect-ratio: 44 / 24;\n    opacity: 0;\n    font-size: calc(var(--cloud-w) * 0.45);\n  }\n\n  .weather-thundercloud svg {\n    display: block;\n    width: 100%;\n    height: 100%;\n    overflow: visible;\n  }\n\n  @keyframes stage-rain-fall {\n    from {\n      transform: translate3d(0, 0, 0);\n    }\n    to {\n      transform: translate3d(0, 50%, 0);\n    }\n  }\n\n  @keyframes stage-rain-splash {\n    0% {\n      transform: scale(0.2);\n      opacity: 0;\n    }\n    12% {\n      opacity: 0.85;\n    }\n    45% {\n      transform: scale(1);\n      opacity: 0;\n    }\n    100% {\n      transform: scale(1);\n      opacity: 0;\n    }\n  }\n\n  /* The photo-finish freeze-frame holds the weather too (the field's own rule only reaches the\n     near layer). */\n  .stage.is-freeze-frame :is(.rain-fall, .rain-splash) {\n    animation-play-state: paused;\n  }\n\n  /* Reduced motion: no splashes (the streaks already stand still: every animation stops). */\n  .reduce .rain-splashes,\n  :host([reduced-motion]) .rain-splashes {\n    display: none;\n  }\n\n  @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {\n    .rain-splashes {\n      display: none;\n    }\n  }\n`;\n","/**\n * Race simulation for tuning and the M8 checks (SPEC.md § 14): fakes stored results under the\n * server's timing rules and runs the choreography on each, then reports how races feel. In the\n * browser it backs SquirrelScramble.debug.simulate(1000); in Node it backs the unit tests.\n *\n * fakeResult() ports the server's draw steps 5 to 7 (SPEC.md § 7): two independent shuffles\n * (finishing order and lanes), then finish times by position. The server rounds its own way;\n * that does not matter here, because the choreography only needs finish times that strictly\n * increase with position.\n *\n * Pure ES module: no DOM, no Lit and no platform imports.\n */\nimport {createRng, randomSeed} from './rng.js';\nimport {themeConfig} from './theme-config.js';\nimport {buildRacePlan, heightAt, leaderAt, leaderChanges} from './choreography.js';\n\n// The largest seed the server stores (SPEC.md § 5, Race.seed).\nconst MAX_SEED = 2147483646;\n// M8 asks who leads at a quarter of the race.\nconst QUARTER = 0.25;\nconst MODES = ['classic', 'chaos'];\n\n/**\n * @description The gaps between consecutive finishers, by position (SPEC.md § 7, step 7): the\n *   runner-up gap from the photo-finish range or the normal range, every later gap from the\n *   later range, all scaled down if the spread exceeds half the race.\n * @param {Object} rng - A seeded generator.\n * @param {number} count - Entrants.\n * @param {number} durationMs - The winner's finish time.\n * @param {number} photoFinishChance - Chance the runner-up gap is a photo-finish gap.\n * @returns {number[]} count - 1 whole-millisecond gaps, each at least 1.\n * @since 1.0.0\n */\nfunction finishGaps(rng, count, durationMs, photoFinishChance) {\n  const rules = themeConfig.serverTiming;\n  const gaps = [];\n  for (let position = 2; position <= count; position += 1) {\n    let range = rules.laterGapMs;\n    if (position === 2) {\n      range = rng.chance(photoFinishChance) ? rules.photoGapMs : rules.runnerUpGapMs;\n    }\n    gaps.push(rng.intBetween(range.min, range.max));\n  }\n  const spread = gaps.reduce((sum, gap) => sum + gap, 0);\n  const limit = durationMs * rules.maxSpreadFraction;\n  if (spread <= limit) {\n    return gaps;\n  }\n  const scale = limit / spread;\n  return gaps.map((gap) => Math.max(1, Math.floor(gap * scale)));\n}\n\n/**\n * @description Fakes a stored result under the server's rules: an independent finishing order\n *   and lane order, then finish times by position with the winner at exactly durationMs.\n *   Generator order: the finishing-order shuffle, the lane shuffle, then the gaps.\n * @param {Object} rng - A seeded generator.\n * @param {string[]} names - Entrant names (at least one).\n * @param {number} durationMs - The race length (the winner's finish time).\n * @param {number} [photoFinishChance] - Defaults to the theme's 0.25.\n * @returns {{durationMs: number, photoFinish: boolean,\n *   entrants: Array<{name: string, lane: number, position: number, finishMs: number}>}} The\n *   result, entrants sorted by lane like the race payload.\n * @throws {RangeError} If there are no names or the length is not positive.\n * @example\n *   const result = fakeResult(createRng(7), ['Alex', 'Sam'], 20000);\n * @since 1.0.0\n */\nexport function fakeResult(\n  rng,\n  names,\n  durationMs,\n  photoFinishChance = themeConfig.race.photoFinishChance\n) {\n  if (!Array.isArray(names) || names.length === 0) {\n    throw new RangeError('fakeResult needs at least one name.');\n  }\n  if (!(Number.isFinite(durationMs) && durationMs > 0)) {\n    throw new RangeError('fakeResult needs a positive durationMs.');\n  }\n  const indexes = Array.from(names.keys());\n  // positionRank[index] + 1 is a name's position; sys_update_xml.name: sys_ws_operation_a74bec561b009350f2e9edf3604bcb24
sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_ws_operation"><sys_ws_operation action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><active>true</active><consumes>application/json,application/xml,text/xml</consumes><consumes_customized>false</consumes_customized><default_operation_uri/><enforce_acl>cf9d01d3e73003009d6247e603f6a990</enforce_acl><http_method>GET</http_method><name>Hall of Fame</name><operation_script><![CDATA[/**
 * Squirrel Race: GET /hall-of-fame?limit=n. The top names across drawn races as
 * [{ name, wins, podiums, lastWin }] with 200 (limit 1 to 25, default 10). A win is first
 * place; a podium is a place the race awarded; void races never count. 403 forbidden
 * without the marshal role. All logic lives in SquirrelRaceEngine.
 */
(function process(request, response) {
  const engine = new SquirrelRaceEngine();
  const denied = engine.checkMarshal();
  const result = denied || engine.hallOfFame(engine.paramValue(request.queryParams.limit));
  const reply = engine.toHttp(result, 200);
  response.setStatus(reply.status);
  response.setBody(reply.body);
})(request, response);
]]></operation_script><operation_uri>/api/x_crli_squirrel/race/hall-of-fame</operation_uri><produces>application/json,application/xml,text/xml</produces><produces_customized>false</produces_customized><relative_path>/hall-of-fame</relative_path><request_example/><requires_acl_authorization>true</requires_acl_authorization><requires_authentication>true</requires_authentication><requires_snc_internal_role>true</requires_snc_internal_role><short_description>Top winners across drawn races (limit 1-25, default 10).</short_description><support_trailing_slash>false</support_trailing_slash><sys_class_name>sys_ws_operation</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin.identity_3</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-10-22 12:18:59</sys_created_on><sys_id>a74bec561b009350f2e9edf3604bcb24</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Hall of Fame</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Squirrel Scramble" source="x_crli_squirrel">4ea49ea28f8447dc9e14c1b33913cb48</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Squirrel Scramble">4ea49ea28f8447dc9e14c1b33913cb48</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_ws_operation_a74bec561b009350f2e9edf3604bcb24</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin.identity_3</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-10-22 12:18:59</sys_updated_on><web_service_definition display_value="Squirrel Race">48aaacde1bc4135083ceedf3604bcb27</web_service_definition><web_service_version/></sys_ws_operation></record_update>

 * Mapping between ServiceNow locale codes and BCP 47 locale codes.
 *
 * ServiceNow uses short codes (e.g. "de") while @lit/localize requires
 * BCP 47 tags (e.g. "de-DE"). This module bridges the two.
 */

export const serviceNowToBcp47 = {
  ar: 'ar-SA', // Arabic
  pb: 'pt-BR', // Brazilian Portuguese
  zh: 'zh-CN', // Chinese (Simplified)
  zt: 'zh-TW', // Chinese (Traditional)
  cs: 'cs-CZ', // Czech
  nl: 'nl-NL', // Dutch
  en: 'en-US', // English
  et: 'et-EE', // Estonian
  fi: 'fi-FI', // Finnish
  fr: 'fr-FR', // French
  fq: 'fr-CA', // French (Canada)
  de: 'de-DE', // German
  he: 'he-IL', // Hebrew
  hu: 'hu-HU', // Hungarian
  it: 'it-IT', // Italian
  ja: 'ja-JP', // Japanese
  ko: 'ko-KR', // Korean
  'es-419': 'es-419', // Latin American Spanish
  nb: 'nb-NO', // Norwegian
  pl: 'pl-PL', // Polish
  pt: 'pt-PT', // Portuguese
  xl: 'en-x-pseudo', // Pseudo (Testing)
  'en-x-pseudo': 'en-x-pseudo', // Pseudo (Testing)
  ru: 'ru-RU', // Russian
  es: 'es-ES', // Spanish
  sv: 'sv-SE', // Swedish
  th: 'th-TH', // Thai
  tr: 'tr-TR', // Turkish
  sk: 'sk-SK', // Slovak
  'sk-SK': 'sk-SK', // Slovak Full BCP
  uk: 'uk-UA', // Ukrainian
  'uk-UA': 'uk-UA' // Ukrainian full BCP
};

/**
 * Convert a ServiceNow locale code to BCP 47.
 * Returns the input unchanged if no mapping exists.
 *
 * @param {string} snCode - ServiceNow locale code (e.g. "de", "ja")
 * @returns {string} BCP 47 locale code (e.g. "de-DE", "ja-JP")
 */
export function toBcp47(snCode) {
  return serviceNowToBcp47[snCode] || snCode;
}

.ss-sprite.ss-flood-water, .ss-sprite.ss-disco-lights, .ss-sprite.ss-var-lines { overflow: hidden; }
.ss-rubber-ring { position: relative; display: block; width: 100%; height: 100%; }
.ss-rubber-ring > .ss-sprite { position: absolute; inset: 0; }
/* Pivots: SVG parts turn about 0 0 unless told otherwise. */ .ss-sprite :is( .crack-body, .crack-pebble, .mole-nose, .dirt, .bubble, .facet, .ball-sparkle, .hail-nut, .var-target, .coat-peek, .fake-moustache, .monitor-screen, .ref-card, .whistle-lines ) { transform-box: fill-box; transform-origin: center; }
.ss-sprite :is(.mole-body, .mole-paws, .duck-rig, .owl-head, .coat-rig, .flood-rig, .var-line) { transform-box: fill-box; transform-origin: 50% 100%; }
.ss-mirror-ball .ball-rig { transform-origin: 50px 0; }
.ss-disco-lights .disco-beam { transform-origin: 80px -4px; }
.ss-owl-referee .ss-motion { transform-origin: 50px 96px; }
/* Earthquake. */ .ss-crack .crack-body { animation: ss-crack-open var(--ss-crack-duration, 500ms) var(--ease-enter, cubic-bezier(0.21, 0.64, 0.52, 1)) var(--ss-oneshot-count, 1) both; }
.ss-crack .crack-pebble { animation: ss-pebble-hop var(--ss-pebble-duration, 700ms) ease-out infinite; }
.ss-crack .crack-pebble.pebble-2 { animation-delay: calc(var(--ss-pebble-duration, 700ms) / -3); }
.ss-crack .crack-pebble.pebble-3 { animation-delay: calc(var(--ss-pebble-duration, 700ms) / -1.5); }
.ss-mole-pop :is(.mole-body, .mole-paws) { animation: ss-mole-pop var(--ss-mole-pop-duration, 600ms) var(--ease-light-bounce, cubic-bezier(0.3, 1.41, 0.4, 0.99)) var(--ss-oneshot-count, 1) both; }
.ss-mole-pop .mole-nose { animation: ss-sniff var(--ss-sniff-duration, 500ms) ease-in-out infinite; }
.ss-mole-pop .dirt { animation: ss-dirt-fly var(--ss-dirt-duration, 900ms) ease-out infinite, ss-field-fade-out var(--ss-dirt-duration, 900ms) linear infinite; }
.ss-mole-pop .dirt.dirt-2 { animation-delay: calc(var(--ss-dirt-duration, 900ms) / -3); }
.ss-mole-pop .dirt.dirt-3 { animation-delay: calc(var(--ss-dirt-duration, 900ms) / -1.5); }
/* Flood. */ .ss-flood-water .flood-rig { animation: ss-flood-rise var(--ss-flood-rise-duration, 2000ms) var(--ease-low-accel, cubic-bezier(0.52, 0.01, 0.3, 0.99)) var(--ss-oneshot-count, 1) both; }
.ss-flood-water .wave-back { animation: ss-waves-left var(--ss-wave-back-duration, 3000ms) linear infinite; }
.ss-flood-water .wave-front { animation: ss-waves-right var(--ss-wave-front-duration, 2200ms) linear infinite; }
.ss-flood-water .bubble { animation: ss-bubble-rise var(--ss-bubble-duration, 1800ms) ease-out infinite, ss-field-fade-out var(--ss-bubble-duration, 1800ms) linear infinite; }
.ss-flood-water .bubble.bubble-2 { animation-delay: calc(var(--ss-bubble-duration, 1800ms) * -0.25); }
.ss-flood-water .bubble.bubble-3 { animation-delay: calc(var(--ss-bubble-duration, 1800ms) * -0.5); }
.ss-flood-water .bubble.bubble-4 { animation-delay: calc(var(--ss-bubble-duration, 1800ms) * -0.75); }
.ss-rubber-ring > .ss-sprite:not(.ss-ring-water) { animation: ss-ring-bob var(--ss-ring-bob-duration, 1800ms) ease-in-out infinite; animation-delay: var(--ss-crowd-delay, 0ms); }
.ss-rubber-duck .duck-rig { animation: ss-duck-bob var(--ss-duck-bob-duration, 1400ms) ease-in-out infinite; }
/* Disco. */ .ss-mirror-ball .ball-rig { animation: ss-ball-drop var(--ss-ball-drop-duration, 900ms) var(--ease-light-bounce, cubic-bezier(0.3, 1.41, 0.4, 0.99)) var(--ss-oneshot-count, 1) both, ss-ball-sway var(--ss-ball-sway-duration, 3000ms) ease-in-out var(--ss-ball-drop-duration, 900ms) infinite; }
.ss-mirror-ball .facet { animation: ss-facet-glint var(--ss-glint-duration, 1200ms) linear infinite; }
.ss-mirror-ball .facet.facet-2 { animation-delay: calc(var(--ss-glint-duration, 1200ms) * -0.25); }
.ss-mirror-ball .facet.facet-3 { animation-delay: calc(var(--ss-glint-duration, 1200ms) * -0.5); }
.ss-mirror-ball .facet.facet-4 { animation-delay: calc(var(--ss-glint-duration, 1200ms) * -0.75); }
.ss-mirror-ball .ball-sparkle { animation: ss-glint-scale var(--ss-glint-duration, 1200ms) ease-in-out infinite, ss-glint-opacity var(--ss-glint-duration, 1200ms) linear infinite; }
.ss-mirror-ball .ball-sparkle.sparkle-b { animation-delay: calc(var(--ss-glint-duration, 1200ms) / -3); }
.ss-mirror-ball .ball-sparkle.sparkle-c { animation-delay: calc(var(--ss-glint-duration, 1200ms) / -1.5); }
.ss-disco-lights .disco-wash { animation: ss-wash-pulse var(--ss-wash-duration, 2400ms) linear infinite; }
.ss-disco-lights .disco-beam { animation: ss-beam-sweep var(--ss-beam-duration, 2400ms) ease-in-out infinite alternate; }
.ss-disco-lights .disco-beam.beam-2 { animation-direction: alternate-reverse; }
.ss-disco-lights .disco-beam.beam-3 { animation-delay: calc(var(--ss-beam-duration, 2400ms) / -2); }
.ss-disco-lights .disco-beam.beam-4 { animation-direction: alternate-reverse; animation-delay: calc(var(--ss-beam-duration, 2400ms) / -2); }
.ss-disco-lights .disco-spot { animation: ss-spot-glide var(--ss-spot-duration, 1800ms) ease-in-out infinite alternate; }
.ss-disco-lights .disco-spot.spot-2 { animation-direction: alternate-reverse; }
/* Acorn hail. */ .ss-hail-nut .hail-nut { animation: ss-hail-wobble var(--ss-hail-wobble-duration, 400ms) ease-in-out infinite alternate; }
.ss-hail-nut .hail-streaks { animation: ss-field-flicker var(--ss-streak-duration, 400ms) linear infinite; }
.ss-anim-hail-fall { animation: ss-hail-fall var(--ss-hail-duration, 1200ms) linear var(--ss-oneshot-count, 1) both; animation-delay: var(--ss-hail-delay, 0ms); }
/* Owl referee. */ .ss-owl-referee.ss-pose-whistle .ss-motion { animation: ss-ref-hop var(--ss-whistle-duration, 500ms) ease-in-out infinite; }
.ss-owl-referee.ss-pose-whistle .owl-head { animation: ss-whistle-puff var(--ss-whistle-duration, 500ms) ease-in-out infinite; }
.ss-owl-referee .whistle-lines { animation: ss-field-flicker var(--ss-whistle-duration, 500ms) linear infinite; }
.ss-owl-referee.ss-pose-monitor .owl-head { animation: ss-peer var(--ss-peer-duration, 1600ms) ease-in-out infinite; }
.ss-owl-referee .monitor-screen { animation: ss-screen-flicker var(--ss-screen-duration, 900ms) linear infinite; }
.ss-owl-referee .ref-card { animation: ss-card-thrust var(--ss-card-duration, 900ms) var(--ease-heavy-bounce, cubic-bezier(0.25, 2.25, 0.45, 1)) infinite; }
/* VAR lines. */ .ss-var-lines .var-line { animation: ss-var-draw var(--ss-var-draw-duration, 700ms) var(--ease-enter, cubic-bezier(0.21, 0.64, 0.52, 1)) var(--ss-oneshot-count, 1) both; }
.ss-var-lines .var-line.var-line-b { animation-delay: calc(var(--ss-var-draw-duration, 700ms) / 2); }
.ss-var-lines .var-target { animation: ss-target-pulse var(--ss-target-duration, 900ms) ease-in-out infinite; }
.ss-var-lines .var-scan { animation: ss-var-scan var(--ss-scan-duration, 1600ms) linear infinite; }
/* Trench coat. */ .ss-trench-coat .coat-rig { animation: ss-teeter var(--ss-teeter-duration, 1600ms) ease-in-out infinite; }
.ss-trench-coat .coat-feet { animation: ss-shuffle var(--ss-shuffle-duration, 300ms) ease-in-out infinite alternate; }

/* Theme hooks. */ .ss-cat-lady { --ss-cl-cardigan-colour: var(--ss-cat-lady-cardigan, #8E5BA8); --ss-cl-dress-colour: var(--ss-cat-lady-dress, #3E9E9E); --ss-cl-bag-colour: var(--ss-cat-lady-bag, #A23B5A); --ss-cl-curler-colour: var(--ss-cat-lady-curlers, #F06292); }
.ss-cat-lady .ss-cl-cardigan { fill: var(--ss-cl-cardigan-colour); }
.ss-cat-lady .ss-cl-dress { fill: var(--ss-cl-dress-colour); }
.ss-cat-lady .ss-cl-bag-body { fill: var(--ss-cl-bag-colour); }
.ss-cat-lady .ss-cl-curlers { fill: var(--ss-cl-curler-colour); }
.ss-flying-cat { --ss-fc-fur-colour: var(--ss-flying-cat-fur, #F08C3A); }
.ss-flying-cat .ss-fc-fur { fill: var(--ss-fc-fur-colour); }
.ss-flying-cat .ss-fc-fur-stroke { stroke: var(--ss-fc-fur-colour); }
.ss-golden-acorn { --ss-ga-gold-colour: var(--ss-golden-acorn, #F2C230); --ss-ga-cap-colour: var(--ss-golden-acorn-cap, #A0672C); }
.ss-golden-acorn .ss-ga-nut { fill: var(--ss-ga-gold-colour); }
.ss-golden-acorn .ss-ga-cap { fill: var(--ss-ga-cap-colour); }
.ss-shark { --ss-sk-skin-colour: var(--ss-shark, #7B9DB8); --ss-sk-belly-colour: var(--ss-shark-belly, #EEF3F6); }
.ss-shark .ss-sk-skin { fill: var(--ss-sk-skin-colour); }
.ss-shark .ss-sk-belly { fill: var(--ss-sk-belly-colour); }
.ss-gardener { --ss-gd-overalls-colour: var(--ss-gardener-overalls, #5B8C3E); --ss-gd-blower-colour: var(--ss-gardener-blower, #FF8F00); }
.ss-gardener .ss-gd-overalls { fill: var(--ss-gd-overalls-colour); }
.ss-gardener .ss-gd-blower-body { fill: var(--ss-gd-blower-colour); }
.ss-leaf-gust { --ss-lg-wind-colour: var(--ss-leaf-gust-wind, #CFD8DC); --ss-lg-pigeon-colour: var(--ss-pigeon, #9EA7B3); }
.ss-leaf-gust .ss-lg-wind { stroke: var(--ss-lg-wind-colour); }
.ss-leaf-gust .ss-lg-pigeon-body { fill: var(--ss-lg-pigeon-colour); }
.ss-ufo { --ss-ufo-hull-colour: var(--ss-ufo-hull, #B0BEC5); --ss-ufo-beam-colour: var(--ss-ufo-beam, #FFF59D); --ss-ufo-alien-colour: var(--ss-alien, #9CCC65); }
.ss-ufo .ss-ufo-hull { fill: var(--ss-ufo-hull-colour); }
.ss-ufo .ss-ufo-beam-light { fill: var(--ss-ufo-beam-colour); }
.ss-ufo .ss-ufo-alien { fill: var(--ss-ufo-alien-colour); }
.ss-woodpecker { --ss-wp-feather-colour: var(--ss-woodpecker, #2B2B2B); --ss-wp-hat-colour: var(--ss-woodpecker-hat, #FDD835); }
.ss-woodpecker .ss-wp-feathers { fill: var(--ss-wp-feather-colour); }
.ss-woodpecker .ss-wp-hat { fill: var(--ss-wp-hat-colour); }
/* * Pivots, in viewBox units (an SVG part turns about 0 0 unless told otherwise), or about the * part's own box (fill-box) where it spins or swells in place. */ .ss-cat-lady .ss-motion { transform-origin: 50px 94px; }
.ss-cat-lady .ss-cl-leg-back { transform-origin: 43.5px 80px; }
.ss-cat-lady .ss-cl-leg-front { transform-origin: 55px 80px; }
.ss-cat-lady .ss-cl-bag { transform-origin: 34px 55px; }
.ss-cat-lady .ss-cl-arm-front { transform-origin: 58px 44px; }
.ss-cat-lady .ss-cl-head { transform-origin: 52px 36px; }
.ss-cat-lady .ss-cl-dangle-cat { transform-origin: 68.6px 33.6px; }
.ss-flying-cat :is(.ss-motion, .ss-fc-figure) { transform-origin: 50px 54px; }
.ss-flying-cat .ss-fc-tail { transform-origin: 29px 49px; }
.ss-golden-acorn .ss-motion { transform-origin: 52px 60px; }
.ss-golden-acorn.ss-pose-loop .ss-ga-body { transform-origin: 52px 30px; }
.ss-golden-acorn.ss-pose-impact .ss-ga-body { transform-origin: 52px 86px; }
.ss-golden-acorn .ss-ga-wing-left { transform-origin: 36px 49px; }
.ss-golden-acorn .ss-ga-wing-right { transform-origin: 68px 49px; }
.ss-shark .ss-motion { transform-origin: 55px 52px; }
.ss-shark .ss-sk-tail { transform-origin: 25px 53px; }
.ss-shark .ss-sk-fin { transform-origin: 56px 62px; }
.ss-shark .ss-sk-jaws { transform-box: fill-box; transform-origin: 0% 50%; }
.ss-gardener .ss-motion { transform-origin: 50px 94px; }
.ss-gardener .ss-gd-leg-back { transform-origin: 46.7px 70px; }
.ss-gardener .ss-gd-leg-front { transform-origin: 54.2px 70px; }
.ss-gardener .ss-gd-toupee:not(.ss-gd-toupee-flying) { transform-origin: 62px 24px; }
.ss-ufo .ss-ufo-saucer { transform-origin: 50px 30px; }
.ss-ufo .ss-ufo-wave { transform-origin: 54px 24.6px; }
.ss-woodpecker .ss-motion { transform-origin: 52px 70px; }
.ss-woodpecker .ss-wp-head { transform-origin: 54px 38px; }
.ss-sprite :is( .ss-ga-sparkle, .ss-ga-burst, .ss-ga-stars, .ss-sk-propeller, .ss-gd-toupee-flying, .ss-gd-glint, .ss-lg-leaf, .ss-lg-pigeon, .ss-lg-feather, .ss-wp-chips, .ss-wp-eye ) { transform-box: fill-box; transform-origin: center; }
/* Cat lady: a bustling walk with a swinging handbag; an overarm throw; a cackle. */ .ss-cat-lady.ss-pose-walk .ss-motion { animation: ss-c2-bob calc(var(--ss-cat-lady-walk-duration, 560ms) / 2) ease-in-out infinite; }
.ss-cat-lady.ss-pose-walk .ss-cl-leg-front { animation: ss-c2-stride var(--ss-cat-lady-walk-duration, 560ms) ease-in-out infinite alternate; }
.ss-cat-lady.ss-pose-walk .ss-cl-leg-back { animation: ss-c2-stride var(--ss-cat-lady-walk-duration, 560ms) ease-in-out infinite alternate-reverse; }
.ss-cat-lady.ss-pose-walk .ss-cl-arm-front { animation: ss-c2-arm-swing var(--ss-cat-lady-walk-duration, 560ms) ease-in-out infinite alternate-reverse; }
.ss-cat-lady .ss-cl-bag { animation: ss-c2-bag-swing var(--ss-cat-lady-walk-duration, 560ms) ease-in-out infinite alternate; }
.ss-cat-lady .ss-cl-bag-cats { animation: ss-c2-peek var(--ss-cat-peek-duration, 2200ms) ease-in-out infinite; }
.ss-cat-lady.ss-pose-throw .ss-cl-arm-front { animation: ss-c2-throw-swing var(--ss-cat-throw-swing-duration, 1000ms) var(--ease-high-accel, cubic-bezier(0.3, 0, 0.08, 1)) infinite; }
.ss-cat-lady.ss-pose-throw .ss-cl-held-cat { animation: ss-c2-held-cat var(--ss-cat-throw-swing-duration, 1000ms) linear infinite; }
.ss-cat-lady.ss-pose-throw .ss-cl-swoosh { animation: ss-c2-swoosh var(--ss-cat-throw-swing-duration, 1000ms) linear infinite; }
.ss-cat-lady.ss-pose-cackle .ss-motion { animation: ss-c2-bob calc(var(--ss-cackle-duration, 360ms) / 2) ease-in-out infinite; }
.ss-cat-lady.ss-pose-cackle .ss-cl-head { animation: ss-c2-cackle-shake var(--ss-cackle-duration, 360ms) ease-in-out infinite; }
.ss-cat-lady.ss-pose-cackle .ss-cl-cackle-lines { animation: ss-c2-flicker var(--ss-cackle-duration, 360ms) linear infinite alternate; }
.ss-cat-lady.ss-pose-cackle .ss-cl-dangle-cat { animation: ss-c2-dangle var(--ss-dangle-duration, 1100ms) ease-in-out infinite alternate; }
/* Flying cat: flailing claws in flight, a wobbling grip when clinging, a dazed tumble. */ .ss-flying-cat.ss-pose-fly .ss-motion { animation: ss-c2-wobble var(--ss-cat-fly-duration, 500ms) ease-in-out infinite alternate; }
.ss-flying-cat.ss-pose-fly .ss-fc-legs { animation: ss-c2-flail var(--ss-cat-flail-duration, 160ms) linear infinite; }
.ss-flying-cat .ss-fc-tail { animation: ss-c2-tail-lash var(--ss-cat-tail-duration, 420ms) ease-in-out infinite alternate; }
.ss-flying-cat .ss-fc-speed { animation: ss-c2-flicker var(--ss-cat-fly-duration, 500ms) linear infinite alternate; }
.ss-flying-cat.ss-pose-cling .ss-fc-figure, .ss-anim-cat-cling { animation: ss-c2-cling-wobble var(--ss-cat-cling-duration, 700ms) ease-in-out infinite; }
.ss-flying-cat.ss-pose-drop .ss-motion { animation: ss-c2-spin var(--ss-cat-drop-spin-duration, 1400ms) linear infinite; }
/* * Cat throw arc: from where the cat leaves her hand to its target, set as * --ss-cat-throw-dx and --ss-cat-throw-dy, peaking --ss-cat-throw-height above the line. */ .ss-anim-cat-throw { animation: ss-c2-cat-throw-arc var(--ss-cat-throw-duration, 900ms) linear var(--ss-oneshot-count, 1) both; }
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ss-cat-lady.ss-pose-walk .ss-motion, .ss-cat-lady.ss-pose-walk .ss-cl-leg-front, .ss-cat-lady.ss-pose-walk .ss-cl-leg-back, .ss-cat-lady.ss-pose-walk .ss-cl-arm-front, .ss-cat-lady .ss-cl-bag, .ss-cat-lady .ss-cl-bag-cats, .ss-cat-lady.ss-pose-throw .ss-cl-arm-front, .ss-cat-lady.ss-pose-cackle .ss-motion, .ss-cat-lady.ss-pose-cackle .ss-cl-head, .ss-cat-lady.ss-pose-cackle .ss-cl-dangle-cat, .ss-flying-cat.ss-pose-fly .ss-motion, .ss-flying-cat.ss-pose-fly .ss-fc-legs, .ss-flying-cat .ss-fc-tail, .ss-flying-cat.ss-pose-cling .ss-fc-figure, .ss-anim-cat-cling, .ss-anim-cat-throw { animation: none; }
/* Still frames: the cat still in her hand, the laugh lines and speed lines showing. */ .ss-cat-lady.ss-pose-throw .ss-cl-held-cat, .ss-cat-lady.ss-pose-cackle .ss-cl-cackle-lines { animation: none; opacity: 1; }
.ss-cat-lady.ss-pose-throw .ss-cl-swoosh, .ss-flying-cat .ss-fc-speed { animation: none; opacity: 0.8; }
.ss-flying-cat.ss-pose-drop .ss-motion { animation: none; transform: rotate(20deg); } }
/* Golden Acorn: a wobbling, buzzing flight; a loop-the-loop; a squashed, jiggling impact. */ .ss-golden-acorn.ss-pose-fly .ss-ga-body { animation: ss-c2-acorn-wobble var(--ss-acorn-wobble-duration, 700ms) ease-in-out infinite; }
.ss-golden-acorn .ss-ga-wing-left { animation: ss-c2-buzz-left var(--ss-acorn-buzz-duration, 90ms) linear infinite alternate; }
.ss-golden-acorn .ss-ga-wing-right { animation: ss-c2-buzz-right var(--ss-acorn-buzz-duration, 90ms) linear infinite alternate; }
.ss-golden-acorn .ss-ga-sparkle { animation: ss-c2-twinkle-scale var(--ss-acorn-sparkle-duration, 900ms) ease-in-out infinite, ss-c2-twinkle-opacity var(--ss-acorn-sparkle-duration, 900ms) linear infinite; }
.ss-golden-acorn .ss-ga-sparkle-2 { animation-delay: calc(var(--ss-acorn-sparkle-duration, 900ms) / -3); }
.ss-golden-acorn .ss-ga-sparkle-3 { animation-delay: calc(var(--ss-acorn-sparkle-duration, 900ms) / -1.5); }
.ss-golden-acorn.ss-pose-loop .ss-ga-body { animation: ss-c2-acorn-loop var(--ss-acorn-loop-duration, 1200ms) ease-in-out infinite; }
.ss-golden-acorn.ss-pose-impact .ss-ga-body { animation: ss-c2-squash-jiggle var(--ss-acorn-jiggle-duration, 240ms) ease-in-out infinite alternate; }
.ss-golden-acorn .ss-ga-burst { animation: ss-c2-pulse var(--ss-acorn-burst-duration, 500ms) ease-in-out infinite; }
.ss-golden-acorn .ss-ga-stars { animation: ss-c2-twinkle-opacity var(--ss-acorn-sparkle-duration, 900ms) linear infinite; }
/* Victory loop on a wrapper: one loop-the-loop of radius --ss-acorn-loop-radius. */ .ss-anim-acorn-loop { animation: ss-c2-acorn-loop-path var(--ss-acorn-loop-duration, 1200ms) ease-in-out var(--ss-oneshot-count, 1) both; }
/* Shark: swimming round the funnel with a googly eye; the hat chomp snaps its jaws. */ .ss-shark.ss-pose-circle .ss-motion { animation: ss-c2-swim var(--ss-shark-swim-duration, 1200ms) ease-in-out infinite; }
.ss-shark .ss-sk-tail { animation: ss-c2-tail-swish var(--ss-shark-tail-duration, 450ms) ease-in-out infinite alternate; }
.ss-shark .ss-sk-fin { animation: ss-c2-fin-paddle var(--ss-shark-tail-duration, 450ms) ease-in-out infinite alternate-reverse; }
.ss-shark .ss-sk-pupil { animation: ss-c2-googly var(--ss-shark-googly-duration, 600ms) ease-in-out infinite; }
.ss-shark.ss-pose-chomp .ss-sk-jaws { animation: ss-c2-chomp-snap var(--ss-shark-chomp-duration, 700ms) var(--ease-high-accel, cubic-bezier(0.3, 0, 0.08, 1)) infinite; }
.ss-shark.ss-pose-chomp .ss-sk-snap { animation: ss-c2-snap-lines var(--ss-shark-chomp-duration, 700ms) linear infinite; }
.ss-shark .ss-sk-propeller { animation: ss-c2-propeller var(--ss-shark-propeller-duration, 260ms) linear infinite; }
.ss-shark .ss-sk-halo { animation: ss-c2-float var(--ss-shark-halo-duration, 2000ms) ease-in-out infinite; }
/* * Shark circling on a wrapper: round an ellipse of --ss-shark-orbit-rx by * --ss-shark-orbit-ry, facing the way it swims and smaller at the back. Stagger several * sharks with --ss-shark-orbit-delay. */ .ss-anim-shark-circle { animation: ss-c2-shark-orbit var(--ss-shark-orbit-duration, 2000ms) linear infinite; animation-delay: var(--ss-shark-orbit-delay, 0ms); }
/* Gardener: a whistling stroll; braced and shaking behind the blower; toupee in flight. */ .ss-gardener .ss-gd-blower { transform-origin: 60px 56px; }
.ss-gardener.ss-pose-walk .ss-motion { animation: ss-c2-bob calc(var(--ss-gardener-walk-duration, 600ms) / 2) ease-in-out infinite; }
.ss-gardener.ss-pose-walk .ss-gd-leg-front { animation: ss-c2-stride var(--ss-gardener-walk-duration, 600ms) ease-in-out infinite alternate; }
.ss-gardener.ss-pose-walk .ss-gd-leg-back { animation: ss-c2-stride var(--ss-gardener-walk-duration, 600ms) ease-in-out infinite alternate-reverse; }
.ss-gardener:is(.ss-pose-blow, .ss-pose-toupee-off) .ss-motion { animation: ss-c2-judder var(--ss-blower-judder-duration, 120ms) linear infinite; }
.ss-gardener:is(.ss-pose-blow, .ss-pose-toupee-off) .ss-gd-blower { animation: ss-c2-shake var(--ss-blower-shake-duration, 70ms) linear infinite; }
.ss-gardener:is(.ss-pose-blow, .ss-pose-toupee-off) .ss-gd-rumble { animation: ss-c2-flicker var(--ss-blower-rumble-duration, 240ms) linear infinite alternate; }

{html, svg, nothing} from 'lit';\\nimport {styleMap} from 'lit/directives/style-map.js';\\n\\n/**\\n * Squirrel Scramble sprite kit, part 1: the shared drawing helpers and the racing squirrel\\n * (SPEC.md § 9 outfits, § 12 art direction; Chaos v2 § 5 poses and effects). All art is\\n * original.\\n *\\n * Every sprite is inline SVG. The parts are Lit `svg` fragments; the <svg> root itself is\\n * written in an `html` template, because Lit renders an <svg> element from `html` and only\\n * its children from `svg`. Every function here is pure: no DOM access, no randomness and no\\n * clock, so a sprite renders the same on the server and in the browser.\\n *\\n * Colours are literal values in the SVG presentation attributes, never `var()` there: a\\n * presentation attribute holding `var()` is not honoured, and the part falls back to black.\\n * Theming happens in CSS instead. The squirrel root sets --fur, --fur-dark, --belly and --eye\\n * (themeable as --ss-fur-<id>, --ss-fur-<id>-dark, --ss-fur-<id>-belly, --ss-eye-albino), and\\n * animations.js maps the fur classes (ss-fur, ss-fur-dark, ss-fur-belly, ss-fur-stroke,\\n * ss-fur-dark-stroke, ss-fur-edge, ss-fur-belly-stroke, ss-pupil) onto them. {html, svg, nothing} from 'lit';\nimport {styleMap} from 'lit/directives/style-map.js';\n\n/**\n * Squirrel Scramble sprite kit, part 1: the shared drawing helpers and the racing squirrel\n * (SPEC.md § 9 outfits, § 12 art direction; Chaos v2 § 5 poses and effects). All art is\n * original.\n *\n * Every sprite is inline SVG. The parts are Lit `svg` fragments; the <svg> root itself is\n * written in an `html` template, because Lit renders an <svg> element from `html` and only\n * its children from `svg`. Every function here is pure: no DOM access, no randomness and no\n * clock, so a sprite renders the same on the server and in the browser.\n *\n * Colours are literal values in the SVG presentation attributes, never `var()` there: a\n * presentation attribute holding `var()` is not honoured, and the part falls back to black.\n * Theming happens in CSS instead. The squirrel root sets --fur, --fur-dark, --belly and --eye\n * (themeable as --ss-fur-<id>, --ss-fur-<id>-dark, --ss-fur-<id>-belly, --ss-eye-albino), and\n * animations.js maps the fur classes (ss-fur, ss-fur-dark, ss-fur-belly, ss-fur-stroke,\n * ss-fur-dark-stroke, ss-fur-edge, ss-fur-belly-stroke, ss-pupil) onto them. Without that\n * sheet the literal colours still draw the right fur.\n *\n * Movable parts sit in named <g> groups (tail, body, belly, head, ear, eye, cheek, arm-front,\n * arm-back, leg, plus the cape, hat and accessory slots) so animations.js can move them with\n * transforms. Every sprite is decorative (aria-hidden): the caller conveys names as text.\n */\n\n/** The viewBox shared by every square sprite: 100 by 100 units. */\nexport const SQUARE_VIEW_BOX = '0 0 100 100';\n\n/** The fur used when a fur id is missing or unknown (matches the theme config default). */\nexport const DEFAULT_FUR = 'red';\n\n/** The squirrel's tail outline, shared with the trench coat in field.js. */\nexport const SQUIRREL_TAIL_PATH =\n 'M42 84C28 88 14 78 15 62C16 48 24 40 22 28C21 18 30 9 40 11C47 12 49 20 44 24C41 18 34 17 32 24C30 32 34 42 33 54C32 66 38 74 46 76Z';\n\n/** The squirrel's head and snout, facing right, shared with the trench coat in field.js. */\nexport const SQUIRREL_HEAD_PATH =\n 'M48 34C48 25 56 21 63 23C69 24 73 28 76 32C79 35 79 40 74 42C69 45 60 46 54 44C50 42 48 38 48 34Z';\n\n/** The squirrel's ear. */\nexport const SQUIRREL_EAR_PATH = 'M52 26C50 18 52 12 56 9C58 14 60 19 59 25Z';\n\n/** The squirrel's inner ear. */\nexport const SQUIRREL_INNER_EAR_PATH =\n 'M53.6 24C53.2 19 54.4 15.5 56 13.5C57 17 57.6 21 57.2 24Z';\n\n/**\n * @description Rounds a coordinate to two decimals so generated path data stays compact.\n * @param {number} value - A finite number.\n * @returns {number} The value rounded to the nearest 0.01.\n * @throws {never} Never throws.\n * @example\n * roundCoordinate(12.3456); // 12.35\n * @since 1.0.0\n */\nexport function roundCoordinate(value) {\n return Math.round(value * 100) / 100;\n}\n\n/**\n * @description Formats one SVG path command with its numbers rounded.\n * @param {string} letter - The path command letter, e.g. 'M', 'C' or 'Q'.\n * @param {...number} values - The command's coordinates, in order.\n * @returns {string} The command, e.g. 'M12.5 30'.\n * @throws {never} Never throws.\n * @example\n * pathCommand('L', 10, 20.004); // 'L10 20'\n * @since 1.0.0\n */\nexport function pathCommand(letter, ...values) {\n return `${letter}${values.map(roundCoordinate).join(' ')}`;\n}\n\n/**\n * @description Builds a themeable CSS value: a custom property with a fallback. For CSS and\n * inline custom properties only; never put the result in an SVG presentation attribute.\n * @param {string} token - Token name without the --ss- prefix, e.g. 'fur-red'.\n * @param {string} fallback - The colour used when no theme sets the token.\n * @returns {string} A CSS value such as 'var(--ss-fur-red, #C8642F)'.\n * @throws {never} Never throws.\n * @example\n * paint('fur-red', '#C8642F');\n * @since 1.0.0\n */\nexport function paint(token, fallback) {\n return `var(--ss-${token}, ${fallback})`;\n}\n\n/**\n * @description Joins class names, skipping empty and non-string entries.\n * @param {...*} names - Candidate class names.\n * @returns {string} A space-separated class list.\n * @throws {never} Never throws.\n * @example\n * classNames('ss-sprite', '', 'ss-flip'); // 'ss-sprite ss-flip'\n * @since 1.0.0\n */\nexport function classNames(...names) {\n return names.filter(name => typeof name === 'string' && name.trim() !== '').join(' ');\n}\n\n/**\n * @description Returns the id when the catalogue has art for it, otherwise the fallback.\n * Inherited keys such as 'constructor' are never treated as ids.\n * @param {Object} catalogue - An art map keyed by id.\n * @param {*} id - The requested id.\n * @param {string} fallback - The id to use when the request is unknown.\n * @returns {string} A known id.\n * @throws {never} Never throws.\n * @example\n * pickId({none: 1, crown: 2}, 'sombrero', 'none'); // 'none'\n * @since 1.0.0\n */\nexport function pickId(catalogue, id, fallback) {\n const known = typeof id === 'string' && Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(catalogue, id);\n return known ? id : fallback;\n}\n\n/**\n * @description Joins a list of points into closed polygon path data.\n * @param {Array<Array<number>>} points - [x, y] pairs in drawing order.\n * @returns {string} Path data starting with M and ending with Z.\n * @throws {never} Never throws.\n * @example\n * polygonPath([[0, 0], [10, 0], [5, 8]]); // 'M0 0L10 0L5 8Z'\n * @since 1.0.0\n */\nfunction polygonPath(points) {\n const commands = points.map(([pointX, pointY], index) =>\n pathCommand(index === 0 ? 'M' : 'L', pointX, pointY)\n );\n return `${commands.join('')}Z`;\n}\n\n/**\n * @description Path data for a star or comic burst: points alternate between two radii.\n * @param {number} centreX - Centre x.\n * @param {number} centreY - Centre y.\n * @param {number} outerRadius - Radius of the points.\n * @param {number} innerRadius - Radius of the notches between points.\n * @param {number} pointCount - Number of points.\n * @returns {string} Closed path data.\n * @throws {never} Never throws.\n * @example\n * burstPath(50, 50, 20, 12, 12); // a twelve-point \"BLAM!\" burst\n * @since 1.0.0\n */\nexport function burstPath(centreX, centreY, outerRadius, innerRadius, pointCount) {\n const points = [];\n const vertexCount = pointCount * 2;\n for (let index = 0; index < vertexCount; index += 1) {\n const radius = index % 2 === 0 ? outerRadius : innerRadius;\n const angle = (Math.PI * index) / pointCount - Math.PI / 2;\n points.push([centreX + radius * Math.cos(angle), centreY + radius * Math.sin(angle)]);\n }\n return polygonPath(points);\n}\n\n/**\n * @description Path data for a five-point cartoon star.\n * @param {number} centreX - Centre x.\n * @param {number} centreY - Centre y.\n * @param {number} radius - Radius of the points.\n * @returns {string} Closed path data.\n * @throws {never} Never throws.\n * @example\n * starPath(60, 14, 3);\n * @since 1.0.0\n */\nexport function starPath(centreX, centreY, radius) {\n return burstPath(centreX, centreY, radius, radius * 0.45, 5);\n}\n\n/**\n * @description Path data for a four-point sparkle (a pinched diamond).\n * @param {number} centreX - Centre x.\n * @param {number} centreY - Centre y.\n * @param {number} radius - Distance from the centre to each tip.\n * @returns {string} Closed path data.\n * @throws {never} Never throws.\n * @example\n * sparklePath(12, 30, 3);\n * @since 1.0.0\n */\nexport function sparklePath(centreX, centreY, radius) {\n const waist = radius * 0.28;\n return polygonPath([\n [centreX, centreY - radius],\n [centreX + waist, centreY - waist],\n [centreX + radius, centreY],\n [centreX + waist, centreY + waist],\n [centreX, centreY + radius],\n [centreX - waist, centreY + waist],\n [centreX - radius, centreY],\n [centreX - waist, centreY - waist]\n ]);\n}\n\n/**\n * @description Path data for a circle drawn with two arcs, so several circles fit in one path.\n * @param {number} centreX - Centre x.\n * @param {number} centreY - Centre y.\n * @param {number} radius - Radius.\n * @returns {string} Closed path data.\n * @throws {never} Never throws.\n * @example\n * circlePath(50, 50, 10) + circlePath(70, 50, 6); // two puffs in one <path>\n * @since 1.0.0\n */\nexport function circlePath(centreX, centreY, radius) {\n const size = roundCoordinate(radius);\n const diameter = roundCoordinate(radius * 2);\n return [\n pathCommand('M', centreX - radius, centreY),\n `a${size} ${size} 0 1 0 ${diameter} 0`,\n `a${size} ${size} 0 1 0 ${-diameter} 0Z`\n ].join('');\n}\n\n/**\n * @description Path data for a cartoon heart whose tip points down.\n * @param {number} centreX - Centre x.\n * @param {number} centreY - Centre y.\n * @param {number} size - Overall size; the heart is about 1.8 times this wide.\n * @returns {string} Closed path data.\n * @throws {never} Never throws.\n * @example\n * heartPath(50, 54, 36);\n * @since 1.0.0\n */\nexport function heartPath(centreX, centreY, size) {\n return [\n pathCommand('M', centreX, centreY + size * 0.45),\n pathCommand(\n 'C',\n centreX - size * 0.9,\n centreY + size * 0.05,\n centreX - size * 0.55,\n centreY - size * 0.75,\n centreX,\n centreY - size * 0.28\n ),\n pathCommand(\n 'C',\n centreX + size * 0.55,\n centreY - size * 0.75,\n centreX + size * 0.9,\n centreY + size * 0.05,\n centreX,\n centreY + size * 0.45\n ),\n 'Z'\n ].join('');\n}\n\n/**\n * @description Path data for a pair of lips (a lipstick kiss mark): a bowed upper lip and a\n * rounded lower lip, as two sub-paths.\n * @param {number} centreX - Centre x.\n * @param {number} centreY - The line between the lips.\n * @param {number} halfWidth - Half the width of the mouth.\n * @param {number} height - Height of the upper lip.\n * @returns {string} Path data with two closed sub-paths.\n * @throws {never} Never throws.\n * @example\n * lipsPath(50, 50, 30, 18);\n * @since 1.0.0\n */\nexport function lipsPath(centreX, centreY, halfWidth, height) {\n const left = centreX - halfWidth;\n const right = centreX + halfWidth;\n const top = centreY - height;\n const dip = centreY - height * 0.45;\n const gap = centreY + height * 0.12;\n const bottom = centreY + height * 1.1;\n const upperLip = [\n pathCommand('M', left, centreY),\n pathCommand('C', left + halfWidth * 0.4, top, centreX - halfWidth * 0.15, top, centreX, dip),\n pathCommand('C', centreX + halfWidth * 0.15, top, right - halfWidth * 0.4, top, right, centreY),\n 'Z'\n ];\n const lowerLip = [\n pathCommand('M', left, gap),\n pathCommand('C', left + halfWidth * 0.5, bottom, right - halfWidth * 0.5, bottom, right, gap),\n 'Z'\n ];\n return [...upperLip, ...lowerLip].join('');\n}\n\n/**\n * @description Path data for a flower's petals: teardrops radiating from the centre.\n * @param {number} centreX -      * two runtimes without surface changes.

     * directly — they do not trigger CSR navigation, only update the URL.

 * @since 1.0.0
 */
export function routeFor(name) {
  if (!PAGE_NAMES.includes(name)) {
    throw new Error(`Squirrel Scramble has no page called '${String(name)}'.`);
  }
  return `/${ROUTE_VERSION}/${name}`;
}

/**
 * @description Builds the app-relative path of a stored race's replay page.
 * @param {string} sysId - The race's sys_id. Callers check its shape first.
 * @returns {string} The path, for example '/v7/replay/<sys_id>' while ROUTE_VERSION is 'v7'.
 * @throws {Error} When sysId is not a non-empty string.
 * @example
 *   navigate(replayRoute(race.sysId));
 * @since 1.0.0
 */
export function replayRoute(sysId) {
  if (typeof sysId !== 'string' || sysId === '') {
    throw new Error('A replay route needs the race sys_id.');
  }
  return `${REPLAY_ROUTE_PREFIX}/${encodeURIComponent(sysId)}`;
}

/**
 * @description Builds the app-relative path of the race page. With a rematch sys_id the setup
 *   view opens with that race's line-up, linked as a rematch (the page's loader reads
 *   ?rematch=).
 * @param {{rematch?: string}} [options] - Options; rematch is the sys_id of the race to rematch,
 *   and empty or missing gives the plain race page.
 * @returns {string} '/v7/play' or '/v7/play?rematch=<sys_id>' while ROUTE_VERSION is 'v7'.
 * @throws {never} Never throws.
 * @example
 *   navigate(playRoute({rematch: race.sysId}));
 *   navigate(playRoute());
 * @since 1.0.0
 */
export function playRoute(options) {
  const rematch = options && typeof options.rematch === 'string' ? options.rematch : '';
  const path = routeFor('play');
  return rematch ? `${path}?rematch=${encodeURIComponent(rematch)}` : path;
}
","/**
 * The Squirrel Scramble shell, as plain data: the four nav items, the shell features, the whole
 * navLayoutContext value, and the app route read from a browser path. The one place the nav list
 * is written: application.js setup() and the pages' repair (utils/shell.js) both build from here.
 *
 * The module has no platform imports on purpose: the i18n service is passed in, so the Node tests
 * can run it with a stub, and the build still sees literal i18n.getMessage() calls (the i18n lint
 * rule getmessage-no-variable-arg and the string extractor accept only a literal argument, as in
 * components/audio/sound-labels.js). Paths come from utils/routes.js, which has no imports either.
 */
import {REPLAY_ROUTE_PREFIX, routeFor} from './routes.js';

/**
 * Routes that belong to a nav item without being its own path: a replay is opened from the
 * History page, so History stays highlighted while it plays.
 */
const ACTIVE_PREFIXES = Object.freeze({
  [routeFor('history')]: Object.freeze([REPLAY_ROUTE_PREFIX])
});

/**
 * The shell features (Chaos v2 contract § 13). Two are off for the race: chat, so the shell's
 * "Ask or search for anything" bar never shows, and onboarding, so the "Get to know Lux" popup
 * never covers the stage.
 */
export const SHELL_FEATURES = Object.freeze({
  menus: false,
  logo: true,
  userSession: false,
  notifications: false,
  themeToggle: false,
  densityPicker: false,
  unifiedExperience: false,
  profile: true,
  helpPanel: true,
  chat: false,
  onboarding: false
});

/**
 * The event the nav layout's ChatController listens for on its host
 * (handleChatVisibilityChange): detail.hidden true hides the chat bar for the page.
 */
export const CHAT_VISIBILITY_EVENT = 'aiux-chat-visibility-change';

/** The Lux URL prefix: /aiux/<basename>, the basename being aiux.json's. */
const AIUX_PREFIX = /^\/aiux\/[^/]+(?=\/|$)/;

/**
 * @description Says whether a nav item should show as the current page.
 * @param {{action?: {path?: string}}} item - The nav item.
 * @param {string} activePath - The active app route: routeFor('play'), say, or a replay's
 *   REPLAY_ROUTE_PREFIX followed by '/<sys_id>' (or the route pattern's '/:id').
 * @returns {boolean} True when the item's path or one of its extra prefixes matches.
 * @throws {never} Never throws.
 * @example
 *   isItemActive({action: {path: '/v7/history'}}, '/v7/replay/abc'); // true
 * @since 1.0.0
 */
export function isItemActive(item, activePath) {
  const itemPath = item && item.action ? item.action.path : '';
  if (!itemPath || typeof activePath !== 'string' || !activePath) {
    return false;
  }
  if (activePath === itemPath) {
    return true;
  }
  const prefixes = ACTIVE_PREFIXES[itemPath] || [];
  return prefixes.some((prefix) => activePath.startsWith(prefix));
}

/**
 * @description Builds the four nav items (Race, History, Hall of Fame, Wardrobe) under the
 *   current route version, with the current page's item marked active. Icon names are native
 *   Horizon icons from the installed @servicenow/aiux icon list.
 * @param {{getMessage: function(string, ...*): string}} i18n - The AIUX i18n service, or a stub.
 * @param {string} activePath - The active app route, for example '/v7/wardrobe'; empty marks
 *   nothing.
 * @returns {Array<Object>} New item objects; only the active one carries active: true.
 * @throws {never} Never throws for a service whose getMessage doesn't.
 * @example
 *   createNavItems(i18n, '/v7/replay/abc').find((item) => item.active).icon; // 'history'
 * @since 1.0.0
 */
export function createNavItems(i18n, activePath) {
  const items = [
    {
      icon: 'flag-event',
      title: i18n.getMessage('Race'),
      action: {type: 'navigate', path: routeFor('play')}
    },
    {
      icon: 'history',
      title: i18n.getMessage('History'),
      action: {type: 'navigate', path: routeFor('history')}
    },
    {
      icon: 'star',
      title: i18n.getMessage('Hall of Fame'),
      action: {type: 'navigate', path: routeFor('hall-of-fame')}
    },
    {
      icon: 'palette',
      title: i18n.getMessage('Wardrobe'),
      action: {type: 'navigate', path: routeFor('wardrobe')}
    }
  ];
  return items.map((item) => (isItemActive(item, activePath) ? {...item, active: true} : item));
}

/**
 * @description Builds the whole navLayoutContext value: the current value kept, with the app
 *   title, the shell features, the nav items and the logos set over it.
 * @param {Object|null|undefined} current - navLayoutContext.get(), or nothing.
 * @param {{getMessage: function(string, ...*): string}} i18n - The AIUX i18n service, or a stub.
 * @param {string} activePath - The active app route; see createNavItems().
 * @returns {Object} The new value to set.
 * @throws {never} Never throws for a service whose getMessage doesn't.
 * @example
 *   navLayoutContext.set(buildShellState(navLayoutContext.get(), i18n, '/v7/play'));
 * @since 1.0.0
 */
export function buildShellState(current, i18n, activePath) {
  const base = current && typeof current === 'object' ? current : {};
  return {
    ...base,
    appTitle: i18n.getMessage('Squirrel Scramble'),
    features: {...SHELL_FEATURES},
    items: createNavItems(i18n, activePath),
    defaultLogoFull: 'servicenow',
    defaultLogoIcon: 'servicenow'
  };
}

/**
 * @description Reads the app route from a browser path: drops the /aiux/<basename> prefix and
 *   any trailing slash. A path without the prefix (a local dev server) is taken as it is.
 * @param {string} pathname - location.pathname, for example
 *   '/aiux/scramble-v7/v7/hall-of-fame'.
 * @returns {string} The app route, for example '/v7/hall-of-fame'; '/' for the app root; '' when
 *   the input is not a non-empty string.
 * @throws {never} Never throws.
 * @example
 *   routePathFromPathname('/aiux/scramble-v7/v7/replay/abc/'); // '/v7/replay/abc'
 * @since 1.0.0
 */
export function routePathFromPathname(pathname) {
  if (typeof pathname !== 'string' || pathname === '') {
    return '';
  }
  const appPath = pathname.replace(AIUX_PREFIX, '').replace(/\/+$/, '');
  if (appPath === '') {
    return '/';
  }
  return appPath.startsWith('/') ? appPath : `/${appPath}`;
}

import {applyShellNav} from './utils/shell.js';

/**
 * The Squirrel Scramble experience shell (SPEC.md § 8): the nav items, the app title and the
 * shell features. setup() runs on every server render and before client navigations. The nav

export default {
  appTheme: AppTheme,
  applicationLayout: 'aiux-nav-layout',

  /**
   * @description Fills the nav shell through applyShellNav() (utils/shell.js): Race, History,
   *   Hall of Fame and Wardrobe, with the current page highlighted (a replay highlights History).

   *   for anything" bar never shows (the nav layout reads features.chat in _initChat(), after
   *   this runs), and onboarding, so the "Get to know Lux" popup never covers the race stage.

    const routes = ctx && ctx.app && Array.isArray(ctx.app.routes) ? ctx.app.routes : [];
    const activeRoute = routes.find((route) => route.active);
    const activePath = activeRoute ? activeRoute.route : '';
    applyShellNav(activePath);

  /**
   * @description Clears the nav items when the user leaves this experience.
   * @returns {void}

","/**
 * The Squirrel Scramble shell, wired to the platform: sets navLayoutContext from the one nav

 *
 * Why the repair: the Lux rendering service kept serving a cached older application.js (the v5
 * shell), whose nav items point at /v5/ routes that no longer exist and which lacks
 * features.chat: false (Chaos v2 contract § 13; SPEC.md § 23, decision 9). So every v7 page
 * calls repairStaleShell(this) from firstUpdated(): it sets the current nav items and features,
 * and asks the nav layout to hide the chat bar. With a fresh shell it changes nothing that shows.
 *
 * Client only for the repair: pages call it from firstUpdated(), never from render() or the
 * constructor. On the server it does nothing.

import {navLayoutContext} from '@servicenow/aiux/aiux-components-nav';
import {i18n} from '@servicenow/aiux/aiux-services';
import {

  buildShellState,
  createNavItems,

/**
 * @description Builds the four nav items in the current language, with the active page marked
 *   (a replay marks History).
 * @param {string} activePath - The active app route, for example '/v7/wardrobe'.
 * @returns {Array<Object>} The nav items.
 * @throws {never} Never throws.
 * @example
 *   buildNavItems(routeFor('history'));
 * @since 1.0.0
 */
export function buildNavItems(activePath) {
  return createNavItems(i18n, activePath);
}

/**
 * @description Sets navLayoutContext: the app title, the shell features (chat and onboarding
 *   off) and the nav items, over whatever the context already holds.
 * @param {string} activePath - The active app route, for example '/v7/play'.
 * @returns {boolean} True when the context was set; false when there is no context to set.

export function applyShellNav(activePath) {
  const context = navLayoutContext;

    return false;
  }
  context.set(buildShellState(context.get(), i18n, activePath));

/**
 * @description Reads the current app route from the browser address.
 * @returns {string} The app route, for example '/v7/history'; '' when there is no location.
 * @throws {never} Never throws.

 *   missing context or host is skipped, and each step's failure is swallowed so the page still
 *   works.
 * @param {HTMLElement} hostElement - The page element; the event bubbles out of its shadow root
 *   to the nav layout.
 * @returns {void}
 * @throws {never} Never throws.

      }));

  }

Only meaningful in Chaos mode: the race engine stores it only for Chaos races and leaves it empty for Classic races. Chaos events are cosmetic and never change who wins.</help><hint>Chaos intensity chosen at setup: Mild, Silly or Absolute Carnage. sys_update_xml.name: sys_ws_operation_6a3be8561b009350f2e9edf3604bcbc8
sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_ws_operation"><sys_ws_operation action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><active>true</active><consumes>application/json,application/xml,text/xml</consumes><consumes_customized>false</consumes_customized><default_operation_uri/><enforce_acl>cf9d01d3e73003009d6247e603f6a990</enforce_acl><http_method>GET</http_method><name>Group members</name><operation_script><![CDATA[/**
 * Squirrel Race: GET /groups/{sys_id}/members. The group's active users, sorted by name, as
 * [{ name, userSysId }] with 200. 404 not_found when no group has that sys_id; 403 forbidden
 * without the marshal role. All logic lives in SquirrelRaceEngine.
 */
(function process(request, response) {
  const engine = new SquirrelRaceEngine();
  const denied = engine.checkMarshal();
  // An empty group is [] (found, no members), so only an unknown group falls through to 404.
  const result = denied
    || engine.groupMembers(request.pathParams.sys_id)
    || engine.notFoundError('No group has that sys_id.');
  const reply = engine.toHttp(result, 200);
  response.setStatus(reply.status);
  response.setBody(reply.body);
})(request, response);
]]></operation_script><operation_uri>/api/x_crli_squirrel/race/groups/{sys_id}/members</operation_uri><produces>application/json,application/xml,text/xml</produces><produces_customized>false</produces_customized><relative_path>/groups/{sys_id}/members</relative_path><request_example/><requires_acl_authorization>true</requires_acl_authorization><requires_authentication>true</requires_authentication><requires_snc_internal_role>true</requires_snc_internal_role><short_description>Active users in a group, sorted by name (404 for an unknown group).</short_description><support_trailing_slash>false</support_trailing_slash><sys_class_name>sys_ws_operation</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin.identity_3</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-10-22 12:18:38</sys_created_on><sys_id>6a3be8561b009350f2e9edf3604bcbc8</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Group members</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Squirrel Scramble" source="x_crli_squirrel">4ea49ea28f8447dc9e14c1b33913cb48</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Squirrel Scramble">4ea49ea28f8447dc9e14c1b33913cb48</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_ws_operation_6a3be8561b009350f2e9edf3604bcbc8</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin.identity_3</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-10-22 12:18:38</sys_updated_on><web_service_definition display_value="Squirrel Race">48aaacde1bc4135083ceedf3604bcb27</web_service_definition><web_service_version/></sys_ws_operation></record_update>
