sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_script_include"><sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><access>package_private</access><active>true</active><api_name>x_crli_squirrel.SquirrelRaceEngine</api_name><caller_access/><client_callable>false</client_callable><description>Squirrel Scramble race engine (server only, not client callable, accessible from this application scope only). Validates a marshal's line-up, draws the finishing order, lanes and finish times with GlideSecureRandomUtil, stores the race and its entrants (insert only: nothing is updated after insert), and returns the race payload that the Squirrel Race REST API and the Lux experience replay. Public methods: draw(request), getRace(sysId), recentRaces(limit), hallOfFame(limit), searchGroups(text), groupMembers(groupSysId), plus REST helpers checkMarshal(), notFoundError(message), toHttp(result, successStatus), paramValue(raw). Pure internals the probes call: _rank(count), _finishTimes(count, durationMs), _cleanOutfit(outfit). Callers: the Squirrel Race scripted REST resources (/api/x_crli_squirrel/race). Design: SPEC.md sections 5 to 7.</description><mobile_callable>false</mobile_callable><name>SquirrelRaceEngine</name><sandbox_callable>false</sandbox_callable><script><![CDATA[/**
 * @description Squirrel Scramble race engine. Validates a marshal's line-up, draws the finishing
 *   order, lanes and finish times, stores the race and its entrants, and returns the race payload
 *   that the Squirrel Race REST API and the Lux experience replay. It also serves race history,
 *   the Hall of Fame and the group look-ups the setup view uses.
 *
 *   Fairness rests on three rules: every random number comes from GlideSecureRandomUtil (never
 *   JavaScript's own generator); the result is drawn and stored before any squirrel moves; and a
 *   stored race is never updated by this class (the one exception voids a draw whose entrants
 *   failed to save).
 *   Server only: not client callable, accessible from this application scope only.
 *   Design: SPEC.md sections 5 to 7.
 * @since 2026-10-22
 */
class SquirrelRaceEngine {
  /**
   * @description Names, codes and limits the engine and its REST resources share, kept in one
   *   place so a table name, role, limit or timing rule is never typed twice.
   * @returns {Object} A frozen constants object.
   * @throws Never.
   * @example
   *   const raceTable = SquirrelRaceEngine.constants.TABLE.RACE;
   * @since 2026-10-22
   */
  static get constants() {
    return Object.freeze({
      LOG_PREFIX: '[SquirrelScramble][SquirrelRaceEngine]',
      ROLE_MARSHAL: 'x_crli_squirrel.marshal',
      PROPERTY_PREFIX: 'x_crli_squirrel.',
      TABLE: Object.freeze({
        RACE: 'x_crli_squirrel_race',
        ENTRANT: 'x_crli_squirrel_entrant',
        GROUP: 'sys_user_group',
        MEMBER: 'sys_user_grmember',
      }),
      STATE: Object.freeze({ DRAWN: 'drawn', VOID: 'void' }),
      MODE: Object.freeze({ CLASSIC: 'classic', CHAOS: 'chaos' }),
      CHAOS_LEVELS: Object.freeze(['mild', 'silly', 'carnage']),
      DEFAULTS: Object.freeze({
        TITLE: 'Squirrel race',
        CHAOS_LEVEL: 'silly',
        TITLE_LENGTH: 80,
        PLACES: 2,
        MAX_ENTRANTS: 50,
        CLASSIC_SECONDS: '10,20,40',
        CLASSIC_DEFAULT: 20,
        CHAOS_SECONDS: '45,60,90',
        CHAOS_DEFAULT: 60,
        PHOTO_FINISH_CHANCE: 0.25,
        LIST_LIMIT: 10,
      }),
      LIMITS: Object.freeze({
        NAME_LENGTH: 40,
        PLACES_MIN: 1,
        PLACES_MAX: 3,
        LIST_MAX: 25,
        ECHO_LENGTH: 40,
        GROUP_RESULTS: 20,
        GROUP_QUERY_MIN: 2,
        GROUP_QUERY_MAX: 80,
        GROUP_MEMBERS: 500,
        HALL_SCAN: 20000,
        ENTRANTS_READ: 1000,
        OUTFIT_JSON: 255,
        SEED_BOUND: 2147483647,
      }),
      TIMING: Object.freeze({
        PHOTO_GAP_MIN: 40,
        PHOTO_GAP_MAX: 140,
        RUNNER_UP_GAP_MIN: 200,
        RUNNER_UP_GAP_MAX: 900,
        LATER_GAP_MIN: 150,
        LATER_GAP_MAX: 700,
        PHOTO_FINISH_MS: 150,
        MAX_SPREAD_SHARE: 0.5,
        CHANCE_SCALE: 1000000,
      }),
      OUTFIT_KEYS: Object.freeze(['hat', 'cape', 'accessory', 'fur']),
      OUTFIT_VALUE: /^[a-z0-9_]{1,24}$/,
      SYS_ID: /^[0-9a-f]{32}$/,
      WHOLE_NUMBER: /^[0-9]{1,9}$/,
      HTTP_STATUS: Object.freeze({ forbidden: 403, not_found: 404, draw_failed: 500 }),
      VOID_REASON_DRAW_FAILED: 'Draw failed',
    });
  }

  /**
   * @description Reads the scoped properties once, so a draw (and the 10,000-call fairness
   *   probes) never re-read configuration.
   * @throws Never: a missing or malformed property falls back to its default with a warning.
   * @example
   *   const engine = new SquirrelRaceEngine();
   * @since 2026-10-22
   */
  constructor() {
    this._const = SquirrelRaceEngine.constants;
    this._config = this._readConfig();
  }

  /**
   * @description The class name, kept for parity with Class.create() includes.
   * @returns {string} 'SquirrelRaceEngine'.
   * @throws Never.
   * @example
   *   new SquirrelRaceEngine().type; // 'SquirrelRaceEngine'
   * @since 2026-10-22
   */
  get type() {
    return 'SquirrelRaceEngine';
  }

  /**
   * @description Says whether the caller may run races. Every REST resource calls this first and
   *   draw() calls it again, so the role is checked wherever a race can be reached.
   * @returns {Object|null} null when the caller has x_crli_squirrel.marshal (admins pass, as
   *   hasRole always does for admin); otherwise the shared forbidden error.
   * @throws Never.
   * @example
   *   const denied = engine.checkMarshal();
   *   if (denied) { answer 403 with denied; }
   * @since 2026-10-22
   */
  checkMarshal() {
    if (gs.hasRole(this._const.ROLE_MARSHAL)) {
      return null;
    }
    this._log('warn', 'checkMarshal', `refused | user=${gs.getUserName()}`);
    return this._error('forbidden', 'Only squirrel marshals can do this.', []);
  }

  /**
   * @description Validates a line-up, draws the result, stores the race and its entrants, and
   *   returns the race payload. Runs SPEC.md section 7's ten steps in order: role check, name
   *   cleaning, validation, places clamp, finishing order, lanes, finish times, seed, insert,
   *   and the void on a failed entrant insert.
   * @param {Object} request - { title, mode, chaosLevel, names[], outfits[], places,
   *   raceSeconds, rematchOf }. outfits is optional and parallel to names. chaosLevel (mild,
   *   silly or carnage; default silly) counts only in Chaos mode. Read only, never changed.
   * @returns {Object} The race payload { race, entrants }, or the shared error shape
   *   { error: { code, message, details } } with code forbidden, no_names, too_many,
   *   name_too_long, duplicate_names, bad_places, bad_mode, bad_length, bad_chaos_level,
   *   bad_outfit, bad_rematch (rematchOf names no stored race) or draw_failed.
   * @throws Never: unexpected failures come back as draw_failed.
   * @example
   *   const result = engine.draw({ mode: 'classic', names: ['Alex', 'Sam'], places: 2,
   *     raceSeconds: 20 });
   * @since 2026-10-22
   */
  draw(request) {
    const nameCount = this._countOf(request && request.names);
    this._log('info', 'draw', `ENTER | names=${nameCount}`);
    try {
      const denied = this.checkMarshal();
      if (denied) {
        this._log('info', 'draw', 'EXIT | refused | code=forbidden');
        return denied;
      }
      const checked = this._validateDraw(request);
      if (checked.error) {
        this._log('info', 'draw', `EXIT | refused | code=${checked.error.code}`);
        return checked;
      }
      const result = this._storeRace(checked.plan);
      const outcome = result.error
        ? `refused | code=${result.error.code}`
        : `ok | race=${result.race.number} | entrants=${result.entrants.length}`;
      this._log('info', 'draw', `EXIT | ${outcome}`);
      return result;
    } catch (err) {
      this._log('error', 'draw', `ERROR ${this._describe(err)}`);
      return this._error('draw_failed', 'The draw could not be completed.', []);
    }
  }

  /**
   * @description Returns a stored race's payload for replay. The payload is built by the same
   *   method draw() uses, so a replay is byte-for-byte the payload the draw returned.
   * @param {string} sysId - The race's sys_id.
   * @returns {Object|null} { race, entrants } with entrants sorted by lane, or null when no
   *   race has that sys_id (or the value cannot be a sys_id).
   * @throws {Error} Only on an unexpected platform failure, after logging it.
   * @example
   *   const payload = engine.getRace(raceSysId);
   * @since 2026-10-22
   */
  getRace(sysId) {
    this._log('info', 'getRace', `ENTER | sysId=${this._safeId(sysId)}`);
    try {
      const race = this._findRace(sysId);
      if (!race) {
        this._log('info', 'getRace', 'EXIT | not found');
        return null;
      }
      const payload = this._buildPayload(race);
      this._log('info', 'getRace', `EXIT | ok | race=${payload.race.number}`);
      return payload;
    } catch (err) {
      this._log('error', 'getRace', `ERROR ${this._describe(err)}`);
      throw err;
    }
  }

  /**
   * @description The most recent races, newest first, each with its entrants' names in lane
   *   order, so the setup view can reuse a previous line-up.
   * @param {number|string} [limit] - 1 to 25; default 10. Anything else falls back to 10.
   * @returns {Object[]} Summaries: { sysId, number, title, state, mode, chaosLevel, places,
   *   entrantCount, durationMs, winner, runnerUp, third, runBy, runOn, rematchOf, names[] }.
   *   chaosLevel is the stored level for a Chaos race and null for Classic. rematchOf is the
   *   original race's sys_id while that race still exists, otherwise null.
   * @throws {Error} Only on an unexpected platform failure, after logging it.
   * @example
   *   const races = engine.recentRaces(10);
   * @since 2026-10-22
   */
  recentRaces(limit) {
    const size = this._clampLimit(limit);
    this._log('info', 'recentRaces', `ENTER | limit=${size}`);
    try {
      const rows = [];
      const race = new GlideRecord(this._const.TABLE.RACE);
      race.addQuery('state', 'IN', [this._const.STATE.DRAWN, this._const.STATE.VOID].join(','));
      race.orderByDesc('sys_created_on');
      race.orderByDesc('number');
      race.setLimit(size);
      race.query();
      while (race.next()) {
        rows.push(this._summarise(race));
      }
      const namesByRace = this._namesByRace(rows.map((row) => row.sysId));
      // rematch_of has no cascade, so it can outlive its race: keep it only while it resolves.
      const liveRematches = this._existingRaceIds(rows.map((row) => row.rematchOf));
      const summaries = rows.map((row) => Object.assign({}, row, {
        rematchOf: liveRematches.has(row.rematchOf) ? row.rematchOf : null,
        names: namesByRace.get(row.sysId) || [],
      }));
      this._log('info', 'recentRaces', `EXIT | races=${summaries.length}`);
      return summaries;
    } catch (err) {
      this._log('error', 'recentRaces', `ERROR ${this._describe(err)}`);
      throw err;
    }
  }

  /**
   * @description The Hall of Fame across drawn races (void races never count). A win is
   *   finishing first. A podium is finishing within the places that race awarded, so third in
   *   a two-place race is not a podium. Names are merged case-insensitively, as the duplicate
   *   check does, and shown with the first spelling met.
   * @param {number|string} [limit] - 1 to 25; default 10.
   * @returns {Object[]} { name, wins, podiums, lastWin } sorted by wins, then podiums, then the
   *   latest win (UTC, newest first; null when the name has podiums but no win), then name.
   * @throws {Error} Only on an unexpected platform failure, after logging it.
   * @example
   *   const legends = engine.hallOfFame(10);
   * @since 2026-10-22
   */
  hallOfFame(limit) {
    const size = this._clampLimit(limit);
    this._log('info', 'hallOfFame', `ENTER | limit=${size}`);
    try {
      const tally = new Map();
      const entrant = new GlideRecord(this._const.TABLE.ENTRANT);
      entrant.addQuery('race.state', this._const.STATE.DRAWN);
      entrant.addQuery('finish_position', '<=', this._const.LIMITS.PLACES_MAX);
      entrant.setLimit(this._const.LIMITS.HALL_SCAN);
      entrant.query();
      let scanned = 0;
      while (entrant.next()) {
        scanned += 1;
        const position = this._readInt(entrant.getValue('finish_position'));
        const placesAwarded = this._readInt(String(entrant.race.places_awarded));
        if (position >= 1 && position <= placesAwarded) {
          const name = entrant.getValue('name') || '';
          const key = name.toLowerCase();
          const won = position === 1;
          const runOn = String(entrant.race.sys_created_on);
          const earlier = tally.get(key) || { name, wins: 0, podiums: 0, lastWin: null };
          const newerWin = won && this._compareText(runOn, earlier.lastWin) > 0;
          tally.set(key, {
            name: earlier.name,
            wins: earlier.wins + (won ? 1 : 0),
            podiums: earlier.podiums + 1,
            lastWin: newerWin ? runOn : earlier.lastWin,
          });
        }
      }
      if (scanned >= this._const.LIMITS.HALL_SCAN) {
        this._log('warn', 'hallOfFame', `scan stopped at ${scanned} rows; counts are partial`);
      }
      const ranked = Array.from(tally.values()).sort((first, second) => (
        second.wins - first.wins
        || second.podiums - first.podiums
        || this._compareText(second.lastWin, first.lastWin)
        || this._compareText(first.name.toLowerCase(), second.name.toLowerCase())
      ));
      const top = ranked.slice(0, size);
      this._log('info', 'hallOfFame', `EXIT | names=${top.length} of ${ranked.length}`);
      return top;
    } catch (err) {
      this._log('error', 'hallOfFame', `ERROR ${this._describe(err)}`);
      throw err;
    }
  }

  /**
   * @description Up to 20 active groups whose name contains the text, for the setup view's
   *   group loader.
   * @param {string} text - What the marshal typed; cleaned like a name, at least 2 characters.
   * @returns {Object[]|Object} [{ sysId, name }] sorted by name, or the shared error shape with
   *   code bad_query when the text is shorter than 2 characters.
   * @throws {Error} Only on an unexpected platform failure, after logging it.
   * @example
   *   const groups = engine.searchGroups('service desk');
   * @since 2026-10-22
   */
  searchGroups(text) {
    const query = this._cleanText(text).substring(0, this._const.LIMITS.GROUP_QUERY_MAX);
    this._log('info', 'searchGroups', `ENTER | length=${query.length}`);
    if (query.length < this._const.LIMITS.GROUP_QUERY_MIN) {
      this._log('info', 'searchGroups', 'EXIT | refused | code=bad_query');
      return this._error('bad_query', 'Type at least two characters to search groups.', []);
    }
    try {
      const groups = [];
      const group = new GlideRecord(this._const.TABLE.GROUP);
      group.addQuery('active', true);
      group.addQuery('name', 'CONTAINS', query);
      group.orderBy('name');
      group.setLimit(this._const.LIMITS.GROUP_RESULTS);
      group.query();
      while (group.next()) {
        groups.push({ sysId: group.getUniqueValue(), name: group.getValue('name') || '' });
      }
      this._log('info', 'searchGroups', `EXIT | groups=${groups.length}`);
      return groups;
    } catch (err) {
      this._log('error', 'searchGroups', `ERROR ${this._describe(err)}`);
      throw err;
    }
  }

  /**
   * @description The active users in a group, sorted by name, so a whole team can be loaded as
   *   entrants.
   * @param {string} groupSysId - The group's sys_id.
   * @returns {Object[]|null} [{ name, userSysId }], or null when no group has that sys_id.
   * @throws {Error} Only on an unexpected platform failure, after logging it.
   * @example
   *   const members = engine.groupMembers(groupSysId);
   * @since 2026-10-22
   */
  groupMembers(groupSysId) {
    this._log('info', 'groupMembers', `ENTER | group=${this._safeId(groupSysId)}`);
    try {
      if (!this._isSysId(groupSysId)) {
        this._log('info', 'groupMembers', 'EXIT | not found');
        return null;
      }
      const group = new GlideRecord(this._const.TABLE.GROUP);
      if (!group.get('sys_id', String(groupSysId))) {
        this._log('info', 'groupMembers', 'EXIT | not found');
        return null;
      }
      const members = [];
      const seenUsers = new Set();
      const member = new GlideRecord(this._const.TABLE.MEMBER);
      member.addQuery('group', group.getUniqueValue());
      member.addQuery('user.active', true);
      member.orderBy('user.name');
      member.setLimit(this._const.LIMITS.GROUP_MEMBERS);
      member.query();
      while (member.next()) {
        const userSysId = member.getValue('user');
        if (userSysId && !seenUsers.has(userSysId)) {
          seenUsers.add(userSysId);
          // getValue() cannot read a dot-walked field, so the element path is used.
          members.push({ name: String(member.user.name), userSysId });
        }
      }
      if (members.length >= this._const.LIMITS.GROUP_MEMBERS) {
        this._log('warn', 'groupMembers', `stopped at ${members.length} members`);
      }
      const sorted = members.slice().sort((first, second) => this._compareText(
        first.name.toLowerCase(),
        second.name.toLowerCase(),
      ));
      this._log('info', 'groupMembers', `EXIT | members=${sorted.length}`);
      return sorted;
    } catch (err) {
      this._log('error', 'groupMembers', `ERROR ${this._describe(err)}`);
      throw err;
    }
  }

  /**
   * @description Builds the shared not_found error, for REST resources whose engine call found
   *   nothing.
   * @param {string} [message] - What was not found.
   * @returns {Object} { error: { code: 'not_found', message, details: [] } }.
   * @throws Never.
   * @example
   *   const result = engine.getRace(id) || engine.notFoundError('No race has that sys_id.');
   * @since 2026-10-22
   */
  notFoundError(message) {
    return this._error('not_found', message || 'Nothing has that id.', []);
  }

  /**
   * @description Maps an engine result to an HTTP status and body, so every REST resource
   *   answers with the same codes: forbidden 403, not_found 404, draw_failed 500, any other
   *   error code 400, and the given success status otherwise.
   * @param {Object|Object[]} result - An engine result (payload, list or error shape).
   * @param {number} successStatus - The status for a result that is not an error.
   * @returns {Object} { status, body }.
   * @throws Never.
   * @example
   *   const reply = engine.toHttp(engine.draw(body), 201);
   *   response.setStatus(reply.status);
   *   response.setBody(reply.body);
   * @since 2026-10-22
   */
  toHttp(result, successStatus) {
    const isError = Boolean(result && !Array.isArray(result) && result.error);
    if (!isError) {
      return { status: successStatus, body: result };
    }
    const statuses = this._const.HTTP_STATUS;
    const code = result.error.code;
    const known = Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(statuses, code);
    return { status: known ? statuses[code] : 400, body: result };
  }

  /**
   * @description Reads one query parameter value. Scripted REST hands query parameters over
   *   as lists, so the first value is taken.
   * @param {*} raw - request.queryParams.<name>.
   * @returns {string} The first value, or '' when there is none.
   * @throws Never.
   * @example
   *   const limit = engine.paramValue(request.queryParams.limit);
   * @since 2026-10-22
   */
  paramValue(raw) {
    if (raw === undefined || raw === null) {
      return '';
    }
    if (typeof raw === 'string') {
      return raw;
    }
    if (typeof raw === 'object' && typeof raw.length === 'number') {
      return raw.length > 0 ? String(raw[0]) : '';
    }
    return String(raw);
  }

  /**
   * @description A random permutation of 0..count-1 by Fisher-Yates shuffle, each swap index
   *   from GlideSecureRandomUtil. Pure: no database access, so the fairness probes can call it
   *   10,000 times without writing anything.
   * @param {number} count - How many items to shuffle (0 or more).
   * @returns {number[]} The shuffled indexes; [] for 0.
   * @throws Never.
   * @example
   *   const finishOrder = engine._rank(5); // for example [3, 0, 4, 1, 2]
   * @since 2026-10-22
   */
  _rank(count) {
    const order = [];
    for (let index = 0; index < count; index += 1) {
      order.push(index);
    }
    for (let index = count - 1; index > 0; index -= 1) {
      const swapWith = this._randomBelow(index + 1);
      const held = order[index];
      order[index] = order[swapWith];
      order[swapWith] = held;
    }
    return order;
  }

  /**
   * @description Finish times by position. Position 1 finishes at exactly durationMs. The
   *   runner-up's gap is 40 to 140 ms with the photo-finish chance, otherwise 200 to 900 ms;
   *   every later gap is 150 to 700 ms. When the gaps add up to more than half of durationMs
   *   they are all scaled down in proportion, so a 50-squirrel race still ends near its length.
   *   Pure: no database access.
   * @param {number} count - Entrants in the race (0 or more).
   * @param {number} durationMs - The winner's finish time in milliseconds.
   * @returns {number[]} Strictly increasing finish times, index 0 being position 1; [] for 0.
   * @throws Never.
   * @example
   *   const times = engine._finishTimes(5, 20000); // for example [20000, 20412, ...]
   * @since 2026-10-22
   */
  _finishTimes(count, durationMs) {
    if (count < 1) {
      return [];
    }
    const timing = this._const.TIMING;
    const gaps = [];
    for (let position = 2; position <= count; position += 1) {
      gaps.push(this._drawGap(position));
    }
    const spread = gaps.reduce((total, gap) => total + gap, 0);
    const allowed = Math.floor(durationMs * timing.MAX_SPREAD_SHARE);
    const scale = spread > allowed ? allowed / spread : 1;
    const times = [durationMs];
    let clock = durationMs;
    gaps.forEach((gap) => {
      // Flooring keeps the scaled spread inside the limit; the 1 ms floor keeps times rising.
      clock += Math.max(1, Math.floor(gap * scale));
      times.push(clock);
    });
    return times;
  }

  /**
   * @description Checks an outfit and returns it as compact JSON. An outfit is an object with
   *   only the keys hat, cape, accessory and fur (any of them may be left out), each value
   *   1 to 24 lower-case letters, digits or underscores. The server does not know the outfit
   *   catalogue, so new outfits never need a server change. Pure: no database access.
   * @param {Object|string|null|undefined} outfit - The outfit, or its JSON. Blank means plain.
   * @returns {string|Object} The outfit JSON ('{}' for a blank outfit), or the shared error
   *   shape with code bad_outfit (details name the offending keys).
   * @throws Never.
   * @example
   *   engine._cleanOutfit({ hat: 'viking', fur: 'grey' }); // '{"hat":"viking","fur":"grey"}'
   * @since 2026-10-22
   */
  _cleanOutfit(outfit) {
    if (outfit === undefined || outfit === null || outfit === '') {
      return '{}';
    }
    let candidate = outfit;
    if (typeof outfit === 'string') {
      try {
        candidate = JSON.parse(outfit);
      } catch (err) {
        return this._error('bad_outfit', 'An outfit is not valid JSON.', []);
      }
    }
    if (typeof candidate !== 'object' || candidate === null || Array.isArray(candidate)) {
      return this._error('bad_outfit', 'An outfit must be an object.', []);
    }
    const keys = this._const.OUTFIT_KEYS;
    const unknownKeys = Object.keys(candidate).filter((key) => keys.indexOf(key) === -1);
    if (unknownKeys.length > 0) {
      const message = `An outfit has only ${keys.join(', ')}.`;
      return this._error('bad_outfit', message, unknownKeys.map((key) => this._echo(key)));
    }
    const presentKeys = keys.filter((key) => Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(candidate, key));
    const badKeys = presentKeys.filter((key) => !this._isOutfitValue(candidate[key]));
    if (badKeys.length > 0) {
      const message = 'Outfit values are 1 to 24 lower-case letters, digits or underscores.';
      return this._error('bad_outfit', message, badKeys);
    }
    const clean = {};
    presentKeys.forEach((key) => {
      clean[key] = candidate[key];
    });
    const json = JSON.stringify(clean);
    if (json.length > this._const.LIMITS.OUTFIT_JSON) {
      return this._error('bad_outfit', 'An outfit is too long to store.', []);
    }
    return json;
  }

  /**
   * @description Validates a draw request and turns it into a plan with clean values, in the
   *   order SPEC.md section 7 lists the checks, so the first problem found is the one returned.
   * @param {Object} request - The draw request; read only.
   * @returns {Object} { plan: { title, mode, chaosLevel, places, durationMs, rematchOf,
   *   entries[] } }, where
   *   each entry is { name, outfit } (outfit as JSON), or the shared error shape.
   * @throws Never.
   * @example
   *   const checked = this._validateDraw({ names: ['Alex'] });
   * @since 2026-10-22
   */
  _validateDraw(request) {
    const source = request && typeof request === 'object' ? request : {};
    const rawOutfits = this._toList(source.outfits);
    const entries = this._pairEntries(this._toList(source.names) || [], rawOutfits);
    const nameProblem = this._checkNames(entries);
    if (nameProblem) {
      return nameProblem;
    }
    const places = this._readPlaces(source.places);
    if (places === null) {
      return this._error('bad_places', 'Places must be 1, 2 or 3.', [this._echo(source.places)]);
    }
    const mode = this._readMode(source.mode);
    if (mode === null) {
      return this._error('bad_mode', 'Mode must be classic or chaos.', [this._echo(source.mode)]);
    }
    const seconds = this._readSeconds(mode, source.raceSeconds);
    if (seconds === null) {
      const allowed = this._allowedSeconds(mode).join(', ');
      const message = `A ${mode} race lasts one of these numbers of seconds: ${allowed}.`;
      return this._error('bad_length', message, [this._echo(source.raceSeconds)]);
    }
    const chaosLevel = this._readChaosLevel(mode, source.chaosLevel);
    if (chaosLevel === null) {
      const message = `A chaos level is one of ${this._const.CHAOS_LEVELS.join(', ')}.`;
      return this._error('bad_chaos_level', message, [this._echo(source.chaosLevel)]);
    }
    if (rawOutfits === null && !this._isBlank(source.outfits)) {
      return this._error('bad_outfit', 'Outfits must be a list, one per name.', []);
    }
    const outfits = entries.map((entry) => this._cleanOutfit(entry.rawOutfit));
    const badOutfitNames = entries
      .filter((entry, index) => typeof outfits[index] !== 'string')
      .map((entry) => entry.name);
    if (badOutfitNames.length > 0) {
      const message = 'An outfit is not valid: only hat, cape, accessory and fur, each 1 to 24 '
        + 'lower-case letters, digits or underscores.';
      return this._error('bad_outfit', message, badOutfitNames);
    }
    const rematchOf = this._readRematch(source.rematchOf);
    if (rematchOf === null) {
      const message = 'rematchOf must be the sys_id of a stored race.';
      return this._error('bad_rematch', message, [this._echo(source.rematchOf)]);
    }
    return {
      plan: {
        title: this._cleanTitle(source.title),
        mode,
        chaosLevel,
        // Step 4: never award more places than there are squirrels.
        places: Math.min(places, entries.length),
        durationMs: seconds * 1000,
        rematchOf,
        entries: entries.map((entry, index) => ({ name: entry.name, outfit: outfits[index] })),
      },
    };
  }

  /**
   * @description Cleans each name and pairs it with its outfit. Outfits are parallel to the raw
   *   names, so a blank name's outfit is dropped with it and the pairs never shift.
   * @param {Array} rawNames - The names as sent.
   * @param {Array|null} rawOutfits - The outfits as sent, or null when none were sent.
   * @returns {Object[]} [{ name, rawOutfit }] for every name that is not blank once cleaned.
   * @throws Never.
   * @example
   *   this._pairEntries([' Alex ', ''], [{ hat: 'viking' }, {}]); // one entry, Alex
   * @since 2026-10-22
   */
  _pairEntries(rawNames, rawOutfits) {
    const entries = [];
    rawNames.forEach((rawName, index) => {
      const name = this._cleanText(rawName);
      if (name !== '') {
        entries.push({ name, rawOutfit: rawOutfits ? rawOutfits[index] : undefined });
      }
    });
    return entries;
  }

  /**
   * @description The name checks: at least one, no more than max_entrants, none over 40
   *   characters, no duplicates (case-insensitive, after cleaning).
   * @param {Object[]} entries - The cleaned entries; read only.
   * @returns {Object|null} The first problem in the shared error shape (details list the
   *   offending names, each duplicate once in its first spelling), or null when all is well.
   * @throws Never.
   * @example
   *   this._checkNames([{ name: 'Sam' }, { name: 'sam' }]); // duplicate_names, ['Sam']
   * @since 2026-10-22
   */
  _checkNames(entries) {
    const maxNameLength = this._const.LIMITS.NAME_LENGTH;
    if (entries.length === 0) {
      return this._error('no_names', 'Add at least one name.', []);
    }
    if (entries.length > this._config.maxEntrants) {
      const message = `${entries.length} names: a race takes at most ${this._config.maxEntrants}.`;
      return this._error('too_many', message, []);
    }
    const tooLong = entries
      .filter((entry) => entry.name.length > maxNameLength)
      .map((entry) => entry.name);
    if (tooLong.length > 0) {
      const message = `Names can be at most ${maxNameLength} characters.`;
      return this._error('name_too_long', message, tooLong);
    }
    const firstSpelling = new Map();
    const duplicates = [];
    entries.forEach((entry) => {
      const key = entry.name.toLowerCase();
      if (!firstSpelling.has(key)) {
        firstSpelling.set(key, entry.name);
      } else if (duplicates.indexOf(firstSpelling.get(key)) === -1) {
        duplicates.push(firstSpelling.get(key));
      }
    });
    if (duplicates.length > 0) {
      return this._error('duplicate_names', 'Two entrants share a name.', duplicates);
    }
    return null;
  }

  /**
   * @description Draws the result for a validated plan and stores it: the race first, with
   *   every field already set, then its entrants. Nothing is updated after insert; if an
   *   entrant fails to save, the race is voided with reason "Draw failed".
   * @param {Object} plan - From _validateDraw; read only.
   * @returns {Object} The race payload, or the shared error shape with code draw_failed.
   * @throws Never: entrant failures are caught and turned into draw_failed.
   * @example
   *   const result = this._storeRace(checked.plan);
   * @since 2026-10-22
   */
  _storeRace(plan) {
    const count = plan.entries.length;
    // Finishing order and lanes come from two independent shuffles, so a lane predicts nothing.
    const finishOrder = this._rank(count);
    const laneOrder = this._rank(count);
    const finishTimes = this._finishTimes(count, plan.durationMs);
    const seed = this._randomBelow(this._const.LIMITS.SEED_BOUND);
    const raceSysId = this._insertRace(plan, finishOrder, finishTimes, seed);
    if (!raceSysId) {
      this._log('error', 'draw', 'race insert returned no sys_id');
      return this._error('draw_failed', 'The race could not be saved.', []);
    }
    let saved = false;
    try {
      saved = this._insertEntrants(raceSysId, plan, finishOrder, laneOrder, finishTimes);
    } catch (err) {
      this._log('error', 'draw', `entrant insert threw ${this._describe(err)}`);
      saved = false;
    }
    if (!saved) {
      this._voidFailedDraw(raceSysId);
      return this._error('draw_failed', 'The race could not be saved, so it was voided.', []);
    }
    const race = this._findRace(raceSysId);
    if (!race) {
      this._log('error', 'draw', `race ${raceSysId} could not be read back`);
      return this._error('draw_failed', 'The race was saved but could not be read back.', []);
    }
    return this._buildPayload(race);
  }

  /**
   * @description Inserts the race row with every field set, including the podium names.
   * @param {Object} plan - The validated plan; read only.
   * @param {number[]} finishOrder - finishOrder[position - 1] is the entry index at that place.
   * @param {number[]} finishTimes - Finish times by position.
   * @param {number} seed - The animation seed.
   * @returns {string} The new race's sys_id, or '' when the insert was refused.
   * @throws {Error} When the platform throws during the insert.
   * @example
   *   const raceSysId = this._insertRace(plan, finishOrder, finishTimes, seed);
   * @since 2026-10-22
   */
  _insertRace(plan, finishOrder, finishTimes, seed) {
    const nameAt = (position) => plan.entries[finishOrder[position - 1]].name;
    const race = new GlideRecord(this._const.TABLE.RACE);
    race.initialize();
    race.setValue('title', plan.title);
    race.setValue('state', this._const.STATE.DRAWN);
    race.setValue('mode', plan.mode);
    // FIXME: insert() fills an empty chaos_level with the column default (silly), after
    // initialize() or newRecord() alike, so a Classic race stores silly until that default is
    // removed. Payloads are unaffected: _chaosLevelOf() returns null for any Classic race.
    race.setValue('chaos_level', plan.chaosLevel);
    race.setValue('places_awarded', plan.places);
    race.setValue('entrant_count', plan.entries.length);
    race.setValue('duration_ms', finishTimes[0]);
    race.setValue('seed', seed);
    race.setValue('photo_finish', this._isPhotoFinish(finishTimes));
    race.setValue('winner_name', nameAt(1));
    // places is already clamped to the entrant count, so these positions always exist.
    race.setValue('runner_up_name', plan.places >= 2 ? nameAt(2) : '');
    race.setValue('third_name', plan.places >= 3 ? nameAt(3) : '');
    race.setValue('run_by', gs.getUserID());
    if (plan.rematchOf) {
      race.setValue('rematch_of', plan.rematchOf);
    }
    const sysId = race.insert();
    return sysId ? String(sysId) : '';
  }

  /**
   * @description Inserts one entrant per squirrel, in lane order, each with its lane, finishing
   *   position, finish time and outfit already set.
   * @param {string} raceSysId - The race the entrants belong to.
   * @param {Object} plan - The validated plan; read only.
   * @param {number[]} finishOrder - finishOrder[position - 1] is the entry index at that place.
   * @param {number[]} laneOrder - laneOrder[lane - 1] is the entry index in that lane.
   * @param {number[]} finishTimes - Finish times by position.
   * @returns {boolean} true when every entrant saved; false at the first refused insert.
   * @throws {Error} When the platform throws during an insert.
   * @example
   *   const saved = this._insertEntrants(raceSysId, plan, finishOrder, laneOrder, finishTimes);
   * @since 2026-10-22
   */
  _insertEntrants(raceSysId, plan, finishOrder, laneOrder, finishTimes) {
    const positionOf = new Map();
    finishOrder.forEach((entryIndex, slot) => {
      positionOf.set(entryIndex, slot + 1);
    });
    for (let lane = 1; lane <= laneOrder.length; lane += 1) {
      const entryIndex = laneOrder[lane - 1];
      const entry = plan.entries[entryIndex];
      const position = positionOf.get(entryIndex);
      const entrant = new GlideRecord(this._const.TABLE.ENTRANT);
      entrant.initialize();
      entrant.setValue('race', raceSysId);
      entrant.setValue('name', entry.name);
      entrant.setValue('lane', lane);
      entrant.setValue('finish_position', position);
      entrant.setValue('finish_ms', finishTimes[position - 1]);
      entrant.setValue('outfit', entry.outfit);
      if (!entrant.insert()) {
        this._log('error', 'draw', `entrant insert refused | lane=${lane}`);
        return false;
      }
    }
    return true;
  }

  /**
   * @description Voids a race whose entrants did not all save, so a half-stored draw can never
   *   pass for a real race. This is the only update the engine ever makes, and only on failure.
   * @param {string} raceSysId - The race to void.
   * @returns {boolean} true when the race was voided.
   * @throws Never: a failure is logged.
   * @example
   *   this._voidFailedDraw(raceSysId);
   * @since 2026-10-22
   */
  _voidFailedDraw(raceSysId) {
    try {
      const race = this._findRace(raceSysId);
      if (!race) {
        return false;
      }
      race.setValue('state', this._const.STATE.VOID);
      race.setValue('void_reason', this._const.VOID_REASON_DRAW_FAILED);
      if (!race.update()) {
        const reason = race.getLastErrorMessage();
        this._log('error', 'draw', `could not void ${race.getValue('number')}: ${reason}`);
        return false;
      }
      this._log('warn', 'draw', `voided ${race.getValue('number')} after a failed draw`);
      return true;
    } catch (err) {
      this._log('error', 'draw', `void threw ${this._describe(err)}`);
      return false;
    }
  }

  /**
   * @description Builds the race payload from stored rows. draw() and getRace() both use it,
   *   which is what makes their payloads identical.
   * @param {GlideRecord} race - A race row, already read; read only.
   * @returns {Object} { race: { sysId, number, title, state, mode, chaosLevel, places,
   *   durationMs, seed, photoFinish, runBy, runOn, rematchOf }, entrants: [{ name, lane,
   *   position, finishMs, outfit }] } with entrants sorted by lane. chaosLevel is the stored
   *   level for a Chaos race and null for Classic.
   * @throws {Error} When the platform throws during the read.
   * @example
   *   const payload = this._buildPayload(race);
   * @since 2026-10-22
   */
  _buildPayload(race) {
    const raceSysId = race.getUniqueValue();
    return {
      race: {
        sysId: raceSysId,
        number: race.getValue('number') || '',
        title: race.getValue('title') || '',
        state: race.getValue('state') || '',
        mode: race.getValue('mode') || '',
        chaosLevel: this._chaosLevelOf(race),
        places: this._readInt(race.getValue('places_awarded')),
        durationMs: this._readInt(race.getValue('duration_ms')),
        seed: this._readInt(race.getValue('seed')),
        photoFinish: this._readFlag(race.getValue('photo_finish')),
        runBy: race.getDisplayValue('run_by') || '',
        runOn: race.getValue('sys_created_on') || '',
        // rematch_of has no cascade, so it can outlive its race: return it only while it resolves.
        rematchOf: this._existingRaceId(race.getValue('rematch_of')),
      },
      entrants: this._readEntrants(raceSysId),
    };
  }

  /**
   * @description Reads a race's entrants for the payload, sorted by lane.
   * @param {string} raceSysId - The race.
   * @returns {Object[]} [{ name, lane, position, finishMs, outfit }].
   * @throws {Error} When the platform throws during the read.
   * @example
   *   const entrants = this._readEntrants(raceSysId);
   * @since 2026-10-22
   */
  _readEntrants(raceSysId) {
    const entrants = [];
    const entrant = new GlideRecord(this._const.TABLE.ENTRANT);
    entrant.addQuery('race', raceSysId);
    entrant.orderBy('lane');
    entrant.setLimit(this._const.LIMITS.ENTRANTS_READ);
    entrant.query();
    while (entrant.next()) {
      entrants.push({
        name: entrant.getValue('name') || '',
        lane: this._readInt(entrant.getValue('lane')),
        position: this._readInt(entrant.getValue('finish_position')),
        finishMs: this._readInt(entrant.getValue('finish_ms')),
        outfit: this._parseOutfit(entrant.getValue('outfit')),
      });
    }
    // The database already sorts lanes numerically; sorting again keeps the contract explicit.
    return entrants.sort((first, second) => first.lane - second.lane);
  }

  /**
   * @description A race row as a history summary, without its names.
   * @param {GlideRecord} race - The current race row; read only.
   * @returns {Object} { sysId, number, title, state, mode, chaosLevel, places, entrantCount,
   *   durationMs, winner, runnerUp, third, runBy, runOn, rematchOf }. rematchOf is the stored
   *   value here; recentRaces() replaces it with null when that race no longer exists.
   * @throws Never.
   * @example
   *   rows.push(this._summarise(race));
   * @since 2026-10-22
   */
  _summarise(race) {
    return {
      sysId: race.getUniqueValue(),
      number: race.getValue('number') || '',
      title: race.getValue('title') || '',
      state: race.getValue('state') || '',
      mode: race.getValue('mode') || '',
      chaosLevel: this._chaosLevelOf(race),
      places: this._readInt(race.getValue('places_awarded')),
      entrantCount: this._readInt(race.getValue('entrant_count')),
      durationMs: this._readInt(race.getValue('duration_ms')),
      winner: race.getValue('winner_name') || '',
      runnerUp: race.getValue('runner_up_name') || '',
      third: race.getValue('third_name') || '',
      runBy: race.getDisplayValue('run_by') || '',
      runOn: race.getValue('sys_created_on') || '',
      rematchOf: race.getValue('rematch_of') || null,
    };
  }

  /**
   * @description The entrants' names for several races at once, in lane order, with one query.
   * @param {string[]} raceSysIds - The races; read only.
   * @returns {Map<string, string[]>} Race sys_id to names.
   * @throws {Error} When the platform throws during the read.
   * @example
   *   const namesByRace = this._namesByRace(['<race sys_id>']);
   * @since 2026-10-22
   */
  _namesByRace(raceSysIds) {
    const namesByRace = new Map();
    if (raceSysIds.length === 0) {
      return namesByRace;
    }
    const entrant = new GlideRecord(this._const.TABLE.ENTRANT);
    entrant.addQuery('race', 'IN', raceSysIds.join(','));
    entrant.orderBy('lane');
    entrant.setLimit(raceSysIds.length * this._const.LIMITS.ENTRANTS_READ);
    entrant.query();
    while (entrant.next()) {
      const raceSysId = entrant.getValue('race');
      const names = namesByRace.get(raceSysId) || [];
      namesByRace.set(raceSysId, names.concat([entrant.getValue('name') || '']));
    }
    return namesByRace;
  }

  /**
   * @description Reads a race by sys_id, refusing anything that cannot be a sys_id first so a
   *   free-text value never reaches the query.
   * @param {string} sysId - The candidate sys_id.
   * @returns {GlideRecord|null} The race row, or null.
   * @throws {Error} When the platform throws during the read.
   * @example
   *   const race = this._findRace(sysId);
   * @since 2026-10-22
   */
  _findRace(sysId) {
    if (!this._isSysId(sysId)) {
      return null;
    }
    const race = new GlideRecord(this._const.TABLE.RACE);
    return race.get('sys_id', String(sysId)) ? race : null;
  }

  /**
   * @description Reads the scoped properties, each with a safe default and a warning when it
   *   is missing or malformed.
   * @returns {Object} { maxEntrants, classicSeconds[], classicDefault, chaosSeconds[],
   *   chaosDefault, photoFinishChance }.
   * @throws Never.
   * @example
   *   this._config = this._readConfig();
   * @since 2026-10-22
   */
  _readConfig() {
    const prefix = this._const.PROPERTY_PREFIX;
    const defaults = this._const.DEFAULTS;
    const classicSeconds = this._readSecondsList(`${prefix}race_seconds`,
      defaults.CLASSIC_SECONDS);
    const chaosSeconds = this._readSecondsList(`${prefix}chaos_race_seconds`,
      defaults.CHAOS_SECONDS);
    return {
      maxEntrants: this._readWholeProperty(`${prefix}max_entrants`, defaults.MAX_ENTRANTS),
      classicSeconds,
      classicDefault: this._readDefaultSeconds(`${prefix}default_race_seconds`,
        defaults.CLASSIC_DEFAULT, classicSeconds),
      chaosSeconds,
      chaosDefault: this._readDefaultSeconds(`${prefix}default_chaos_race_seconds`,
        defaults.CHAOS_DEFAULT, chaosSeconds),
      photoFinishChance: this._readChanceProperty(`${prefix}photo_finish_chance`,
        defaults.PHOTO_FINISH_CHANCE),
    };
  }

  /**
   * @description Reads a whole-number property of 1 or more.
   * @param {string} name - The property name.
   * @param {number} fallback - Used, with a warning, when the value is missing or not valid.
   * @returns {number} The value.
   * @throws Never.
   * @example
   *   this._readWholeProperty('x_crli_squirrel.max_entrants', 50);
   * @since 2026-10-22
   */
  _readWholeProperty(name, fallback) {
    const value = this._toWholeNumber(String(gs.getProperty(name, String(fallback))));
    if (value === null || value < 1) {
      const warning = `${name} is not a whole number of 1 or more; using ${fallback}`;
      this._log('warn', '_readConfig', warning);
      return fallback;
    }
    return value;
  }

  /**
   * @description Reads a comma-separated list of race lengths in seconds.
   * @param {string} name - The property name.
   * @param {string} fallback - The default list, used with a warning when the value is invalid.
   * @returns {number[]} The allowed lengths.
   * @throws Never.
   * @example
   *   this._readSecondsList('x_crli_squirrel.race_seconds', '10,20,40'); // [10, 20, 40]
   * @since 2026-10-22
   */
  _readSecondsList(name, fallback) {
    const raw = String(gs.getProperty(name, fallback));
    const seconds = raw.split(',').map((part) => this._toWholeNumber(part.trim()));
    if (seconds.some((value) => value === null || value < 1)) {
      this._log('warn', '_readConfig', `${name} is not a list of whole seconds; using ${fallback}`);
      return fallback.split(',').map((part) => parseInt(part, 10));
    }
    return seconds;
  }

  /**
   * @description Reads a default race length, which must be one of the allowed lengths.
   * @param {string} name - The property name.
   * @param {number} fallback - The default length.
   * @param {number[]} allowed - The allowed lengths for the mode; read only.
   * @returns {number} The default, or the first allowed length (with a warning) when the
   *   configured default is not allowed.
   * @throws Never.
   * @example
   *   this._readDefaultSeconds('x_crli_squirrel.default_race_seconds', 20, [10, 20, 40]);
   * @since 2026-10-22
   */
  _readDefaultSeconds(name, fallback, allowed) {
    const value = this._readWholeProperty(name, fallback);
    if (allowed.indexOf(value) !== -1) {
      return value;
    }
    this._log('warn', '_readConfig', `${name} (${value}) is not allowed; using ${allowed[0]}`);
    return allowed[0];
  }

  /**
   * @description Reads a chance between 0 and 1.
   * @param {string} name - The property name.
   * @param {number} fallback - Used, with a warning, when the value is missing or not valid.
   * @returns {number} The chance.
   * @throws Never.
   * @example
   *   this._readChanceProperty('x_crli_squirrel.photo_finish_chance', 0.25);
   * @since 2026-10-22
   */
  _readChanceProperty(name, fallback) {
    const value = parseFloat(String(gs.getProperty(name, String(fallback))));
    if (Number.isNaN(value) || value < 0 || value > 1) {
      this._log('warn', '_readConfig', `${name} is not a chance from 0 to 1; using ${fallback}`);
      return fallback;
    }
    return value;
  }

  /**
   * @description Reads places: blank means the default of 2; otherwise a whole number 1 to 3.
   * @param {*} value - The places sent.
   * @returns {number|null} The places, or null when not valid.
   * @throws Never.
   * @example
   *   this._readPlaces(4); // null
   * @since 2026-10-22
   */
  _readPlaces(value) {
    if (this._isBlank(value)) {
      return this._const.DEFAULTS.PLACES;
    }
    const places = this._toWholeNumber(value);
    const limits = this._const.LIMITS;
    const valid = places !== null && places >= limits.PLACES_MIN && places <= limits.PLACES_MAX;
    return valid ? places : null;
  }

  /**
   * @description Reads the mode: blank means classic; otherwise classic or chaos (case and
   *   surrounding spaces ignored).
   * @param {*} value - The mode sent.
   * @returns {string|null} 'classic' or 'chaos', or null when not valid.
   * @throws Never.
   * @example
   *   this._readMode('turbo'); // null
   * @since 2026-10-22
   */
  _readMode(value) {
    if (this._isBlank(value)) {
      return this._const.MODE.CLASSIC;
    }
    if (typeof value !== 'string') {
      return null;
    }
    const mode = value.trim().toLowerCase();
    const modes = [this._const.MODE.CLASSIC, this._const.MODE.CHAOS];
    return modes.indexOf(mode) !== -1 ? mode : null;
  }

  /**
   * @description Reads the race length: blank means the mode's default; otherwise it must be
   *   one of the mode's allowed lengths.
   * @param {string} mode - 'classic' or 'chaos'.
   * @param {*} value - The raceSeconds sent.
   * @returns {number|null} The length in seconds, or null when not allowed.
   * @throws Never.
   * @example
   *   this._readSeconds('classic', 15); // null
   * @since 2026-10-22
   */
  _readSeconds(mode, value) {
    if (this._isBlank(value)) {
      return mode === this._const.MODE.CHAOS
        ? this._config.chaosDefault
        : this._config.classicDefault;
    }
    const seconds = this._toWholeNumber(value);
    return seconds !== null && this._allowedSeconds(mode).indexOf(seconds) !== -1
      ? seconds
      : null;
  }

  /**
   * @description Reads the chaos level. It counts only in Chaos mode, where blank means silly
   *   and anything else must be mild, silly or carnage (case and surrounding spaces ignored).
   *   In Classic mode the value sent is ignored and nothing is stored.
   * @param {string} mode - 'classic' or 'chaos'.
   * @param {*} value - The chaosLevel sent.
   * @returns {string|null} The level to store ('' for Classic), or null when not valid.
   * @throws Never.
   * @example
   *   this._readChaosLevel('chaos', 'turbo'); // null
   * @since 2026-10-22
   */
  _readChaosLevel(mode, value) {
    if (mode !== this._const.MODE.CHAOS) {
      return '';
    }
    if (this._isBlank(value)) {
      return this._const.DEFAULTS.CHAOS_LEVEL;
    }
    if (typeof value !== 'string') {
      return null;
    }
    const level = value.trim().toLowerCase();
    return this._const.CHAOS_LEVELS.indexOf(level) !== -1 ? level : null;
  }

  /**
   * @description A stored race's chaos level for a payload or summary: the stored level for a
   *   Chaos race, null for Classic (whatever the column holds) and null for a Chaos race with no
   *   level stored (one drawn before levels existed).
   * @param {GlideRecord} race - A race row, already read; read only.
   * @returns {string|null} 'mild', 'silly', 'carnage' or null.
   * @throws Never.
   * @example
   *   const chaosLevel = this._chaosLevelOf(race);
   * @since 2026-10-22
   */
  _chaosLevelOf(race) {
    if (race.getValue('mode') !== this._const.MODE.CHAOS) {
      return null;
    }
    return race.getValue('chaos_level') || null;
  }

  /**
   * @description The allowed race lengths for a mode.
   * @param {string} mode - 'classic' or 'chaos'.
   * @returns {number[]} The lengths in seconds.
   * @throws Never.
   * @example
   *   this._allowedSeconds('chaos'); // [45, 60, 90]
   * @since 2026-10-22
   */
  _allowedSeconds(mode) {
    return mode === this._const.MODE.CHAOS
      ? this._config.chaosSeconds
      : this._config.classicSeconds;
  }

  /**
   * @description Cleans the title like a name, defaults it, and fits it to the column, whose
   *   length is read from the dictionary so a widened column is used in full.
   * @param {*} value - The title sent.
   * @returns {string} The title to store.
   * @throws Never.
   * @example
   *   this._cleanTitle('  Friday   coffee '); // 'Friday coffee'
   * @since 2026-10-22
   */
  _cleanTitle(value) {
    const cleaned = this._cleanText(value);
    if (cleaned === '') {
      return this._const.DEFAULTS.TITLE;
    }
    const maxLength = this._fieldLength(this._const.TABLE.RACE, 'title',
      this._const.DEFAULTS.TITLE_LENGTH);
    return cleaned.substring(0, maxLength).trim();
  }

  /**
   * @description Reads rematchOf, which must name a race that still exists (a race can be
   *   deleted, and rematch_of does not cascade).
   * @param {*} value - The rematchOf sent.
   * @returns {string|null} '' when none was sent, the race's sys_id when it resolves, or null
   *   when it names no stored race (draw() then refuses with bad_rematch).
   * @throws {Error} When the platform throws during the read (draw() answers draw_failed).
   * @example
   *   this._readRematch(previousRaceSysId);
   * @since 2026-10-22
   */
  _readRematch(value) {
    if (this._isBlank(value)) {
      return '';
    }
    return this._existingRaceId(value);
  }

  /**
   * @description Resolves one race sys_id: the value itself while the race exists, else null.
   *   Used wherever a payload carries rematchOf, so a dangling reference reads as null.
   * @param {*} sysId - The candidate sys_id (blank or malformed reads as null).
   * @returns {string|null} The sys_id, or null.
   * @throws {Error} When the platform throws during the read.
   * @example
   *   this._existingRaceId(race.getValue('rematch_of'));
   * @since 2026-10-22
   */
  _existingRaceId(sysId) {
    if (!this._isSysId(sysId)) {
      return null;
    }
    const candidate = String(sysId);
    return this._existingRaceIds([candidate]).has(candidate) ? candidate : null;
  }

  /**
   * @description Which of several race sys_ids still exist, in one query.
   * @param {Array} sysIds - Candidate sys_ids; blanks and malformed values are ignored. Read only.
   * @returns {Set<string>} The sys_ids of races that exist.
   * @throws {Error} When the platform throws during the read.
   * @example
   *   const live = this._existingRaceIds(rows.map((row) => row.rematchOf));
   * @since 2026-10-22
   */
  _existingRaceIds(sysIds) {
    const existing = new Set();
    const candidates = sysIds
      .filter((sysId) => this._isSysId(sysId))
      .map((sysId) => String(sysId));
    if (candidates.length === 0) {
      return existing;
    }
    const race = new GlideRecord(this._const.TABLE.RACE);
    race.addQuery('sys_id', 'IN', candidates.join(','));
    race.setLimit(candidates.length);
    race.query();
    while (race.next()) {
      existing.add(race.getUniqueValue());
    }
    return existing;
  }

  /**
   * @description Cleans a name or other short text: tabs, line breaks and other spaces become
   *   one space; control, zero-width and text-direction characters are removed (they could
   *   make a name look different from what is stored); then runs of spaces collapse and the
   *   ends are trimmed.
   * @param {*} value - The text; anything other than a string or number reads as blank.
   * @returns {string} The cleaned text.
   * @throws Never.
   * @example
   *   this._cleanText('  Sam \t Smith '); // 'Sam Smith'
   * @since 2026-10-22
   */
  _cleanText(value) {
    if (typeof value !== 'string' && typeof value !== 'number') {
      return '';
    }
    const text = String(value);
    let kept = '';
    for (let index = 0; index < text.length; index += 1) {
      const code = text.charCodeAt(index);
      if (this._isSpaceCode(code)) {
        kept += ' ';
      } else if (!this._isHiddenCode(code)) {
        kept += text.charAt(index);
      }
    }
    // Splitting on single spaces and dropping the empty parts trims and collapses in one step.
    return kept.split(' ').filter((part) => part !== '').join(' ');
  }

  /**
   * @description Says whether a character code is a space of any kind.
   * @param {number} code - A UTF-16 code unit.
   * @returns {boolean} true for space, tab, line breaks, no-break and other Unicode spaces.
   * @throws Never.
   * @example
   *   this._isSpaceCode(9); // true (tab)
   * @since 2026-10-22
   */
  _isSpaceCode(code) {
    return code === 32 || (code >= 9 && code <= 13) || code === 160 || code === 5760
      || (code >= 8192 && code <= 8202) || code === 8232 || code === 8233 || code === 8239
      || code === 8287 || code === 12288;
  }

  /**
   * @description Says whether a character code is a control, zero-width or text-direction
   *   character.
   * @param {number} code - A UTF-16 code unit.
   * @returns {boolean} true for characters a name must not keep.
   * @throws Never.
   * @example
   *   this._isHiddenCode(8203); // true (zero-width space)
   * @since 2026-10-22
   */
  _isHiddenCode(code) {
    return code < 32 || (code >= 127 && code <= 159) || (code >= 8203 && code <= 8207)
      || (code >= 8234 && code <= 8238) || (code >= 8288 && code <= 8303) || code === 65279;
  }

  /**
   * @description Says whether an outfit value is allowed.
   * @param {*} value - The value.
   * @returns {boolean} true for 1 to 24 lower-case letters, digits or underscores.
   * @throws Never.
   * @example
   *   this._isOutfitValue('<script>'); // false
   * @since 2026-10-22
   */
  _isOutfitValue(value) {
    return typeof value === 'string' && this._const.OUTFIT_VALUE.test(value);
  }

  /**
   * @description Parses a stored outfit for the payload. A stored value that no longer passes
   *   the outfit check is shown as a plain squirrel rather than trusted.
   * @param {string|null} stored - The outfit column.
   * @returns {Object} The outfit object.
   * @throws Never.
   * @example
   *   this._parseOutfit('{"hat":"viking"}'); // { hat: 'viking' }
   * @since 2026-10-22
   */
  _parseOutfit(stored) {
    const json = this._cleanOutfit(stored);
    return typeof json === 'string' ? JSON.parse(json) : {};
  }

  /**
   * @description Draws one finishing gap for a position.
   * @param {number} position - 2 for the runner-up, 3 or more for the rest.
   * @returns {number} The gap behind the previous squirrel, in milliseconds.
   * @throws Never.
   * @example
   *   this._drawGap(2); // 40 to 140, or 200 to 900
   * @since 2026-10-22
   */
  _drawGap(position) {
    const timing = this._const.TIMING;
    if (position !== 2) {
      return this._randomBetween(timing.LATER_GAP_MIN, timing.LATER_GAP_MAX);
    }
    if (this._happens(this._config.photoFinishChance)) {
      return this._randomBetween(timing.PHOTO_GAP_MIN, timing.PHOTO_GAP_MAX);
    }
    return this._randomBetween(timing.RUNNER_UP_GAP_MIN, timing.RUNNER_UP_GAP_MAX);
  }

  /**
   * @description Says whether the first two finished within the photo-finish margin.
   * @param {number[]} finishTimes - Finish times by position; read only.
   * @returns {boolean} true when the runner-up finished within 150 ms of the winner.
   * @throws Never.
   * @example
   *   this._isPhotoFinish([20000, 20090]); // true
   * @since 2026-10-22
   */
  _isPhotoFinish(finishTimes) {
    return finishTimes.length > 1
      && finishTimes[1] - finishTimes[0] <= this._const.TIMING.PHOTO_FINISH_MS;
  }

  /**
   * @description A secure random whole number from 0 to bound - 1. Every random number the
   *   engine uses comes through here, from GlideSecureRandomUtil.
   * @param {number} bound - The exclusive upper bound, 1 or more.
   * @returns {number} The number.
   * @throws Never for a bound of 1 or more.
   * @example
   *   this._randomBelow(4); // 0, 1, 2 or 3
   * @since 2026-10-22
   */
  _randomBelow(bound) {
    return GlideSecureRandomUtil.getSecureRandomIntBound(bound);
  }

  /**
   * @description A secure random whole number in an inclusive range.
   * @param {number} lowest - The smallest value.
   * @param {number} highest - The largest value.
   * @returns {number} The number.
   * @throws Never.
   * @example
   *   this._randomBetween(40, 140);
   * @since 2026-10-22
   */
  _randomBetween(lowest, highest) {
    return lowest + this._randomBelow(highest - lowest + 1);
  }

  /**
   * @description Says whether an event with the given chance happens this time, to one part in
   *   a million.
   * @param {number} chance - 0 to 1.
   * @returns {boolean} true with probability chance.
   * @throws Never.
   * @example
   *   this._happens(0.25);
   * @since 2026-10-22
   */
  _happens(chance) {
    const scale = this._const.TIMING.CHANCE_SCALE;
    return this._randomBelow(scale) < Math.round(chance * scale);
  }

  /**
   * @description Clamps a list limit to 1 to 25, defaulting to 10.
   * @param {*} limit - The limit sent.
   * @returns {number} The limit to use.
   * @throws Never.
   * @example
   *   this._clampLimit('99'); // 25
   * @since 2026-10-22
   */
  _clampLimit(limit) {
    const parsed = parseInt(this.paramValue(limit), 10);
    if (Number.isNaN(parsed) || parsed < 1) {
      return this._const.DEFAULTS.LIST_LIMIT;
    }
    return Math.min(parsed, this._const.LIMITS.LIST_MAX);
  }

  /**
   * @description Reads a column's length from the dictionary, with a fallback.
   * @param {string} table - The table.
   * @param {string} field - The column.
   * @param {number} fallback - Used when the length cannot be read.
   * @returns {number} The length.
   * @throws Never.
   * @example
   *   this._fieldLength('x_crli_squirrel_race', 'title', 80);
   * @since 2026-10-22
   */
  _fieldLength(table, field, fallback) {
    try {
      const record = new GlideRecord(table);
      record.initialize();
      const element = record.getElement(field);
      if (element === null || element === undefined) {
        return fallback;
      }
      const length = parseInt(element.getED().getLength(), 10);
      return length > 0 ? length : fallback;
    } catch (err) {
      this._log('warn', '_fieldLength', `${table}.${field}: ${this._describe(err)}`);
      return fallback;
    }
  }

  /**
   * @description Turns a list-like value into an array.
   * @param {*} value - The value.
   * @returns {Array|null} The array, or null when the value is not a list.
   * @throws Never.
   * @example
   *   this._toList(['Alex']); // ['Alex']
   * @since 2026-10-22
   */
  _toList(value) {
    if (Array.isArray(value)) {
      return value;
    }
    if (value && typeof value === 'object' && typeof value.length === 'number') {
      return Array.from(value);
    }
    return null;
  }

  /**
   * @description Counts the items in a list-like value, for logging.
   * @param {*} value - The value.
   * @returns {number} The count; 0 when not a list.
   * @throws Never.
   * @example
   *   this._countOf(['Alex', 'Sam']); // 2
   * @since 2026-10-22
   */
  _countOf(value) {
    const list = this._toList(value);
    return list ? list.length : 0;
  }

  /**
   * @description Says whether a value was left out.
   * @param {*} value - The value.
   * @returns {boolean} true for undefined, null or a string of only spaces.
   * @throws Never.
   * @example
   *   this._isBlank('  '); // true
   * @since 2026-10-22
   */
  _isBlank(value) {
    return value === undefined || value === null
      || (typeof value === 'string' && value.trim() === '');
  }

  /**
   * @description Reads a whole number from a number or a string of digits.
   * @param {*} value - The value.
   * @returns {number|null} The number, or null when it is not a whole number.
   * @throws Never.
   * @example
   *   this._toWholeNumber('20'); // 20
   * @since 2026-10-22
   */
  _toWholeNumber(value) {
    if (typeof value === 'number') {
      return Number.isInteger(value) ? value : null;
    }
    if (typeof value === 'string' && this._const.WHOLE_NUMBER.test(value.trim())) {
      return parseInt(value.trim(), 10);
    }
    return null;
  }

  /**
   * @description Reads an integer column value.
   * @param {string|null} value - The stored value.
   * @returns {number} The number; 0 when empty.
   * @throws Never.
   * @example
   *   this._readInt('3'); // 3
   * @since 2026-10-22
   */
  _readInt(value) {
    const parsed = parseInt(value, 10);
    return Number.isNaN(parsed) ? 0 : parsed;
  }

  /**
   * @description Reads a True/False column value, which GlideRecord gives as '1' or '0'.
   * @param {string|null} value - The stored value.
   * @returns {boolean} The flag.
   * @throws Never.
   * @example
   *   this._readFlag('1'); // true
   * @since 2026-10-22
   */
  _readFlag(value) {
    return value === '1' || value === 'true';
  }

  /**
   * @description Compares two strings for sorting, with null before any string.
   * @param {string|null} left - The first value.
   * @param {string|null} right - The second value.
   * @returns {number} -1, 0 or 1.
   * @throws Never.
   * @example
   *   this._compareText('a', 'b'); // -1
   * @since 2026-10-22
   */
  _compareText(left, right) {
    if (left === right) {
      return 0;
    }
    if (left === null) {
      return -1;
    }
    if (right === null) {
      return 1;
    }
    return left < right ? -1 : 1;
  }

  /**
   * @description Says whether a value can be a sys_id.
   * @param {*} value - The value.
   * @returns {boolean} true for 32 lower-case hexadecimal characters.
   * @throws Never.
   * @example
   *   this._isSysId('not-a-sys-id'); // false
   * @since 2026-10-22
   */
  _isSysId(value) {
    return value !== undefined && value !== null && this._const.SYS_ID.test(String(value));
  }

  /**
   * @description A sys_id that is safe to log: the value itself, or 'invalid'.
   * @param {*} value - The value.
   * @returns {string} The loggable value.
   * @throws Never.
   * @example
   *   this._safeId('<script>'); // 'invalid'
   * @since 2026-10-22
   */
  _safeId(value) {
    return this._isSysId(value) ? String(value) : 'invalid';
  }

  /**
   * @description A sent value, cleaned and shortened, for an error's details.
   * @param {*} value - The value.
   * @returns {string} At most 40 characters.
   * @throws Never.
   * @example
   *   this._echo('turbo'); // 'turbo'
   * @since 2026-10-22
   */
  _echo(value) {
    return this._cleanText(value).substring(0, this._const.LIMITS.ECHO_LENGTH);
  }

  /**
   * @description Builds the shared error shape.
   * @param {string} code - The error code.
   * @param {string} message - A readable message.
   * @param {Array} details - Offending names or values; read only.
   * @returns {Object} { error: { code, message, details } }.
   * @throws Never.
   * @example
   *   this._error('no_names', 'Add at least one name.', []);
   * @since 2026-10-22
   */
  _error(code, message, details) {
    return { error: { code, message, details: details.map((item) => String(item)) } };
  }

  /**
   * @description A thrown value as text, for logs.
   * @param {*} err - The thrown value.
   * @returns {string} Its message.
   * @throws Never.
   * @example
   *   this._describe(new Error('boom')); // 'boom'
   * @since 2026-10-22
   */
  _describe(err) {
    return err && err.message ? String(err.message) : String(err);
  }

  /**
   * @description Writes one log line in the app's format: [SquirrelScramble][SquirrelRaceEngine]
   *   [LEVEL] method message. Names are never logged, only counts and codes.
   * @param {string} level - 'info', 'warn' or 'error'.
   * @param {string} method - The method writing the line.
   * @param {string} message - The message.
   * @returns {void}
   * @throws Never.
   * @example
   *   this._log('info', 'draw', 'ENTER | names=5');
   * @since 2026-10-22
   */
  _log(level, method, message) {
    const line = `${this._const.LOG_PREFIX}[${level.toUpperCase()}] ${method} ${message}`;
    if (level === 'error') {
      gs.error(line);
    } else if (level === 'warn') {
      gs.warn(line);
    } else {
      gs.info(line);
    }
  }
}

Scramble">6034db60bdae62650172468867a73546</source_aix_project><source_browser_code/><sourcemap>{"version":3,"file":"api-D8FYFioh.js","sources":["../../../lib/theme-config.js","../../../lib/outfits.js","../../../lib/api.js"],"sourcesContent":["/**\n * The one theme object for Squirrel Scramble (SPEC.md § 12). Data only: no functions, no DOM.\n *\n * Everything that makes the race a squirrel race lives here: timings, race lengths, the\n * choreography and Chaos constants, the outfit catalogue and rarities, the lane palette, the\n * crowd, the skies and the commentary phrase bank. A duck theme is a copy of this file with the\n * nouns, outfits, phrases and colours changed; the logic modules read whatever object they are\n * given and default to this one.\n *\n * Treat it as read-only at run time: a replay is only identical if the constants are.\n * Phrase texts are plain strings with {name} and {other} placeholders. The component layer\n * translates them; the i18n lint rule only extracts literal getMessage() arguments, so it needs\n * a literal catalogue keyed by the phrase keys below.\n */\nexport const themeConfig = {\n id: 'squirrel',\n name: 'Squirrel Scramble',\n racerNoun: {singular: 'squirrel', plural: 'squirrels'},\n\n timings: {\n // One choreography step (SPEC.md § 11.2). Every entrant's ticks sit on this grid.\n tickMs: 250,\n // \"3-2-1, go\": three steps of one second each before the clock starts.\n countdownFrom: 3,\n countdownStepMs: 1000,\n // Switch to the result view this long after the last awarded place finishes (§ 11.12).\n handOffMs: 1500,\n // At most one new commentary line this often (§ 8 race view).\n commentaryGapMs: 1500,\n // A new leader must stay in front this long before it counts (§ 11.11).\n leaderHoldMs: 500,\n // CSS-only confetti: this many pieces, removed after this long (§ 8 result view).\n confettiMs: 4000,\n confettiPieces: 60,\n // The first two finishers within this gap make a photo finish (§ 5, Race.photo_finish).\n photoFinishThresholdMs: 150,\n // \"Final stretch!\" at this share of the race (§ 11.11).\n finalStretchFraction: 0.75\n },\n\n race: {\n // Client-side default only; the server's x_crli_squirrel.max_entrants property wins.\n maxEntrants: 50,\n maxNameLength: 40,\n // Bib labels truncate to this many characters, ellipsis included (§ 8 race view).\n labelMaxChars: 14,\n // Labels rotate 45 degrees when a lane is narrower than this (§ 8 race view).\n rotateLabelsBelowPx: 90,\n defaultPlaces: 2,\n maxPlaces: 3,\n // Client default; the server's x_crli_squirrel.photo_finish_chance property wins.\n photoFinishChance: 0.25,\n lengths: {\n classic: [\n {seconds: 10, label: 'Quick'},\n {seconds: 20, label: 'Standard'},\n {seconds: 40, label: 'Epic'}\n ],\n // Renamed in Chaos v2 (contract § 1) so no length shares a name with a level.\n chaos: [\n {seconds: 45, label: 'Short'},\n {seconds: 60, label: 'Proper'},\n {seconds: 90, label: 'Marathon'}\n ]\n },\n defaultSeconds: {classic: 20, chaos: 60},\n // Scale bands (§ 8 scale): flat labels and full outfits up to 12 entrants, rotated labels\n // and hat-and-fur outfits from 13, compact 30 px lanes from 31.\n scale: {flatLabelsUpTo: 12, simplifiedOutfitsFrom: 13, compactLanesFrom: 31}\n },\n\n // The server's finish-time rules (SPEC.md § 7, draw step 7), mirrored for simulate().\n serverTiming: {\n photoGapMs: {min: 40, max: 140},\n runnerUpGapMs: {min: 200, max: 900},\n laterGapMs: {min: 150, max: 700},\n // If the total spread exceeds this share of the race, every gap is scaled down.\n maxSpreadFraction: 0.5\n },\n\n choreography: {\n // Base climb per tick, in climb units, drawn uniformly (§ 11.3).\n paceMin: 0.5,\n paceMax: 1.5,\n // The average base climb. Chaos drops and lifts are sized against an entrant's expected\n // total climb, tickCount x paceMean, so \"5 height units\" means about 5% of the tree.\n paceMean: 1,\n // Form curve: 1 + formAmplitude x sin(2 pi x frequency x tick / tickCount + phase).\n // SPEC.md § 11.3 suggests 0.35. Tuned to 0.6: at 0.35 a variance estimate put the eventual\n // winner in front at the 25% mark in about 22% of 8-entrant Classic races (10 s races are\n // the worst, because the finishing spread is a larger share of a short race), too close to\n // the M8 limit of 25%. At 0.6 the estimate is about 17%. The lowest multiplier is 0.4, so a\n // fading squirrel still climbs.\n formAmplitude: 0.6,\n formFrequencyMin: 0.5,\n formFrequencyMax: 1.5,\n // Height ceiling before an entrant's final tick (§ 11.8): nobody touches the chestnut early.\n preFinishCeiling: 98,\n // No event in the last 10% of an entrant's ticks (§ 10, § 11.4). Whole percent, so the tick\n // limit is exact integer arithmetic.\n eventFreeTailPercent: 10,\n // No event before this tick, so \"Go!\" is clean.\n earliestEventTick: 2,\n // An entrant stalls for at most 40% of its ticks (§ 10). Whole percent, as above.\n maxStallPercent: 40,\n // Random start ticks an event tries before it is dropped (spans may not overlap).\n placementAttempts: 6,\n // Keyframe heights are rounded to this many decimals, which keeps plans compact.\n heightDecimals: 4\n },\n\n // Classic events (§ 11.4). Each entrant rolls each event once, in this order.\n classicEvents: {\n nutStop: {chance: 0.35, minTicks: 2, maxTicks: 4},\n // One tick of minus 2 to 4 times the mean climb, then a tick to recover (no effect).\n slip: {chance: 0.25, minMeanClimbs: 2, maxMeanClimbs: 4, recoveryTicks: 1},\n burst: {chance: 0.3, ticks: 3, paceMultiplier: 2.2}\n },\n\n // The Chaos deck (SPEC.md § 10, Chaos v2 contract § 4): the shape of each event. How often each\n // one happens is the level's business (chaosLevels below).\n chaosDeck: {\n // Per-squirrel chances (the suitor) halve above 30 entrants.\n crowdedFieldAbove: 30,\n crowdedChanceFactor: 0.5,\n // Random start ticks (and targets) an ordinary event tries before it is dropped.\n placementAttempts: 8,\n // Attempts for the guaranteed moments: the \"every squirrel\" pass, and each finale slot.\n coverageAttempts: 12,\n finaleSlotAttempts: 4,\n // Event starts follow this curve (contract § 1): [share of the race, relative weight],\n // linear in between. Calm for the first 15%, building, a plateau from 55% to 75%, then\n // fading into the quiet zone (the last 10% of each squirrel's ticks never moves).\n intensity: {\n points: [[0, 0.03], [0.15, 0.08], [0.55, 1], [0.75, 1], [0.9, 0.15], [1, 0]]\n },\n tornado: {\n minEntrants: 3,\n // Starts between 25% and 70% of the race (whole percent, exact integer arithmetic).\n earliestPercent: 25,\n latestPercent: 70,\n minLifted: 2,\n maxLifted: 4,\n // The funnel crosses the stage in this long; flight ticks count as stalled.\n flightMs: 2500,\n minDropUnits: 5,\n maxDropUnits: 15,\n dizzyTicks: 2,\n // A second tornado starts at least this long after the first has landed.\n spacingMs: 1000\n },\n hunter: {\n hitChance: 0.7,\n // A hit knocks off 20% to 40% of the squirrel's running climb total.\n minFallFraction: 0.2,\n maxFallFraction: 0.4,\n minStunTicks: 2,\n maxStunTicks: 3,\n // A miss has no effect on the climb; this many ticks are kept clear for the animation.\n missTicks: 4\n },\n suitor: {\n // At most a third of the field (integer division by fieldDivisor).\n fieldDivisor: 3,\n slapChance: 0.25,\n minKissTicks: 3,\n maxKissTicks: 6,\n slapTicks: 2\n },\n eagle: {minLiftUnits: 10, maxLiftUnits: 20, carryTicks: 3},\n beaver: {stallTicks: 2},\n // A 90 s race rolls for a second strike.\n lightning: {stallTicks: 2, secondStrikeFromMs: 90000},\n // Each cat clings for 2 to 4 ticks and slows its squirrel to 40% pace.\n catLady: {\n minThrows: 2,\n maxThrows: 4,\n throwGapTicks: 2,\n minClingTicks: 2,\n maxClingTicks: 4,\n clingPace: 0.4\n },\n // Checked every 2.5 s from 20% to 88% of the race; at most one every 10 s. The lead\n // threshold is the level's.\n goldenAcorn: {\n checkpointMs: 2500,\n fromPercent: 20,\n toPercent: 88,\n minFallFraction: 0.2,\n maxFallFraction: 0.3,\n dizzyTicks: 2,\n minGapMs: 10000\n },\n // A field event that stalls everyone needs at least half the field free to join in.\n leafBlower: {\n minClingTicks: 2,\n maxClingTicks: 3,\n minHatLoss: 1,\n maxHatLoss: 2,\n minFieldPercent: 50\n },\n ufo: {beamTicks: 6, dazedTicks: 2},\n earthquake: {shakeTicks: 6, minSlips: 2, maxSlips: 4, minSlipUnits: 5, maxSlipUnits: 15},\n // The water rises over 2 ticks; squirrels still below it then get a 3-tick burst.\n flood: {\n durationTicks: 8,\n burstDelayTicks: 2,\n burstTicks: 3,\n burstMultiplier: 2.2,\n minWaterUnits: 15,\n maxWaterUnits: 25\n },\n // \"Every squirrel stalls 2 s to dance\" (contract § 4).\n disco: {durationTicks: 8, minFieldPercent: 50},\n acornHail: {\n hailTicks: 6,\n minChubby: 2,\n maxChubby: 4,\n minSlowTicks: 3,\n maxSlowTicks: 5,\n slowPace: 0.6\n },\n // \"A 1.5 s stall for all\" (contract § 4).\n var: {stallTicks: 6, minFieldPercent: 50},\n trenchCoat: {maxHeightGapUnits: 15, minDisguiseTicks: 3, maxDisguiseTicks: 5, dazedTicks: 1},\n woodpecker: {stallTicks: 3},\n // Late events (the Golden Acorn, the trench coat, flood bursts) leave every height before\n // them unchanged; this compensation reshapes the squirrel's later free ticks, within these\n // bounds, so it still reaches the top exactly on time.
